title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
At Weheat, we are building the next generation of heat pumps: cleaner, smarter, and affordable for as many households as possible. From our high-tech facilities in Duizel (Eindhoven region), we develop, test, and manufacture our own heat pumps—from initial concept to scalable production.



Weet u niet zeker welke vaardigheden u nodig heeft voor deze functie? Lees dan de volledige omschrijving hieronder voor een compleet beeld van de kandidaatseisen.

In Duizel, everything comes together: engineering, prototyping, testing, and production. You work here daily with other engineers, close to the hardware and real-world application. We work closely with our hub in Utrecht, but strongly believe in on-site collaboration when it comes to complex technology. Our culture is down-to-earth and ambitious, with a strong sense of ownership, short lines of communication, and a clear focus on progress.


Weheat is re-engineering the heat pump from the printed circuit board up, making home heating cleaner, smarter, and affordable. From our facilities in the Eindhoven region and our hub in the center of Utrecht, we design, build, and continuously improve our own heat pumps. Our culture is down-to-earth and ambitious: we value data over opinion, rigorous engineering over quick fixes, and progress over process.


Every Weheat heat pump in the field generates high-frequency telemetry, performance data, energy usage, system behavior. Our software layer, Weheat Intelligence, uses this data to optimize for the cheapest energy moments, turn the home into a thermal battery, and learn how each house heats and cools. As our fleet grows, so does the need for a reliable, well-structured data platform underneath it all. That platform is your domain.


Your Mission

You design, build, and evolve the data platform that powers Weheat. You bring structure, reliability, and clarity to a data landscape that spans heat pump telemetry, energy optimization, fleet analytics, and business intelligence. Your work is the backbone every engineer, analyst, and product team builds on.


But building the platform is only half the job. We believe a good data engineer doesn't just move data from A to B, you also know what to measure, how to measure it correctly, and when a number is telling the wrong story. You're the person who checks whether the mean is misleading, whether the right outliers are included, and whether the time window actually supports the conclusion.


The Challenge

  • Full-Scope Data Platform: Architect and manage the platform that connects heat pump telemetry with business domains like sales, support, and operations, using Databricks and modern data tooling
  • High-Throughput Telemetry: Build and maintain real-time and batch pipelines that process high-volume heat pump telemetry, including streaming algorithms for live health monitoring, anomaly detection, and fleet-wide diagnostics.
  • Scalable Architecture: CDesign storage layers and governance that serve diverse consumers from data scientists to business teams, each with different latency and shape requirements
  • AI-Ready Infrastructure: Structure the data platform with the semantic clarity, metadata, and tooling readiness that enables AI-driven analytics, so that as the technology matures, Weheat is ready to adopt it, not retrofit for it
  • Analytical Judgment: Turn raw data into trustworthy metrics and actionable insights, choosing the right statistical methods, challenging assumptions, and making complex findings clear for every stakeholder
  • Team & Leadership: Be the voice that sets the standard for how Weheat thinks about data, mentor a growing team, shape the roadmap, and build a culture where every decision starts with the right number

About Weheat

Weheat is re-engineering the heat pump from the printed circuit board up. Based in our Smart Factory in Eindhoven and our Commercial & Digital Hub in Utrecht, we combine high-tech hardware with intelligent software to accelerate the energy transition. We operate with a flat structure and a focus on scientific first principles: we value data over opinion and rigorous engineering over quick fixes.


What we offer

  • The opportunity to work on complex, physical problems with direct societal impact (CO2 reduction/Grid Stability).
  • A collaborative environment with a high density of technical talent (MSc/PhD level).
  • Autonomy to define the technical roadmap within your domain. xgiwjmb
  • Competitive compensation and the opportunity to grow with a future European market leader.

Your Profile

  • Strong background in data engineering and distributed data systems
  • Experience designing and building data platforms that serve multiple domains and stakeholders, not just a single use case
  • Skilled in reliable ETL/ELT, data lakes, or data warehouses at scale
  • Experience with time-series pipelines, streaming, or IoT-scale architectures
  • Strong communicator who can work across engineering, operations, sales, and finance without losing technical depth
  • Proactive mindset: you think ahead and build for scale, reliability, and clarity
  • Bonus: experience in energy, manufacturing, telemetry, or embedded/real-time systems

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
A Plant Reliability Engineer is responsible for ensuring the continuous, efficient, and safe operation of plant equipment and systems. They develop and implement strategies to minimize unplanned downtime, extend asset life, and improve overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

Key Responsibilities

  • Reliability Strategy Development: Design and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to reduce equipment failures and unplanned downtime.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Lead investigations into equipment failures and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Asset Management: Monitor and analyze equipment performance data to identify trends and prioritize maintenance activities.
  • Maintenance Planning: Collaborate with maintenance and operations teams to schedule and optimize maintenance activities.
  • Continuous Improvement: Drive reliability improvement initiatives using methodologies such as RCM (Reliability-Centered Maintenance), FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), and Six Sigma.
  • Capital Projects Support: Provide reliability input during the design and commissioning of new equipment or plant modifications.
  • KPI Tracking: Monitor key reliability metrics such as MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures), MTTR (Mean Time to Repair), and equipment availability.
  • Training & Mentoring: Support and train maintenance technicians and operators on reliability best practices.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (or related field).
  • Experience: 3–7 years of experience in a manufacturing or process plant environment.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in CMMS, vibration analysis, thermography, lubrication management, and other predictive maintenance tools.
  • Certifications (preferred): Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE), CMRP (Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional).
  • Soft Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills; ability to work cross-functionally.

The base salary for this position is between $110,000 to $130,000.

title: Scada data engineer
description:
Draag bij aan de (elektriciteits)netwerken voor de energietransitie.



Ligt uw cv klaar? Zo ja, en bent u ervan overtuigd dat dit de functie voor u is, zorg er dan voor dat u zo snel mogelijk solliciteert.
Wat ga je doen?

Met jouw energie kan het



  • Aan de slag met unieke systemen die bij Enexis de bedrijfsvoering van vandaag én de toekomst ondersteunen.
  • Bijdragen aan (elektriciteits)netwerken die vloeiend aansluiten op de bronnen voor de energietransitie.
  • Zorgen dat de software- en netwerkbeveiliging aan de hoogste eisen voldoen.

Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan


Als SCADA data engineering bij de afdeling Operationele Techniek (OT) in Weert krijg je alle kansen om te leren en door te groeien in een uitdagende omgeving. Jij zorgt samen met je collega’s voor de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van de operationele techniek. Die techniek is onmisbaar voor je collega’s van de afdeling Bedrijfsvoering die de middenspanningsnetten van Enexis 24/7 besturen en bewaken. En waardevol voor alle afdelingen die onze stroomnetten futureproof maken. De afdeling OT bestaat uit verschillende werkstromen. Binnen de werkstroom OT Automatisering ga je aan de slag in één van de agile-teams die verantwoordelijk is voor het configureren, implementeren en optimaliseren van de data in het SCADA-systeem.


Dit zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden:



  • Configureren, implementeren, optimaliseren en beheren van de data in het SCADA-systeem van Enexis.
  • Uitvoeren van testen van nieuw gebouwde stations- en distributieautomatisering en testen van nieuwe functionaliteiten.
  • Opstellen, reviseren en/of controleren van functionele en technische documentatie.
  • Verhelpen van storingen die doorkomen vanuit foutieve data in het SCADA-systeem.
  • Verlenen van advies omtrent SCADA- en controle-aangelegenheden, bijvoorbeeld aan projectleiders of technisch specialisten.
  • Deelnemen aan ontwerp-, veiligheids- en voortgangsoverleggen.
  • Op dit moment zoeken we in Weert versterking. Je hebt in het team zowel collega’s in Zwolle als Weert.
  • Wij geven je een goede start met een SCADA-basisopleiding en daarna gerichte trainingen.

Functie-eisen

Zo pak jij het aan


Eigenaarschap nemen voor jouw aandachtsgebied èn de operationele techniek, daar draait het om bij de afdeling OT. Daarom zoek jij makkelijk de samenwerking met je collega’s. Je neemt graag het initiatief en komt met oplossingen voor vraagstukken of verbetervoorstellen voor processen. Bij al je werkzaamheden heb je oog voor de wensen en behoeften van onze interne klanten. Je bent bereidheid om ook buiten kantoortijden paraat te staan, we werken immers in een 24/7-dienstverlenende afdeling binnen Enexis Netbeheer. Verder heb je:



  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau met een opleiding in een elektrotechnische of ICT-richting (bijvoorbeeld technische informatica, mechatronica).
  • Affiniteit met het aandachtsgebied operationele techniek/SCADA.
  • Affiniteit met data.
  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands.
  • Kennis en ervaring met agile werken (SAFe-methodiek) is een pré.

Team & cultuur

Je zet je schouders eronder met


Ruim 130 collega’s verdeeld over de regio’s Noord en Zuid van de afdeling Operationele Techniek (OT) binnen het bedrijfsonderdeel Netwerk Perfomance Management (NPM). Een divers team van beginnende en senior OT-specialisten met een groot wij-gevoel. Allemaal staan we voor elkaar klaar. De jongeren helpen de oudere garde met de snelle veranderingen, en de senior collega’s helpen de beginners met hun opleiding. Samen nemen we de verantwoording voor de hele operationele techniek. Omdat de beveiliging van onze netten en informatie superbelangrijk is, werken we voornamelijk op kantoor.


Wat krijg je van ons?

En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou


Bij Enexis werk je in de voorhoede van een van de grootste uitdagingen van onze tijd: de energietransitie. Daarbij zorgen we goed voor je. En met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden:



  • Bijdrage van 70% aan je ABP Keuzepensioen.
  • Persoonlijk budget van 10% en een 13e maand van 10,7% van je bruto jaarsalaris. Deze kun je flexibel inzetten of maandelijks of jaarlijks laten uitbetalen.
  • 24,5 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband. Meer oplaadtijd nodig? Met je persoonlijk budget en 13e maand koop je tot wel 35,5 extra verlofdagen.
  • Een door ons ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een vergoeding van € 2,45 per dag.
  • Laptop of tablet en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding en een eersteklas ov-abonnement voor zakelijk gebruik.
  • Vitaliteitsbudget van € 700,- voor bijvoorbeeld een sportabonnement.
  • Ruimte om te groeien met ons interne ontwikkelplatform of externe opleidingen en trainingen. xgiwjmb

title: Research Scientist/Engineer 3 - Climate Impacts Group
description:
Job Description

The UW Climate Impacts Group has an outstanding opportunity for a Research Scientist 3 to join its growing team.

About this Opportunity

Reporting to a senior scientist, the Climate Impacts Group Research Scientist 3 will independently lead tasks within and support management of moderately sized applied climate resilience and water management projects. This position will play a critical role in advancing climate resilience for the Pacific Northwest and requires advanced analytical skills using spatial and quantitative analysis methods and mixed methods research approaches, as well as a highly collaborative mindset.

This is a research position with no teaching requirements and no path to university tenure. This position is focused on applied research which may come at the expense of published research.

This is a hybrid eligible position with expectations to work in person at the UW Seattle campus at least two days per week, with additional on-site requirements for meetings and events. Our current in-office days are Mondays and Wednesdays. A telework agreement is completed annually with your supervisor.

Key Responsibilities

Research [50%]

  • Independently lead tasks and support management of moderately sized applied climate resilience and water management projects;
  • Evaluate the benefits, tradeoffs, uncertainties, and implementation considerations of water management and/or climate adaptation strategies to support evidence-based planning and decision making;
  • Apply spatial and quantitative analysis methods to analyze, integrate, and communicate complex social and environmental data using R, Python, GIS, or related tools;
  • Apply mixed-methods research approaches to holistically evaluate complex environmental management and climate resilience challenges (e.g., semi-structured interviews, surveys, literature reviews, policy analysis, case studies, spatial analysis).

Project Management [25%]

  • Lead or co-lead project-specific research activities, such as literature reviews, contextual analyses, needs assessments, monitoring and evaluation strategies, and development of technical guidance, as part of larger projects;
  • Develop and manage timelines and coordinate on assigned project tasks while contributing to broader project management activities;
  • Co-design and facilitate workshops, interviews, advisory committee meetings, and other engagement activities with project partners;
  • Supervise and mentor junior staff, interns, and/or graduate student workers;
  • Contribute to maintaining high-quality project deliverables through effective coordination, documentation, and communication with internal and external collaborators.

Partnerships and External Engagement [15%]

  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with Pacific Northwest water managers and utilities, local government agencies, Tribes, non-profit organizations, and research collaborators to advance climate adaptation planning and implementation;
  • Develop technical guidance, decision support resources, reports, visualizations, and presentations for practitioner, scientific, and public audiences;
  • Represent the Climate Impacts Group through participation in project advisory groups, collaborative initiatives, and professional meetings;
  • Respond to emerging partner needs and contribute to identifying opportunities for future applied research and decision-support resources.

Grant Writing and Proposal Development [5%]

  • Collaborate with Climate Impacts Group research scientists and principal investigators to support development of competitive proposals for externally funded research and applied projects;
  • Contribute technical expertise to support proposal development efforts, including scoping and drafting relevant sections, coordination with project collaborators, and related activities;
  • Help identify emerging research opportunities and cultivate relationships with external collaborators.

Other duties as assigned in service of the Climate Impacts Group mission [5%]

  • Support special projects, strategic initiatives and timely responses to partner and UW needs.

Required Qualifications

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager.

  • Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, hydrology or engineering, natural resources, planning, geography, public policy, economics, or a related field
  • A minimum of 4 years of experience managing climate resilience and/or water management projects
  • Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

Additional Qualifications

  • Familiarity with water resources management, watershed planning, environmental management, or related fields, including familiarity with climate impacts on water systems and adaptation strategies;
  • Experience collaborating with state and local government agencies, utilities, Tribes, watershed organizations, community-based organizations, and/or practitioners;
  • Strong analytical skills, including familiarity with mixed-methods approaches and the application of spatial and quantitative analysis methods to analyze, integrate, and communicate complex social and/or environmental data using R, Python, GIS, or related tools; and
  • Superior writing and oral communication skills, including demonstrated ability to communicate complex scientific information clearly and concisely for technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree and/or experience working on applied water resources projects involving water supply, watershed management, stormwater, nature based solutions, water quality, water reuse, or related topics;
  • Experience developing climate change impacts and adaptation guidance and/or decision-support tools;
  • Experience working with environmental, climate, hydrologic, or other complex datasets;
  • Experience with applied social science research methods such as interviews, case studies, literature reviews, policy evaluation, and/or related qualitative and quantitative approaches;
  • Experience with co-production and use-inspired research;
  • Experience facilitating meetings and collaboration among researchers, practitioners, decision makers;
  • Knowledge of climate adaptation planning and implementation in the Pacific Northwest;
  • Attention to detail and demonstrated commitment to technical accuracy and reproducibility;
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively and build strong collaborative relationships within interdisciplinary teams (spanning physical science, engineering, policy and social science), and within hybrid and geographically distributed teams.

Working Conditions

Occasional travel may be required across the UW Seattle campus and to partner sites across the states of Washington, Oregon, and Idaho.

About the Team

The University of Washington Climate Impacts Group (CIG) supports the development of climate resilience by advancing understanding of climate risks & enabling science-based action to manage those risks. Since 1995, the Climate Impacts Group has linked cutting-edge scientific research with innovative approaches to community engagement to produce exceptional research products, develop strong relationships among resource managers, planners, and policy makers in the region and build regional capacity for addressing climate variability and change. The Climate Impacts Group sits within EarthLab, in the UW College of Environment.

title: Senior Director, Information Design and Graphics
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

About the Practice

Visual Communications Consulting (VCC) sits inside Disputes & Economics and serves every practice on the Ankura map. We are one bench with three doors. Trial Studio delivers courtroom-grade demonstratives, scientific illustration, 2D and 3D animation, jury research, courtroom technology, and opening and closing presentations built shoulder to shoulder with counsel. Creative Comms carries transformation narratives, executive and board storytelling, crisis and litigation communications, and employee campaigns. Net New Creative is the multiplier: AI-augmented production, analytics storytelling, interactive exhibits, explainability design for models and data, and a content engine that runs across social, video, web, and events, all operating inside the firm's secure AI environment. The overlaps are the offer. Every practice at Ankura produces analysis that must persuade someone; VCC exists to bring those stories to life. We are expanding from a regional trial-services practice into a national and, in time, global one, and we are hiring the leaders who will build it.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director who does one thing better than almost anyone: takes dense, technical, high-stakes material and turns it into visuals that a judge, a juror, a board, or a regulator can follow and believe. This is a senior craft and leadership role at the center of the practice, with a particular mandate in healthcare and life sciences, where Ankura's medical device, pharmaceutical, hospital, and health policy work produces exactly the kind of clinical, scientific, and regulatory content that needs a designer who has lived inside it.

You will lead information design and graphics across Trial Studio and Creative Comms: demonstratives and trial presentations, scientific and mechanism illustration, infographics, presentation systems, proposal and pursuit templates, and brand governance for the practice's output. You will build and manage the template and asset systems that let a national practice deliver consistent, courtroom-grade work from any city, and you will mentor a growing bench of designers as the practice scales. New York places you in the first wave of our regional expansion and close to the Am Law 100 firms and corporate legal departments that drive our trial pipeline.

What You Will Do

  • Design and direct courtroom demonstratives, trial presentations, and hearing graphics that translate clinical data, scientific mechanisms, financial analysis, and technical evidence into clear, persuasive visuals in partnership with counsel and testifying experts.

  • Lead information design for healthcare and life sciences matters: mechanism-of-action diagrams, study designs, regulatory pathways, device and procedure illustration, and data visualization built to withstand cross-examination.

  • Own the practice's presentation systems, proposal and RFP templates, and brand standards, ensuring that work produced across regional pods and the core studio meets a single quality bar.

  • Design executive, board, and investor presentations, infographics, and digital and print collateral for Creative Comms engagements and for Ankura practices that engage VCC on their client work.

  • Manage design production on multiple concurrent matters: scoping, scheduling, vendor and freelance coordination, budget tracking, and quality control against tight trial and hearing deadlines.

  • Integrate AI-assisted design and production tools into the studio workflow inside the firm's secure AI environment, and help set the standards for where they are used and where they are not.

  • Mentor designers and trial technicians, lead critiques, and contribute to hiring and upskilling as the bench grows.

  • Support the New York regional pod and pursuit activity with local law firms and corporate clients alongside the practice lead and Ankura Disputes & Economics leadership.

What You Bring

  • Twelve or more years in information design, presentation design, or graphic design, including senior roles where you led design for a professional services firm, a life sciences or healthcare company, or a litigation graphics practice.

  • A portfolio that shows complex-to-clear translation: scientific, clinical, financial, or technical content rendered for non-expert decision makers. Healthcare and life sciences depth is strongly preferred.

  • Experience building and governing template systems, brand standards, and reusable asset libraries for a distributed organization.

  • Expert-level command of Microsoft PowerPoint and Adobe Creative Cloud, with working knowledge of motion, interactive, or 3D tools and current AI-assisted design platforms.

  • A record of leading website, brand, or presentation redesigns, managing vendors and budgets, and mentoring junior designers.

  • Calm under deadline and comfortable working directly with attorneys, experts, and executives; trial or hearing experience is a strong plus.

  • Bachelor of Fine Arts or equivalent in visual communications, graphic design, or a related field.

The Heterogeneous Integration Group (HIG) HBM Architecture team develops next-generation High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) solutions that power AI, high-performance computing, cloud infrastructure, and advanced networking systems. The team works across architecture, design, verification, packaging, product engineering, and technology development to evaluate innovative memory architectures and deliver scalable, high-performance semiconductor solutions.

Position Overview

As an HBM Design Architect, New College Graduate, you will contribute to the evaluation and development of future HBM and DRAM architectures. Working with experienced architects and engineering teams, you will analyze system and block-level design tradeoffs related to performance, power, area, thermal behavior, reliability, and manufacturability. This role provides an opportunity to leverage AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and data-driven engineering methodologies to accelerate architecture exploration and improve decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze HBM and DRAM architectures using analytical models, simulations, silicon data, and AI-assisted techniques to evaluate timing, bandwidth, power, area, thermal performance, reliability, and design complexity.
  • Develop and apply modeling, simulation, and data-analysis methodologies to assess alternative architectural approaches, identify design sensitivities, and support technology pathfinding.
  • Collaborate with architecture, circuit design, layout, packaging, product, and system teams to evaluate implementation feasibility, performance tradeoffs, signal integrity, power delivery, and manufacturability considerations.
  • Perform root-cause analysis using simulation and measured data to improve model accuracy, validate assumptions, and provide evidence-based design recommendations.
  • Communicate technical findings through presentations, design reviews, architecture discussions, and written documentation, clearly articulating assumptions, risks, and recommended actions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field completed prior to the employment start date.
  • Strong foundation in at least two of the following areas: CMOS circuits, digital or mixed-signal design, semiconductor devices, computer architecture, memory systems, thermal sciences, signal integrity, power delivery, or advanced packaging.
  • Experience developing engineering models, simulations, or analytical methodologies through graduate research, coursework, internships, or laboratory projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technical problems, draw evidence-based conclusions, and communicate recommendations effectively to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Graduate research, internship, thesis, dissertation, or project experience related to HBM, DRAM, SRAM, memory controllers, high-speed interfaces, semiconductor architecture, or 3D integration technologies.
  • Experience with engineering simulation and analysis tools such as HSPICE, FineSim, Spectre, or similar circuit-design environments.
  • Understanding of power, performance, area, timing, thermal, and reliability tradeoffs in advanced semiconductor designs.
  • Experience using data analytics, AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Generative AI technologies to enhance engineering productivity, design exploration, or technical analysis.
  • Technical communication experience demonstrated through publications, conference presentations, patents, research reviews, or design reports.

title: Reservoirs Commercial Graduate
description:
Salary: £33,000, Permanent role.
Start date: September 2027

Location: Successful graduate will be based from Peterborough with occasional travel to our London hub (Kings Cross), one of our construction sites or a partner office. Please note your placements may vary across the region and departments so flexibility is essential.

Help shape the future of water, the environment and the communities we serve

With a plan worth over £11 billion of investment, we're building for better — for you, for the communities we serve, for our environment. As part of this we are looking for you to join Anglian Water's Graduate Programme and tackle some of the biggest environmental and infrastructure challenges facing the region. From climate resilience and major engineering projects to digital innovation and customer experience, you'll develop the skills, experience and support needed to become one of our future leaders or specialists.

Your career path
The water industry is changing rapidly, creating exciting opportunities for the next generation of talent. At Anglian Water, you'll work on real challenges that matter, developing expertise across your chosen profession while contributing to projects that support customers, communities and the environment.

You'll learn from experienced colleagues, take on meaningful responsibility and build the skills, knowledge and confidence to shape your future career, while helping us shape the future of water.

To find out more from our recent graduates please visit our Anglian Water careers page: Graduates - Anglian Water Careers

Professional Development & Memberships
We're committed to helping you build a career, not just gain a job. Through our two-year graduate programme, you'll experience different placements, work on real business challenges and learn from experienced colleagues across the organisation. You'll have access to a wide range of development opportunities, support towards professional qualifications and funded membership of a relevant professional institution, helping you grow your expertise and achieve professional accreditation where appropriate.

Your programme

Working within the Reservoirs Programme you will gain exposure to a wide range of commercial activities supporting the procurement, delivery and management of multi-million-pound contracts.

You'll be involved in:

  • Supporting the management of strategic supplier and contractor relationships

  • Assisting with contract administration and commercial governance activities

  • Assisting with the development of commercial and procurement strategies

  • Analysing commercial data, risks and opportunities

  • Supporting tender evaluations and contract award processes

  • Assisting with the preparation of reports and presentations for senior stakeholders

  • Monitoring supplier performance and contractual compliance

  • Working collaboratively with programme, engineering, finance and legal teams

  • Contributing to negotiations and the commercial decision-making processes

Throughout the programme, you'll receive structured development, mentoring and hands-on experience across different commercial disciplines.

What you will bring

We're particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate strong analytical and numerical skills, excellent communication and relationship-building abilities, commercial awareness and curiosity and confidence working with data and information. We're looking for graduates who want to help shape the future of water while developing a successful and rewarding career of their own.

For this role, you’ll need to have obtained or be studying towards a minimum 2:2 in any of the following degree discipline, Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Economics, Finance, Law or a related discipline and have graduated by September 2027 for the 2027 intake. This should be obtained in the last 3 years if not currently studying.

Benefits
Alongside a competitive salary, you'll receive a comprehensive health and wellbeing package, private healthcare, 26 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, and a double-matched pension scheme with up to 21% total contribution. We also offer an excellent family leave package, including enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave, helping you balance your career with the moments that matter most.

Closing Date: 27th September 2026

Site Tour: 26th or 28th October, at our Lincs site. If shortlisted, this is an opportunity to learn more about the role, meet colleagues, and gain first-hand insight into the work you'll be doing.

Assessment Centres (in Person): 11th or 13th November at our Lancaster House office, Huntingdon

title: IT-projektledare
description:
Välkommen till Alingsås! Som medarbetare i vår kommun har du alla möjligheter att vara med och utveckla verksamheten och din arbetsplats. Med nära 4000 anställda är vi tillräckligt stora för att driva förändring och samtidigt tillräckligt små för att var och en ska kunna påverka och få utrymme för sina idéer. Här finns plats för nytänkare. Tillsammans skapar vi Alingsås!

Kultur- och utbildningsförvaltningens verksamheter omfattas av gymnasieskola, anpassad gymnasieskola, vuxenutbildning, fritidsgårdar, kulturskola, kulturhus, bibliotek, museum, konsthall, turism, evenemangsverksamhet, anläggningar, Nolhaga ishall, Nolhaga lantgård, Nolhaga Parkbad samt föreningsstöd. Inom hela förvaltningen arbetar idag cirka 420 medarbetare.

Nu söker vi en IT-projektledare som vill vara med och bidra till förvaltningens fortsatta digitala utveckling!

När du börjar hos oss så erbjuder vi dig:

	• En trygg anställning
	• Möjlighet till semesterväxling
	• Extra semesterdagar när du fyllt 40 år
	• Kompetensutvecklingsplan
	• Föräldrapenningtillägg
	• Friskvårdsbidrag och förmånliga rabatter via E-passi
	• Cykelförmån
	• Möjlighet att delvis arbeta på distans
	• En arbetsplats som ligger centralt med gångavstånd till pendel, restauranger och butiker

Välkommen med din ansökan!

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som IT-projektledare får du en central roll i Kultur- och utbildningsförvaltningens fortsatta digitala utveckling. Du arbetar nära våra verksamheter för att säkerställa att vi har rätt digitala verktyg, ändamålsenliga system och en IT-miljö som är både säker och långsiktigt hållbar. Du ansvarar för att leda utvecklingsinitiativ, samordna förvaltningens systemförvaltning och driva arbetet med att utveckla våra digitala arbetssätt. Uppdraget handlar lika mycket om att skapa struktur, ordning och kvalitet som  att identifiera nya möjligheter genom digitalisering och AI.

Du kommer att vara en drivande kraft i förvaltningens digitala utveckling och bidra till att skapa smartare arbetssätt och bättre service. En viktig del av uppdraget är att tillsammans med verksamheterna identifiera möjligheter där digital teknik kan göra verklig skillnad. Det kan handla om att utveckla AI-lösningar som effektiviserar arbetet eller stödja verksamheterna i att använda digital teknik på ett smart, säkert och hållbart sätt. Du behöver vara en person som kan kombinera utvecklingskraft med tålamod och förståelse för verksamhetens olika förutsättningar. Du ser värdet av att involvera chefer och medarbetare och bygger förändring tillsammans med dem.

Du arbetar i nära samarbete med förvaltningens andra IT-projektledare. Tillsammans kompletterar ni varandras kompetenser och fungerar som ett gemensamt stöd för hela förvaltningens digitala utveckling. Du har även ett nära samarbete med kommunens centrala IT-organisation, informationssäkerhetsfunktion och andra stödfunktioner.

Som IT-projektledare kommer du bland annat att:

	• Leda och samordna förvaltningens arbete med digital utveckling
	• Ansvara för förvaltningens systemförvaltning och samordna arbetet med våra verksamhetssystem
	• Säkerställa att våra IT-stöd är ändamålsenliga, effektiva och används på ett enhetligt sätt
	• Arbeta strategiskt med informationssäkerhet och dataskydd
	• Bidra till ett systematiskt arbete med informationssäkerhet och IT-säkerhet
	• Identifiera verksamheternas behov och omsätta dem till konkreta utvecklingsinsatser
	• Driva utvecklingsprojekt inom digitalisering, AI och verksamhetsutveckling
	• Samverka med kommunens centrala IT-organisation kring tekniska lösningar och förvaltningsfrågor
	• Utbilda och stödja chefer och medarbetare i användningen av digitala verktyg
	• Omvärldsbevaka och identifiera nya lösningar som kan skapa nytta för verksamheten.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har:

	• Högskoleutbildning inom IT, systemvetenskap, digitalisering eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
	• Erfarenhet av att leda eller samordna digitala utvecklingsprojekt
	• Erfarenhet av verksamhetsutveckling med stöd av digital teknik
	• Erfarenhet av systemförvaltning eller arbete med verksamhetssystem
	• God förståelse för IT-infrastruktur och tekniska lösningar
	• Kunskap om AI, digitala verktyg, informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och säker användning av digitala tjänster
	• God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har:

	• Bred teknisk förståelse
	• Erfarenhet av projektledning enligt etablerade projektmodeller
	• Erfarenhet av AI och Microsoft 365-plattformen
	• Erfarenhet från offentlig verksamhet, kultur-, fritids-, turism- eller utbildningsverksamhet.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde efter överenskommelse.

Första intervjuerna planeras att hållas 15-19/10.

För att underlätta rekryteringsarbetet ber vi dig att bifoga relevanta intyg och betyg för tjänsten du söker samt vid eventuell intervju ha möjlighet att uppvisa giltig ID-handling såsom pass eller nationellt ID kort.

Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du INTE söka via systemet utan kontakta ansvarig rekryterande chef för hantering av din ansökan.



Vi har endast möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via Visma Recruit.

Alingsås kommun tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning. På vår webbplats kan du läsa mer om lön, löneutveckling, kollektivavtal, lönestatistik och våra förmåner: https://www.alingsas.se/naringsliv-och-arbete/jobb/vilka-ar-vi/

title: Data Engineer
description:
Als Data Engineer benut je geavanceerde Business Intelligence-tools om data uit diverse bronnen te ontsluiten en in een krachtig 'data warehouse' te transformeren. Hiermee leg je het fundament voor geavanceerde analyses en rapportages die cruciaal zijn voor strategische besluitvorming en operationele optimalisatie. Jouw missie is het verbinden, organiseren en ontsluiten van gegevens op een manier die Centric en onze klanten een voorsprong geeft.


Alle potentiële sollicitanten worden aangemoedigd om de volledige functieomschrijving door te lezen alvorens te solliciteren.

Hoe doe je dat? Door het doel van de klant voorop te zetten én te scoren. Het is jouw passie voor data en jouw drive om bedrijven te helpen slagen in het tijdperk van datagedreven besluitvorming. Je bent geen gewone data engineer, je bent een visionair, een probleemoplosser en een pionier in data-intelligentie. Bij Centric krijg je de kans om je talenten te benutten, te groeien en te werken aan inspirerende projecten voor diverse toonaangevende organisaties. Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van data-oplossingen en -architecturen
  • Extraheren, transformeren en laden van gegevens (ETL) uit verschillende bronnen
  • Werken met moderne (Cloud-)technologie in het datawerkveld
  • Optimaliseren van gegevensprocessen voor prestaties en schaalbaarheid
  • Samenwerken met multidisciplinaire teams om de behoeften van de klant te begrijpen en te vertalen naar technische oplossingen
  • Onderhouden en monitoren van gegevensstromen en systemen

Als Data Engineer treed je in dienst bij Centric en word je ingezet bij één of meerdere opdrachtgevers. De diversiteit in werklocatie, welke maximaal één uur van huis ligt, laat je kennismaken met vele organisaties. Zo blijf je ontwikkelen binnen jouw vakgebied. Met jouw Field Manager stel je een ontwikkelplan op en samen bepalen jullie welke opleidingen, trainingen en opdrachten passen bij jouw ontwikkelingswensen. Tot slot word je onderdeel van de vakgroep (EC), waarin kennisdeling en onderlinge coaching met collega’s centraal staat.

Wij zorgen voor een werkomgeving waar jij blij kunt zijn en gewaardeerd wordt. Andersom voeg jij als Cloud Data engineer waarde toe met jouw:

  • Een HBO- of WO-studie afgerond
  • Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met Azure-dataservices zoals Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, etc.
  • Kennis van programmeertalen en querytalen zoals SQL, Python, Scala, etc.
  • Vaardigheid om oplossingen te ontwerpen die voldoen aan veiligheids- en compliance-vereisten
  • Sterk analytisch denkvermogen en uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief in teamverband te werken

Bij Centric bieden we een dynamische omgeving waarin je jouw vaardigheden kunt benutten voor diverse uitdagende projecten bij boeiende klanten. Hier krijg je de mogelijkheid om voortdurend bij te leren en te groeien in een omgeving die in de voorhoede staat van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. Daarnaast omvat deze functie:

  • Een brutosalaris tot €6.000,00 per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
  • 26 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantietoeslag die we in mei uitbetalen
  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen van 7,5% van je pensioengrondslag
  • Een winstdeling tot wel 50% van het gemiddelde brutomaandsalaris
  • Loyaliteitsdagen: des te langer je bij ons werkt des te meer vrije tijd
  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding tot € 15,00 per maand
  • Onbeperkte mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van huis naar het werk reist
  • Tot 15% voordeel op jouw collectieve ziektekostenverzekering
  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,00 als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

title: Intern - F10 Process & Equipment Engineer
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

Location
Singapore

Department
Process Equipment Engineering (PEE)

Project Title
AI-Enabled CMP Equipment Health & Breakage Risk Prediction Dashboard

Project Description
Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) tool performance directly influences wafer quality, equipment reliability, and manufacturing efficiency. This project focuses on developing an AI-Enabled dashboard that integrates fab equipment and manufacturing data to identify early indicators of wafer breakage, equipment degradation, and yield excursions.

The intern will work on data exploration, predictive analytics, and visualization techniques to develop an intelligent monitoring solution that enables proactive decision-making. Through this project, the intern will gain exposure to semiconductor manufacturing equipment, reliability engineering methodologies, Artificial Intelligence applications, and data-driven engineering practices within a high-volume manufacturing environment.

Objective of the Project
Develop an AI-Enabled equipment monitoring and risk prediction dashboard capable of identifying potential CMP tool-related wafer breakage and excursion risks before significant manufacturing impact occurs.

Opportunities for Full Time Employment
High-performing candidates may be considered for future r opportunities based on business needs and performance.

Project Scope

  • Analyze historical equipment and manufacturing datasets associated with CMP operations.

  • Correlate equipment performance indicators such as Tool ID, workstation data, preventive maintenance records, and SPC violations with wafer breakage events and yield excursions.

  • Develop an AI-Enabled risk scoring model using historical manufacturing and equipment reliability data.

  • Create interactive Power BI dashboards to visualize equipment health, excursion trends, and breakage risk indicators.

  • Evaluate opportunities to incorporate Generative AI, AI Assistants, or Agentic AI concepts for automated reporting and engineering insights generation.

Learning Opportunities

  • Gain understanding of CMP equipment architecture, maintenance practices, and reliability engineering principles.

  • Learn how predictive analytics and Artificial Intelligence can be applied within semiconductor manufacturing environments.

  • Develop experience in handling large-scale manufacturing datasets and performing statistical analysis.

  • Build practical skills in Power BI dashboard development and engineering data visualization.

  • Collaborate with equipment engineers to understand real-world equipment performance challenges and continuous improvement methodologies.

Deliverables

  • AI-Enabled CMP Breakage Risk Index.

  • Equipment Health Scorecard for CMP tools.

  • Pareto analysis identifying key contributors to breakage and excursion risks.

  • Automated Top-10 High-Risk Tool Monitoring Dashboard.

  • Automated reporting solution providing engineering insights and early warning indicators.

Impact of the Project

  • Improve visibility of equipment health conditions through predictive monitoring.

  • Enable earlier identification of potential wafer breakage and excursion risks.

  • Support proactive maintenance planning and engineering decision-making.

  • Reduce manual effort associated with data consolidation and risk assessment.

  • Demonstrate the application of AI-driven solutions to improve manufacturing equipment performance.

Skillsets Required

  • Basic programming knowledge in Python, SQL, or similar data analysis tools.

  • Familiarity with data visualization platforms such as Power BI.

  • Understanding of statistical analysis, machine learning, or Artificial Intelligence concepts is desirable.

  • Experience working with large datasets and extracting meaningful insights.

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, communication skills, and willingness to learn AI-enabled engineering workflows.

Course of Interest
The ideal candidate should be pursuing a Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.

Duration of Period
The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full time internship period of 5 months from Jan to May 2027.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Bouw mee aan het dataplatform van de toekomst bij Alfen!



Solliciteer hieronder na het doorlezen van alle details en ondersteunende informatie met betrekking tot deze vacature.

Ben jij een Data Engineer die energie krijgt van complexe datastromen, schaalbare dataplatformen en slimme data‑oplossingen? Wil je werken met moderne technologieën als Snowflake, Matillion en Power BI en directe impact maken op besluitvorming binnen een innovatieve organisatie? Dan is deze rol bij Alfen iets voor jou.


Jouw rol

Als Data Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van het Alfen Data Platform. Dit platform vormt de ruggengraat voor het gebruik van data‑en analysetoepassingen binnen Alfen. Je ontsluit en verwerkt data uit uiteenlopende bronnen: van ERP‑ en HR‑systemen tot servicedesk‑omgevingen en IoT‑data uit batterijsystemen.


Je werkt nauw samen met functioneel applicatiebeheer, IT, business stakeholders en externe leveranciers om betrouwbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige data‑oplossingen te realiseren.


Je rapporteert aan de Manager Business Applications.


Wat ga je doen?

In deze developer‑rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige data‑ecosysteem, van bron tot inzicht:



  • Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van robuuste datastromen naar het dataplatform
  • Modelleren van data voor analytische toepassingen (DWH & Data Lake)
  • Ontsluiten en integreren van interne en externe databronnen (databases, API’s, JSON, files)
  • Ontwikkelen van scripts, algoritmes en modellen (met name in Python en SQL)
  • Bewaken en optimaliseren van performance, capaciteit en betrouwbaarheid van het dataplatform
  • Integreren van nieuwe datamanagement‑technologieën en software‑engineering tools
  • Zorgen voor veilige verwerking en analyse van data
  • Datavisualisatie mogelijk maken richting de business via Power BI
  • Begeleiden van releases en deelnemen aan diverse ICT‑ en dataprojecten
  • Actief bijdragen aan de datastrategie, roadmap en afdelingsdoelstellingen

Tooling & Technologie

Je werkt met een moderne en professionele data stack, waaronder:



  • Snowflake (cloud data platform)
  • Matillion (ETL/ELT)
  • Python en SQL
  • Power BI (inclusief DAX en tabular modellen)
  • Azure‑infrastructuur (compute, storage en security)

Wat neem je mee?
Opleiding & ervaring

  • HBO‑niveau, bij voorkeur in (bedrijfs)informatica, ICT, software‑engineering of informatiekunde
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van dataplatformen
  • Ervaring met Snowflake en Matillion óf vergelijkbare tools
  • Sterke kennis van SQL en dimensioneel modelleren
  • Ervaring met transactionele én analytische databases
  • Ervaring met Power BI en DAX
  • Goede kennis van Azure op het gebied van infrastructuur en security

Competenties & vaardigheden

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen en probleemoplossend denken
  • Klant‑ en businessgericht
  • Organisatiesensitief en communicatief sterk
  • In staat om data‑oplossingen end‑to‑end te realiseren
  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk)

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een sleutelrol binnen een groeiend en innovatief datalandschap
  • Werken met moderne cloud‑en data‑technologieën
  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling en innovatie
  • Samenwerking met gedreven professionals binnen IT en de business
  • Impactvolle projecten binnen een organisatie die volop in beweging is Een marktconform salaris volgens de CAO Metalektro.
  • 27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV‑dagen per jaar.
  • Een solide pensioenregeling via PME, waarbij Alfen meer dan de helft van de premie betaalt.
  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.
  • Toegang tot onze online leeromgeving voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
  • Betrokken collega’s en leuke activiteiten via AlFun en Young Alfen.
  • Gratis sportactiviteiten, zoals marathons, fitnesssessies en sportclinics. xgiwjmb
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per km, tot maximaal 50 km enkele reis.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Google Cloud Filestore, Copy Services
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Filestore provides a fully managed NFS service for Enterprise Cloud users who need a traditional file system that is hosted in GCP. We are transforming our services into an active, intelligent substrate for Agents that can support 10s of millions of Agents, with high-performing, persistent, secure, and shareable storage.

The Copy Services Team owns Filestore's Backup and Disaster Recovery mechanisms, backing up 1.5 Petabytes and replicating 250TiB daily for thousands of Filestore customers.

Our mission is to deliver an enterprise grade, high performance, highly reliable filesystem as a service for GCP customers, build the most advanced and feature-full cloud filesystem in the world, and build a system capable to grow according to customer demand and usage in terms of capacity and performance.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
  • Define, design and implement the next set of key features of the Cloud Filestore backup services.
  • Work closely with peers from Filesystem engineering, product, project management, and SRE teams.
  • Improve the existing backups and disaster recovery functionality and infrastructures.
  • Help define, design and implement the next generation of the filesystem's backups service.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms, and software development in one or more programming languages.
  • 3 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.
  • 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholder groups.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • Experience developing accessible technologies.
  • Experience in designing and implementing large-scale filesystems or distributed storage systems.
  • Deep expertise in storage systems, distributed systems architecture, data replication, and disaster recovery technologies.

title: New College Grad - HBM SoC Design Engineer/Architect
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

About the Team

At Micron Technology, we transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. The Heterogeneous Integration Group (HIG) develops next-generation High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) solutions that enable advanced AI, high-performance computing, data center, and networking applications. Our team collaborates across architecture, RTL design, verification, physical design, firmware, and product engineering to deliver innovative memory-centric SoC solutions that meet demanding power, performance, area, quality, and schedule objectives.

Position Overview

As an HBM SoC Design Engineer/Architect, you will contribute to the design, integration, and validation of advanced HBM logic die and memory-centric SoCs. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will apply knowledge gained through academic coursework, research, internships, and engineering projects to solve real-world semiconductor design challenges. This role offers opportunities to develop expertise in digital design, ASIC development, HBM architecture, and AI-enabled engineering methodologies that improve design productivity and quality.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and integrate digital logic and subsystem RTL using Verilog or SystemVerilog for next-generation HBM SoC solutions.
  • Collaborate with architects and cross-functional engineering teams to translate functional requirements into microarchitectures, interface definitions, and implementation plans.
  • Support design-quality activities including simulation, synthesis, static timing analysis, clock-domain crossing (CDC) analysis, debugging, and design reviews.
  • Evaluate power, performance, area, and timing tradeoffs to develop data-driven technical recommendations and improve design quality.
  • Develop automation solutions and leverage AI Assisted workflows, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI technologies to improve engineering productivity, verification efficiency, and design analysis.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field completed prior to the employment start date.
  • Academic, research, internship, or project experience in digital design, ASIC development, FPGA design, computer architecture, or a related discipline.
  • Working knowledge of Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, or another hardware description language.
  • Understanding of digital design fundamentals including finite-state machines (FSMs), pipelining, clocking, reset strategies, timing concepts, and synchronous logic.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively in collaborative engineering environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline completed prior to the employment start date.
  • Coursework, research, internship, or project experience in SoC design, RTL development, design verification, physical design, embedded systems, or semiconductor technologies.
  • Familiarity with synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), simulation, formal verification, UVM, FPGA prototyping, or industry-standard EDA tools.
  • Understanding of memory systems and high-speed interfaces such as HBM, DDR, LPDDR, PCIe, or CXL.
  • Experience with automation, AI Enabled development tools, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Assistants, or Agentic AI solutions applied to semiconductor design, validation, or engineering workflows.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
Maak impact met data bij TreeHouse en haar internationale labels!


Denkt u de juiste kandidaat te zijn voor de volgende functie? Solliciteer dan na het lezen van de volledige omschrijving.
Over de functie

Als Junior Data Engineer sta je aan de basis van onze datagedreven strategie. Je gaat aan de slag met ons analyseplatform STAM, volledig gebouwd in de Google Cloud. Dit platform is de motor achter onze interne inzichten, externe adviezen aan gemeenten en beleggers, en de bekende Pararius Huurmonitor.

Jouw missie? Leren hoe je schaalbare datastromen ontwerpt en bouwt die miljoenen gebruikers ondersteunen. Onder begeleiding van ervaren collega's word je verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het bouwen en beheren van Python scripts voor ETL-processen om data uit diverse bronnen en API’s te ontsluiten.
  • Het vertalen van ruwe data naar bruikbare datasets in BigQuery met behulp van SQL scripts en dbt.
  • Het ondersteunen bij het automatiseren van workflows met moderne tools zoals Github Actions voor CI/CD en Terraform.
  • Het meedenken over de datakwaliteit: we willen dat onze inzichten 100% betrouwbaar zijn.

Je maakt deel uit van het Analytics-team (1 lead, 1 medior data engineer en 3 analisten). Dit is de ideale omgeving om snel te groeien, fouten te mogen maken en de kneepjes van het vak te leren van experts.

Over TreeHouse

Maak kennis met TreeHouse: een toonaangevende digitale onderneming, gespecialiseerd in de vastgoedmarkt waarin we vooral gefocust zijn op de huurmarkt. Zo helpen we maandelijks meer dan 3 miljoen woningzoekenden bij het vinden van een nieuw thuis. Dat doen we in Nederland met onze labels en high-traffic platforms , én het voor makelaars ontwikkelde CRM-pakket Pararius Office en Leadflow. En we zijn actief in de UK met ons platform .uk en in Frankrijk met .

We zijn een informeel bedrijf met zo’n 80 enthousiaste medewerkers. We werken in kleinschalige teams waarin we snel proberen te schakelen en veel met elkaar sparren. Dat zorgt er ook voor dat er veel vrijheid is in de manier van werken; onze teams verbeteren zichzelf constant.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je bent aan het begin van je carrière en barst van de ambitie. Je vindt het leuk om complexe puzzels op te lossen en wil graag werken met de nieuwste cloud-technologieën.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in een relevante richting (bijv. Informatica of Computer Science).
  • 0-2 jaar ervaring: stage-ervaring of een eerste relevante baan is een pré, maar een sterke passie en een goed portfolio zijn net zo belangrijk.
  • Goede basiskennis van SQL en Python.
  • Je bent bekend met het concept van cloudomgevingen (bijv. Google Cloud, AWS of Azure).
  • Je bent analytisch sterk, nauwkeurig en niet bang om vragen te stellen.
  • Leergierigheid: de tech-stack verandert snel, en jij verandert graag mee.
Wat bieden wij jou?

Wij begrijpen dat jouw expertise het verschil maakt. Daarom bieden we jou:

  • Een uitdagende startfunctie met veel ruimte voor training en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
  • Begeleiding door een ervaren engineer die je helpt een expert te worden in Google Cloud en Data Engineering.
  • Een marktconform salaris passend bij jouw niveau.
  • Laptop van de zaak.
  • Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: 8% vakantiegeld, 25 vakantiedagen, reiskostenvergoeding en 70% vergoeding op je pensioenpremie.
  • Professionele groei: toegang tot opleidingen, conferenties en de vrijheid om met nieuwe tools en technieken te experimenteren.
  • Een unieke werkplek in Rotterdam: ons kantoor in Blaak 555 biedt een prachtig uitzicht, daarnaast hebben we gezamenlijke lunches en doen we regelmatig aan teamuitjes. xgiwjmb

title: Principal Program Scheduler – Persistent Surveillance Portfolio
description:
Leidos is seeking an accomplished Principal Program Scheduler to provide strategic scheduling leadership on the Persistent Surveillance Portfolio of programs, within our Defense Sensors Business Area.

This exciting role provides a direct scheduling leadership opportunity to support a Department of Defense radar program delivering multiple systems to the USMC, Army, & Air Force, including full life-cycle support, logistics, and site activation activities. In this dynamic role, you will serve as a principal scheduling authority for mission-critical programs, trusted by senior leadership to anticipate risks, drive solutions, and ensure alignment between technical execution, resources, and program objectives. This role is ideal for a senior level scheduling professional who thrives in fast-paced, high-impact environments and seeks to apply their expertise to programs that directly support national defense.

This position will be housed at our Research Park Facility in Huntsville, Alabama, where you will be working with various Integrated Product teams, key program stakeholders, and Technical SMEs; to improve program planning and execution while ensuring compliance with contractual requirements and company policy and procedures.

The Principal Program Scheduler position will be an integral part of the larger enterprise-wide Leidos Corporate Earned Value Management (EVM) Center of Excellence (COE). The Leidos Corporate EVM COE is a team-leading and executing the core responsibilities of scheduling, planning, EVMS, the associated infrastructure and tools, implementations, training, and surveillance for Leidos.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for applying scheduling theory/practice to develop the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and related artifacts in compliance with applicable standards and policies such as EVM standard EIA-748 and industry best practices (e.g., PASEG, NDIA) in alignment with the mission of the EVM COE and in support of programs.
  • Requires a high-level understanding of programmatic scheduling theory and practice
  • Provide the “why” - demonstrating the ability to clearly communicate schedule analysis, execution metrics, and overall program understanding through a cost informed scheduling perspective.
  • Responsible for implementing practices to align the time phasing and plans for resources with the IMS to provide an integrated technical, schedule, and resource/cost baseline and forecast/ ETC for programs.
  • Ability to create “what-if” scenarios within the schedule that inform program leadership
  • Serves as a scheduling leader in assisting programs with issue identification & resolution solutions.
  • Implement program scheduling business rhythms & controls
  • Develop scheduling artifacts to meet contractual/project requirements
  • Monitor, analyze, and report performance against baseline schedules to ensure that contractual cost and schedule objectives are met
  • Significant interface with Program Managers, Contracts, and Senior Technical Personnel, as well as other organizations
  • Provide Leadership, guidance, and mentorship to other emerging scheduling professionals
  • Must be able to collaboratively work onsite at our Huntsville location multiple days per week, or on an “as needed” basis.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Requires a BA degree and 12+ years of prior relevant scheduling experience in DOD Environment; Additional education, experience or training will be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Ability and willingness to obtain a DoD Secret clearance in the future.
  • Must have advanced expertise using Microsoft Project scheduling software
  • Must possess an understanding of advanced scheduling theory including experience with:
    • Schedule status & version control processes
    • Schedule health assessment (e.g., 14-Point Analysis)
    • Resource loading/management
    • Baseline change control processes
    • Schedule Execution Metrics (BEI, CEI, CPLI, SV, SPI etc.)
    • Schedule Risk Assessment (SRA)/Monte Carlo Analysis and tools
    • Critical Path Method (CPM) and Margin/Float management

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience scheduling as an Aerospace and Defense Prime/Major Subcontractor
  • Experience in a Manufacturing/Production/Prototyping environment
  • Intermediate to advanced expertise using Structured Solutions Inc. (SSI) Tools for Microsoft Project
  • Experience w/ Milestones Professional
  • Utilization of MS Project Macros
  • Current and active DoD Secret clearance.

title: LATAM Service desk Incident Manager
description:
You will be responsible for coordinating, overseeing, and continuously improving the end‑to‑end management of IT incidents to ensure timely resolution and minimal business impact. • Support KPI and SLA performance by contributing to reporting, root cause analysis, and initiatives to improve incident response, communication, and user experience

Qualifications

  • Experience with ITIL

  • Working knowledge of operating systems and systems software

  • Advanced level of English

title: Lead Agentic Software & DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Partially remote, with Paris or Dubai as preferred hubs. Fully remote possible for an exceptional profile.

Contract: Full-time, permanent

ABOUT PMP STRATEGY

PMP Strategy is an international strategy consulting firm helping executive teams turn strategic ambition into measurable results. We combine strategic advisory, technology, data and AI expertise to help clients design and deliver transformations across technology-intensive industries.

Agentix Studio is PMP Strategy's dedicated data and AI delivery team. Our experienced team designs and delivers business applications, AI solutions and agentic systems for clients. We are strengthening our software engineering capabilities to take POCs and MVPs into robust, scalable and maintainable production products.

THE ROLE

As Lead Software & DevOps Engineer, you will help our CTO and the Agentix Studio team turn the POCs and MVPs we build into production-grade software products. You will work with PMP Strategy consultants, who bring the business and sector expertise, and with client technical teams.

You will lead software delivery, deployment, operations and maintenance, while helping develop the software engineering layer of our agentic delivery model. The CTO retains responsibility for overall technology architecture, infrastructure strategy, product and use‑case roadmap, and overall technical direction. You will take ownership of selected areas of engineering execution and product delivery.

YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Industrialise and operate production‑grade software

  • Translate business requirements into reliable digital products and AI‑powered applications with PMP Strategy consultants.
  • Design and implement software components, services, MCP/API integrations, workflows and agentic applications.
  • Take POCs and MVPs to an industrial standard, covering architecture, code quality, security, performance, scalability and resilience.
  • Supervise delivery from prototype to production and establish reusable delivery patterns.
  • Apply sound practices for testing, versioning, CI/CD, release management, deployment, monitoring and documentation.
  • Support deployments in client environments and guide client teams through integration, go‑live and handover.
  • Diagnose production incidents and manage reliability, technical debt, dependencies, model upgrades and security updates.
  • Maintain and continuously improve applications after go‑live.
  • Coach the Studio's data engineers on software engineering, DevOps and production practices.

2. Develop the Agentix Studio's agentic software engineering capability

  • Define practical standards for agent‑assisted software development.
  • Establish reusable project templates, repository structures, context files and workflows.
  • Help consultants and engineers use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools effectively.
  • Design agentic coding pipelines for planning, implementation, code review, testing and documentation.
  • Define human review and quality gates, and develop patterns for orchestration, tool use, MCP integration and workflow automation.
  • Improve the reliability, security, observability and cost control of agentic applications.
  • Create reusable components, deployment patterns and evaluation methods.
  • Share best practices across the Studio and support the CTO on software engineering technology choices.

3. Help clients evolve their software development lifecycle

  • Assess how clients design, build, test, review and deploy software.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce agentic coding safely and effectively.
  • Design workflows combining developers, coding agents and human quality gates.
  • Help clients select and configure coding tools and models.
  • Define standards for context engineering, code review, testing and agent governance.
  • Support pilot teams as they move from experimentation to repeatable delivery.
  • Extend agentic workflows into testing, integration, documentation, release management and maintenance.
  • Coach client developers and technical leads, and contribute to recommendations, workshops and executive presentations.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 7 to 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant production delivery.
  • Strong experience designing, building, deploying and maintaining software used by real users or customers.
  • Strong software delivery, DevOps and platform skills, including testing, CI/CD, observability, cloud services, containers, infrastructure as code, secrets management and secure deployment pipelines.
  • Proven experience taking POCs or MVPs into robust, production‑grade solutions.
  • Recent, meaningful experience with agentic coding or agentic software development pipelines.
  • Hands‑on experience with tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Aider or equivalent.
  • Credentials showing that agentic coding was part of a real engineering workflow, not only an isolated experiment.
  • Experience delivering AI‑powered or agentic applications into production.
  • Ability to review code and technical designs, set engineering standards and guide other engineers.
  • Full professional fluency in English, written and spoken.

Consulting and client-facing experience

Previous experience in consulting, technology consulting, professional services or another highly client‑facing environment is close to essential. You should be comfortable running workshops, interviewing technical teams, understanding client constraints, explaining complex topics clearly, turning analysis into recommendations, presenting to senior stakeholders and guiding a client through deployment and production adoption.

Background

We are particularly interested in candidates from an agentic AI startup, a fast‑growing technology company, a digital product company with high production standards, a developer productivity or AI infrastructure team, or a leading technology or AI company such as Google, Uber, Datadog, OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent. Experience working in a startup environment is especially valuable.

THE IDEAL PROFILE

title: Research Fellow (Natural Sciences and Science Education Department) [NIE]
description:
The National Institute of Education invites suitable applications for the position of Research Fellow on a 20-month contract at the Natural Sciences and Science Education Department.

Project Title: Furthering Adoption of Integrated Resources to Shape Integrated Learning Experiences: Primary 5 and 6 Study

Project Introduction:

This study delves into science learning in Primary 5 (P5) and Primary 6 (P6). The adoption and considered adaptations of the integrated suite of resources by P3 and P4 science teachers opens fresh opportunities for investigating science classroom practices in P5 and P6 in at least three domains.

  • Examine and detail primary science learning interactions, trajectory, and adoption of integrated resources in P5/P6 and compare them with P3/P4 experiences. The P5/P6 study completes the documentation of classroom practices in primary science classrooms to offer a complete and comprehensive understanding of primary science teaching and learning in Singapore.
  • Examine, detail, and compare adoption and adaptation of integrated resources in P5/P6 Standard and Foundation Science classes. Specifically, we seek to examine scaffolding, instructional approaches, and academic emotions of Standard and Foundation classes to inform review of curriculum and resources to make them more inclusive as well as explore differentiated learning approaches to cater to students of different learning progress.
  • Examine and detail the development of Ways of Thinking and Doing Science (WOTD) in P5/P6 and compare them with P3/P4. Particularly, we examine how teachers support students to develop explanations from observations made and data collected during hands-on inquiry. We also will examine how students are supported to communicate their explanations. Strengthening students’ capacities to engage with all eight aspects of WOTD supports the development of E21CC such as critical, adaptive, and inventive thinking (CAIT) as well as communication in Science.

Requirements:

  • PhD in Science Education or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching science in K-12 schools.
  • Demonstrated experience in the development of teaching resources at the national level.
  • Strong academic publication record in the field of Science Education.
  • Proficiency with mixed-method research approaches, including both quantitative and qualitative methodologies.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the research team in data collection, analysis, and the preparation of research publications.
  • Conduct literature searches in the area of research.
  • Engage with schools and teachers to disseminate research findings.
  • Present research findings at international conferences.
  • Any other administrative duties as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

Who Are We?

Stand Out For Good, Inc. is a rapidly growing women’s fashion company with 5 unique brands, in 130+ locations, across 38 states. Position Title:
