Job Description:

OREGON YOUTH AUTHORITY

Information Services Project Manager 1

SALEM, OREGON - Central Office - Information Systems Department

The Oregon Youth Authority's Information Services Project Management Office is hiring a Project Manager 1 to lead technology projects that directly shape how OYA serves youth across the state. In this role, you will manage the full lifecycle of IT initiatives — from initial planning through implementation and closeout — coordinating with technical teams, vendors, and business partners to keep projects on scope, on schedule, and within budget. You will identify and mitigate risk, manage change requests, and keep leadership and stakeholders informed through clear, consistent reporting. This is a chance to bring structure and consistency to how OYA delivers technology solutions that strengthen security, improve compliance, and enhance services for staff and the youth in our care. We're looking for someone who thrives on organization, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical partners, and applies an equity lens to the project decisions that affect our workforce and the communities we serve.

Your role as IS Project Manager 1:

  • Manage the full lifecycle of small to medium IT projects — initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout — including charters, schedules, budgets, and governance documentation.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks; manage the issue log and formal change control process, escalating significant items to project sponsors or governance leadership.
  • Coordinate implementation, deployment, and go-live activities — including system testing and UAT — across application, infrastructure, security, and business teams.
  • Support PMO governance by maintaining project documentation, preparing portfolio and executive status reporting, and applying established project management standards.
  • Lead stakeholder communication and compliance — developing communication plans, preparing status reports and briefings, and ensuring project work aligns with agency, security, and accessibility standards.

About OYA

The Oregon Youth Authority (OYA) is a national leader in the juvenile justice field, pioneering the implementation of a positive human development framework for its work with staff and youth, and using data to match the right youth with the right services. We seek to foster cultural competence and pursue equitable solutions to support youth under our care. Our agency mission is to protect the public and reduce crime by holding youth accountable and providing opportunities for reformation in safe environments.

If you are looking to join a team that values individual and cultural differences and the opportunity to contribute in the success of youth reformation by enriching our workforce with diversity, OYA wants to hear from you!

People of color, women and other members of historically underserved communities are strongly encouraged to apply!

  • Generous Paid Time Off: 11 holidays, 3 personal business days, monthly sick leave and vacation leave that increases with years of service.

  • Retirement Benefits: Membership in Public Employees Retirement System (PERS)/Oregon Public Service Retirement Plan (OPSRP).

  • Wellness Resources: Support for work-life balance, health, and overall well-being.

  • Career Development: Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

  • Commuting: Access to Get There - Oregon’s carpool matching tool and trip planner.

  • Student Loan Forgiveness: Potential eligibility for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program.

  • Live, work, and play in Salem, Oregon.

title: Senior Security Architect
description:
AEGIS Insurance Services Inc. has an immediate opening for:

Senior Security Architect

Job Description:

AEGIS Insurance Services, Inc. (“AEGIS”) has an immediate opening for a Senior Security Architect responsible for defining, designing, implementing, and maintaining the enterprise security architecture of AEGIS. This role serves as the senior technical authority for cybersecurity and provides leadership across security architecture, engineering, operations, infrastructure security, cloud security, identity and access management, application security, data protection, and security technology modernization.

The Senior Security Architect partners closely with the Chief Information Security Officer, Vice President, IT Infrastructure, infrastructure team, application teams, business stakeholders, risk management, legal, and external vendors to ensure technology solutions align with regulatory requirements and cybersecurity best practices.

Job Requirements:

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, infrastructure security, network security, cloud security, or related technical disciplines
  • Undergraduate degree in Information Systems, Management Systems, Cybersecurity or related discipline or equivalent certification or work experience
  • CISSP, GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender (GCED), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Cloud Threat Detection (GCTD) certifications desired
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise security architectures
  • Extensive hands-on experience administering and supporting security technologies
  • Demonstrated experience in security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and security architecture
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 security, cloud security, identity and access management, endpoint security, and data protection technologies
  • Experience evaluating and selecting cybersecurity technologies and vendors
  • Insurance industry experience desired

AEGIS Core Competencies:

  • Collaborative Communications and Behavior: 0Develops and maintains effective working relationships as a team member and across divisions; readily collaborates and shares information, seeks and provides constructive feedback, and supports a respectful workplace.
  • Initiative and Accountability: Proactively addresses opportunities to enhance AEGIS’ people, processes, products, and services, takes ownership for one’s responsibilities by acting with integrity and in the best interest of the organization and stakeholders.
  • Quality-Focused: Demonstrates a solution-focus, displays thoroughness and accuracy through quality deliverables, and demonstrates persistence and perseverance in achieving concrete and tangible outcomes.
  • Service-Oriented: Conveys a genuine desire and ability to anticipate and meet customer needs and creates and nurtures mutually beneficial relationships within AEGIS and with AEGIS Members and brokers

Essential Job Functions:

Planning and Strategy – Security Architecture

  • Define and maintain enterprise security architecture, standards, policies, design patterns, and technical control requirements
  • Develop security roadmaps aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk management priorities
  • Lead security architecture reviews for infrastructure, cloud, application, network, endpoint, and third-party technology initiatives
  • Identify security gaps and recommend strategic remediation plans
  • Define secure reference architectures and implementation standards

Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement – Security Engineering & Operations

  • Design, implement, configure, administer, and maintain security technologies and controls
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting of security, network, cloud, server, endpoint, and identity-related technologies
  • Lead implementation activities for new security technologies, upgrades, migrations, and modernization projects
  • Maintain responsibility for day-to-day operation of key cybersecurity platforms
  • Participate directly in incident response, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned activities
  • Conduct technical security assessments, architecture reviews, and risk analyses
  • Develop and maintain security technical documentation, standards, procedures, implementation guides, and architectural diagrams
  • Support vulnerability management and IT’s remediation efforts
  • Perform security monitoring, threat analysis and control validation activities
  • Develop and govern enterprise security hardening requirements for operating systems, network devices, servers, cloud services, and supporting infrastructure; collaborate with IT and Infrastructure teams to implement secure configurations, remediate security gaps, and continuously improve cybersecurity resilience across the technology environment
  • Participate in maintenance windows, emergency response activities, and after-hours support as required
  • Maintain deep technical expertise across a broad range of security disciplines within a lean security organization

Project/Program Management and Support – Microsoft 365, Cloud & Data Security

  • Provide architecture and operational support for Microsoft 365 security capabilities including Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Purview, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Teams, and Microsoft Copilot
  • Develop security controls protecting sensitive information, collaboration platforms, and AI-enabled technologies
  • Evaluate security risks associated with cloud adoption, data sharing, AI technologies, and third-party integrations
  • Support Zero Trust initiatives across identity, device, application, and data layers

System Maintenance and Optimization – Infrastructure & Network Security

  • Provide architectural and engineering leadership for network security, firewalls, secure web gateways, remote access, endpoint protection, server security, segmentation, and monitoring solutions
  • Review infrastructure designs for security
  • Lead security reviews of system upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure modernization initiatives

Resource, Expense, and Vendor Management

  • Evaluate cybersecurity products, managed services, and third-party technologies
  • Perform technical due diligence and security assessments during procurement activities
  • Develop security requirements for vendor selection and solution design
  • Lead proof-of-concept activities and security architectural reviews for new technologies

Collaboration and Team Support

  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point for cybersecurity matters
  • Mentor security, infrastructure, and application teams on secure design and operational best practices
  • Communicate technical risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Influence technology decisions across the enterprise through expertise and leadership

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
A great opportunity has opened for a Senior DevOps Engineer for a leading Financial Services Client of ours in Amsterdam, Netherlands.


Wilt u solliciteren? Lees alle informatie over deze functie hieronder en klik dan op de sollicitatieknop.

Contract Duration: 24+ months (2 year project)

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands

Working Pattern: Hybrid

What you will do:

You will need to be able to configure and think outside the box on how to maintain and efficiently utilize our YML pipelines. Automate where things can be automated.

Since our detection system needs specific monitoring, you will be expected to pitch in to enhance our monitoring from certificate updates to loss of incoming data. With your Java skillset, you will also be expected to enhance our infrastructure together with your teammates and the Grid.

Example: adding new dashboards in Grafana or adding alerts on things as an improvement after previous incidents, i.e. making sure these incidents don't happen again without us knowing it in advance and being able to act on it.
  • Solving technical debt / increasing automation: getting rid of technical debt and implementing solutions that are optimized for maintainability and robustness. Example: all infrastructure-as-code and automating manual tasks (like certificate creation, patching pipelines, etc).

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with a strong background in:

  • Proven experience in operations, maintenance, and lifecycle management.
  • Skills & Expertise – Mandatory: Proficient in Azure and Azure YAML pipelines. Strong Linux and Ansible skills. Expertise in monitoring and alerting systems.

title: Sr. Database Administrator TS/SCI Poly
description:
Leidos has a new and exciting opportunity for a Sr. Database Administrator in our Intel Sector's Cyber & Analytics Business Area (CABA). Our talented team is at the forefront in Security Engineering, Computer Network Operations (CNO), Mission Software, Analytical Methods and Modeling, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), and Cryptographic Key Management. Join us and make a difference in National Security!

A Sr. Database Administrator is needed to support a large, complex, fast-paced, operational program. The selected individual will assess, audit, analyze, validate, and report database Security Requirements Guide (SRG) and STIG vulnerabilities while ensuring security controls are implemented in accordance with DoD, DISA, and cybersecurity policies and procedures. They will evaluate discrepancies against applicable policies, directives, and database SRG/STIG requirements, and document recommended additions, deletions, or revisions.

  • Implement and maintain DISA STIGs for platforms Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cassandra and/or MONGO DB.

  • Perform vulnerability scans, analyze findings, and remediate security weaknesses.

  • Support Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes and contribute to Authority to Operate (ATO) packages.

  • Conduct routine security readiness reviews and document Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) items.

  • Collaborate with Information System Security Officers (ISSOs) to validate and report compliance.

  • Review database SRG and/or STIGs as updates are released, and report changes with the potential to have significant impact.

  • Determine the impact and risk of submitted change requests prior to implementation and participate in meetings to provide cyber oversight for web changes that affect the level of risk.

  • Perform system updates and Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert (IAVA) patching.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve database problems.

  • Perform database recovery actions.

  • Modify existing database scripts to enhance systems support and create new database scripts for recurring database issues.

  • Develop and execute SQL queries for routine and ad hoc requests.

Basic Qualifications

  • Masters with 15 – 20 years of prior relevant experience or Doctorate with 13 – 16 years of prior relevant experience. Additional experience may be substituted for a degree.

  • In-depth experience implementing and maintaining database security controls.

  • In-depth experience applying Oracle CPU patches, IAVA patches, and other database products.

  • In-depth experience with Linux security as it relates to Oracle databases.

  • In-depth experience troubleshooting and resolving database problems and issues.

  • Must have hands-on experience installing, configuring, and upgrading RDBMS software.

  • Must have experience with procedural languages such as PL/SQL.

  • Clearance Required: Must have TS/SCI with Polygraph.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with real-time, highly available data replication technologies such as Oracle Data Guard, Oracle Streams, Oracle GoldenGate, Sybase Replication Server.

  • Experience with the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and/or as a member of an Agile team.

  • Extensive, in-depth knowledge of databases, with primary focus on Oracle and other relational and non-relational/NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

  • Experience using Oracle SQL/PLSQL, and SQL in general.

  • Experience with MongoDB and/or Cassandra.

title: Software Engineer, Content Safety
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our mission in the Content Safety organization is to protect Google’s users and the internet as a whole from exposure to offensive, sensitive or potentially harmful content. We achieve this by contributing directly to our foundational models and collaborating closely with DeepMind.

Beyond keeping users safe at scale, we also play a key role in accelerating Google's product launches by providing product teams with the right tools to explore new ideas and products following our Responsible AI principles. Our team combines unique subject matter expertise in the content safety domain, ML and high-throughput infrastructure.

In this role, you will keep society safer. You will work on problems like transformer architecture, and find comfort in an ever-changing landscape, anticipating threats that don't exist yet.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

  • Design, build, and scale content safety systems including classifiers, vector databases, and multimodal models to protect business-critical products and GenAI experiences.
  • Develop and maintain production-grade distributed systems and content processing pipelines optimized for high throughput and reliability across server-side and on-device environments.
  • Model training, evaluation, and productionization workflows, incorporating feedback loops and automation to continuously improve model quality and performance.
  • Implement agentic workflows and advanced heuristics for deep threat understanding, enabling the proactive detection of complex abuse patterns.
  • Drive agile engineering efforts to identify and mitigate novel abuse patterns, ensuring Google’s products remain engaged and safe in a shifting threat landscape.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software programming in Python, Java, or C++.
  • 1 year of experience in a core ML domain, such as generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), computer vision, speech/audio, reinforcement learning, recommendation systems, or ML infrastructure.
  • 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model training, model inference, model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

title: Production Operators
description:
Job Description

PRODUCTION OPERATOR- Grand Haven, MI

Pay Rate: $23.70

Shift: 2nd and 3rd -Overtime as needed

JOB FUNCTION – REQUIREMENTS – SUCCESS FACTORS

The Production Operator physically manufactures quality, powder coatings in support of PPG Industries, as a leader in the powder coatings market. The incumbent is responsible for the operation and maintenance of the facility’s manufacturing equipment and the quality of the product at every step of the manufacturing stage while meeting all safety requirements.

Requires: Successful completion of the employment selection process, and experience in a manufacturing environment. Must be able to operate a variety of industrial production related equipment, possess good math skills and mechanical ability, be flexible and willing to rotate work assignments readily, and be capable of forklift operation certification. High school diploma or equivalent is preferred.

Strong oral and written communication skills and interpersonal skills are essential. Must also possess problem solving skills, be capable of making logical decisions, and be capable of working without direct supervision and be focused on details and specification tolerances.

Success Factors: Prime Success Factors (focus on results, drive change, promote teamwork, build trust and respect, understand market & customer perspective) plus the following:

Excellent Attendance, concern for quality, maintain work area in good housekeeping condition, initiative, ability to learn and retain job knowledge, adaptability, productivity, and consistency. Teamwork, communication, and attention to detail are also essential.

Duties and Responsibilities: Operators will be assigned to any of the four areas below.

-Preassembly

Responsible for the weighing of raw material components according to a specific formula on a batch ticket. Raw materials must be retrieved from the storage area, hand weighed and then placed on a pallet after being clearly marked with the appropriate PPG Champ code. Pallets will then be moved to a staging area for processing.

-Mixing

Tends powder coating mixing machines that mixes the raw material. Ensures weigh out ingredients matches batch ticket and that raw materials have been weighed correctly. Loads the raw material mixes into appropriate container and mixes per normal operating procedures or instructions on batch ticket. Once mix has been completed, cleans mixers and states pre-mix for next operation. Completes information on machine activity on log sheets.

-Extrusion

Operates and cleans the extruder machinery to product specifications and extruder parameters. Reviews production order to ascertain product data such as product type, quantities and specifications of products. Sets the extruder parameters such % torque, feed rate and extrusion temperature according to written instructions. Monitors equipment to ensure that all parameters stay within specification. Reports machine failure to supervisor or manager. Completes information on machine activity on log sheets.

-Grinding or Milling

Operates milling equipment to grind product to customer specification by setting operating conditions per written instructions. Packages and labels finished product; disassembles, cleans and assembles mills and vibratory equipment, completes logs and other documentation timely and accurately. Maintains quality by obtaining samples at specified intervals during batch processing. Cleans and performs preventative maintenance on equipment between runs.

Quality

Operators must participate in the PPG Quality Process.

Safety

Works in a safe and effective manner to ensure personal safety and product quality. Must be current on all aspects of safety as detailed in the SOP’s.

Production Operators are also required to perform a variety of other general tasks related to the production of powder coating products as directed by supervision. (ie., housekeeping, attend team meetings as directed by the Team Facilitator or Management and/or other duties as assigned.)

Contact with Others:

Job requires routine contact with others to give or get information (ie., Technical Personnel, Maintenance, Production Operators, Staff, Visitors).

Work Environment:

Works in manufacturing, warehouse and/or lab areas. Incumbent will be required to lift and carry up to 55 lbs and move up to 320 lb drums with mechanical assistance. Stair and ladder climbing, standing for long periods of time, stooping and pulling occurs. Wearing approved safety equipment; including, safety glasses with side shields, steel- toed shoes, uniform, hard hat/bump cap, gloves, hearing protection and dust mask or respirator (when required) is a must. The environment is dusty, and the operator may get wet when cleaning equipment.

Equipment Utilized:

Lift Truck, Screw feeder, Sample Grinder, Grinding Mill, Scales, Hand Tools, Extruder, Hand Sieve, Rotary Sieve, Chill Belt, Pre-mixer, Truck Dock Equipment, Safety Equipment, Bar Coding equipment and other equipment as required for operating production.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer

Heb jij zin in een complexe IT-omgeving? Wil je met verschillende softwarecomponenten, tools en scripttalen werken? En ben je goed in troubleshooting of wil je dat worden? Dan moet je bij onze opdrachtgever Carerix zijn. Hier werk je als DevOps Engineer in een AWS-cloudomgeving.


Als u meer wilt weten over de vereisten voor deze functie, lees dan verder voor alle relevante informatie.

Samen met jouw 4 collega’s DevOps werk je afwisselend samen met de 4 agile remote developmentteams (samen zo’n 18 developers, verspreid over Europa, 2 in Rotterdam). De voertaal in het team is Engels.

Van die 4 developmentteams werkt er één aan de bestaande omgeving, waarin de core-applicatie draait, een Applicant Tracking Systeem (ATS). Drie teams werken aan de nieuwe omgeving.

In die nieuwe omgeving draaien de plugins van partners, de API’s, zoeken met AI, etc. Uiteindelijk (waarschijnlijk Q4 2026) gaat de core-applicatie ook naar de nieuwe omgeving. Beiden worden gehost bij Amazon.

De oude omgeving is feitelijk een datacentervirtualisatie. De nieuwe is een state-of-the-art IaaS-omgeving: serverless met microservices, gebruikmakend van Docker en Kubernetes. Daar bestaat je werk zeker voor 25% uit scripten in Bash en Python.

Eerlijk is eerlijk, op dit moment zal 80% van je werk nog gericht zijn op de oude omgeving, maar gaandeweg gaat dat dus verschuiven naar de nieuwe. Voor de klanten van Carerix is de core-applicatie hun primaire bedrijfssysteem, dat ook gekoppeld is aan hun website. Performance en uptime zijn dus absoluut key.Je zorgt er dan ook voor dat alle instanties en diensten high performant en beschikbaar zijn voor klanten en partners, en tevens zijn voorzien van de laatste updates.

Afwisselend met je directe collega’s heb je daarom regelmatig de 7-uur-in-de-ochtend-dienst (lekker vanuit huis natuurlijk), om voor het begin van de werkdag van de klant te kijken of alles nog goed werkt.

Daarnaast werk je samen met de developers aan nieuwe producten.

Je krijgt bij Carerix volop de ruimte om ontwikkelingen die je signaleert te vertalen naar verbetervoorstellen voor het platform en om je eigen innovatieve ideeën uit te voeren.

Zo heeft een van de DevOps engineers een eigen tool ontwikkeld voor het management en activatie van klantapplicaties die inmiddels breed in gebruik is binnen Carerix!

Wie zoeken wij voor Carerix?

Je voelt je verantwoordelijk voor alle taken die horen bij operations. Dus of je jezelf nou Systeem Beheerder, Cloud Engineer, Operations Engineer, DevOps Engineer of Site Reliability Engineer noemt, maakt ons niet zoveel uit. Als je het maar leuk vindt om die breedte op te pakken. Als je bij een incident roept “dat staat niet in mijn functie-omschrijving” gaat er een harde zoemer af ;-)

De juiste instelling en motivatie zijn voor Carerix belangrijker dan het hebben van diploma’s, IT-certificeringen of ervaring met specifieke technologieën. Sterker nog, “getrouwd zijn” met bepaalde technologieën is niet handig in een omgeving die aan verandering onderhevig is. De praktijk leert dat een mbo-4-niveau (dus geen diploma vereist), wel nodig is om deze job te kunnen handelen.

Carerix heeft – zoals je gelezen hebt - een hybride omgeving waar nu flink verbouwd wordt, terwijl de winkel natuurlijk open is. Dat levert soms complexe situaties op die om jouw creatieve oplossingen vragen.

Je snapt dat je in deze rol af en toe dingen buiten kantoortijden moet doen, zodat je klanten daar geen last van hebben. Dat komt in de praktijk één keer per week/twee weken voor. Vaak kun je dat gewoon vanuit huis doen.

Software componenten waarmee je gaat werken zijn:

  • Relationele databases (Carerix werkt met PostgreSQL)

Carerix zoekt iemand die:

  • Incidenten snel kan analyseren en oplossen
  • Makkelijk nieuwe software, tools en scripttalen leert
  • “Security aware” is (hoe zo jij het vinden als je cv op straat kwam te liggen?)
  • Weet wat netwerkprotocollen zijn en wat performance tuning is
  • Ervaring heeft met minimaal één scripttaal (Carerix gebruikt vooral Python en Bash) en één relationele database (Carerix gebruikt zelf PostgreSQL)
  • Goed Engels speekt en schrijft, de werktaal van het team
  • Een beetje Nederlands kan, fijn om te kunnen socializen met de andere collega’s op kantoor.

Carerix is een internationaal bedrijf dat zich sinds 2004 specialiseert in cloud-based recruitment software (Applicant Tracking System & Customer Relationship Management). Carerix vormt voor haar klanten het hart van hun recruitmentactiviteiten en is onmisbaar in het primaire bedrijfsproces. Carerix wordt toegepast binnen uitzenden, werving en selectie, detachering en corporate recruitment. Carerix heeft klanten in de Benelux (70%) en elders in Europa (30%).

Carerix is een snel groeiende organisatie van ongeveer 80 medewerkers en zo’n 15 miljoen euro omzet. Carerix kent een platte, transparante en ambitieuze organisatiestructuur met korte communicatielijnen. Collegialiteit en behulpzaamheid zijn kenmerkend voor de cultuur en staan hoog in het vaandel. Carerix is onderdeel van de Pixid Group (50 miljoen euro omzet).

Kom je bij Carerix werken? Dan krijg je ruimte voor initiatief en creativiteit om jezelf én Carerix een stap verder te krijgen. Elke week valt er genoeg te beleven en te leren. Het DevOps-team is een team dat elkaar écht wil helpen naar een hoger niveau. Carerix is een technisch bedrijf, dus je wordt voorzien van goede tools die je helpen bij je werk (een goede laptop en telefoon).

Natuurlijk krijg je ook goede arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de 5200 en 5700 euro dat past bij jouw ervaring, op basis van 40 uur per week.
  • Een kwartaalbonus gekoppeld aan je persoonlijke doelen, die varieert tussen de 300 en 600 euro .
  • Je start op een jaarcontract, dat na een jaar wordt omgezet in een vast contract, als je goed op je plek zit.
  • Bij voorkeur werk je fulltime (40 uur), maar 32 uur is bespreekbaar.
  • Hybride werken is - na je inwerktijd - de norm. De afspraak binnen het team is om op dinsdag en donderdag aanwezig te zijn in Rotterdam.
  • Reis je met de auto, dan vergoedt Carerix 0,23 eurocent per kilometer vanaf de eerste kilometer. OV-kosten worden volledig vergoed.
  • Informele werksfeer; je mag zijn wie je bent!
  • Concrete (door)groeimogelijkheden; je bent bij Carerix nooit uitgegroeid.
  • 25 vakantiedagen.
  • Aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling, waarbij de helft van de premie wordt betaald door Carerix

Sollicitatie

Mooie kans hè?! Als jij ervan overtuigd bent dat jij dé DevOps Engineer voor Carerix in Rotterdam bent: solliciteer nu.

Je toekomstige collega Jeroen Steenkamp is beschikbaar voor een informeel voorgesprek, voordat je besluit te solliciteren. Via mij kun je een afspraak met hem maken.

Na een videocall met mij, praat je eerst met technische collega’s en daarna met de CTO Eelco Bode en HR Manager Anna Versluis. Gaat dat ook goed, dan krijg je een aanbieding.

Heb je nog vragen over deze vacature van DevOps Engineer in Rotterdam?

  • stuur een mail aan
  • chat met Bas via video in zijn virtual meeting room op Whereby.
  • bekijk deze video voor een snelle impressie: een bezoek aan de website van e-people om nog meer video's te bekijken: hanteert en onderschrijft de NVP Sollicitatiecode bij al haar vacatures en is hierop dan ook aanspreekbaar. xgiwjmb

    Bas Westland, de consultant die deze vacature in behandeling heeft, onderschrijft de Recruitercode en is hierop aanspreekbaar.

title: Cardiovascular Technologist (CVT) - Cardiac Catheterization Lab - UW Medical Center-Montlake

Job Description

Job Posting Text

$10,000 Recruitment Incentive to eligible new employees

UW Medical Center - Montlake's Cath Lab has an outstanding opportunity for an CARDIOVASCULAR TECHNOLOGIST (CVT).


WORK SCHEDULE:

  • 100% FTE, Full-time, 40-hours-per-week

  • Day Shift, Monday-Friday, 7:00am – 5:30pm, with rotating day off

  • On-Call Shifts after regular department hours according to a monthly schedule


DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION:

The Cardiac Cath Lab at UW Medical Center – Montlake is a highly specialized procedural area providing advanced diagnostic and interventional cardiovascular care for adult patients with complex cardiac conditions. As a regional referral center and part of a nationally recognized academic medical center, the Cath Lab performs a broad range of procedures including diagnostic coronary angiography, percutaneous coronary interventions (PCI), chronic total occlusion (CTO), structural heart interventions, heart transplant care, adult congenital heart disease (ACHD) intervention, STEMI, Mechanical Circulatory Support (MCS), and emergent cardiac procedures. The Cath Lab team works collaboratively in a fast-paced environment to deliver safe, evidence-based, and patient-centered care.

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS:

  • Our team is one of the most experienced in the country in managing the risk of complex interventions

  • You will have access to the newest, least invasive therapies, unavailable at any other site in the region, including those not yet offered to the public

  • Work as part of a dynamic, comprehensive care team

  • Make a difference for the patients and employees we serve

  • Opportunity to provide career growth


PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Scrubbing, monitoring, and circulating complex interventional cardiology cases.

  • Effectively communicate with physicians and other staff about changes in the patient’s condition, including hemodynamic monitoring and symptomatology. May participate in performance improvement and CQI activities within the department.

  • Case types include all complex coronary (PCI, CTO, Brachy), structural heart (TAVR, TMVR, Mitraclip, Tricuspid clip, LAAO, ASD/PFO/VSD, etc.), heart failure/transplant (Biopsies, RHC, Impella, Tandem, ECMO, IABP) and adult-congenital procedures


REQUIREMENTS:

  • Associate of Arts (AA) degree from an accredited Interventional Cardiovascular Technologist (CVT) program AND registration by Cardiovascular Credentialing International (CCI) AND Licensure by the State of Washington as a Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist (CIS)


OR

  • Associate of Arts (AA) degree from an accredited Radiologic Technologist program AND Registration by the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) AND Licensure by the State of Washington as a Radiologic Technologist (RT)

The UW Medical Center-Montlake campus is located on the edge of the beautiful UW campus which includes many amenities available to our staff as well as very convenient public transit options including the Sound Transit’s light rail station across the street.

Excellence. Exploration. Education.

UW Medicine’s mission is to improve the health of the public by advancing medical knowledge, providing outstanding primary and specialty care to the people of the region, and preparing tomorrow’s physicians, scientists and other health professionals.

All across UW Medicine, our employees collaborate to perform the highest quality work with integrity and compassion and to create a respectful, welcoming environment where every patient, family, student and colleague is valued and honored. Nearly 29,000 healthcare professionals, researchers, and educators work in the UW Medicine family of organizations that includes: Harborview Medical Center, UW Medical Center - Montlake, UW Medical Center - Northwest, UW Medicine Primary Care, UW Physicians, UW School of Medicine, and Airlift Northwest.

title: University Intern, Disputes & Economics - Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

This position supports the Ankura Disputes & Economics Business Group - one of six practices focused on client delivery services across the Firm.

Practice Overview:

The Healthcare & Life Sciences practice focuses on assisting healthcare and life science clients and their counsel in addressing the issues associated with complex disputes, investigations, regulatory and compliance, and technology services. Our practice professionals have a thorough understanding of the issues facing a broad range of clients in the healthcare industry including but not limited to provider, payer, and pharmacy clients. We bring the deep industry knowledge and experience necessary to assist these clients with their most pressing and sensitive matters.

  • Ankura’s provider team has experience assisting hospitals, long term care centers, outpatient and diagnostic centers, DME providers, home health agencies, hospice centers and their legal counsel to provide effective solutions for their most complex litigation and compliance issues.

  • Ankura’s payer team brings a combination of compliance, operations, audit, clinical coding, data analytics, financial, valuation, and systems professionals to support payer executives and their counsel with regulatory compliance, operations, disputes, investigations, and transaction support and due diligence.

  • Ankura’s pharmacy team assists counsel across the entire spectrum of pharmacy benefits, including retail, hospital, and specialty pharmacies; distributors; pharmacy benefit managers; and plan sponsors. Our expertise includes: the quantification of financial exposure through analytic and statistical methods; prescription drug claims submission and payment; pharmacy benefit administration; Medicare Part D compliance; and the preparation of expert and consultative reports shared with prosecutors or used in commercial litigation.

Role Overview: Summer Interns, working as part of a project team, perform critical, value-added work that directly impact a client’s bottom line. You may be involved in projects supporting our provider, payer or pharmacy clients with disputes, investigations, regulatory and compliance, or technology services related issues.

Responsibilities:

  • Developing and performing financial, accounting, economic, and statistical analyses

  • Providing detailed fact finding, research and analysis

  • Developing computer models including detailed and complex spreadsheet analyses

  • Assisting with data gathering activities including document review, research, and quality control of data entry activities and preparation of expert reports and exhibits

  • Demonstrating proper documentation of analysis

  • Providing excellent client service.

Requirements:

Candidates should be top academic performers, be interested in the consulting industry, and meet the following criteria:

  • Pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree with an expected graduation date between December 2027 to August 2028, with a major in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Statistics or Public Policy.

  • A cumulative GPA of 3.2 or better.

  • Interest in the healthcare industry.

  • Interested in working with large data sets and developing analytical models.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Creative problem-solving ability and a collaborative, consultancy mindset.

  • Ability to multi-task and effectively prioritize tasks.

  • Highly motivated, driven, and dynamic attitude towards work and career.

  • Ability to excel within a team environment.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; familiarity with Microsoft Access, SQL, or statistical packages such as R, SAS, SPSS.

  • Ability to work overtime or travel as requested.

  • Please note that this role requires permanent authorization to work in the U.S. (i.e. U.S. citizen or permanent resident). Internships and full-time University Associate roles are not eligible for U.S. immigration sponsorship, work visa or any other temporary work authorization (i.e. OPT, CPT).

Ankura is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. A reasonable estimate of the current payrate for this internship is: $34/hr.

TU Delft (Delft University of Technology)

title: Commercial Operations Leadership Graduate
description:
Salary: £33,000, Permanent role.
Start date: September 2027

Location: Based within the Anglian Water Cambridgeshire area. Please note your placements and final role may vary across the region and departments, so flexibility is essential.

Join our Commercial Operations Leadership Graduate Programme and be at the heart of the services that keep water flowing and our business running.

With a plan worth over £11 billion of investment, we're building for better — for you, for the communities we serve, for our environment. As part of this we are looking for you to join Anglian Water's Graduate Programme and tackle some of the biggest environmental and infrastructure challenges facing the region. From climate resilience and major engineering projects to digital innovation and customer experience, you'll develop the skills, experience and support needed to become one of our future leaders or specialists.

Your career path

The water industry is changing rapidly, creating exciting opportunities for the next generation of talent. At Anglian Water, you'll work on real challenges that matter, developing expertise across your chosen profession while contributing to projects that support customers, communities and the environment.

You'll learn from experienced colleagues, take on meaningful responsibility and build the skills, knowledge and confidence to shape your future career, while helping us shape the future of water.

To find out more from our recent graduates please visit our Anglian Water careers page: Graduates - Anglian Water Careers.

Professional Development & Memberships

We're committed to helping you build a career, not just gain a job. Through our two-year graduate programme, you'll experience different placements, work on real business challenges and learn from experienced colleagues across the organisation. You'll have access to a wide range of development opportunities, support towards professional qualifications and funded membership of a relevant professional institution, helping you grow your expertise and achieve professional accreditation where appropriate.

Your programme

Working within Central Services, you'll be part of a team that delivers safe, efficient and cost-effective services across Anglian Water. Supporting colleagues throughout the business, Central Services plays a critical role in enabling the delivery of our business plan objectives and ensuring our people, assets and operations can perform at their best.

What you could be involved with:

  • Supporting the delivery of capital investment projects, including project management activities and urgent infrastructure schemes.

  • Working with asset maintenance teams to ensure our facilities and operational assets remain safe, reliable and effective.

  • Contributing to facilities and estates projects, helping manage workplaces, accommodation and maintenance services across the region.

  • Supporting fleet operations, ensuring vehicles, plant and equipment are available, compliant and ready to support frontline teams.

  • Working alongside logistics teams responsible for warehousing, materials management, emergency response activities and regional distribution services.

  • Collaborating with colleagues and external partners to deliver services that support operational performance and business objectives.

Through rotational placements across key services, this graduate programme offers a unique opportunity to understand the breadth of services that underpin Anglian Water's operations while developing the skills, knowledge and experience needed to build a successful career within the business.

What you will bring

We are looking for people who are curious, ambitious and ready to learn. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, working collaboratively and bringing different perspectives to the challenges we face. Most importantly, we're looking for graduates who want to help shape the future of water while developing a successful and rewarding career of their own. We welcome applicants who are excited about technology products and passionate about the water industry.

For this role, you’ll need to have obtained in the last 3 years or be studying towards a minimum 2:2 in any degree discipline and have graduated by September 2027 for the 2027 intake.

Benefits

Alongside a competitive salary, you'll receive a comprehensive health and wellbeing package, private healthcare, 26 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, and a double-matched pension scheme with up to 21% total contribution. We also offer an excellent family leave package, including enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave, helping you balance your career with the moments that matter most.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
Location: Letterkenny (Hybrid 2-3 days p/week in office)

Working Hours: 1pm-9pm

Are you interested in building capabilities that enable the organization with innovation, speed, agility, scalability and efficiency? The Global Technology team takes great pride in our culture where digital transformation is built into our DNA! When you join our organization at Prudential, you’ll unlock an exciting and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading financial services institutions.

Your Team

As a Senior Business Systems Analyst on/in Digital Experience Journey, you will partner with product owners, tech leads, designers, engineers and delivery professionals to improve MYPRU & IDEX applications. This role will specifically support authenticated customer experiences and authentication capabilities. You will act as the primary interface between Technology and specific business areas, identifying business unit requirements, creating project and process specifications, coordinating with project teams, and ensuring adherence to schedules and budgets to solve sophisticated business problems, deploy innovative products, services and experiences to delight our customers! In addition to applied analytical and technical experience, you will bring excellent problem solving, communication and teamwork skills, along with agile ways of working, strong business insight, an inclusive leadership attitude and a continuous learning focus to all that you do.

Here is What You Can Expect on a Typical Day

  • Support the Director Business Systems Analyst and Product Owner setting ambitious and clear product vision, and communicating ‘the story’ effectively to key stakeholders and the rest of the team Beginning to identify opportunities to provide input to the team & coach others with occasional guidance

  • Works on solving extremely complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangible variables

  • Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact

  • Partner with compliance, UX, engineering, operations, and customer service teams to define secure, customer-friendly authentication experiences across web and mobile journeys.

  • Create current-state and future-state journey maps, process flows, decision trees, API/data-flow documentation, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability matrices to support delivery of authenticated digital experiences.

  • Use production incident trends, customer feedback, analytics, authentication failure data, and service metrics to identify root causes, prioritize improvements, and strengthen the end-to-end login and authenticated experience.

  • Work on significant and unique issues where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangible variables and may impact future concepts, products or technologies

  • Works on extremely complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of often complex variables related to technology and/or data. Exercises independent judgment in developing methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy from inception and determine business value once solution enters production

  • Ensure alignment of product features and stories, i.e., review, give feedback, and prioritize user stories in line with product vision

  • Understands the vision and owns aspects of the product management/roadmap activities

The Skills & Expertise You Bring

  • Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering; Analytics or experience in related fields

  • Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)

  • Knowledge of business concepts, tools and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business

  • Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges

  • Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills

  • Experience supporting authenticated digital applications such as customer dashboards, profile/contact management, secure document access, alerts, transactional servicing, and cross-platform customer journeys.

  • Ability to translate authentication business needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, negative scenarios, operational controls, and measurable success metrics such as login success rate, abandonment, failure reason, call reduction, and customer effort.

  • Familiarity with APIs, event logging, data mapping, system integrations, browser/mobile authentication behaviours, and testing approaches needed to validate secure, reliable, and accessible authenticated experiences.

  • Applied experience and/or expertise with several of the following:

    • Product Management: Planning, Progress Monitoring and Status Reporting, including visualization of works; Scaling Agile – Organizing, synchronizing multiple teams setup Estimations, ROI, project life cycle

    • Effective Communication: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Ability to facilitate dialogue at the right level of detail for all members of the Agile team.

    • Decision-Making & Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

    • Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.

    • Interpersonal Relationships: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner. Ability to work seamlessly with business partners and software developers alike in a liaison role.

    • Financial Acumen: Knowledge of understanding of financial concepts, tools and processes and how financial metrics are used to monitor and drive outcomes. Includes understanding of company accounts/metrics (ex: balance sheet, profit/loss, cash flow, budget & forecast).

    • Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

  • Preferred qualifications: experience with authenticated customer portals, customer journey mapping, production incident analysis, and financial services or insurance digital servicing.

You’ll Love Working Here Because You Can

Join a team and culture where your voice matters; where every day, your work transforms our experiences to make lives better. As you put your skills to use, we’ll help you make an even bigger impact with learning experiences that can grow your technical AND leadership capabilities. You’ll be surprised by what this rock-solid organization has in store for you.

title: Cat Scan Technologist (CT)

Contributes to the Hospital’s mission to care, heal and to excel in service to our community by independently performing Computerized Tomography (CT) examinations meeting ACR imaging standards and maintaining safety standards using state-of-the-art CT scanners, power injectors, PACS, and other related medical imaging equipment. title: Director, Supply Chain Resilience
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron Technology leads the world in innovating memory and storage solutions. These solutions accelerate turning information into intelligence. They encourage the world to learn, communicate, and advance faster than ever.

The Global Procurement team drives Micron’s growth by delivering outstanding total cost management and supply chain resilience. They use innovative predictive tools, risk analysis, and emphasize sustainability and diversity. Join Micron's Global Procurement group as the Director of Supply Chain Resilience. You will play a central role in improving Micron’s global supply chain strength and crafting the future of the semiconductor supplier ecosystem. This is a powerful opportunity to lead pivotal initiatives that protect critical supply, support long-term ecosystem growth, and establish Micron as a leader in supply chain resilience.

You will lead a distributed team responsible for supply risk mapping, market intelligence, supporting sub-tier engagement strategy, and geopolitical risk management. Working closely with Procurement leaders and collaborators across the enterprise, you will help strengthen Micron's long-term supply assurance, resilience, and competitive advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct worldwide efforts to enhance Micron's supply resilience and long-term supply assurance strategy.

  • Develop and maintain detailed supply chain mapping and concentration risk evaluations across N-tier suppliers for critical materials, equipment, and assembly and test services.

  • Conduct geopolitical and macroeconomic risk assessments and translate findings into actionable supply resilience strategies.

  • Establish and report supply resilience metrics, supply assurance benchmarks, and value-at-risk/value-protected measures to provide executive leadership with insight into emerging risks, mitigation efficiency, and overall resilience performance.

  • Strengthen market intelligence capabilities to identify emerging supply risks, technology shifts, capacity constraints, and strategic opportunities across the semiconductor ecosystem over a 5+ year horizon.

  • Collaborate with category teams to ensure sustained availability of essential materials, equipment, components, and manufacturing capacity.

  • Partner cross-functionally to develop geographically diversified and domestic supplier ecosystems that reduce geopolitical, trade, capacity concentration, and supply disruption risks while strengthening long-term supply resilience.

  • Develop and maintain disruption response playbooks addressing geopolitical events, trade restrictions, export controls, natural disasters, and various supply chain disruption situations.

  • Lead virtual war rooms and executive response activities during significant supply disruptions and business continuity incidents.

  • Foster the implementation of advanced analytics, digital innovations, and AI-supported solutions to improve supply visibility, risk identification, scenario planning, and decision-making within multi-tier supply networks.

Leadership Expectations

  • Act as a strategic leader with a point of view and trusted advisor to executive leadership on supply resilience and ecosystem development priorities.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and proactive risk management.

  • Build positive relationships across functions to accelerate decision-making and execution.

  • Develop and mentor talent while strengthening organizational capabilities in risk management, supply resilience, and market intelligence.

  • Champion continuous improvement and guidelines across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or comparable experience in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

  • 10+ years of experience leading complex supply chain, procurement, strategy, operations, or risk management initiatives.

  • Demonstrated experience leading global cross-functional teams and driving strategic business outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of semiconductor supply chains, manufacturing ecosystems, and critical supplier markets.

  • Proven experience assessing and handling supply chain risk, geopolitical exposure, and business continuity challenges, including crisis and disruption response.

  • Outstanding leadership and program management skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse senior collaborators around critical initiatives.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills.

  • Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for process improvements, including the thoughtful use of AI-enabled tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience in semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, technology, industrial, materials, or capital equipment industries.

  • Deep understanding of critical minerals, advanced materials, semiconductor equipment, and technology supply chains.

  • Proficiency in strategic foresight, geopolitical risk evaluation, and market intelligence to detect early warning indicators, assess potential disruption scenarios, and promote proactive supply chain resilience planning.

  • Experience building supply resilience frameworks and enterprise risk management programs.

  • Proven experience implementing digital, analytics, and AI-powered solutions to enhance supply visibility and decision-making.

title: AVP, Investments
description:
About Us

We’re not like other insurance companies. From our specialty products to our business model, our culture to our results — we’re different. Different is who we are, and how we work, interact, deliver and succeed together. Creating a different and better insurance experience doesn’t just happen. It takes focus and a shared passion for going beyond the expected to forge relationships and deliver care that makes a difference. This approach rises from and is supported by our talented, ethical and smart team of employee owners united around a single purpose: to work alongside our customers and partners when they need us, in unexpected ways, with exceptional results. Apply today to make a difference with us.

RLI is a Glassdoor Best Places to Work company with a strong, successful background. For decades, our financial track record has been stellar — a testament to our culture and validation of our reputation as an excellent underwriting company.

Position Purpose

Under general direction and with significant independence, leads the company's investment function and develops and delivers investment results for the company's property and casualty insurance general account and surplus assets. Develops and executes portfolio strategy, asset allocation, implementation, risk oversight, outside investment manager relationships, and reporting across all asset classes appropriate for an insurance company. Develops surplus growth strategies and income opportunities while balancing capital preservation, liquidity, liability characteristics, regulatory requirements, and risk tolerances.

Partners with Treasury, Accounting, Finance, Actuarial, Enterprise Risk, and other stakeholders to align investment strategy with the company's liquidity, capital, liability, and financial objectives. The role has significant flexibility and independent judgment in how investment objectives are developed and executed and presents strategy, results, risks, outlook, and recommendations to senior management and the Board of Directors.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop, recommend, and execute investment strategy for property and casualty general account and surplus assets, including asset allocation, duration, credit quality, liquidity, income, and total return objectives, consistent with investment policy and the company's capital, liability, and liquidity requirements.

  • Independently identify, evaluate, and implement investment opportunities across all appropriate asset classes, including surplus growth and income strategies, while balancing expected return, capital preservation, liquidity, liability characteristics, regulatory requirements, and risk tolerances.

  • Monitor portfolio performance, market and credit risk, liquidity, concentration, compliance, and GAAP and Statutory implications; conduct scenario analysis and recommend timely portfolio actions.

  • Select and oversee outside investment managers, consultants, custodians, and other investment partners; establish and evaluate mandates, performance expectations, fees, guidelines, compliance, risk, and organizational changes.

  • Use FactSet, Bloomberg, BondEdge, and related systems for market research, portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk analysis, forecasting, management reporting, and data integrity.

  • Develop investment reporting, analysis, and recommendations for senior management and the Board of Directors regarding portfolio strategy, performance, risk, market conditions, and outlook.

  • Partner with Treasury to align investment portfolio positioning with enterprise liquidity, funding, and capital requirements, and collaborate with Accounting, Finance, Actuarial, Enterprise Risk, rating agencies, and other stakeholders regarding investment strategy and results.

  • Oversee adherence to the company's investment policies and guidelines and recommend changes to investment policy, guidelines, limits, or governance practices based on market conditions, portfolio needs, regulatory requirements, and company objectives.

  • Provide leadership and direction for investment staff, including establishing priorities, developing capabilities and talent, and ensuring effective execution of the company's investment strategy.

Education & Experience

  • Typically requires a bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible investment management experience

  • Direct experience managing property and casualty insurance company general account assets, with accountability for portfolio strategy, implementation, and performance.

  • CFA designation and/or MBA preferred.

  • [OR] equivalent level of education and experience

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies

  • Broad understanding of all asset classes appropriate for an insurance company, including public and private fixed income, cash and short-term investments, public equities, real estate, private markets, and alternatives permitted by investment policy.

  • Strong knowledge of property and casualty insurer investment considerations, including asset-liability management, liquidity, capital preservation, statutory and GAAP accounting, regulation, and rating agency considerations.

  • Advanced proficiency with FactSet, Bloomberg, and BondEdge or equivalent systems is desired; advanced Microsoft Excel skills are also required.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop surplus growth strategies and identify sustainable income opportunities while managing risk and liquidity.

  • Experience evaluating and overseeing outside investment managers, including due diligence, mandate design, performance review, fee assessment, and relationship management.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the presence and judgment to present complex investment matters clearly and confidently to senior management and the Board of Directors.

  • Demonstrated executive judgment, initiative, and accountability; ability to independently develop recommendations, make investment decisions within delegated authority, and deliver portfolio results with limited supervision.

  • Ability to synthesize data, solve complex problems, make well-supported decisions, and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Compensation Overview

The base salary range for the position is listed below. Please note that the base salary is only one component of our robust total rewards package at RLI. The salary offered will take into account a number of factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, scope & responsibilities of the role, qualifications/credentials, talent availability & specialization, as well as business needs. The below range may be modified in the future.

Base Pay Range

$137,855.00 - $204,714.00

Total Rewards

At RLI, we're all owners. We hire the best and the brightest employees and allow them to share in the company's success through our Total Rewards. With the Employee Stock Ownership plan at its core, the Total Rewards program includes all compensation, benefits and perks that come with being an RLI employee.

Financial Incentives

  • Annual bonus plans

  • Employee stock ownership plan (ESOP)

  • 401(k) — automatic 3% company contribution

  • Annual 401k and ESOP profit-sharing contributions (Up to 15% of eligible earnings)

Work & Life

  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays

  • Paid volunteer time off (VTO) to support our communities

  • Parental and family care leave

  • Flexible & hybrid work arrangements

  • Fitness center discounts and free virtual fitness platform

  • Employee assistance program

Health & Wellness

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Flexible spending and health savings accounts

  • 2x base salary for group life and AD&D insurance

  • Voluntary life, critical illness, & accident insurance for purchase

  • Short-term and long-term disability benefits

Personal & Professional Growth

RLI encourages its employees to pursue professional development work in insurance and job-related areas. We make a commitment to employees to provide educational opportunities that help them enhance their skills and further their career advancement. RLI fosters a true learning culture and encourages professional growth through insurance courses, in-house training and other educational programs. RLI covers the cost for most programs and employees typically earn a bonus upon successful completion of approved courses and certifications. Our personal and professional growth benefits include:

  • Training & certification opportunities

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Education bonuses

Diversity & Inclusion

Our goal is to attract, develop and retain the best employee talent from diverse backgrounds while promoting an environment where all viewpoints are valued and individuals feel respected, are treated fairly, and have an opportunity to excel in their chosen careers. We actively support, and participate in, initiatives led by the American Property Casualty Insurance Association that aim to increase diversity in the insurance industry. Cultivating an exceptional and diverse workforce to deliver excellent customer service reinforces our culture and is a key to achieving superior business results.

RLI is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Systems Engineer I
description:
Sierra Space Careers:

At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role

The Systems Engineer I contributes to the development and implementation of advanced system solutions by providing alignment and connection to the technical team throughout the product development lifecycle. The Systems Engineer I represents the viewpoint of the integrated whole during system development and works to glue segments and subsystems together via top-down decomposition of stakeholder requirements, traceability through development artifacts, and bottom-up validation and verification of the system. They help to shepherd the team through technical development milestones, track performance measures and identify technical risks to arrive at a compliant and cohesive system solution. The Systems Engineer I should have a basic understanding of Systems Engineering principles as they build expertise on specific systems engineering skills such as requirements management, system architecture development, concept of operation definition, system integration and system verification.

In this role, you will specify, architect, and integrate complex system solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and objectives. You will derive, decompose, allocate, trace, and manage system requirements and architectures to ensure alignment with project goals. Additionally, you will support development milestone reviews by creating artifacts and deliverables, and participate in system integration and verification activities to ensure system functionality and performance. Identifying and managing technical risks and developing mitigation strategies will be a key aspect of your responsibilities, as will adhering to established engineering processes and standards. Furthermore, you will communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders to ensure project alignment and successful execution.

About You

Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Requires Bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree).
  • Typically entry-level 0 - 2 years of experience.
  • Basic knowledge and understanding of systems design and development principles.
  • Ability to work in a team and follow instructions from senior engineers.
  • Ability to clearly communicate verbally and in writing.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Practical understanding of Systems Engineering principles and practices, including a basic understanding of the systems development lifecycle.
  • Experience with Requirements Management and Model Based Systems Engineering tools, such as DOORS, CAMEO EA, Rhapsody, Matlab, and SysML.
  • Experience with risk management, technical performance tracking, systems integration, and system verification and validation.
  • Familiarity with technical baseline and configuration management.
  • Experience or certification in INCOSE standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
  • Participated in 2026 SS Intern Academy.

Compensation:

Pay Range:

$77,685.00 - $106,816.50

Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness.

Elevate Your Career

At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations.


We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more.

Sierra Space is an industry-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space-based assets and enable space exploration.

Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure, Capacity and Demand
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

This team develops software to optimize the design, planning, deployment, and decommissioning of cluster layouts for Google data centers. Our fleet consumes as much power as the entire city of San Francisco, so we're handling a number of fun, open-ended, and challenging problems to optimize rack placement, reduce our environmental impact, and save Google money.

In this role, you will drive the planning to deploy all the machine racks and network racks across our data centers. You will be responsible for efficiently deploying these resources in the optimal configuration for our customers across various product areas (YouTube, Search, Ads, etc.) at Alphabet and for all our external customers supported by Google Cloud. Additionally, you will use AI to automate rack placement at Google's data centers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

As the Bioresources Permit Control Officer, you’ll oversee the complete lifecycle of the permit-to-work (PTW) process for high-risk activities, such as; hot work, confined space entry, and electrical isolations. title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
DeepLight AI is a specialist AI and data consultancy dedicated to helping organisations turn complex data into secure, scalable, and actionable business capability. Based in the UAE, DeepLight partners with clients across a range of industries to design and deliver tailored data, analytics, and AI solutions.

DeepLight does not take a one-size-fits-all approach. We work with clients to understand their business context, existing technology landscape, and strategic goals, then design solutions that integrate effectively into their enterprise architecture. From building robust data foundations to enabling advanced analytics and AI platforms, we help clients create practical, high-impact intelligent systems that are secure, scalable, and aligned to business value.

We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer who thrives at the intersection of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, and team leadership. If you love solving complex data challenges, setting engineering benchmarks, and shaping real-world solutions directly with clients, this is your stage.

The Opportunity

As a Lead Data Engineer, you will be the primary technical authority driving data engineering for high-profile client engagements. This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role where you will design production-grade platforms, elevate engineering quality, and mentor the next generation of talent.

You’ll be leading by example - balancing rapid delivery with long-term engineering rigor, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and serving as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

Drive End-to-End Delivery

  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade data pipelines, lakehouses, and analytics-ready datasets
  • Turn complex business problems into clear technical designs, delivery roadmaps, and actionable engineering tasks
  • Stay hands-on: solve tough technical challenges, perform code reviews, and jump in on production issue resolution

Raise the Engineering Bar

Inspire & Influence
