  • Partner directly with client architects, data scientists, and business leaders, translating complex technical choices into clear business value

As an AI consultancy, our greatest asset is the expertise of our people. While technical mastery is the foundation of what we do, the ability to bridge the gap between complex data science and actionable business value is what defines your success with Deeplight. We’re looking for individuals who are not only world‑class in their fields of specialism, but also compelling communicators and persuasive advocates for their own skills. You will be the face of our firm, tasked with building trust, articulating the "why" behind your technical decisions, and effectively "selling" your vision to high-level stakeholders. If you thrive on the challenge of presenting cutting‑edge solutions as much as you do on building them, you will fit right in.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL with a proven track record of delivering end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines and scalable data architectures
  • Hands‑on expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) and deep proficiency in platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, BigQuery, or Redshift
  • Deep understanding of data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming vs. batch processing, orchestration, and production monitoring
  • Solid grasp of data privacy, access control, encryption, schema management, and enterprise data quality frameworks
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to navigate client environments, guide stakeholders, and balance delivery pace with technical quality
  • Strong understanding of how robust data engineering enables advanced analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI applications

Why Join DeepLight AI?

  • Lead critical, high‑visibility engineering initiatives across top‑tier client environments
  • Work with cutting‑edge cloud and AI technologies in a collaborative, fast‑evolving consultancy environment
  • Join a team that values technical mastery, pragmatic leadership, and continuous innovation

Benefits

The benefits you’ll enjoy as part of this role include:

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive personal health insurance
  • Full Individual Visa Sponsorship
  • Professional development and certification support
  • Subscription reimbursement relating to your role
  • Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI projects
  • Monthly Employee Incentive program
  • Career advancement opportunities in a rapidly growing AI company

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI implementation while working with a talented team of professionals at the forefront of technological innovation. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in driving our company's success in delivering transformative AI solutions to our clients.

At DeepLight AI, we recognise that diversity drives innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where individuals with different thinking styles can thrive and contribute their unique strengths to our specialised AI and data solutions.

Our goal is to ensure our application and interview process is accessible, predictable, and fair for all candidates.

If you require any specific adjustments to the application process, or if you require any reasonable adjustments should you be successful in being processed to the interview stage, please do let us know. This information will be kept strictly confidential and will not impact hiring decisions.

title: Silicon Micro-architecture Design Lead, Google Cloud
description:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will join a team developing Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs) to accelerate machine learning computation in data centers. You will collaborate with Architecture, Verification, Power and Performance, and Physical Design teams to specify and deliver quality designs for next-generation accelerators. You will solve technical problems through micro-architecture innovation and evaluate design trade-offs between performance and power.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

  • Lead a team of Engineers in the design organization to deliver complex IPs or Subsystems. Communicate and work with multi-disciplined and multi-site teams.
  • Define micro-architecture (uArch) specifications and block-level design documents, including interface protocols, block diagrams, transaction flows, and pipeline details.
  • Perform RTL development, subsystem integration, and System on a Chip (SoC) integration, as well as Lint, CDC, FV, and UPF checks.
  • Participate in simulation debug, synthesis, timing and power closure, and silicon bring-up.
  • Participate in test plan and coverage analysis of the block and SOC-level verification.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in ASIC/SoC development with Verilog/SystemVerilog.
  • Experience in micro-architecture and design of IPs and Subsystems.
  • Experience in ASIC/SoC design verification, synthesis, timing/power analysis, and Design for Testing (DFT).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience with coding languages (e.g., Python or Perl).
  • Experience in System on a Chip (SoC) designs and integration flows.
  • Knowledge of arithmetic units, bus architectures, processor design, accelerators, or memory hierarchies.
  • Knowledge of high-performance and low-power design techniques.

title: Senior Commercial Analyst, Supply Chain
description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 347 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ approximately 13,000 people and operate in 60 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.

What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities May Include:

  • Lead comprehensive financial analysis, including profitability reviews, variance analysis, and financial modelling, to support business decisions and optimize performance.
  • Prepare and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets and forecasts, ensuring accuracy and alignment with strategic business goals.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., supply chain, commercial, sales) to provide actionable insights that enhance financial decision-making and operational outcomes.
  • Provide analytical support for business case development, cost analysis, and evaluation of strategic initiatives to ensure informed decision-making.
  • Drive process improvements by supporting the implementation and optimization of financial tools, automation efforts, and standardized processes.
  • Perform post-investment reviews to assess the performance of strategic initiatives and recommend corrective actions where needed.
  • support efforts to improve reporting, forecasting, and financial data quality, ensuring timely and accurate consolidation of financial information.
  • Support ad-hoc financial analysis and special projects, including pricing strategies, cost savings initiatives, and performance tracking, to drive business improvements.

As the Senior Commercial Analyst - Supply Chain, you'll be the primary Finance Business Partner to our Supply Chain function, working with the New Zealand Supply Chain Leadership Team and helping shape key operational and strategic decisions. Acting as the link between Finance and Operations, you'll provide commercial insight and financial leadership across a complex supply chain environment.


About the role

This role directly influences how our supply chain performs today and how it evolves for the future. We're looking for a commercially minded finance professional who thrives at the intersection of finance and operations.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning activities for Supply Chain

  • Delivering insight into productivity, labour, transport, and network costs

  • Developing financial models, commercial cases and investment evaluations

  • Providing detailed performance analysis and variance commentary

  • Supporting strategic projects

  • Identifying opportunities to improve operational and financial performance

  • Partnering with leaders to solve business challenges and support informed decision making


What success looks like


In this role, you'll:

  • Build trusted relationships with Supply Chain leaders and become their first point of contact for financial guidance

  • Bring clarity to complex operational and financial information

  • Challenge thinking constructively and influence decision making through evidence based recommendations

  • Translate data into practical insights that improve business performance

  • Manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes with minimal supervision

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement


About you

You'll be an experienced commercial finance professional who enjoys working closely with operational stakeholders and influencing business outcomes.

Essential experience

  • CA, CPA or equivalent accounting qualification

  • Strong commercial finance, FP&A or business partnering background

  • Experience supporting operational leaders in a complex environment

  • Advanced Excel and financial modelling capability skills

  • Strong budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis experience

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management ability

Highly desirable

  • Supply chain, logistics, manufacturing or operations finance experience

  • Experience supporting capital projects and investment decisions

  • Exposure to Power BI & SAP and BW

  • Experience analysing operational cost drivers such as labour, transport and productivity

If you're looking for a role where you can apply commercial thinking, influence outcomes and make a tangible impact on business performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Remote Type

Hybrid Remote

Skills to succeed in the role

Adaptability, Budget Management, Business Case Development, Cost Analysis, Empathy, Experimentation, Financial Advising, Financial Analysis, Financial Forecasting, Financial Modeling, Financial Reporting and Analysis, Process Improvements, Taking Ownership, Teamwork, Understand Customers, Variance Analysis

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Klaar om impact te maken met automatisering en cloudtechnologie?

Als DevOps Engineer bij Team EIFFEL bouw je aan slimme CI/CD pipelines, automatiseer je infrastructuur en adviseer je klanten over moderne DevOps strategieën. Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in verschillende sectoren, waar je continu verbetert en vernieuwt. Of je je wilt verdiepen in cloudtechnologie of juist jouw brede DevOps expertise verder wilt uitbouwen: bij ons bepaal jij je route.

Dit ga je doen

Als DevOps Engineer werk je binnen onze Business Unit Technology aan uiteenlopende projecten. Je maakt deel uit van een team van 30 IT consultants en werkt voor verschillende soorten organisaties. Dat betekent afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en veel ruimte om je technische én adviesvaardigheden in te zetten. Je schakelt intensief met development en operations teams en speelt een belangrijke rol in het vormgeven van moderne DevOps werkwijzen. Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van CI/CD pipelines voor diverse projecten.
  • Automatiseren van infrastructuur met tools zoals Terraform, Ansible of Pulumi.
  • Beheren en optimaliseren van cloudomgevingen, zoals Azure en AWS.
  • Adviseren van klanten over DevOps strategieën en best practices.
  • Monitoren en verbeteren van security en compliance binnen DevOps processen.
  • Samenwerken met development en operations teams om een cultuur van Continuous Improvement te stimuleren.

Je bent fit for the job als je...

Je hebt ruime ervaring als DevOps Engineer en voelt je thuis in een dynamische consultancy omgeving. Je kent containertechnologieën en cloudplatformen door en door en schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek en advies. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden weet je klanten helder mee te nemen in keuzes, oplossingen en best practices. Je wilt blijven groeien, nieuwe technieken ontdekken en werkt graag in omgevingen waar je impact maakt.

Harde eisen:

  • Hbo opleiding richting business IT & management of een vergelijkbare studie.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als DevOps Engineer binnen consultancy of een vergelijkbare dynamische omgeving.
  • Diepgaande kennis van Docker en Kubernetes, sterke ervaring met Azure en goede scriptingvaardigheden (bijv. Python, Bash).

Zachte eisen:

  • Je hebt ervaring met Infrastructure as Code en configuratiemanagement en zet dit effectief in.
  • Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (minimaal C1 niveau).
  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen klantvragen, technische uitdagingen en adviesrollen.

For international candidates: our consultants must be able to communicate in Dutch at a minimum of C1 level, both spoken and written.

Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 6.000 en 7.800 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en relevante certificaten. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot meer dan 950 trainingen en cursussen die je onbeperkt kunt volgen.

Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in een inspirerende consultancy omgeving waar je niet sectorgebonden bent. Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je samen met 75 consultants, waarvan 30 IT consultants in jouw directe team. De sfeer is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist

Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is Team EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is. Of je nu werkt voor een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis: jij helpt teams slimmer werken en brengt ideeën van papier naar praktijk. Soms voor grote transformaties, soms voor snelle oplossingen. Van startup tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je met 75 consultants verdeeld over drie specialisaties: Data & Analytics, IT en GEOS. Als DevOps Engineer maak je deel uit van het IT team, samen met zo'n 30 collega consultants. Omdat we niet sectorgebonden werken, krijg je de kans om in verschillende omgevingen ervaring op te doen. IT raakt alle sectoren, daardoor is er altijd een project dat past bij jouw kennis, ambitie en energie.

Elke vrijdag is onze samenwerkdag in het clubhuis in Arnhem. Die staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega's en het versterken van de onderlinge verbinding. Moet je opdrachtgever je die dag op kantoor hebben? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

Team EIFFEL is onderdeel van een community van ruim 3.000 experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers. Groot in omvang, maar persoonlijk in cultuur. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die wil groeien, ontwikkelen en zichzelf scherp wil houden.

Deze skills komen van pas

  • Software testing en automatisering

Je communiceert sterk en weet klanten op een duidelijke, rustige manier mee te nemen in complexe DevOps vraagstukken. Je werkt graag samen en stimuleert teams om continu te verbeteren. Met jouw analytische blik zie je snel waar knelpunten zitten en vind je oplossingen die werken, altijd met aandacht voor security en compliance. Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in DevOps en cloudtechnologie en past die kennis toe in je werk. Je houdt van hard werken, maar zeker ook van humor op de werkvloer. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent gericht op groei en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

title: Maintenance Execution Engineer 16/7
description:
APM Terminals

Ben je opzoek naar een technisch uitdagende functie waarin jij samen met jouw collega’s zorgt dat onze volautomatische terminal 24/7 operationeel blijft door storingen te voorkomen en op te lossen? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Als Maintenance Execution Engineer bij APM Terminals werk je in het 16/7 rooster in onregelmatige diensten (dag -en avonddienst) en ben jij op een supermoderne terminal verantwoordelijk voor het preventief en correctief onderhouden van het equipment.

Wie zijn wij?

APM Terminals Maasvlakte II (MVII) is één van ’s werelds modernste en meest geautomatiseerde containerterminals, strategisch gelegen in de Rotterdamse haven. Als onderdeel van de A.P. Moller-Maersk Groep en het wereldwijde netwerk van APM Terminals, leveren wij een actieve bijdrage aan het faciliteren van wereldhandel en het bevorderen van duurzame economische groei.

Wat MVII onderscheidt is onze cultuur van innovatie, veiligheid en operationele excellentie. De LEAN-methodologie vormt een integraal onderdeel van onze werkwijze - van continue procesverbetering tot samenwerking op de werkvloer. Bij MVII werk je in een omgeving die vooruitstrevend is, data-gedreven en gebouwd op verbetering. Sluit je aan bij ons en draag bij aan een terminal die wereldwijd de norm zet.

Wat wij bieden

Bij APM Terminals stimuleren we een dynamische en lerende werkomgeving waarin jouw ontwikkeling centraal staat. Dankzij onze focus op Lean denken en continu verbeteren, krijg je bij ons de ruimte én de middelen om je vaardigheden uit te breiden en impact te maken.

  • Werken op een van de meest geavanceerde en geautomatiseerde terminals ter wereld

  • Een dynamische werkomgeving met wisselende teams en continue operationele uitdaging

  • Mogelijkheden om je technische vaardigheden in onderhoud en storingsanalyse verder te ontwikkelen

  • Directe impact op de continuïteit en betrouwbaarheid van onze 24/7 operatie

  • Een gemiddelde werkweek van 32,94 uur per week;

  • Een uitstekend salaris (afhankelijk van o.a. ervaring) op basis van van onze Cao-schaal 6;

  • Ploegentoeslag van 24,41%;

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder, reiskostenvergoeding obv €0.23
    per km , 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling;

De functie:

Het is belangrijk dat de productie te allen tijde ongestoord kan doorgaan, waarbij jij en je collega’s in staat worden gesteld om het werk tijdig en binnen de gestelde kwaliteits- en veiligheidseisen af te ronden.

We werken daarom in 5 shifts waarbij elke shift wordt aangestuurd door een Shiftleader Maintenance Execution die leidinggeeft aan gemiddeld 8 collega’s. Omdat je als 16/7 (dag/avond) deel uitmaakt van een team dat 24/7 (dag/avond/nacht) werkt heb je met een aantal collega’s een verspringend rooster. In een vast schema maak je dus deel uit van alle 5 de shifts. Dat maakt dat er net wat meer van je gevraagd wordt dan als je deel uit maakt van een ‘vaste’ ploeg;

In deze functie ben je o.a bezig met en verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Uitvoeren van preventief en correctief onderhoud aan terminalequipment

  • Opsporen, analyseren en oplossen van storingen om stilstand te minimaliseren

  • Uitvoeren van functietesten en afstellen van equipment onderdelen

  • Samenwerken met contractors en interne teams voor onderhoudswerkzaamheden

  • Bijdragen aan het voorkomen van herhaalstoringen door structurele verbeteringen

Wat zoeken wij?

  • Continue verbetermentaliteit: we zijn op zoek naar iemand die een doordachte verbetermentaliteit meebrengt—nieuwsgierig naar hoe werk wordt uitgevoerd en gemotiveerd om in de loop van de tijd zinvolle, duurzame verbeteringen door te voeren

  • MBO niveau 4 werk- en denkniveau met een afgeronde technische opleiding (bijv. werktuigbouw, elektrotechniek of automatisering)

  • Vaardig met programma’s zoals Word en Excel

  • Ervaring met onderhoud en storingsanalyse binnen een technische omgeving

  • Proactieve, zelfstandige en oplossingsgerichte werkhouding

  • Communicatief vaardig waardoor je kennis goed kunt overbrengen en duidelijk kunt communiceren. Van belang bij werken in verschillende shifts en voor toelichten van je motivatie voor deze functie

  • Flexibiliteit in het team. Je werkt bijna elke shift met een nieuw team waardoor je flexibel moet kunnen zijn en snel moet kunnen schakelen als het gaat om de dynamiek en werkzaamheden binnen het team

  • Gezonde kijk op veilig werken

  • Teamspeler, je bent prima in staat om je dagelijks ‘aan te passen’ aan de dynamiek van het wisselende team maar je ‘staat toch je mannetje’

  • Kennis van de techniek binnen een containerterminal;

  • Beschikbaar voor het werken van onregelmatige diensten (dag- en avond diensten)

Interesse?

Herken je jezelf in bovenstaand profiel? Solliciteer dan via onze job portal! Om een goede aansluiting met de vacature te bepalen, vragen we je om een uitgebreide motivatie plus een CV. Als je vragen hebt over deze vacature, kun je contact opnemen met Tim Brunner (Manager Maintenance Execution) op tim.bruenner@apmterminals.com

description:
Essity is a leading global hygiene and health company. Our expertise began with the acquisition of the Swedish company Mölnlycke in 1975, through which our roots stretch back to 1849. Today, our sustainable innovations from globally trusted brands, designed for everybody and every body, care for the well-being of 1 billion people in 150 countries every day. Working at Essity is not just a career but a chance to make the world healthier, safer, and more hygienic. We innovate for good to break barriers and contribute to shaping a healthier future. At Essity, we have a people-first approach where every career is as unique as the individual. We empower employees to excel together and reach their full potential through a winning culture driven by a powerful purpose. Our performance-orientated environment motivates employees to think differently and embrace challenges so we can continue improving lives, every day through better hygiene and health. We provide a sustainable work-life based on flexibility for both employees and employers. We are committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion in everything we do. It is the key to our success in creating an inclusive, collaborative, and caring company culture where you can be you with us. Our purpose of Breaking Barriers to Well-being, enables customers and consumers to lead fuller lives at all stages of life. Our leading global brands include TENA and Tork, and other strong brands such as Actimove, Cutimed, JOBST, Knix, Leukoplast, Libero, Libresse, Lotus, Modibodi, Nosotras, Saba, Tempo, TOM Organic and Zewa are sold in 150 countries. I In 2024, Essity had net sales of approximately SEK 146bn (EUR 13bn) and employed 36,000 people. We are headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden and Essity is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. If you want to join a company where dedication to people is powered by innovation, welcome to Essity!

Vill du arbeta i ett världsledande internationellt hälso- och hygienföretag med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter? Till vårt bruk i Lilla Edet söker vi nu en El- och Automationstekniker som vill arbeta nära produktionen och vara med och säkerställa en stabil och säker drift.

Vad vi erbjuder

Essity Edet Bruk, med 400 anställda, producerar ca. 100,000 ton papper i form av toalett- och hushållspapper varje år. Sedan januari 2022 är Edet Bruk först i världen med storskalig mjukpappersproduktion utan fossila CO2 utsläpp. Bruket består av flera produktionssteg; återvunnen fiberhantering, ångcentral, massaberedning, papperstillverkning, konvertering, logistik samt flera stödfunktioner. Här arbetar vi med hela processkedjan, från råvara till färdig produkt i förpackning. Tillsammans med drivna och engagerade kollegor får du arbeta på en tekniskt avancerad linje och producera produkter i världsklass. Du erbjuds en spännande arbetsplats med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och generösa förmåner.

Vill du få en känsla för Bruket och vår kultur? Lär dig mer om oss här.

Om rollen

Som El- och Automationstekniker blir du en del av ett RST-arbetslag som arbetar med driftnära, förebyggande och avhjälpande underhåll.

Rollen handlar framför allt om att säkerställa tillgänglighet och driftsäkerhet i produktionen genom systematisk felsökning, förebyggande underhåll och förbättringsarbete. Du kommer att arbeta nära operatörer, mekaniker och andra tekniker för att snabbt identifiera och lösa problem när de uppstår.

En viktig del av arbetet är att lära känna den utrustning och process som du ansvarar för. Det handlar om att förstå hur olika komponenter, givare, ventiler, instrument och styrsystem samverkar för att skapa en stabil produktion.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Felsökning av produktionsutrustning och automationssystem

  • Förebyggande underhåll av el- och automationsutrustning

  • Kontroll och verifiering av givare, mätutrustning och instrument

  • Byte och reparation av elektriska komponenter

  • Analys och åtgärd av driftstörningar

  • Förbättringsarbete och optimering av utrustning

  • Samarbete med operatörer, mekaniker och seniora automationsspecialister

  • Användning av PLC-system som ett verktyg vid felsökning och analys

Tjänsten är förlagd till dagtid med beredskap.

Vem du är

Vi tror att du har en bakgrund inom elteknik och trivs med praktiskt tekniskt arbete nära produktionen.

Du är nyfiken och vill förstå sambanden bakom tekniska problem. När något inte fungerar nöjer du dig inte med att lösa felet, utan vill även förstå orsaken bakom det.

För att lyckas i rollen är du strukturerad, engagerad och har en god förmåga att samarbeta med andra samtidigt som du kan arbeta självständigt.

Vi ser gärna att du har

  • Gymnasieutbildning inom el, automation eller motsvarande

  • Erfarenhet av felsökning inom industriell verksamhet

  • God förståelse för elteknik och styr- och reglerteknik

  • Förmåga att läsa elscheman och teknisk dokumentation

  • Erfarenhet av arbete i produktions- eller processindustri är meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av ABB- eller Siemenssystem är meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Erfarenhet av PLC-system och automationsutrustning

  • Erfarenhet av instrumentering, givare, ventiler och processtyrning

  • Erfarenhet av förebyggande underhåll inom industrin

Vi värdesätter framför allt en stark teknisk grund inom el och felsökning. Erfarenhet av avancerad PLC-programmering är inget krav då större programmeringsändringar hanteras av specialister inom verksamheten.

Ytterligare information

Låter det här intressant? Om du är redo för en ny utmaning och känner igen dig i beskrivningen, sök tjänsten idag!

Vänligen observera att vi endast tar emot ansökningar via hemsidan på grund av GDPR. Vi gör löpande urval och intervjuer kan komma att bokas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vi kommer att genomföra ett alkohol-och drogtest innan en eventuell anställning. I vissa fall kan även en bakgrundskontroll komma att göras innan en eventuell anställning.

title: Student Success Center Coordinator
description:

Indian River State College is seeking a highly motivated and student-centered Student Success Coordinator to serve as a key resource for prospective and current students across our campuses.

In this role, you will be one of the first points of contact for students and visitors, helping them navigate programs, admissions processes, campus resources, and student support services. You will play an important role in creating a welcoming environment, coordinating campus tours, supporting front desk operations, training student ambassadors, and ensuring every student interaction reflects Indian River State College's commitment to exceptional service.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who enjoys working with people, solving problems, and helping others succeed. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy collaborating with colleagues across departments, and are committed to delivering an outstanding student experience, we'd love to hear from you.

About Us

Indian River State College is a leading public institution on Florida’s Treasure Coast, serving students across multiple campuses in four counties. We are committed to academic excellence, innovation, and community engagement, offering associate and bachelor’s degrees, workforce training, and continuing education programs that meet the needs of our region.

At The River, we believe every student’s and every employee’s story matters. We value the diverse perspectives, experiences, and talents that come together across our campuses, creating a learning environment and workplace that is supportive, inclusive, and inspiring.

With flexible learning options online, on campus, and hybrid, we meet students where they are and prepare them for real-world success. Programs like the Promise Program expand access by providing eligible students with tuition-free opportunities, ensuring every learner has the chance to thrive.

Why Join The River

When you join Indian River State College, you become part of a collaborative and mission-driven community where your work makes a meaningful impact. Here, your role is more than a job; it’s an opportunity to shape futures, support student success, and contribute to a college that is changing lives every day.

What We Offer

We are committed to supporting the well-being and professional growth of our employees through a comprehensive and competitive benefits package:

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; life insurance; supplemental plans; and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Affordable Coverage: PPO and HMO options starting at approximately $50/month for individual coverage and $180/month for family coverage

  • Growth & Development: Professional development opportunities, leadership training, and career advancement pathways

Under minimal supervision, this position, oversee the activity within the college’s Student Success Centers. Lead the efforts to ensure consistent customer service across all campuses, including guidance and training to staff and student workers. Partners with Recruitment & Admissions to cross train staff at the front desk and communication center. description:

What you’ll do in this role:

In this role, you will require in-depth knowledge and experience in Supply Chain Planning. You will use best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve performance. You will solve complex problems by taking a new perspective using existing solutions and work independently with minimal guidance.

You will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and may direct the work of other staff members. Additionally, you may lead projects with limited risks and resources. Your role requires conceptual and practical experience in Supply Chain Planning and basic knowledge of related disciplines. You will need awareness of the competition, industry best practices, and the factors that differentiate your company in the market.

You will develop and implement innovative solutions to complex problems, exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Your work will impact the achievement of goals and objectives within your team and other disciplines. Additionally, you will explain complex or sensitive information and work to build consensus.

  • You will adhere to Integer’s Values and all safety, environmental, security, and quality requirements including, but not limited to: Quality Management Systems (QMS), Safety, Environmental and Security Management Systems, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, company policies and operating procedures, and other regulatory requirements.
  • You will be responsible for analyzing customer demand to create the Master Production Schedule.
  • You will track NPI activities and communicate information to relevant parties.
  • You will communicate with external customers and suppliers to ensure production requirements are being met, and problem-solve to remove bottlenecks.
  • You will collaborate with the customer operations team to gather accurate demand forecasts and incorporate them into production plans.
  • You will monitor to ensure optimum inventory levels.
  • You will utilize production data to identify trends, assess performance, and make data-driven decisions for process improvements.
  • You will effectively use enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems to input and update production plans, ensuring accurate data availability.
  • You will address unforeseen challenges such as equipment breakdowns, material shortages, or production delays by devising solutions.
  • You may perform other duties as needed and as directed by your leadership.

How you will be measured?

The specific measures listed below may be subject to change and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list

  • On-Time Delivery: measures the ability of the role to create and execute production schedules that align with predetermined timelines. It quantifies the percentage of production orders or schedules that are completed and fulfilled within the specified timeframes. A high On-Time Delivery percentage indicates effective planning, coordination, and timely execution of production activities.
  • Schedule Attainment: evaluates how closely the actual production output aligns with the planned production schedule. It is calculated by comparing the planned production quantities with the actual quantities produced over a specific time period. This metric provides insight into the Planner's ability to translate demand forecasts into achievable production plans and the extent to which those plans are realized in practice.
  • Sales Order Backorder: measures the volume of customer orders that cannot be fulfilled immediately due to insufficient inventory levels or production capacity.
  • Inventory levels: measure inventory value and days on hand to target based on Plan for Every Part analysis. These metrics requires the Planner to monitor WIP aging & FG levels and coordinate with other departments to ensure adherence to inventory targets.
  • Capacity Utilization: Measure how well the available production capacity is utilized. This helps assess whether the Planner optimally allocates resources and minimizes idle time.

What sets you apart?

  • A Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field is desired, along with at least four years of relevant experience; however, if you do not meet the education requirement, you may be considered with more than five years of relevant experience in supply chain management.

  • Clear and professional communications to all levels of the organization are essential in this role, and you will have well-developed written and oral communication skills.
  • You maintain a calm demeanor that transcends the high energy, constantly changing supply chain environment.
  • You possess a positive, can-do attitude with an underlying belief that failure is not an option.

title: Senior Associate, Funds Operations
description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

This role has a key focus on an individual who has operational experience with Hong Kong domiciled Funds and who can effectively manage workflows that ensure high levels of operational service delivery. The role is best suited to candidates who have experience in working on a wide range of operational tasks simultaneously. The key operational functions for which this role will be responsible are detailed below:

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Fund Cash Flows - Coordinating information about cash flows and funding requirements for PIMCO Funds and communicating to the PIMCO trade floor teams.
  • Fund NAVs - Review of the Fund Valuations (NAVs) calculated by the Fund Administrator (external service provider) to ensure accuracy before release to market.
  • Investor Servicing - Overseeing the Registry (external service provider) for the on boarding, AML / KYC reviews, transactions monitoring, email and call queries from Fund investors.
  • Fund Financial Reporting & Audit – Coordinating the Fund Administrator and Fund Auditor for the Annual and Semi-Annual preparation of Financial Statements for the Hong Kong Funds.
  • Fund Distributions & Tax Deliverables – Managing the Fund Administrator and Fund Tax Advisor for the Monthly and Quarterly preparation of Fund Distributions as well as the reporting requirements.
  • Fee & Cost Disclosures - Production and review of Fee & Cost disclosures for the Hong Kong Funds. Working with technology teams to source data, compiling and validating results and providing information to the account management teams.
  • Fund Fees – Overseeing the processes around Management Fees for the Funds, including checking of fee accruals, preparation of invoices for fee collection and management of any fee rebate arrangements.
  • Service Provider Oversight & Incident Management - Oversight of vendors to ensure service quality and coordination of periodic due diligence programs. Working with Legal & Compliance teams on managing any operational incidents.

In addition to these business-as-usual tasks, this role will also be involved from time to time in projects to enhance operating process and implement change internally (and with vendors).

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in a Business-related field preferred and any post graduate study (CFA or similar highly regarded)
  • 6 + years’ experience within Fund Operations of an Asset Management firm is preferred for this role.
  • Understanding of the Hong Kong Unit Trust Regulatory environment
  • Ability to learn and master new concepts and processes quickly
  • Inquisitive nature to learn and build on knowledge base
  • Ability to manage small projects of work alongside business as usual
  • Strong analytic approach and problem solving skills required

title: Senior Data Engineer | Utrecht
description:
Klaar om als Senior Data Engineer/Platform Engineer impact te maken bij toonaangevende organisaties? Bij Team EIFFEL werk je projectmatig aan uitdagende datavraagstukken, van corporates tot overheid. Je bouwt aan slimme data-oplossingen én begeleidt collega’s in hun groei. Jij kiest je richting: verdiepen of verbreden. Zo blijf je jezelf voor.



Zorg ervoor dat al uw sollicitatiegegevens up-to-date en in orde zijn voordat u op deze vacature solliciteert.
Dit ga je doen

  • Je verzamelt en integreert data uit verschillende bronnen zoals databases en API’s
  • Je ontwerpt, bouwt en optimaliseert dataplatformen en data-architecturen, conform de Medaillon Architectuur
  • Je transformeert en modelleert data voor BI-analyses en datagedreven besluitvorming
  • Je ontsluit data voor eindgebruikers en werkt samen met analisten
  • Je begeleidt junior en medior collega’s; de inhoud verschilt per opdracht

Je bent fit for the job als je...

  • minimaal 5 jaar ervaring hebt als Data Engineer of vergelijkbaar (binnen een Microsoft omgeving)
  • een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt in Informatica, Data Science of Business IT & Management
  • ervaring hebt met SQL, Python en ETL/ELT tools zoals Data Factory, dbt of Airflow en kennis van AVG richtlijnen en hoe data daarop aansluit
  • ervaring hebt met CI/CD, Git en data-integraties (API’s)
  • Nederlands spreekt en schrijft op minimaal C1-niveau
  • bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B

Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 5.500 en 8.500 euro bruto per maand op basis van een 40 urige werkweek, passend bij jouw ervaring en expertise.



  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist

Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van multinational tot start up: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.


Je sluit je aan bij Team Analytics, een groeiend team van gedreven data professionals. Samen help je organisaties door heel Nederland om datagedreven werken naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je werkt aan projecten waar je écht impact maakt en je krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise te verdiepen en te verbreden.


Op vrijdag werken we samen in ons clubhuis in Arnhem. Deze dag staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega’s en het versterken van de verbinding met Team EIFFEL. Verwacht je opdrachtgever je die dag op locatie? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.


EIFFEL is onderdeel van Team EIFFEL: een community van ruim 3.000 experts binnen interim, consultancy en projectmanagement. Met opdrachten in 24 kennisdomeinen, bij meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers, en een trainingsaanbod waar je eindeloos uit kunt kiezen, helpen onze Performance Managers jou een loopbaan te bouwen die past bij jouw ambitie en levensfase. xgiwjmb


Deze skills komen van pas

  • SQL
  • RESTful API development
  • Kennis van programma's en portfolio's
  • Kennis van BI-tools
  • ETL processen

Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en business en neemt anderen mee in jouw keuzes en oplossingen.

title: Sjuksköterskor, välkomna till Infektionsavdelningen!
description:
Vill du bli en del av Region Jämtland Härjedalen – en region att längta till och växa i? Hos oss bidrar du till utveckling och tillväxt i hela länet och arbetar för att erbjuda bästa möjliga service, vård och stöd för alla som bor i eller besöker regionen. 

Vi erbjuder en arbetsmiljö präglad av samarbete, delaktighet och engagemang, där både bredd och spetskompetens tas till vara. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas i din roll, oavsett om du är ny i yrket eller har lång erfarenhet. 

Vi vill bli fler! Välkommen till Infektionsavdelningen!

Hos oss får du möjlighet att utreda allt ifrån tropiska sjukdomar till sepsis och sårvård. Patienterna är i alla åldrar med varierande grundsjukdomar. Det alla har gemensamt är att de har eller misstänks ha en infektion som kräver akut sjukvård.

Vi utför ofta avancerad akutsjukvård vilket gör att man blir väldigt bred i sin yrkeskunskap och du får möjlighet att använda hela av ditt kompetensspektra. Här får du en bred och bra grund som sjuksköterska, oavsett om du är nyexaminerad eller redan har yrkeserfarenhet. Vi uppmuntrar till kompetensutveckling genom ständigt förbättringsarbete och det egna ansvaret att vara med att påverka hur verksamheten bedrivs.

Hos oss tillämpas önskeschema som därefter samordnas utifrån verksamhetens behov.

4 plats(er). 5

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
På avdelningen arbetar vi i team med sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor och läkare i patientnära vård. 
Vi har en sjuksköterskegrupp med höga ambitioner, en undersköterskegrupp med hög kompetens och en stabil och bra läkargrupp och en härlig stämning i arbetslaget.

Infektionsavdelningen har 17 vårdplatser varav 15 enkelrum med sluss och möjlighet till isolering. Tio rum har även ingång från loftgång utifrån, om det behovet uppstår.

Tjänsten innebär rotationsarbete dag, kväll och natt. Önskeschema på 10 veckor läggs inför varje ny schemaperiod. Din introduktion på arbetsplatsen anpassas utifrån din erfarenhet, men vanligtvis ges minst 4 veckors inskolning tillsammans med en utsedd handledare. 

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är Legitimerad Sjuksköterska. Du har en positiv inställning och gillar att jobba i team men också att ta eget ansvar och initiativ när det behövs. Du har ett intresse av infektionssjukdomar och det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av avdelningsarbete.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde:  Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Urval och tillsättning sker löpande under annonseringstiden. Vi ser därför att du kommer med din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Ditt nya hem? Läs mer om att bo och leva i Östersund. www.ostersund.se

Välkommen till Jämtland Härjedalen! www.jamtland.se

Här hittar du mer information om Region Jämtland Härjedalen: www.regionjh.se

title: Medior Data Engineer – Databricks & Lakehouse Platform (Cloud)
description:
Job Description


Bent u de juiste sollicitant voor deze functie? Ontdek het door het functieoverzicht hieronder te lezen.

Fugro is a global leader in Geo‑data, building a modern cloud‑based lakehouse platform on Databricks to unlock high‑quality, governed data at scale. As we accelerate our digital transformation, we are looking for a hands‑on Medior Data Engineerwho enjoys building reliable cloud data pipelines, curating trusted datasets, and enabling analytics and AI across the organisation. You will work closely with engineering, analytics, data science and domain teams to deliver production‑grade data products that power Fugro’s global operations.

Your role

  • You design, build and maintain cloud‑native batch and streaming pipelines on Databricks using Lakeflow, Delta Lake and orchestration tools.

  • You implement the medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) to deliver trustworthy, performant datasets.

  • You develop transformations in PySpark and Spark SQL and help standardise reusable engineering patterns.

  • You take ownership of data quality, observability and operational reliability through validation, monitoring, alerting and runbooks.

  • You work with Unity Catalog to ensure governed access, documentation and lineage‑aware development.

  • You translate analytical and business requirements into scalable, pragmatic datasets that enable BI, analytics and AI.

  • You contribute to engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing approaches, CI/CD and cost‑efficient cloud usage.

  • You collaborate closely with platform, analytics and domain teams to deliver production‑ready data products end‑to‑end.

Your track record

  • You bring 3–6 years of experience in data engineering or equivalent experience delivering production‑grade cloud pipelines.

  • You have strong Python and SQL skills and hands‑on experience with Apache Spark on Databricks.

  • You have worked in at least one major cloud environment (AWS, Azure or GCP) and understand cloud storage and security concepts.

  • You are familiar with lakehouse principles, Delta Lake and incremental processing patterns.

  • You understand data governance concepts such as catalogs, permissions, lineage and data contracts (Unity Catalog is a plus).

  • You have experience with common ingestion patterns (files, APIs, databases) and know how to balance reliability, performance and cost.

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders.

What Fugro offers

  • A competitive salary;

  • 29 holidays per year based on a fulltime employment (of which 4 are appointed by Fugro management) and the possibility to purchase 12 additional days;

  • Extensive career & training opportunities both nationally and internationally;

  • Flexible working hours and the ability to work from home in accordance with your manager and corporate policies;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • Modern pension scheme;

  • Collective health insurance;

  • Possibility to register with our corporate fitness plan;

  • Coaching options through our EAP (Employee Assistance Program).

Are you interested?

Please visit our Company Page to find out more on what it is like to work at Fugro.

If you have any further questions, please contact Umit Nesar, Corporate Recruiter, tel.

After you have applied

  • You will receive an automated confirmation-email of the receipt of your application;

  • When we see a match, we will invite you for the first interview within a couple of days. Of course, you will also receive a message if we will not invite you;

  • After a successful first round, you will be invited for the second round;

  • If we are both still positive after the second interview, we will make you an offer and with that we hope to welcome you at Fugro!

Fugro does not accept any unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies. xgiwjmb Acquisition to Fugro Recruitment or any Fugro employee is not appreciated.

However, we encourage candidates who may fall outside of this range to apply as well.


About the role

Principal, Software Engineering – InsurTech Finance Core Systems

About the role:

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership across Intact’s InsurTech Finance Core Systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical influence. You will remain hands-on through prototyping, targeted code reviews, and technical troubleshooting when needed, while helping shape architecture, technology strategy, and engineering practices across the organization.

You will help solve complex engineering challenges, advance technology strategy, and raise the technical capabilities of the teams around you through expertise, collaboration, and influence.

What you’ll do here:

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through prototyping, targeted code reviews, and technical troubleshooting when needed to address difficult, complex challenges.
  • Lead the resolution of high-severity issues involving performance, reliability, security, cloud costs, data quality, and complex integrations across finance systems.
  • Define architecture, technical standards, and technology roadmaps for Finance Core Systems.
  • Design scalable, resilient, secure, and cost-effective solutions for data pipelines, high-volume transaction processing, and large-scale online and offline finance calculations.
  • Implement practical AI and agentic AI solutions, including frameworks and guardrails that improve engineering productivity.
  • Research emerging technologies and lead proof-of-concepts that support innovation and business outcomes.
  • Communicate technical decisions clearly, build alignment through influence, and mentor senior engineers and technical leaders.

What you bring to the table:

  • Senior or Principal-level experience in software engineering, architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong hands-on engineering experience, including prototyping, targeted code reviews, technical troubleshooting, and resolving complex production issues.
  • Proven expertise in system design, architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, security, observability, data pipelines, and high-volume transaction processing.
  • Experience designing and operating systems that support large volumes of online and offline financial calculations and transactions.
  • Practical experience implementing AI or agentic AI solutions in products, platforms, or engineering processes.
  • Expert hands-on experience with Python and Node.js is a strong asset.
  • Experience with Oracle ERP, SAS, Databricks, and Snowflake is an asset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to executive stakeholders.
  • A collaborative, low-ego, and people-first approach, with the ability to mentor others and lead through influence rather than formal authority.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering; a master’s degree or higher is an asset.
  • For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English-speaking colleagues across the country.
  • No Canadian work experience required however must be eligible to work in Canada.

#LI-Hybrid

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Klaar om als Senior Data Engineer/Platform Engineer impact te maken bij toonaangevende organisaties? Bij Team EIFFEL werk je projectmatig aan uitdagende datavraagstukken, van corporates tot overheid. Je bouwt aan slimme data-oplossingen én begeleidt collega’s in hun groei. Jij kiest je richting: verdiepen of verbreden. Zo blijf je jezelf voor.

Dit ga je doen
  • Je verzamelt en integreert data uit verschillende bronnen zoals databases en API’s
  • Je ontwerpt, bouwt en optimaliseert dataplatformen en data-architecturen, conform de Medaillon Architectuur
  • Je transformeert en modelleert data voor BI-analyses en datagedreven besluitvorming
  • Je ontsluit data voor eindgebruikers en werkt samen met analisten
  • Je begeleidt junior en medior collega’s; de inhoud verschilt per opdracht

Je bent fit for the job als je...
  • minimaal 5 jaar ervaring hebt als Data Engineer of vergelijkbaar (binnen een Microsoft omgeving)
  • een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt in Informatica, Data Science of Business IT & Management
  • ervaring hebt met SQL, Python en ETL/ELT tools zoals Data Factory, dbt of Airflow en kennis van AVG richtlijnen en hoe data daarop aansluit
  • ervaring hebt met CI/CD, Git en data-integraties (API’s)
  • Nederlands spreekt en schrijft op minimaal C1-niveau
  • bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B

Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 5.500 en 8.500 euro bruto per maand op basis van een 40 urige werkweek, passend bij jouw ervaring en expertise.

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van multinational tot start up: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Je sluit je aan bij Team Analytics, een groeiend team van gedreven data professionals. Samen help je organisaties door heel Nederland om datagedreven werken naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je werkt aan projecten waar je écht impact maakt en je krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise te verdiepen en te verbreden.

Op vrijdag werken we samen in ons clubhuis in Arnhem. Deze dag staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega’s en het versterken van de verbinding met Team EIFFEL. Verwacht je opdrachtgever je die dag op locatie? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

EIFFEL is onderdeel van Team EIFFEL: een community van ruim 3.000 experts binnen interim, consultancy en projectmanagement. Met opdrachten in 24 kennisdomeinen, bij meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers, en een trainingsaanbod waar je eindeloos uit kunt kiezen, helpen onze Performance Managers jou een loopbaan te bouwen die past bij jouw ambitie en levensfase.

  • SQL
  • RESTful API development

Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en business en neemt anderen mee in jouw keuzes en oplossingen.

title: Sr. Group Lead
description:
We are looking for an experienced and customer-focused Senior Group Lead to oversee team performance and day-to-day operations within a fast-paced Contact Center/BPO environment. The role will provide leadership, coaching, and operational direction to ensure the team consistently meets performance targets while delivering an excellent customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of customer service professionals, ensuring achievement of productivity, quality, service level, and customer satisfaction targets.
  • Provide day-to-day operational direction, guidance, and support to team members.
  • Monitor team performance and conduct regular coaching, feedback, and performance improvement discussions.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality customer service in accordance with client and company standards.
  • Address escalated customer concerns and provide appropriate resolutions while maintaining a customer-centric approach.
  • Monitor operational metrics and identify performance trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Operations, Quality, Training, WFM, and other support teams to address operational concerns and improve team performance.
  • Drive employee engagement, motivation, and retention through effective communication and people management practices.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, client requirements, processes, and compliance standards.
  • Conduct team huddles and communicate business updates, performance expectations, and process changes.
  • Prepare and provide regular performance updates and reports to management.
  • Identify process and performance improvement opportunities and support the implementation of corrective action plans.
  • Manage attendance, schedule adherence, and other workforce-related concerns within the team.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex operational and customer-related issues.
  • Perform other leadership and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4 years of work experience in a Contact Center/BPO environment.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a leadership position, such as Team Leader, Supervisor, Group Lead, or similar role.
  • Strong experience in people management, coaching, and performance management.
  • Strong customer service orientation with a demonstrated ability to manage customer concerns effectively.
  • Experience managing operational KPIs such as Service Level, Quality, Productivity, CSAT, AHT, and Attendance is preferred.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to make sound decisions and handle escalations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Willing to work on shifting schedules, weekends, and holidays depending on business requirements.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience managing large or multi-team operations.
  • Background in customer service, sales, collections, or other customer-facing BPO operations.
  • Experience in performance improvement and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of Contact Center operations and performance management.

title: Digital Data and Technology Graduate
description:
Salary: £33,000, Permanent role.
Start date: September 2027

Location: Huntingdon or Peterborough based. Please note your placements and final role may vary across the region and departments, so flexibility is essential.

Help shape the future of water, the environment and the communities we serve

With a plan worth over £11 billion of investment, we're building for better — for you, for the communities we serve, for our environment. As part of this we are looking for you to join Anglian Water's Digital Data and Technology Graduate Programme and tackle some of the biggest environmental and infrastructure challenges facing the region. From climate resilience and major engineering projects to digital innovation and customer experience, you'll develop the skills, experience and support needed to become one of our future leaders or specialists.

Your career path

The water industry is changing rapidly, creating exciting opportunities for the next generation of talent. At Anglian Water, you'll work on real challenges that matter, developing expertise across your chosen profession while contributing to projects that support customers, communities and the environment.

Few organisations can offer the opportunity to combine cutting-edge technology with the chance to improve the environment for six million customers every day. You'll learn from experienced colleagues, take on meaningful responsibility and build the skills, knowledge and confidence to shape your future career, while helping us shape the future of water.

To find out more from our recent graduates please visit our Anglian Water careers page: Graduates - Anglian Water Careers

Professional Development & Memberships

We're committed to helping you build a career, not just gain a job. Through our two-year graduate programme, you'll experience different placements, work on real business challenges and learn from experienced colleagues across the organisation. You'll have access to a wide range of development opportunities, support towards professional qualifications and funded membership of a relevant professional institution, helping you grow your expertise and achieve professional accreditation where appropriate.

Your programme

Join Anglian Water’s Digital, Data and Technology (DDaT) Graduate Programme and help shape the future of water and water recycling services in the East of England, through innovation, data-driven decision-making, and cutting-edge technology.

This is a unique opportunity to launch your career in a vital industry, whilst developing your leadership, technical, and strategic capabilities.

As part of our DDaT directorate, you’ll be at the heart of digital transformation across Anglian Water. You’ll work on real-world challenges that affect millions of customers, helping us deliver resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible services.

Our graduate programme offers structured rotations across key areas of DDaT, including:

  • Data, Digital & Software Engineering – building and maintaining critical systems and applications

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning – applying intelligent solutions to optimise operations and customer service

  • Data Analytics – turning data into actionable insights for smarter decision-making

  • Infrastructure & Operations, and Operational Technology (OT) – integrating digital tools with physical infrastructure to improve performance and reliability

  • Cybersecurity & Digital Risk – protecting our systems and data in an increasingly connected world

  • Enterprise, Solution and Platform Architecture – designing scalable, secure and future-ready technology landscapes that support business strategy and innovation

  • Data and Digital Product Management – shaping the lifecycle of digital products and data services to meet user needs and deliver business value

  • Data and Information Governance and Management – ensuring data and information is accurate, secure, and ethically managed to support compliance, effective business processes, data sharing and open data, and trusted decision-making.

What you will bring

We are looking for people who are curious, ambitious and ready to learn. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, working collaboratively and bringing different perspectives to the challenges we face. Most importantly, we're looking for graduates who want to help shape the future of water while developing a successful and rewarding career of their own. We welcome applicants who are excited about technology products and passionate about the water industry.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates with degrees in technology, digital, data, cyber security, engineering, business systems, cloud infrastructure, user experience design, information management, or related disciplines. If your degree has provided you with strong analytical, problem-solving and digital skills, we'd love to hear from you.

For this role, you’ll need to have obtained in the last 3 years or be studying towards a minimum 2:2 in the preferred degree disciplines listed and have graduated by September 2027 for the 2027 intake.

Benefits

Starting your career brings exciting opportunities and new responsibilities. That's why we provide access to Stream, a financial wellbeing platform designed to help you make the most of your money. From workplace savings and budgeting tools to financial education, rewards and cashback offers, you'll have access to practical support that helps you build strong financial habits from day one

Alongside this we offer a competitive salary, you'll receive a comprehensive health and wellbeing package, private healthcare, 26 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, and a double-matched pension scheme with up to 21% total contribution. We also offer an excellent family leave package, including enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave, helping you balance your career with the moments that matter most.

Closing Date: 27th September 2026

Assessment Centre (in Person): Friday 23rd October at our Lancaster House Head Office in Huntingdon

title: Senior ProServe Cloud Architect – Travel & Hospitality, AWS Professional Services - Benelux
company: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL, Dutch Branch
description:
AWS is seeking an exceptional Senior ProServe Cloud Architect to join our team supporting one of EMEA's most strategic partnerships in the travel and hospitality sector. In this role, you'll work directly with a leading global travel platform to architect and deliver transformative cloud solutions that redefine customer experience at scale.

As the technical bridge between ProServe Account Executives and Shared Delivery Teams, you'll translate complex business challenges into innovative, scalable AWS solutions. You'll own the technical narrative—from initial discovery through solution design and delivery—ensuring every engagement drives measurable business impact for one of the world's most influential travel technology companies.

What excites you:

  • Architecting at scale: Design solutions that handle millions of customer interactions across global markets, leveraging AWS services including Amazon Connect, AI/ML, and real-time data processing
  • Innovation with impact: Shape the future of travel technology by implementing omnichannel customer service platforms, personalization engines, and intelligent automation
  • Strategic influence: Partner directly with customer engineering and product leaders to drive cloud adoption and modernization initiatives
  • Technical breadth: Work across the full AWS stack—from serverless architectures and containerization to data analytics and AI-powered customer insights
  • Thought leadership: Coach customer teams on cloud best practices, DevOps automation, and operational excellence while building lasting technical relationships

This is a customer-facing role requiring travel to client locations across EMEA to deliver hands-on professional services and strategic guidance.

Key job responsibilities
Solution Design & Architecture: Create and lead complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions that deliver measurable Customer Business Outcomes (CBOs). Operate as the technical conduit between ProServe Account Executives and Shared Delivery Teams, ensuring proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and optimized for customer success.

Pre-Sales Technical Leadership: Provide technical expertise, best practices, and solution demonstrations during the pre-sales motion. Lead initial scoping, design, and engagement planning to accelerate deal closure and drive customer lifetime value.

Trusted Customer Advisory: Act as a strategic advisor to customer engineering and product leaders on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions to address their most complex business challenges. Define cloud operating models and drive enterprise transformation initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Account Managers, Shared Delivery Teams, and AWS service teams to ensure seamless solution hand-off and successful implementation. Influence revenue through bookings, solution alignment, and delivery excellence.

Knowledge Leadership: Mentor and train team members, create reusable artifacts, and drive process improvements across the organization. Share technical expertise through internal and external thought leadership.

Business Value Translation: Translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including C-level executives.

A day in the life
Your day will center on direct engagement with a leading global travel platform's engineering and product leaders, translating their business challenges into scalable AWS solutions. You'll lead technical pre-sales activities—designing architectures, scoping engagements, and presenting solutions to both technical teams and executives. Internally, you'll collaborate closely with a multicultural, large account team including ProServe Account Executives, AWS Account Managers, Solution Architects, and Shared Delivery Teams across EMEA. You'll operate as the technical bridge that ensures proposed solutions are realistic and optimized for customer success, navigating diverse perspectives and working styles to drive alignment.

Beyond customer-facing work, you'll mentor team members, create reusable artifacts, and stay current on AWS services and travel industry trends. You'll solve complex problems like architecting omnichannel customer service platforms handling millions of global interactions, designing real-time analytics solutions, modernizing legacy applications, and implementing AI/ML-powered personalization—all while defining cloud operating models that enable organizational transformation.

About the team
The Professional Services team at AWS is responsible for assisting enterprise customers as they shift to the cloud by incorporating our services into their overall architecture. We work hand-in-hand with customer teams and AWS partners to provide deep expertise in the architecture, design, development, and implementation of cloud computing initiatives that result in real business outcomes. As part of our team, you'll accelerate the adoption of our products all while advocating for the success of our customers.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of IT platform implementation in a technical and analytical role experience
  • 7+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
  • 3+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
  • Bachelor's degree, or 10+ years of professional or military experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management

Responsible for overseeing project controls, project cost management, and the development of performance metrics for all projects in the assigned department. Provides leadership in the assessment and audit of project management and project controls performance. In addition, this position will also support capital work, associated O&M activities, and provide metrics and reporting to departmental leadership that will be used in the ongoing management. Provide leadership, direction, training, coordination, and effective communication to support all project phases with a safe, efficient, economical, risk-balanced approach to achieve short- and long-range goals and to obtain maximum customer satisfaction.

Develop relationships and effectively communicate with all stakeholders including internal customers, external customers, team members, suppliers, contractors, vendors, and industry peers. title: Principal Cybersecurity Domain Architect
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

About the Team

Micron’s Cyber Defense & Resiliency organization is responsible for protecting the company’s global technology environment through modern security architecture, engineering, detection, and response capabilities. We drive strategic cybersecurity initiatives that strengthen enterprise resilience, advance Zero Trust principles, and ensure security capabilities evolve alongside emerging threats, cloud adoption, and AI technologies!

About the Role

As a Principal Cybersecurity Domain Architect, you will serve as the technical authority for Network Security, Endpoint Security, and Detection & Response! This is a deep, focused role for an architect who wants authority and mastery in a defined lane rather than breadth across the entire enterprise. You will set the direction for how Micron designs, deploys, and operates its network, endpoint, and detection and response capabilities, and be the go-to design authority that engineering, operations, and security leadership rely on within these domains. As we adopt AI and autonomous agent technologies at pace, this role extends detection and response to cover agentic defense, detecting and responding to threats against and originating from AI agents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve reference architectures, standards, design principles, and multi-year roadmaps for Network Security, Endpoint Security, and Detection & Response.

  • Serve as the enterprise security design authority, conducting architecture reviews and approving security designs for new initiatives and technologies.

  • Define technology strategies, evaluation criteria, and platform selections across EDR/XDR, SIEM, SOAR, network security, and related controls.

  • Drive Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, segmentation, secure access, endpoint protection, and detection engineering strategies across the enterprise.

  • Ensure detection and response architectures support rapid investigation, containment, recovery, and cyber resiliency objectives.

  • Partner with AI Enablement and security leadership teams to develop detection and response capabilities for AI systems and autonomous agents.

  • Produce security risk assessments, identify control gaps, and recommend remediation strategies for proposed solutions.
