title: IASE / ISSE
description:
Information Assurance Security Engineer (IASE) / Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE)

Location: Suitland, MD
Clearance: Active TS/SCI

Leidos is hiring a hands-on Information Assurance Security Engineer (IASE) / Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) to support a complex, mission-driven enterprise environment in Suitland, MD.

In this engineering-focused role, you will actively secure, administer, harden, and maintain critical systems and infrastructure while collaborating across network, systems, cybersecurity, and architecture teams to continuously strengthen and evolve the organization’s overall security posture. You will combine deep technical security expertise with hands on engineering, vulnerability remediation, security testing, and architecture support to help protect mission critical systems and capabilities.

This role is open to candidates across a range of experience levels. The scope of the position and corresponding compensation will be aligned with the selected candidate’s background and expertise.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary security engineering resource for enterprise infrastructure, providing hands on administration, configuration, security hardening, troubleshooting, and vulnerability remediation.

  • Research and evaluate cybersecurity tools, technologies, and methodologies to identify opportunities to strengthen enterprise security.

  • Participate in architecture and engineering reviews and provide security recommendations for new capabilities, technologies, and infrastructure changes.

  • Troubleshoot complex security issues across storage, networking, operating systems, authentication, and enterprise infrastructure.

  • Conduct vulnerability assessments, ethical hacking, and penetration testing to identify and address security risks.

  • Review and harden storage protocols and services, including NFS, SMB/CIFS, iSCSI, and management interfaces, based on operational and security requirements.

  • Apply and validate applicable DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), Security Requirements Guides (SRGs), vendor security guidance, and industry security best practices.

  • Configure and maintain secure administrative access using technologies and principles such as SSH, HTTPS/TLS, role based access control (RBAC), centralized authentication, and least privilege.

  • Develop and deliver training on cybersecurity tools, technologies, and processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Information Assurance, or a related field with 8+ or 12+ years of experience; Master’s degree with 6+ or 10+ years of experience. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance.

  • 8+ years of security engineering experience, including experience with DoD RMF, ICD 503, and/or the NIST Risk Management Framework.

  • Extensive experience with Intelligence Community (IC), Department of Defense (DoD), Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), NAVINTEL Cybersecurity, Fleet Cyber Command (FLTCYBERCOM), and DoDIIS processes, tools, systems, reporting mechanisms, and requirements supporting Assessment and Authorization (A&A).

  • 5+ years of software development experience using Java, C, C++, or other programming or scripting languages, including experience designing and developing host based and network based scanning tools.

  • Experience with Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) based tools and specifications.

  • Experience installing, configuring, testing, deploying, operating, and maintaining enterprise network based scanning and reporting tools such as Trellix/ESS, ACAS, RedSeal, Evaluate STIG, SteelCloud ConfigOS, and STIG Manager.

  • Extensive experience hardening modern Unix operating systems, such as Oracle Solaris 10/11 and RHEL, as well as Microsoft Windows environments using Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs).

  • Extensive experience securing systems and software in accordance with IC, DoD, and industry security best practices.

  • Experience developing security controls, testing methodologies, and test procedures for systems, cloud based architectures, and Cross Domain Solutions (CDS).

  • 2+ years of project management experience.

  • Demonstrated ability to take a proactive, results oriented approach while building effective customer and team relationships.

Required Certifications

  • Active IAT or IAM Level II/III DoD 8140 approved baseline certification, such as CISSP ISSEP or SecurityX, or the ability to obtain the required certification within 30 days of hire.

Leidos is seeking a Senior Information System Security Engineer (ISSE) to support cybersecurity authorization related efforts for SMIT. SMIT is the largest IT services program for the Navy. Under the Service Management, Integration, and Transport (SMIT) program, the Leidos team will deliver the core backbone of the Navy's enterprise network (NMCI), including cybersecurity services, network operations, service desk, and data transport. Ultimately, the Leidos team will support the Navy in unifying its shore-based networks and data management to improve capability and service while also saving significant dollars by focusing efforts under one enterprise network.

What You'll Get to Do:
The ISSE will perform cybersecurity authorization services, including acting as a main point of contact for cybersecurity authorization related aspects to the assigned information systems, ensuring systems are maintained per security policies and procedures and maintaining compliance and ongoing reporting to management.

Responsibilities include:
•Serve as a primary information system security engineer (ISSE) for Authorization to Operate (ATO) packages under the Navy Risk Management Framework (RMF).
•Assist in the development and review of ATO submissions and coordinate all updates and corrections to assessment and authorization (A&A) artifacts.
•Evaluate software and hardware during pre-acquisition phases to determine its ability to meet minimum security requirements based on NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 security controls.
•Author, review, coordinate and submit cybersecurity authorization required artifacts to eMASS (including change requests) to achieve milestones such as Interim Authority to Test (IATT) and ATO in accordance with the project schedule.
•Support conducting cybersecurity authorization activities to comply with all current Cybersecurity and IA manuals, instructions, and guides within the DoDI 8500.01, DON 5239, the RMF Process Guide, and the RMF Risk Assessment Guide.
•Continuously monitor system resources through automated scanning and implement automated reporting feeds to support cybersecurity authorizations.
•Verify patch compliance using the approved technical solution (i.e., Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS)), Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert (IAVA) compliance dashboards, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoints.
•Coordinate with local administrators to troubleshoot and elevate patching issues in a timely manner in order to meet patch compliance timelines.
•Assist with the implementation of security procedures, and verify information system security requirements, including coordinating the execution, review, and disposition of Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) checklists for systems, applications, developed code and other components.
•Independently develop and maintain system security documentation, including drafting, reviewing, editing and recommending guidance for Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Tactics, Techniques, & Procedures (TTP), Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) and Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) Score Card.
•Participate in regular briefings with the customer on cybersecurity statuses, including preparing briefing materials. Work closely with government Cyber team to support ATO conditions and requirements.
•Support site visits / audits, including System Readiness Reviews (SRR).
•Ensure secure, effective and efficient operation of network systems, architecture, and topology.

•Hold an active security certification that meets DOD 8570 IAT level III or higher.

•Understanding of techniques and tactics used to exploit systems (MITRE ATTACK) to determine risk and possible mitigations.
•Ability to understand technical mitigations/know resources to identify proper mitigating factors (i.e. https://attack.mitre.org/mitigations/enterprise/).
•Experience with eMASS to include control inheritance, TR Import, and POAM import functionality.

•Assist with the implementation of security procedures, and verify information system security requirements, including coordinating the execution, review, and disposition of Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) checklists for systems, applications, developed code and other components.

•Hands-on experience in working with DoD networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the development, qualification, and deployment of advanced metrology applications for 3D NAND process development, with primary emphasis on Focused Ion Beam (FIB) and one or more of the following:
    • Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM)
    • Optical interferometry or White Light Interferometry (WLI)
    • Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM)

    • Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM)

title: Site Lead
description:
About Leidos Australia

At Leidos Australia, our work goes beyond a job title. We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life.

Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter.

Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work. This includes:

  • Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days (up to 12 extra days off per year), part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours.
  • Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing.
  • Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities.
  • Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities.
  • Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way.
  • And Much More – These are just a few of the ways we invest in our people and help them thrive.

About the Team

You’ll join a team where people work with integrity, inclusion, innovation, agility, collaboration and commitment. In practice, that means sharing ownership, solving complex problems together and staying connected to the customer context, the purpose behind the work and how each role contributes to meaningful outcomes.

We deliver prime systems integration projects which build, develop and support military solutions for Defence. The team focuses on leveraging our local engineering, our services expertise, and global products to bring new capabilities to the Australian Defence Force.

The Opportunity

This is a varied, hands-on opportunity combining site leadership with operations coordination at our Mulgrave facility. As the Site Lead, you will guide day-to-day production and warehouse activities while providing broader operational support to keep the site organised, safe and running effectively.

  • Coordinate onsite production and warehouse activities, supporting the delivery, return, servicing, inspection and inventory management of CBRND equipment and packages.
  • Oversee equipment calibration, servicing, maintenance records and work orders, ensuring accurate information is maintained in Costpoint and supporting contract quality requirements.
  • Undertake operations coordination duties across procurement, supply chain, goods receipting, facilities, security, office administration and onsite contractor activities.
  • Work closely with production, warehouse, engineering, quality, finance and operations stakeholders to manage priorities, support site requirements and improve operational processes.

About You

You will bring a practical and adaptable approach, with the ability to move confidently between site leadership, operational coordination and hands-on support. You will be comfortable managing competing priorities, maintaining accurate records and building effective working relationships across a multidisciplinary environment.

Essential:

  • Experience coordinating work within a production, warehouse, manufacturing, facilities or operational environment.
  • Capability in planning activities, organising resources and supporting teams to meet operational and service requirements.
  • Experience using ERP or maintenance management systems to manage work orders, inventory, purchasing or equipment records.
  • Ability to interpret and follow standard operating procedures, maintain quality documentation and support workplace health and safety requirements.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with varied stakeholders.
  • A valid Australian driver’s licence and a forklift licence, or willingness to obtain one.
  • Willingness and ability to undertake routine manual handling, including boxes weighing up to 20 kg.

Advantageous:

  • Experience supervising or providing day-to-day guidance to production or warehouse personnel.
  • A Certificate III or IV in electrical, electronics, mechatronics, mechanical fitting, project management, warehousing, supply chain management or a related discipline.
  • Experience with Costpoint, SAP, MILIS or Defence logistics processes.
  • Knowledge of calibration, equipment servicing, stocktaking, freight coordination and goods receipting.
  • Experience supporting procurement, facilities, security, office management or operational events.

This role requires the successful applicant to be an Australian citizen and hold (or could obtain) a Baseline security clearance.

What to Expect When You Apply

Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward, respectful and easy to navigate. If your skills, experience and qualifications look aligned with the role, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you to discuss the next stage. You can expect:

  • An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team
  • An interview with the hiring manager or interview panel
  • Any role-specific assessment, technical discussion or customer step required for the position

We’ll let you know what to expect before each stage, including who you’ll meet and how to prepare. If you need any adjustments or support during the process, please let us know.

Ready to explore what’s possible?

If this sounds like a role where you can make an impact and continue to grow, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply via the “Apply Now” button with your resume. If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact Ben George, Talent Acquisition.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

title: Sr. Inventory Optimization Specialist
description:
We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water.

We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource.

What we do:

For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​

Scope of Position

This data-driven and collaborative individual, as part of Supply Chain Management team, will be responsible for optimizing inventory deployment, network performance, and supply chain execution to achieve targeted service levels while minimizing inventory investment. The position partners closely with Product Management, Manufacturing Operations, Distribution Centers, Demand Planning, Supply Management, Sourcing, Finance, and Sales to identify and implement inventory and network optimization opportunities, resolve supply chain risks, and drive execution through cross-functional collaboration. This role also serves as a key liaison to the agent network for supply chain-related issues and continuous improvement.

This position reports to the S&OE Manager.

This role is hybrid and is based in North Andover, Massachusetts.

Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and refinement of inventory and service dashboards, KPIs, and reporting tools that strengthen visibility and actionability across the Supply Chain.

  • Analyze inventory performance across distribution centers, agents, and field locations to identify optimization opportunities and drive implementation through cross-functional teams.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for supply chain issues raised by agent representatives and ensure timely resolution.

  • Identify and execute inventory rebalancing opportunities across the network to improve product availability, reduce excess inventory, and optimize working capital.

  • Analyze inventory positioning throughout the distribution network and recommend stocking location strategies to improve service and reduce logistics costs.

  • Monitor inventory health and service performance metrics, perform root cause analysis of inventory-related issues, and implement preventive actions to improve future performance.

  • Facilitate execution-related supply chain reviews and coordinate actions to mitigate inventory shortages, excess inventory, and service risks.

  • Proactively identify inventory and service risks, communicate impacts to stakeholders, and coordinate corrective action plans to mitigate customer and operational disruptions.

  • Monitor short-term supply, demand, inventory, backlog, and allocation exceptions to identify service risks and translate findings into prioritized corrective actions; including inventory rebalancing for service.

  • Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Distribution, Sourcing, and Commercial teams to balance customer priorities against available supply, inventory constraints, and network capacity.

  • Analyze projected stockouts, fill-rate gaps, aged backlog, and constrained supply situations; recommend mitigation plans including inventory redeployment, prioritization, substitution, expedite avoidance, or escalation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field: Supply Chain, Business, Operations or Finance.

  • 5+ years of experience in supply chain management using relevant inventory management tools.

  • Experience with ERP systems and an understanding of how ERP systems integrate with supply chain processes (SAP preferred)

  • Demonstrated proficiency in inventory management and cost reduction initiatives

  • Experience with other software packages including Windows, and Microsoft Office.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, decision making, and presentation skills. Strong interpersonal skills are also essential to effectively interact with all teams, areas and levels of business affecting the forecast process – both internal and external.

  • Strong facilitation and influencing skills are required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • APICS or other related certification

  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel

General Applicable Company Competencies

  • Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency.

  • Punctuality and dependability.

  • Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions.

  • Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts.

  • Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees.

  • Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action.

Working Conditions

While performing the job duties, you will be working in an office environment. You will be required to work in the office at the North Andover, Massachusetts location three days per week (Monday – Wednesday) and can work remotely two days per week (Thursday and Friday).

Physical Requirements: Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Ability to remain seated at a desk or workstation for extended periods.

  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks like typing on a keyboard or using a mouse for extended periods.

  • Ability to physically move around the office, organize or transport files, packages, or other office-related materials.

  • Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry tasks.

  • Ability to communicate clearly with management and coworkers, particularly in meetings or phone calls.

  • Ability to operate standard office equipment such as computers, printers, phones, and copiers.

title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
description:
Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)

Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?
 Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.
Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.
Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:
• ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
• vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
• ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
• ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
• bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
• werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
• meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
• testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
• signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?
 Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:
  • veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
  • direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
  • veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
  • hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
  • ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
  • werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
  • korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
  • een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
  • een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?
 We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.
Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
  • enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
  • goede kennis van C# en .NET;
  • ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
  • ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
  • ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
  • ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
  • je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
  • je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
  • je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
  • je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken
Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.
Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.
Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.
Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?
 Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.
Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.
Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?
Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

  • Werken met de gaafste automerken!
  • Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
  • Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
  • Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
  • Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken
  • 8,5 medewerkers tevredenheid

description:

KUOW has an outstanding opportunity for On Call Announcer to join their team.

Reporting to the Director of Audience, the On-Call Announcer is responsible for an assigned on-air shift. The position includes live announcing during assigned shift as well as recording breaks for overnight automation.

This is a temporary, hourly on-call position with work on weekdays and weekends. Candidates must be able to work a varied schedule when required, including some early mornings, evenings and weekends.

Announcing (85%)

  • Serve as primary announcer and board operator for assigned shift.
  • Monitor system and KUOW communications and news wire to provide programming updates

title: Staff Software Engineer - Front End
description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

As a Staff Software Engineer in the Transaction Journey (TJ) organization, you will use your deep Frontend web expertise to build products that deliver high business impact to our customers. You will lead the design and development of a collaborative transaction management platform that streamlines the process of buying and selling homes, which spans key areas such as: transaction forms, eSign, compliance review, and commissions processing. You will lead teams to deliver features that make it easier for agents to work with clients and other parties to complete critical tasks throughout the transaction, so that they can spend less time managing it, and more time with their clients, and building their business. You will collaborate cross-functionally with multiple teams as well as with our product and design teams to identify and deliver the right solutions for our customers and support the growth of the world’s most scalable brokerage.

You are an engineer who is passionate about creating great products that are easy to use. You feel it is critical that your voice is heard in product and business decisions. You love to learn, and equally love to share your knowledge with others. You are a great communicator and you take care to understand before making yourself understood.

You design systems that are fault tolerant, scalable, highly available, well-tested, eventually consistent, and follow best practices such as the single responsibility principle. Your code is designed for modularity and re-use. You take pride in delivering solid code that is well-tested, peer-reviewed, and follows best practices. You have strong opinions on code structure, style, and development processes.

At Compass, You Will

  • Provide strategic direction and ownership of platform architecture, data ingestion and normalization, to deliver an industry leading search experience at scale.
  • Independently define and lead the delivery of complex technical projects across the entire stack.
  • Champion a culture of operational excellence by defining reliability KPIs, establishing accountability for service health, and leading architectural improvements that proactively reduce technical debt, manual toil, and infrastructure costs.
  • Adopt and operationalize modern and emerging software patterns, including integrating AI, data pipelines, and telemetry systems to automate workflows
  • Operate in a scalable engineering culture that leverages modern principles of AI assisted workflows, decoupled systems, and automated CI/CD/testing/monitoring to drive efficiencies
  • Inspire, recruit, and mentor fellow engineers.
  • Join a great team with a lot of visibility and some challenging projects on the horizon

What We Look For

  • BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent practical experience
  • 10+ years of experience developing comprehensive, well-tested, and high-performance software applications in Typescript, Javascript, and HTML/CSS
  • 5+ years of experience with React and NodeJS
  • 3+ years of experience using AWS / cloud technologies
  • A track record as a technical leader with cross-team impact
  • Understanding and adherence to industry-standard best practices in software development and architecture while keeping abreast of evolving technologies in AI
  • A sheer eye for design and attention to detail, the products you build should not merely be functional but should take in context and anticipate our customer’s needs in a beautiful way
  • Strong critical thinking skills, great communication skills and passion for delivering operational excellence
  • Strong familiarity with continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, containerization, and Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong sense of technical empathy for your end-users (whether they are real estate agents or fellow developers)
  • Nice to have: Experience with backend programming experience using languages such as Java, Golang, or Python
  • Nice to have: Experience with Kafka and event-driven systems, gRPC, Thrift, and other server-to-server communication protocols

If you're passionate about shaping the future of real estate technology and possess the skills and experience we're seeking, we encourage you to join our dynamic team at Compass. Together, we'll continue to transform the industry.

Compensation:

The base pay range for this position is $228,000- 240,000 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses and restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.

Perks That You Need To Know About

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

Do your best work, be your authentic self.

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. title: Python Data Engineer
description:
Werken aan morgen, met de beste technologie van nu. Werken bij LINKIT gaat om grenzen verleggen. Ontdekken, ontwikkelen, expertise delen en continu zoeken naar verbetering. We combineren lange termijn strategisch denken, diepgaande enterprise-ervaring en een mensgerichte aanpak om klanten te helpen hun bedrijfsprocessen te transformeren en te domineren in hun industrie. Elke dag werken meer dan 1.000 van onze mensen uit 20+ landen aan kritieke technologie bij bedrijven als Defensie, KLM en ASML.


Als u geïnteresseerd bent om op deze vacature te solliciteren, zorg er dan voor dat u voldoet aan de volgende, hieronder vermelde vereisten.

Groot genoeg voor impact, klein genoeg om verbonden te blijven

De digitale revolutie draait om één ding: data, en wel in ongekende hoeveelheden. Als Senior Python Engineer bij LINKIT sta je aan het roer van deze transformatie. Wij bouwen de geavanceerde data-architecturen die realtime informatievoorziening mogelijk maken.

Dit ga jij doen als Phyton Engineer bij LINKIT

Je werkt aan complexe, data-gedreven oplossingen voor toonaangevende klanten. Zo ontwikkelen we bij KLM een realtime applicatie voor vrachtdata-analyse op GCP met Kafka en Spark. Voor KNMI beheren we het centrale AWS-cloudplatform, en bij Audax begeleiden we de migratie naar InfluxDB voor realtime verwerking van energieprijzen. Binnen ons team van ruim 20 Data Engineers werk je met de nieuwste technologieën aan projecten die écht het verschil maken. Concreet ga je:

  • Schaalbare data platforms en pipelines ontwerpen en bouwen in o.a. Python, Java en Scala.
  • Complexe datasets transformeren naar bruikbare informatie voor besluitvorming.
  • Werken met moderne tools zoals Hadoop, Spark, Airflow en cloudoplossingen (GCP, AWS, Azure).
  • Data-architecturen optimaliseren die kritieke bedrijfsprocessen ondersteunen.
  • Nauw samenwerken met data science teams en anticiperen op hun technische behoeften.
  • Bouwen aan robuuste, toekomstbestendige oplossingen die direct impact maken.
Dit neem jij mee om impact te maken

Gezien de complexiteit van onze data-projecten en de schaal waarop we opereren, zoeken we een combinatie van technische kennis en hands-on ervaring. Als Phyton Engineer breng je het volgende mee:

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ‘hardcore’ Data Engineering ervaring, bij voorkeur aangevuld met ML- en AI-integratie of de wens om dat te leren.
  • Een analytische mindset met slimme, creatieve oplossingen voor complexe data uitdagingen.
  • Je beheerst Python en/of Scala en hebt ook goede kennis van SQL.
  • Je deelt graag je kennis en staat open voor feedback, of het nu gaat over data-architecturen of de toekomst van AI.
  • Je bent thuis in cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) en data-tools als Airflow, Databricks, Spark voor het bouwen van ML-ready infrastructuren.

Twijfel je omdat je niet aan alles voldoet? Laat dat je niet tegenhouden en solliciteer vooral!

We beloven je betekenisvol werk met collega’s die bij je passen

We zijn gewone mensen, makkelijk in de omgang en voelen ons net zo thuis in het team van onze klanten als in ons eigen kantoor. We zijn een hechte groep van getalenteerde mensen die samen ons bedrijf opbouwen en runnen. Bij LINKIT bouw je niet alleen aan de toekomst van onze klanten, maar ook aan die van onszelf. Hier maak je deel uit van een prijswinnende bedrijfscultuur. Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Bruto salaris tot €6.000 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld.
  • Pensioenopbouw bij Zwitserleven waarbij we 50% van de premie betalen of extra salaris als je kiest om niet deel te nemen.
  • 25 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.
  • Telefoon en de nieuwste Microsoft Surface of Macbook.
  • Een netto maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.
  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling – een traditie die we al 8 jaar trots hooghouden.
  • Persoonlijke coaching via ons unieke mentor-netwerk en ongelimiteerd trainingsbudget voor je professionele ontwikkeling.
  • Bij LINKIT werk je 40 uur, waarvan gemiddeld 36 uur op projecten. De overige tijd is gereserveerd voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, innovatie en het delen van kennis tijdens onze clubdagen.
  • Bijzondere extra’s zoals onze 2-wekelijkse clubdagen, jaarlijkse wintersport, toegang tot een wellbeing platform, Wendy’s dagelijkse verse lunch en nog veel meer….

Wij nodigen je graag uit voor een korte kennismaking. xgiwjmb Wil je eerst nog meer weten over de functie-inhoud of over onze projecten? Neem gerust contact op met Dineke via of

Nieuwegein, Utrecht, Netherlands

Document Assembly/Organization

  • Assist with management of document-intensive cases

  • Interact with government agencies to obtain information

  • Conduct legal and non-legal research and summarize findings by memorandum or report

  • Attend both in-town and out-of-town trials

  • Other tasks as assigned

Out‑of‑Town Trial Support

eDiscovery

  • Data entry

  • Document analysis

  • Quality control of case databases

  • Print data in organized format

­Timekeeping/Time Sheets

Teamwork

  • Prioritize work, handle sensitive information, and maintain requisite interaction with clients, attorneys, paralegals, and other staff

Other duties as assigned.

ESSENTIAL CAPABILITIES

Keep personally identifiable information, personal health information and attorney/client privileged information confidential; comply with Firm policies and ethics rules; prioritize daily responsibilities and special projects and readjust as priorities change; coordinate resources to meet deadlines; perform multiple tasks in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment; maintain a calm, courteous, and professional demeanor; be a constant-learner, flexible, proactive, efficient and resourceful; take initiative, and follow through; strong team-player; prompt, regular, and predictable attendance; strong organizational, grammar, and proofreading skills; pay attention to detail; outstanding interpersonal and client service skills; clear, effective, and professional verbal and written communication skills; proficiency and fluent in reading, writing, and verbal communication in English

Technical Knowledge

Must be able to type a minimum of 40 wpm with minimal errors. Must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook) and Adobe Acrobat. Must be capable of learning (and may be required to have working knowledge of) on‑line research programs such as Westlaw and Lexis. Must be familiar with operation of office equipment, including personal computer, printer, photocopier, and telephone.

Physical and Mental Capabilities

Operate a telephone, personal computer, and all types of photocopy equipment and other necessary office equipment; read and comprehend handwritten and typed notes or instructions; type on a computer keyboard in a sitting or standing position for extended periods of time during a 7.5‑hour workday; learn and effectively use Firm style and software applications; accurately proofread documents; accurately record and deliver phone messages; carry files, binders, and pouches of files for short distances. May be required to possess valid driver’s license, have a good driving record, and drive personal vehicle to accomplish work assignments. Must be capable of delivering and obtaining documents from downtown offices and court buildings. May be required to travel out of town and/or out of state to accomplish work assignments.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

title: Principal Signal Integrity Engineer
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Principal Signal Integrity Engineer — Interface Pathfinding

About the Role

At Micron, we transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. As a global leader in memory and storage innovation, we develop technologies that accelerate intelligence and enable the next era of AI, ML, and advanced computing.

Micron’s Interface Pathfinding team operates at the leading edge of that mission — serving as a bridge between corporate strategy and engineering through forward-looking investigation and development of energy-efficient bandwidth solutions. Our work spans innovative circuit, signaling, packaging, and interconnect solutions with a 3–5 year technology horizon, grounded in rigorous analysis, hands-on measurement, and a commitment to building a robust intellectual property portfolio.

As a Principal Signal Integrity Engineer, you will be a core technical contributor on a deliberately small, senior team united around the goal of preparing high-speed interface innovations for high-confidence product adoption.

What You’ll Work On

Micron’s Interface Pathfinding team investigates and validates novel interconnect and signaling solutions for high-speed memory and die-to-die interfaces. The signal integrity scope is broad and analytically deep — spanning electrical modeling, channel analysis, and substrate evaluation — with an emphasis on original analysis rather than execution of established playbooks.

Key signal integrity domains include:

  • Interconnect Modeling — Generating and validating electrical models for packages, substrates, and interconnects used in forward-looking feasibility studies
  • Substrate & Packaging Evaluation — Assessing next-generation substrate technologies and providing strategic direction on their signal integrity implications
  • Channel & I/O Co-Optimization — Performing SI analysis during feasibility studies and driving I/O + channel co-optimization, including coordination with supporting organizations
  • Design Rule Development — Driving progressive design rules that enable package and system-level performance scaling
  • Link Budgeting & Sim-to-Silicon Correlation — Establishing forward-looking link budgets and developing methodologies that connect simulation predictions to measured silicon outcomes

What You’ll Own

  • Interconnect Modeling: Own the generation and validation of interconnect models — from field solver extraction through time- and frequency-domain circuit simulation — serving as the authoritative source for model quality on the team.
  • Technology Evaluation: Lead SI assessment of forward-looking substrate and packaging technologies, translating physical characteristics into channel performance projections and strategic recommendations.
  • Feasibility Analysis: Drive SI analysis during pathfinding studies, including I/O and channel co-optimization, and provide direction to supporting organizations when analysis is distributed.
  • Design Rule Definition: Develop and champion progressive package and system-level design rules grounded in electromagnetic analysis and simulation data.
  • Link Budgeting: Define forward-looking link budgets and establish the sim-to-silicon correlation methodologies that give the team and product programs confidence in pre-silicon predictions.
  • Cross-Disciplinary Engagement: Collaborate across Signal Integrity, Circuit and Chip Design, Packaging R&D, and System Integration — translating SI findings into actionable guidance for partner teams.
  • Design Documentation: Author analysis reports, modeling methodology documents, and design rule specifications that serve as the authoritative reference for the team and follow-on programs.

What You Bring

Required

  • MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related field (MS with strong electromagnetic/SI fundamentals accepted; PhD preferred but not sufficient on its own — demonstrated hands-on modeling and simulation capability is what differentiates)
  • 10+ years of industry experience in signal or power integrity analysis applied to high-speed interface technologies
  • Extensive experience applying electromagnetic and transmission line theory to SI/PI analysis of differential and single-ended interfaces
  • Extensive experience with time- and frequency-domain simulation tools — ADS, HSPICE, SPECTRE, or equivalent
  • Deep experience with electromagnetic field solvers — Q3D, SIWAVE, HFSS, or equivalent — including solver setup, mesh strategy, and result validation
  • Working knowledge of hardware measurement tools — oscilloscopes, TDR, VNA — and their application to SI characterization
  • Comfortable with broad ownership, cross-discipline collaboration, and making analytical decisions with real program consequences
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — this role produces modeling reports, link budgets, and design rule documents

Preferred

  • Familiarity with memory I/O architectures and their signal integrity constraints
  • Experience with advanced packaging technologies — 2.5D/3D integration, embedded die, or high-density organic substrates — and their electromagnetic modeling challenges
  • Post-silicon characterization experience — correlating simulation predictions to measured TDR, insertion loss, eye diagrams, or BER results
  • Some familiarity with modeling optical links
  • Willingness to learn and apply Artificial Intelligence -based methods to streamline modeling and simulation workflows
  • Prior experience in a pathfinding or advanced development environment where analysis methodology is actively developed, not inherited

Why This Role

  • You will do original signal integrity analysis on problems that matter — developing the interconnect models and channel solutions that define what high-speed memory and die-to-die interfaces can achieve.
  • You will work alongside genuinely exceptional engineers — spanning analog design, chip design, packaging R&D, and system integration — in an environment where SI analysis directly shapes architectural decisions.
  • The team is intentionally small and senior — decisions get made quickly, bureaucracy is minimal, and your technical judgment will be trusted.
  • You are joining an active program with real momentum — your analytical leadership will directly shape its trajectory and scope.
  • This is a long-term opportunity — strong execution early creates compounding impact as the program scales.

A Note to All Candidates

This role is part of a deliberate effort to build a long-term, high-caliber team around a compelling high-speed interface technology program. We are looking for engineers who want to own something, build something, and grow with a program. If that description resonates, we’d like to hear from you.

As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on .

title: Developer/Agency Commercial Lead

The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

Some of our best SMB merchants come to us through the local developers and agencies who build for them.You will work on strengthening PayPal’s presence on the Italian market by leading local engagement, attending key E-com events, and representing PayPal across the ecosystem to generate incremental merchant business. You’ll be responsible for building stronger local relationships, drive lead generation, and position PayPal as a preferred payment solution among merchant communities. You will identify opportunities, create referral activity and connect agency-generated leads to the appropriate Merchant Attach or Account Management owner.

  • Collaborate internally to influence process quality and efficiency.

  • Influence through defined processes and procedures.

  • Manage a defined portfolio of local developer and agency relationships.

  • Execute agreed referral, pipeline and commercial-development plans.

  • Identify, qualify and route incremental merchant opportunities.

  • Explain PayPal value propositions and integration options in practical commercial terms.

  • Coordinate with sales, Partner and Product teams to resolve straightforward barriers.

  • Track lead quality, conversion and incremental business contribution.

At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role

The Lead Supply Chain Data Scientist will drive advanced analytics and data science initiatives to optimize supply chain operations, with a focus on Materials Requirements Planning (MRP) system accuracy, inventory optimization, and production scheduling. This role combines deep supply chain domain expertise with advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, and AI capabilities to transform complex datasets into actionable business insights. The position requires both technical excellence in data science and strategic leadership in supply chain analytics.

About You

Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Analytics & AI Leadership

  • Develop and execute analytics strategies aligned with business and supply chain objectives, translating complex data into actionable insights

  • Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to analyze complex supply chain datasets

  • Develop and scale Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities, including copilot, RAG, and workflow automation solutions for supply chain applications

  • Drive technical strategy, best practices, AI governance, and adoption of enterprise AI capabilities

  • Generate actionable insights from data analysis to support strategic business decisions

  • Provide data insight to support and improve processes to enhance service quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction

  • Supply Chain Performance & Analytics

  • Develop, manage, and maintain key supply chain performance and financial metrics, including on-time delivery, supplier quality, Purchase Order projections, Goods Receipt projections, Purchase Price Variance trend, and Excess & Obsolescence trend

  • Develop and maintain a Supply Chain Metrics platform for use by leadership at multiple levels of the organization

  • Support the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) process by compiling, analyzing, and presenting supply chain data to cross-functional stakeholders

  • Monitor and report on inventory levels, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization

  • Utilize AI/BI tools to analyze MRP outputs (planned orders, exception messages) and perform what-if simulations to forecast material shortages or excesses

  • MRP System Strategy & Optimization

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize MRP parameters (e.g., safety stock, lot sizes, lead times, safety time) within the ERP system (SAP) to maximize service levels while minimizing inventory investment

  • Own the accuracy, performance, and optimization of the Materials Requirements Planning system

  • Analyze large datasets to identify bottlenecks in replenishment and production scheduling

  • Data Quality, Governance & Technical Excellence

  • Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across supply chain systems and reporting platforms

  • Comprehensive understanding of IT systems, software development data, CI/CD, engineering, and business processes

  • Strong understanding of database environments and upgrades

  • Utilize SQL, Python, R, PowerBI, and other analytics/data platforms to manipulate large datasets, perform root cause analysis, and automate reporting

  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner with supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, quality, and engineering teams to solve complex business problems

  • Serve as the primary liaison between Procurement, Production, Business Development, and IT to align MRP strategies with customer demand and capacity planning

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to operationalize solutions using modern cloud and MLOps platforms

  • Process Improvement & Innovation

  • Identify opportunities for automation, system integration, and process optimization to improve MRP efficiency and decision-making speed

  • Identify areas for improvement, develop improvement plans, and lead implementation thereof

  • Proven track record of process improvement and implementation

  • Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor, coach, and manage a team of analysts, data scientists, or planners

  • Provide thought leadership across analytics and AI initiatives

  • May supervise, mentor, and/or coach other business systems analysts

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Science, Operations, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree; Masters degree with 6+ years of experience also qualifies)

  • Typically 8+ years of progressive experience combining:

  • Material planning, production planning, or supply chain analytics

  • Data science, statistical modeling, and machine learning applications

  • Focus on system optimization and process improvement

  • Strong experience with SAP MRP and advanced data visualization tools (Power BI or similar tools)

  • Advanced Excel skills (modeling, VBA) and SQL knowledge to extract and manage data

  • Expertise in programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL

  • Comprehensive understanding of IT systems, software development data, CI/CD, and business processes

  • Strong understanding of database environments and upgrades


Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related field

  • Technical Skills - Advanced

  • Experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn

  • Strong knowledge of statistical analysis and data mining techniques

  • Experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka

  • Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker

  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI

  • Experience with version control systems like Git

  • Experience with MLOps platforms and model deployment best practices

  • Certifications

  • APICS CPIM (Certified in Production and Inventory Management) or CSCP (Certified Supply Chain Professional) certification is highly desirable

  • Leadership & Domain Expertise

  • Proven track record of leading analytics initiatives and driving measurable business impact

  • Experience in supervising, mentoring, and coaching other analysts and data scientists

  • Deep understanding of supply chain operations, inventory management, and production planning principles

  • Experience with Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) processes

$128,648.00 - $176,891.00

We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more.

You will be working in close partnership with instrument suppliers and/or vendors, site environmental sustainability leadership teams, site manufacturing teams, site facility teams, global smart manufacturing teams, global labs etc. to perform measurement, optimize measurement methodologies, write and document measurement reports, and provide data insights and recommendations to propel Micron towards the goal of achieving net zero emissions.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Licenses and Certifications

Skills and Abilities

  • May be regularly required to stand or sit for extended periods, walk long distances, use hands to handle, hold, or feel objects, tools, or controls, reach with arms, and talk or hear.

title: Head of Release - Cambridge
description:
Ready to take your career global?

Are you ready to unleash your full potential? We’re looking for people who are passionate about payments to chart GlobalPayments’ path to being the largest and most-loved payments company in the world.

What you will be doing

  • Line manager of a team of release managers responsible for the roll out of changes to a very high volume payment gateway.

  • Defines and leads the release management strategy for GlobalPayments payment gateways, cloud platforms and supporting technology services.

  • Manages the full release lifecycle, including release planning, readiness, approval, deployment, monitoring, post-release validation, audit evidence and continuous improvement.

  • Ensures software, infrastructure, cloud and platform changes are delivered safely, predictably and without negative customer or operational impact.

  • Owns release governance across business-critical, high-availability payment processing services, balancing delivery throughput, operational resilience, regulatory obligations and customer experience.

  • Leads release planning, scheduling, stakeholder engagement and supplier coordination across cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

  • Manages the work efforts of Release Managers and associated release, deployment and platform delivery resources, including leadership, coaching, performance management and resource planning.

  • Identifies and allocates release, technical, engineering, DevOps, cloud and operational resources to support portfolio and programme delivery priorities.

  • Forecasts release and deployment resource needs based on product demand, portfolio commitments, platform roadmap activity and operational change volumes.

  • Ensures release activity adheres to agreed change, incident, audit, PCI, security, risk and operational control standards.

  • Provides input into product, platform and technology direction where release complexity, operational readiness or deployment risk may affect delivery outcomes.

  • Coordinates with engineering, platform, product, service management, security, risk, audit and compliance teams to verify that releases meet regulatory and operational requirements.

  • Ensures proper application of cloud, DevOps and platform technologies to support safe, repeatable and observable production release outcomes.

  • Champions CI/CD, deployment automation, infrastructure as code, release pipeline improvement and repeatable deployment practices.

  • Ensures release approaches are appropriate for cloud-hosted and hybrid platforms, including technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, OpenShift, EKS, EC2, Helm, Jenkins and Terraform.

  • Ensures effective monitoring, alerting, logging and observability are in place so deployment progress, service health and customer impact can be understood quickly.

  • Oversees release communications before, during and after deployment, ensuring stakeholders receive timely, accurate and business-relevant updates.

  • Resolves critical release issues, acts as an escalation point for release readiness and deployment risk, and contributes to broader technology and service improvement.

  • Ensures base applications, platforms and supporting services meet appropriate quality, resilience and release-readiness standards.

  • Adheres to departmental software delivery, release management, change management and client delivery process standards.

  • Other related duties assigned as needed.

What you bring:

  • Knowledge of GlobalPayments products, services, payment processing platforms and customer-facing technology capabilities.

  • Knowledge of release management, deployment management, change management, ITIL, service management and operational governance practices.

  • Knowledge of cloud, DevOps and platform engineering principles, including CI/CD, automation, infrastructure as code, container orchestration and observability.

  • Knowledge of relevant cloud and deployment technologies, including AWS, Kubernetes, OpenShift, EKS, EC2, Helm, Jenkins, Terraform and equivalent tooling.

  • Knowledge of regulated technology environments, including PCI, audit, security, risk and evidence requirements.

  • Skill in release planning, project management, organisation, communication, analysis and people leadership.

  • Skill in leading, supervising and managing effectively under pressure, particularly during complex or time-critical release activity.

  • Skill in translating technical deployment risk into clear business impact and actionable decision-making.

  • Ability to interact confidently with executive-level stakeholders, internal customers, suppliers and senior technology leaders.

  • Ability to analyse business, product and operational needs and determine the related release, platform and technology support required.

  • Ability to maintain positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple releases, projects, activities, dependencies and problem areas concurrently.

  • Ability to delegate work to qualified managers, release leads, engineers or delivery resources as appropriate.

  • Ability to lead, direct and manage effectively across matrixed, distributed and cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to operate independently while maintaining appropriate governance, escalation and stakeholder alignment.

  • Ability to exhibit solid decision-making and problem-solving skills under operational pressure.

  • Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.

Experience

  • Typically requires nine or more years of relevant experience in release management, software delivery, technology operations or platform delivery.

  • Typically requires seven or more years of management or supervisory experience.

  • Experience leading release management across business-critical, high-availability payment processing services.

  • Experience working across cloud-hosted and hybrid platforms, including AWS, Kubernetes, OpenShift, EKS, EC2, Helm, Jenkins and Terraform or equivalent tooling.

  • Works under general direction of senior or executive technology management.

  • Leads and mentors a team of Release Managers and associated release, deployment and platform delivery resources.

  • Participates in the development of release methods, governance, programmes, operating models and people capability across GlobalPayments technology.

  • Controls decisions across a broad release management function and acts as a project leader, escalation point and subject matter expert for complex release planning, deployment risk, operational readiness and production change.

  • Provides input into strategic direction for release management, cloud deployment practices, DevOps adoption and platform delivery improvement.

  • In some instances, this manager may have subordinate managers or supervisors.

About the team

The Release team owns the planning, governance and safe execution of production change across WPG payment gateways, cloud platforms and supporting technology services. The team works closely with engineering, platform, product, service management, security, risk and compliance teams to ensure releases are predictable, controlled and delivered without negative customer or operational impact.

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

Who are we?
Here within the Anglian Water @one Alliance we are a totally collaborative organisation made up of our eight partner companies (Anglian Water, Balfour Beatty, Barhale, Binnies, MMB, MWH Treatment, Skanska and SWECO) and our extended supply chain, working together to deliver over half of Anglian Water’s capital investment programme.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Systems Engineer

Location: This is a Hybrid role. Whiteley, Hampshire

Clearance Required: This role will require attainment and maintenance of SC clearance

About Leidos

At Leidos, we deliver innovative technology and solutions that help safeguard critical capabilities and transform frontline services. Our work in the UK spans Air Traffic Management, Public Services, Defence, Healthcare, Government, Safety, and Security, helping tackle some of the country's most complex challenges.

The Opportunity

We are looking for Systems Engineers to join our growing team. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a large-scale programme delivering critical infrastructure and services that will support the future of UK Air Traffic Management.

You'll work collaboratively with operational users, stakeholders, architects, customers, and suppliers to define and deliver systems engineering solutions across the full project lifecycle. A significant part of the role will involve developing both text-based and model-based requirements, architecture, and design artefacts.

While the role can be performed largely remotely, regular travel to our Whiteley office (near Portsmouth) will be required.

You will support the delivery of systems engineering activities across complex system integration programmes, with a particular focus on Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).

Key responsibilities include:

  • Deliver systems engineering activities across complex programmes and projects.

  • Work with stakeholders, suppliers, and architects to define and manage system requirements.

  • Develop requirements, models, designs, and architecture artefacts using MBSE approaches and tools such as DOORS.

  • Support solution design, compliance activities, technical reviews, and project milestones.

  • Produce engineering documentation including designs, analyses, compliance reports, and security, safety, and service-related artefacts.

  • Conduct technical assessments, trade studies, and feasibility evaluations to support solution development.

  • Contribute to the delivery of integrated solutions using COTS and bespoke technologies.

What We're Looking For

We welcome applications from candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you meet some of the criteria below, we'd still love to hear from you.

  • Experience with systems engineering in complex or mission-critical environments.

  • Knowledge of architecture modelling tools, frameworks, and languages such as SysML, TOGAF, MODAF, ArchiMate, or similar.

  • Experience developing requirements, system models, interfaces, and design artefacts using text-based and model-based approaches.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with customers, stakeholders, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams.

  • Experience evaluating solutions through trade studies, feasibility assessments, or technical analysis.

  • Understanding of service-oriented, virtualised, or cloud-based architectures.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences.

What we do for you:
At Leidos we are PASSIONATE about customer success, UNITED as a team and INSPIRED to make a difference. We offer meaningful and engaging careers, a collaborative culture, and support for your career goals, all while nurturing a healthy work-life balance.
We provide an employment package that attracts, develops and retains only the best in talent. Our reward scheme includes:

  • Contributory Pension Scheme

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • 33 days Annual Leave (including public and privilege holidays)

  • Access to Flexible benefits

  • Flexi Working

Commitment to Diversity:

We welcome applications from every part of the community and are committed to a truly diverse and inclusive culture. We foster a sense of belonging, welcoming all perspectives and contributions, and providing equal access to opportunities and resources for everyone. If you have a disability or need any reasonable adjustments during the application and selection stages, please let us know, and we will respond in a way that best fits your needs.

Who We Are:

Leidos UK & EUROPE – we work to make the world safer, healthier, and more efficient through technology, engineering and science.

Leidos is a growing company delivering innovative technology and solutions focused on safeguarding critical capabilities and transformation in frontline services, our work in the United Kingdom includes addressing some of the most complex problems in defence, healthcare, government, safety and security, and transportation.

Working together as Team Leidos we are helping to transform the UK's defence supply chain by providing an integration of a complex mixture of services, at low risk, using a modern suite of systems that will deliver one version of the truth. For the first time, the MOD will see the whole picture, as it is happening.

What Makes Us Different:

Purpose: you can use your passion and abilities at Leidos to keep the people you care about safe. We are at the forefront of machine learning, AI, cyber security and solutions. Using your skills in the technology frontline by helping to build a safer world. You can inspire change.

Collaboration: having flexibility to do your job is one of our core benefits, enabling you to become part of our extraordinary team. We have been empowering our people to work flexibly for years. Whether you work from home, the office or on customer sites, we will give you the digital tools and the flexibility to work smarter and align your needs and ours.

People: Leidos empowers people from every background to be themselves and gives you the tools to learn new skills by enabling growth whilst developing. We believe that extraordinary people need opportunities to grow, to be inspired and to inspire others. At Leidos, we invest in technical academies, career rotations and a career development plans that that enhance your future.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range:

£47,600.00-£61,000.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary.
