Summary

The Assistant Director of Engineering is directly responsible for supervising the engineering and grounds teams to maintain the condition of the properties at optimal levels. This includes executing ongoing and preventative maintenance programs, monitoring expenses, inventorying parts and supplies and ensuring projects are completed in accordance with La Jolla Beach & Tennis Club, Inc. guidelines.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Salary Range: 90k-110k annualized

  • Responsible for staffing and maintenance of all engineering positions.

  • Ensures neatness and cleanliness of the engineering shop and all engineering storage and areas of responsibility.

  • Supervises directly all engineering personnel.

  • Selects, hires, and trains department personnel.

  • Prepares reports, budgets and correspondence.

  • Prepares monthly financial critiques along with monthly 90 day rolling forecast.

  • Ensures quality control and work standards are maintained and regularly updated to meet changing department and property needs.

  • Ensures that compliance is met with all applicable ordinances, regulations and laws (OSHA, ADA, etc.).

  • Implements and monitors preventative maintenance programs (i.e. utilizing HotSOS, department systems, etc.).

  • Administers work request program in conjunction with Guest Assistance/Hotsos tracking program.

  • Provides support and assistance to all departments to serve guest satisfaction, sales and profit goals.

  • Facilitates monthly departmental meeting.

  • Analyzes tasks for potential dangers and promptly corrects hazards or informs supervisor and/or safety committee representative.

  • Follows safety rules and regulations at all times.

  • Maintains familiarity with GL codes, and code packing slips and material requisitions.

  • Assist in preparation of annual budget.

  • Monitors the purchase orders and material requisition systems to ensure that effective cost control is being maintained.

  • Other duties may be assigned.

  • Confers with workers to resolve complaints regarding work.

  • Coaches and counsel’s department personnel as needed.

  • Sets an example for subordinates by meeting and exceeding the performance requirements of the job and maintaining good work habits (punctuality, reliability).

  • In conjunction with the preventative maintenance program, observes the building and mechanical equipment to identify ways to conserve energy. Whenever possible, attempts to reduce unnecessary energy consumption and to ensure necessary consumption is as efficient as possible.

  • Assists in effectively establishing and implementing energy conservation programs. Offers technical advice and information for energy programs within each department.

  • Maintains knowledge of the building fire and life safety systems and trains others in the operation of the system.

  • Maintains familiarity with the La Jolla Beach and Tennis Club Emergency Organization Plan.

Technical and Service Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance activities on utility systems to provide continuous supply of heat, electric power, gas, or air required for operations.

  • Inspects operating machines and equipment for conformance with operational standards.

  • Works with Director of Facilities and Director of Engineering in planning, developing, and implementing new methods and procedures designed to improve operations, minimize operating costs, and effect greater utilization of labor and materials.

  • Responds and ensures quick response by the Engineering Department to member and guest needs, which will meet or exceed expectations.

  • Confers with management to resolve maintenance problems and recommend measures to improve operations and conditions of machines and equipment.

  • Maintains skills and knowledge in the following areas: H.V.A.C. and Refrigeration; Boiler Plant Operation, A/C electrical and electrical troubleshooting; telephone switch; electronic door locks, arc welding, gas welding, soldering and brazing; plumbing (with steel, copper and plastic pipe; fire protection, hydraulics, pneumatics, sanitation, laundry and kitchen equipment).

OUTCOME

The overall maintenance of the guest rooms and the facilities influence member, guest and co-employee impression of the total organization. Clean, well maintained guest rooms, facilities and equipment will contribute to guest comfort and satisfaction and achieve room occupancy and revenue goals.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly supervises employees in the Engineering Department. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Associate's degree (A. A.) or equivalent from Two‑year College or technical school; or three to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence in English representing appropriate business etiquette in written form (grammar, punctuation, syntax, etc). Ability to speak effectively in English with customers, managers, vendors, or employees of organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Must have valid California driver’s license.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to walk; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit and taste or smell.

The employee must constantly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORKING CONDITIONS

ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly works in outside weather conditions. The employee frequently works near moving mechanical parts and in high, precarious places and is frequently exposed to risk of electrical shock and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, extreme cold, and extreme heat. The employee is responsible in taking action to perform the task safely.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.

The La Jolla Beach & Tennis Club is committed to ensuring a safe work environment for all employees. In compliance with federal “Right to Know” requirements, the company freely discloses this information so that all employees are informed about

potential hazards in the work place. We encourage all employees to immediately report any known or potentially dangerous hazards to management.

INTERACTION

Employees in the position of Director of Engineering interact frequently with all the departments, tenants and guests. Employees must have the ability to communicate effectively and work with many departments along with designated guests or vendors.

SCHEDULING

This company operates seven days a week, 24 hours a day. Shifts will generally be rotated unless you were hired for a specific shift, as much as possible to be fair to everyone. Be aware that at times it may be necessary to move you from your accustomed shift if business or task assignments demand. At times it may be necessary to move you from your accustomed shift if business or task assignments demand. title: IT Cyber Security Specialist
description:
Mission Overview:


Keystone Solutions is seeking an IT Cyber Security Specialist for a consultancy mission at a client site. The primary objective of this role is to enhance the operational security team responsible for protecting, detecting, and responding to cybersecurity incidents.


The consultant will integrate into the team as a SecOps engineer specializing in network and infrastructure security, contributing to the security operations while being available for on-call duties 24/7 in rotation with other team members.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Manage daily security tools and incidents.
  • Maintain and optimize security tools (excluding exploitation).
  • Collaborate with the Security Operations Center (SOC) and other teams to enhance overall security.
  • Participate in projects related to operational security.
  • Respond on-call or on standby based on incident criticality.
  • Handle security incidents (analysis, escalation, resolution) including documentation.
  • Coordinate different teams for incident resolution or security improvement.
  • Analyze network flows and correlate with alerts.
  • Contribute to securing network architectures, configuration relevance, and exception management (impact and risk analysis).
  • Participate in tuning protection and detection rules, especially on network security tools (WAF, IDS/IPS, NDR, Proxy, etc.).
  • Establish exception management (impact and risk analysis).
  • Provide transversal support on security tools.
  • Conduct post-mortem analysis of incidents: technical retrospectives, recommendations, and follow-up on action plans with the ITSM team.
  • Process alerts (SIEM, WAF, etc.) from the SOC and/or security tools.
  • Conduct security monitoring and threat intelligence: tracking CVEs, IOCs, MITRE ATT&CK tactics.
  • Participate in the development or continuous improvement of SecOps processes, procedures, and guides.
  • Support IT projects related to operational security: security reviews, providing technical-functional advice, and active participation in project teams.
  • Utilize ITSM tools (Jira Service Management, etc.).
  • Perform any other activities related to operational security based on service needs and priorities.

Working Conditions:


This mission will be executed within the security division of the client under the supervision of the operational security manager. The consultant will provide regular full-time services (40 hours/week) and will ensure availability for on-call duties 24/7, with a commitment to respond to certain alerts within a maximum of 30 minutes.


The SOC and the client may call the consultant on duty to handle priority 1 or 2 incident analysis, take response actions, and coordinate teams until the incident is resolved. Integration into existing processes (incident management, change management, SOC, etc.) is essential.


Expected Deliverables:


  • Activity and incident reports, progress reports on post-incident recommendations.
  • NIS2: initial notification, preliminary report, and final report.
  • Change log of rules (who, what, why).
  • Optimized configurations of security tools.
  • Technical documentation, processes, and procedures.
  • Improvement recommendations and advice.
  • Cyber dashboard, operational, tactical, and strategic reporting.
  • Follow-up on security KPIs.

Expected Behavioral Competencies:


  • Clear communication.
  • Rigorous change management.
  • Emergency management.
  • Incident prioritization.
  • Adaptability and learning capability.
  • Technical curiosity.
  • Autonomy.
  • Team collaboration.
  • Assertiveness and ability to challenge.

Evaluation Method:


The evaluation will include an interview where questions and/or situational assessments related to the mission description will be utilized.


If you are ready to tackle technical and strategic challenges in a dynamic consultancy environment, apply today at Keystone Solutions Career Portal.

title: Director, Claims Supply Chain
description:
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we help people, businesses, and society prosper in good times and be resilient in bad times.

  • Flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work model

  • Multiple benefits offered to support physical and mental wellbeing, including telemedicine, Wellness account and much more

Salary range (but not limited to):

149,600 - 182,800

20%

Our pension offerings provide flexibility and long-term security for our employees beyond their careers. We are one of the few companies offering the opportunity to receive guaranteed income for life via our defined benefit pension plan.

Salary for the candidate will be determined taking into consideration a number of factors including: experience, skills, qualifications, anticipated contribution to role, internal equity, etc. The salary range presented above is based on a 35-hour workweek and would represent a majority of different candidate profiles. However, we encourage candidates who may fall outside of this range to apply as well.


About the role

Who We Are:

The Supply Chain team is at the heart of the strategy in our Claims organization. Being a part of the largest business unit within Intact, the exposure of this role crosses many business units within Claims and our Intact strategies. This role is the voice and interpretation of our results within claims and is heavily reliant to provide consulting on trends and actions to stakeholders widely in the organization.

About This Role:

The Director, Claims Supply Chain leads the strategy, operations, and performance of Property Supply Chain within Intact’s Claims organization. The role collaborates closely with senior leaders in Claims, Procurement, and other operational business units, as well as executive stakeholders, to optimize supplier performance, advance strategic initiatives, deliver national projects, and achieve cost, operational quality, and customer service objectives. The Director also leads a national team and fosters strong, collaborative relationships across the supply chain function.

What you'll do here:

  • Oversee processes and operations and drive strategy for Property Supply Chain

  • Support the Claims and Procurement departments in their projects and initiatives

  • Analyze, recommend, and implement strategic projects to optimize supply chain management

  • Ensure optimal performance of quantitative and qualitative indicators related to the operational performance of suppliers

  • Lead or contribute to national projects to meet quality, schedule and cost objectives while ensuring that projects meet the company's high customer service standards and objectives

  • Participate in the operations and deployment of projects and collaborative policies by planning, directing, and controlling the various operational phases

  • Ensure constant and professional communication with the various business partners to establish relationships based on trust and collaboration

  • Responsible for negotiating contracts with strategic suppliers

  • Drive initiatives towards achieving Net Zero and promote sustainability within the supply chain

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Post secondary education: Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or Actuarial Science - is required

  • Minimum 10-years professional experience: Finance, Supply Chain Management, or Property & Casualty insurance - is required

  • Minimum 5-years experience leading direct reports nationally, including performance management, coaching, and career development – is required

  • Ability to travel nationally is required

  • Strong ability to create presentations and present to all levels including executive leadership

Ability to communicate with employees, physicians, management, and external business contacts in a courteous and professional manner. description:

title: Data engineer
description:
Wil jij als data engineer een sleutelrol spelen in de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern dataplatform? Ben je sterk in het ontsluiten, structureren en integreren van data en wil je werken met Azure, Databricks, Python en PySpark? Dan is dit jouw kans! In deze functie help je mkb-ondernemers om meer waarde uit hun data te halen en krijg je volop ruimte om mee te denken over architectuur, optimalisaties en toekomstige data-initiatieven. Klinkt dat als een uitdaging die bij jou past? Ontdek dan wat de rol van data engineer bij Moore DRV jou te bieden heeft!



Vergeet niet uw cv te controleren voordat u solliciteert. Zorg er ook voor dat u alle vereisten met betrekking tot deze functie doorleest.
Jouw functie als data engineer

Je start je werkdag samen met het data analytics team tijdens een korte stand‑up. Hier bespreken jullie de voortgang van projecten, uitdagingen en de belangrijkste prioriteiten voor de dag. Daarna ga je aan de slag met het aansluiten van nieuwe databronnen, het optimaliseren van bestaande dataflows en het monitoren van dagelijkse datastromen. Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw rol is het waarborgen van de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid van data. Je controleert actief op afwijkingen, voert validaties uit en zorgt ervoor dat gegevens alleen beschikbaar zijn voor geautoriseerde gebruikers. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met data‑analisten en BI‑specialisten om ervoor te zorgen dat de ontsloten data geschikt is voor analyses, dashboards en rapportages. Eventuele knelpunten los je zelfstandig op en je legt je werkzaamheden zorgvuldig vast. Aan het einde van de dag beheer je jouw wijzigingen via Git en werk je de documentatie bij, zodat collega’s altijd beschikken over actuele informatie.


Als data engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontsluiten en integreren van data uit verschillende systemen, waaronder Exact Online, AFAS, Twinfield, Nmbrs en andere ERP‑, HR‑ en CRM‑oplossingen. Met behulp van Python, PySpark en Databricks ontwikkel en onderhoud je schaalbare data pipelines die data verzamelen, verrijken en beschikbaar maken voor verdere verwerking. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan een geautomatiseerde pipeline die dagelijks financiële gegevens uit Exact Online verwerkt en opslaat in een centraal datamodel. Daarnaast speel je een actieve rol in het realiseren van een veilig en toekomstbestendig dataplatform. Je maakt gebruik van onder andere encryptie, toegangsbeheer, monitoring en veilige cloudopslag binnen Azure om data betrouwbaar beschikbaar te stellen. Datakwaliteit wordt zowel automatisch als handmatig gecontroleerd, waarbij je samenwerkt met collega’s om een hoge standaard te waarborgen. Dankzij jouw ervaring met API‑koppelingen verbind je moeiteloos verschillende systemen en draag je bij aan innovatieve data‑integraties en toekomstige datamigratieprojecten.


Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden als data engineer:

  • Ontwikkelen van dataflows en ontsluiten van databronnen binnen Azure en Databricks.
  • Bouwen en onderhouden van cloud‑based data pipelines met Python en PySpark.
  • Projectmatig samenwerken met collega’s binnen het data analytics team.
  • Ontwerpen, bouwen en ondersteunen van een veilig en schaalbaar dataplatform.
  • Afstemming met BI specialisten om gegevensvereisten te begrijpen en te vertalen naar technische oplossingen. Je ontwikkelt een koppeling om alle financiële transacties van klanten uit Exact Online te ontsluiten.
  • Opleveren van veilige, betrouwbare en schaalbare data‑oplossingen in samenwerking met andere interne teams.

Het team van IT consulancy werkt over de vestigingen heen.


Wat zoeken wij

Onze nieuwe collega heeft minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als data engineer. Verder:



  • Heb jij kennis van gedistribueerde dataverwerkings frameworks, zoals Apache Spark Architecture.
  • Heb je bij voorkeur ervaring met het bouwen en onderhouden van cloud‑based data pipelines.
  • Heb je praktische kennis van Python, kennis van PySpark is een pré.
  • Heb je kennis van agile methodologie en API’s. Daarnaast ben jij altijd up‑to‑date als het gaat om de nieuwste technologieën en trends op het gebied van data.

Werken bij IT consultancy & analytics in Bergen op Zoom

Ons team helpt ondernemers passende software‑ en BI‑oplossingen te kiezen en te implementeren, zodat zij hun (financiële) ambities en doelstellingen sneller en eenvoudiger bereiken. We motiveren ondernemers in de echte economie om los te breken uit hun traditionele processen en begeleiden ze naar een nieuwe manier van werken, door slimme toepassing van IT en data. Daarvoor combineren we onze kennis van mkb‑ondernemingen met onze uitgebreide kennis van branchegerichte IT‑ en data‑oplossingen. Als collega binnen IT Consultancy & Analytics werk je samen met ongeveer 30 enthousiaste collega’s en naast dat je direct voor klanten werkt, heb je ook een ondersteunende functie voor alle vestigingen van Moore DRV. Je hebt dus veelvuldig contact met collega’s en bent vaak op locatie bij onze klanten in Noord‑Brabant, Zeeland en Zuid‑Holland. Jouw werkplek kan daarom variëren, waar je ook vanuit huis kan werken, maar er is altijd een flexibele werkplek voor jou beschikbaar op ons kantoor in Bergen op Zoom of een van onze andere kantoren!


Wat wij jou bieden als data engineer

  • 28 vakantiedagen.
  • Mogelijkheid om 10 extra vakantiedagen per jaar bij te kopen voor als je er een keer goed tussenuit wilt!
  • 3 flexibele (feest)dagen in het kader van diversiteit.
  • Één ESG verlofdag per kalenderjaar, zodat jij een ESG activiteit met jouw team kan gaan doen.
  • Je kunt gebruik maken van de leasefietsregeling.
  • Laptop en mobiele telefoon.
  • Laagdrempelige, onbeperkte online ondersteuning door psychologen en coaches bij stress, zelfvertrouwen en mentale balans via OpenUp.
  • Pensioenregeling en bedrijfsfitnessregeling of een bijdrage aan je sportcontributie.
  • Onbeperkt toegang tot trainingen via de DRV Academie en deelname aan externe congressen. xgiwjmb
  • Leuke uitjes met de personeelsvereniging.

title: Assistant Gen Counsel / Senior Counsel  - FERC
description:
Job Posting End Date

09-28-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, FERC Legal and RTO Policy, the Assistant General Counsel / Senior Counsel, FERC will lead and independently manage significant federal energy regulatory matters, including proceedings before the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission and matters in PJM, SPP, and MISO. AEP’s scale and multi-region footprint will provide the attorney with opportunities to work on issues central to the industry’s evolution, including transmission and regional cost allocation, wholesale market and resource adequacy rules, interconnection and transmission service, rapid growth in large loads and data centers, complex rate proceedings, and the FERC-regulatory aspects of strategic transactions and investments. The position offers substantial ownership and a varied docket. The attorney will develop strategy, advise senior leaders, draft and advocate AEP’s positions, and manage matters from inception through resolution, while partnering with internal business and policy teams and outside counsel as appropriate. The practice is centered on FERC electric rates and terms of service, transmission, interconnection, wholesale markets, FERC transaction approvals, and NERC issues. Experience with formula rates, cost-of-service principles, and utility accounting is especially valuable, although the role will extend well beyond any single FERC subject area.

Job Description

What You'll Do:

  • Represent AEP on complex, high-profile FERC proceedings and disputes involving transmission rates and service, regional transmission planning and cost allocation, interconnection, wholesale market design, capacity and resource adequacy, large-load integration and other matters under the Federal Power Act.
  • Develop and execute legal and regulatory strategy from issue identification through resolution; conduct legal analysis; prepare and review comments, protests, complaints, briefs, testimony, settlement materials, legal opinions and other filings; and advocate AEP’s positions in contested proceedings, rulemakings and settlement processes.
  • Represent AEP in PJM, SPP and MISO stakeholder, tariff and governance processes, working closely with the FERC and RTO Policy organization and business leaders to shape outcomes on transmission, markets, planning, reliability and large-load issues.
  • Provide practical, business-oriented advice to AEP’s transmission, generation, commercial, regulatory, finance, operations and other teams regarding FERC jurisdiction, RTO tariffs, transmission service, interconnection, rates, compliance and state-federal jurisdictional issues.
  • Advise on complex rate matters, including transmission formula rates, cost of service and utility accounting, while maintaining a broad portfolio that also includes tariff terms and conditions, transmission policy, interconnection and wholesale-market matters.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Secfi is building the private wealth stack for employees and executives with equity.



Scroll naar beneden om alle bijbehorende functie-eisen en eventuele verantwoordelijkheden voor succesvolle kandidaten te zien.
The Problem We're Solving

Private markets are where most wealth is created today, and they're notoriously hard for individuals to navigate. The best financial advice has always been a luxury, reserved for the ultra-wealthy, delivered by private bankers.


Even those who can afford an advisor often find that most have a blind spot when it comes to pre-IPO company equity & stock options. It's a black box for most in the industry.


Meanwhile, startup employees give years of their lives. Intense work, real sacrifice. Then the company finally has its exit, and they get burned. They pay more tax than they need to. They don't have access to private bank liquidity solutions. They mishandle their shares. They can leave millions on the table, on the single biggest financial decision of their life.


We're changing that!


Secfi is putting sophisticated equity strategy in the hands of the people building the world's most innovative companies.


We work with the builders behind the best tech companies on the planet. We're doubling revenue year on year, growing AUM at over 200%, and we're trusted by employees from companies like Canva, Stripe, SpaceX, Databricks and Anthropic.


We're indirectly invested in more than half the IPOs of the biggest tech brands you know, and we help the people who built them with something deeply personal: their finances.


Why Now?

We're at an inflection point. Demand is climbing, and we're expanding fast on all fronts. A great fintech is a strong blend of financial products and technology, and we're pushing hard on each.


The financial products. The financing and wealth platforms that already drive our revenue, with a fast-growing user base. Now we're deepening them. Automating what's still manual, shipping the features that turn a strong business into a category leader. It's the highest-leverage work in the company: every improvement compounds straight to the bottom line.


The technology. Maeve is our agentic financial planner, and it's becoming the interface for everything Secfi does. Not a feature bolted onto the side, but the hub: the connective layer between our financing, wealth and planning products, and the way customers interact with all of it.


We've merged frontier AI with each person's real financial data and our proprietary calculation engines to bring clarity to the most complex decisions someone will ever face. The more context it holds, the better it gets. The Forecaster predicts the future value of private equity, something only investment banks can do today. We're building it for everyone.


This is a genuinely hard space. Many moving parts, uncertain outcomes, probabilistic by nature, where accuracy and trust are everything. Whatever advice we give has to be right, every time.


It's early enough that the biggest problems are still unsolved. The people who join now are the ones who'll solve them.


About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build the systems behind some of the most consequential financial decisions people ever make.


Let's be straight about what this is, and what it isn't. If you're chasing scale problems - millions of concurrent users, distributed systems at the edge of what infrastructure can handle, this isn't the role. Our user numbers are around 60,000 & growing.


The real complexity here is in the domain and the nature of the problems you’ll need to solve: probabilistic financial modelling, tax logic across multiple jurisdictions reverse engineered into software, forecasting the value of assets that don't have a public price, accessing data that needs to be accurate.


The math is hard. The correctness bar is absolute. Get it wrong and someone makes a life-changing decision on bad information.


You’ll work in a small, tight team. Backend, frontend, design, product. Horizontal structure, high agency, limited overhead. You’ll report to the Head of Product & Technology.


We don't want someone who waits for nicely packaged work. We want an engineer who goes and understands the world the product lives in. What customers are actually trying to do, why we're building what we're building, and what the domain demands. You’ll need to learn the domain deeply enough to have opinions about them. That's not a side quest; it's the job.


What You'll Own

Maeve - the agentic hub. Maeve is becoming the interface for everything Secfi does, the layer that connects our financing, wealth and planning products and gets smarter with every user it serves. Built on Bedrock with Claude, model-agnostic, running LangChain and LangSmith. You'll build the systems that let an AI planner reason over real financial data and our proprietary calculation engines, and be right every time.


The calculation engines. The tax logic, the modelling, the Forecaster. This is the core intellectual property of the company and the hardest code in the building.


Core product surfaces. Our equity planning tools, onboarding and financing flows are used by thousands of people. You’ll build user-facing product, not internal admin panels.


Turning manual into software. Parts of our financing and wealth business still run manually. Underwriting, contracts, advisor workflows. Rebuilding these as proper systems is the highest-leverage engineering in the company. Every improvement compounds straight to revenue.


Knowing whether it worked. We care about impact, not output. You’ll want to know what the thing you built actually did.


Experience You Need

  • Strong Python. Someone who builds and ships production services.
  • Real product experience. You've built customer-facing systems in a core product and had impact on them.
  • SQL and relational databases. You know how to model data properly and you understand what the database is actually doing.
  • REST API design and build. You've designed the contract, not just implemented someone else's.
  • Public cloud. You've built and run services in production on AWS or equivalent.
  • Technology agnostic. You pick the right tool for the problem rather than the one you already know.
  • A track record in unstructured, high-ownership environments. Startup, scaleup, or a larger company that genuinely moves like one. Somewhere you had to work out what mattered rather than being told.
  • Proactive about the domain. You've shown that you go and understand the problem space, the customers, and why the solution is the shape it is.
  • A STEM degree. It doesn't need to be computer science.

Bonus Points

  • You've built with agents. Professionally or personally. We care that you've actually done it and show inquisitiveness in the latest technology.
  • Startup or scaleup experience. Many hats, real pace.
  • A complex or regulated domain - fintech, biotech, security etc. Somewhere correctness mattered and the problems were genuinely hard.
  • GraphQL. An understanding is plenty.
  • You care about analytics. You measure what you build.

Our Stack

Maeve: Bedrock · Claude (model agnostic) · LangChain / LangSmith


And we run Claude Code Premium - multiple coding agents.


Practicalities

Location - Amsterdam, 3 days a week (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday)


Contract - 1 year Dutch contract, indefinite thereafter


Eligibility - We sponsor work visas, process the 30% ruling & relocate for the right person (relocation credit provided)


Compensation - €90 - €120K (including 8% holiday allowance) + 5% pension contribution + bonus + stock options


What's In It For You?

You’ll build for the builders. Our customers are the founders, executives and early employees behind the best tech companies on the planet. Canva, Stripe, SpaceX, Databricks, Anthropic. We're indirectly invested in over half the IPOs you'd recognise. These are demanding, sophisticated people, and you'll be building something deeply personal for them: their financial lives.


The hardest problems aren't in the infrastructure. They’re in the domain. Probabilistic modelling, multi-jurisdiction tax, forecasting private assets, all wired into an agentic product where the answer has to be right every time. If you want a problem that will genuinely stretch you, this is a rare one.


Build agentic AI, properly. Maeve isn't a chatbot bolted onto a website. It's frontier AI wired into real financial data and proprietary calculation engines, doing something nobody has done before.


The ambition is the whole point. We're building the largest investment and advisory platform for the most ambitious and innovative people on the planet. We're at the forefront of pre-IPO tech investing, and AUM is growing at over 200% a year. There's a lot of room to run.


Massive impact, small team. There's no layer between you and the work. What you build ships, and you'll see what it did.


A business that's actually working. We're profitable, self-funded, and doubling revenue year on year. You're building from strength, not sprinting ahead of a runway.


Early enough to matter. We're in the re-acceleration phase. The foundations are built and profitable, and the biggest problems are still unsolved. The people who join now are the ones who'll define what this becomes.


How we work. Amsterdam office 3 days a week with your product and design teammates. Up to 4 - 6 weeks fully remote a year. Company trips like a fully paid ski trip, hiking in Norway. Lots of autonomy and room to grow, if you deliver. High trust, high standards. We iterate fast, we're not afraid to kill ideas, and we work hard. But we look after our people; this isn't a place that mistakes long hours for good work. xgiwjmb


The Hiring Process

Step 1: 30 minute call with our internal Talent Partner


Step 2: 45 minute call with our Head of Product & Technology


Step 3: Panel style technical meeting with some of our team members


Step 4: Final conversation with our Founder & CEO to ensure all questions are answered & offer!

title: Tier 2 Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst
description:
Leidos is seeking an experienced Tier 2 Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst to support the Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC) CyberPRIMES program. Leidos is a major partner on the contract and will provide a substantial portion of the cybersecurity workforce supporting the Defense Human Resources Activity (DHRA) and DMDC.

The Tier 2 SOC Analyst will perform advanced analysis of cybersecurity events escalated from Tier 1 or identified through enterprise monitoring capabilities. This position will correlate security data, determine the scope and potential impact of suspicious activity, support incident triage and containment, preserve evidence, and coordinate with incident responders and other cybersecurity teams to protect DHRA systems and networks.

Work Locations:

  • Mark Center, Alexandria, Virginia – 3 positions

  • Department of Defense Center – Monterey Bay, Seaside, California – 3 positions

Clearance: Active Secret security clearance required at time of consideration. U.S. Citizen is a must.

Mission Environment

DMDC supports the Defense Human Resources Activity within the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness (OUSD(P&R)) and maintains the Department of Defense’s largest and most comprehensive central repository of personnel, manpower, casualty, pay, entitlement, personnel security, identity, readiness, training, and related data. The DHRA Information Technology (IT) environment includes approximately 15,000 network and endpoint devices supporting more than 600 Government-Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) applications and approximately 100 Risk Management Framework (RMF) authorization boundaries managed through the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS). The Tier 2 SOC Analysts operate within a 24x7 security operations environment responsible for detecting, analyzing, escalating, and supporting response to cybersecurity activity affecting DHRA systems and networks. Tier 2 analysts provide the deeper technical analysis required when events cannot be resolved through initial Tier 1 triage.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Perform advanced analysis of cybersecurity events escalated from Tier 1 analysts or identified through endpoint, user-activity, network, and other enterprise monitoring capabilities.

  • Correlate alerts, security telemetry, and supporting technical data to determine the nature, scope, severity, and potential impact of cybersecurity activity.

  • Distinguish legitimate activity, false positives, policy violations, suspicious behavior, and potential cybersecurity incidents.

  • Determine appropriate next actions based on approved SOC procedures, playbooks, and escalation criteria.

  • Recommend or initiate authorized actions to contain or mitigate identified threats.

  • Support cybersecurity incident triage, escalation, and containment in coordination with the incident-response team.

  • Preserve relevant technical evidence and supporting information required for further investigation and incident response.

  • Document investigative actions, analysis, findings, and conclusions in Government-approved systems.

  • Maintain complete and accurate event records, tickets, timelines, and supporting evidence.

  • Contribute to required SOC event reporting and operational status information.

  • Perform Tier 2 troubleshooting of cybersecurity tools, alerts, security data, and related technical issues.

  • Use approved Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) security-analysis tools to investigate cybersecurity events.

  • Support security testing, mitigation activities, and cybersecurity compliance checking as required by SOC operations.

  • Coordinate analysis with incident responders, network engineers, endpoint-security personnel, cybersecurity-tool teams, system administrators, and other cybersecurity stakeholders.

  • Identify recurring false positives, detection gaps, or ineffective alerting and recommend improvements to monitoring and detection capabilities.

  • Support tuning of cybersecurity monitoring capabilities to improve detection accuracy and analyst effectiveness.

  • Contribute to SOC procedure, playbook, and process improvements based on operational experience and lessons learned.

  • Support knowledge transfer across SOC analysts to improve consistent analysis and response within the 24x7 operating environment.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 5 or more years of relevant cybersecurity experience. Specific experience, education and training may be considered in lieu of degree.

  • Experience performing cybersecurity event analysis, SOC operations, cyber defense, incident triage, or security monitoring.

  • Experience analyzing and correlating alerts from multiple cybersecurity monitoring capabilities.

  • Experience investigating endpoint, network, user-activity, or other cybersecurity events.

  • Experience determining the scope, severity, and potential impact of suspicious cybersecurity activity.

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity incident escalation, containment, mitigation, or evidence preservation.

  • Experience using enterprise security-analysis or cybersecurity monitoring tools.

  • Experience performing Tier 2 cybersecurity troubleshooting.

  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity attack techniques, network-security concepts, endpoint security, event analysis, and incident-response processes.

  • Ability to document investigations, findings, actions, and conclusions clearly and accurately.

  • Ability to work effectively within a team-based 24x7 security operations environment.

  • U.S. Citizenship required.

  • Active Secret security clearance required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting a Department of Defense or Federal Security Operations Center.

  • Experience working in a 24x7 SOC or Cybersecurity Service Provider environment.

  • Experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms and enterprise cybersecurity monitoring tools.

  • Experience analyzing endpoint, network, identity, user-activity, intrusion-detection, or other cybersecurity telemetry.

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity incident response and digital-evidence preservation.

  • Experience tuning security alerts, detection logic, or monitoring capabilities to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.

  • Experience developing or refining SOC procedures, playbooks, or escalation criteria.

  • Experience with cybersecurity mitigation, compliance checking, or security testing.

  • Familiarity with Department of Defense cybersecurity requirements and Risk Management Framework processes.

  • Familiarity with DHRA, DMDC, or comparable Department of Defense enterprise environments.

title: Integrations Specialist
description:
Job Description

Indian River State College is seeking a talented and solutions-oriented Integration Specialist to help power the technology connections that keep our College running smoothly. In this critical role, you will design, develop, and support integrations between enterprise applications, cloud services, databases, and third-party systems, ensuring accurate, secure, and reliable data exchange across the institution. Working closely with technology teams, vendors, faculty, and staff, you will solve complex challenges, optimize business processes, and help deliver the seamless digital experiences that support student success and operational excellence.
If you enjoy troubleshooting, building innovative solutions, and making systems work better together, we invite you to join our team and make a meaningful impact at Indian River State College.

About Us

Indian River State College is a leading public institution on Florida’s Treasure Coast, serving students across multiple campuses in four counties. We are committed to academic excellence, innovation, and community engagement, offering associate and bachelor’s degrees, workforce training, and continuing education programs that meet the needs of our region.

At The River, we believe every student’s and every employee’s story matters. We value the diverse perspectives, experiences, and talents that come together across our campuses, creating a learning environment and workplace that is supportive, inclusive, and inspiring.

With flexible learning options online, on campus, and hybrid, we meet students where they are and prepare them for real-world success. Programs like the Promise Program expand access by providing eligible students with tuition-free opportunities, ensuring every learner has the chance to thrive.

Why Join The River

When you join Indian River State College, you become part of a collaborative and mission-driven community where your work makes a meaningful impact. Here, your role is more than a job; it’s an opportunity to shape futures, support student success, and contribute to a college that is changing lives every day.

What We Offer

We are committed to supporting the well-being and professional growth of our employees through a comprehensive and competitive benefits package:

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; life insurance; supplemental plans; and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Affordable Coverage: PPO and HMO options starting at approximately $50/month for individual coverage and $180/month for family coverage

  • Retirement Security: Florida Retirement System (FRS) participation, plus optional tax-deferred annuities and Roth 403(b) plans

  • Work-Life Balance: Generous paid vacation, personal, and sick leave

  • Perks & Discounts: Reduced rates on services and access to local attraction discounts

  • Growth & Development: Professional development opportunities, leadership training, and career advancement pathways

JOB SUMMARY:


Under general supervision, develops, implements, monitors, and supports integrations between the College’s enterprise applications, cloud services, databases, and external systems. Works with technology teams, College departments, and vendors to analyze integration requirements, maintain reliable data exchange, troubleshoot interface failures, and ensure that integrations meet operational, security, and data-quality standards.

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, configure, test, implement, and maintain integrations between enterprise applications, cloud services, databases, and third-party systems.
  • Develop and support application programming interfaces, web services, middleware workflows, data transformations, automated file transfers, and extract-transform-load processes.
  • Monitor scheduled integrations, interface queues, automated processes, and data transfers to ensure timely and successful completion.
  • Investigate and resolve integration failures, data discrepancies, authentication issues, performance problems, and other interface-related incidents.
  • Work with College departments, application owners, technical teams, and vendors to gather requirements and define data mappings, business rules, workflows, and expected outcomes.
  • Validate integrated data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with established business requirements.
  • Develop test plans, conduct integration testing, coordinate user acceptance testing, and support production deployment and post-implementation validation.
  • Maintain technical specifications, data mappings, process diagrams, configuration records, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.
  • Apply appropriate security controls to integrations, including authentication, authorization, encryption, credential management, secure file transfer, and least-privilege access.
  • Evaluate the effect of application upgrades, vendor changes, data-model changes, and new business requirements on existing integrations.
  • Coordinate with vendors and technical support providers to resolve issues and implement new or modified integration capabilities.
  • Develop scripts, queries, and automated processes that improve data exchange, monitoring, error handling, and operational efficiency.
  • Follow established change-management, incident-management, software-development, testing, and documentation procedures.
  • Participate in scheduled maintenance, system implementations, application upgrades, after-hours support, and the on-call rotation as assigned.
  • Complete all other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Development, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred; or an equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and progressively responsible professional experience.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience developing or supporting application integrations, enterprise applications, data interfaces, software solutions, or related technologies preferred.
  • Experience supporting integrations involving Ellucian Banner, ADP, or comparable enterprise resource planning, student information, human resources, or payroll systems is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of REST and SOAP web services, application programming interfaces, JSON, XML, flat-file formats, and secure file-transfer methods.
  • Experience with SQL, relational databases, data queries, data mapping, transformation, validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, Java, C#, or comparable technologies.
  • Familiarity with integration platforms, middleware, extract-transform-load (ETL) tools, cloud workflow services, or integration platform-as-a-service technologies.
  • Working knowledge of authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth, API keys, certificates, SAML, and service accounts.
  • Familiarity with cloud applications, software-as-a-service platforms, enterprise resource planning systems, student information systems, and identity-management technologies.
  • Understanding of software-development lifecycle, testing, version control, change management, incident management, and release-management practices.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical issues, trace data through multiple systems, identify root causes, and implement reliable solutions.
  • Understanding of data security, privacy, access control, FERPA, and other requirements applicable to institutional data.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, time-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical personnel, vendors, administrators, faculty, and staff.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms, integration technologies, database technologies, or enterprise applications are preferred.

Employees must able to respond effectively during emergency situations and participate in on-call rotations and off-hours maintenance as needed.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

This position classifies the physical exertion requirements as sedentary work involving lifting no more than 25 pounds at a time and occasionally lifting or carrying articles like docket files, ledgers, and small tools. Although a sedentary job is defined as one which involves sitting, a certain amount of walking and standing is often necessary in carrying out job duties. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required occasionally, and other sedentary criteria are met.

ADDITIONAL EXPECTATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Additionally, all employees of the College are expected to maintain professional standards of communication, able to learn and apply new technology, and abide by all policies and procedures. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.

title: Technical Operations Regional Lead
description:
Security is at the core of Google's design and development process: it is built into the DNA of our products. The same is true of our offices. You're an expert who shares our seriousness about security and our commitment to confidentiality. You'll collaborate with our Facilities Management team to create innovative security strategies, investigate breaches and create risk assessment plans for the future. You believe that providing effective security doesn't come at the expense of customer service - you will be our bodyguard (and our long lost pal).

As a Technical Operations Regional Lead for Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS), you will be a part of the team responsible for the development and sustainment efforts for a variety of applications that keep Googler’s safe and secure. With your expertise in physical security technology, managing vendor partners and critical operations, you will join the GSRS Global Security Systems team.From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive events, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.
  • Manage regionally based vendor operations for technical operations, credential management operations and physical access operations, as it relates to credential production and distribution, project management to integrate new physical security assets into Google’s enterprise security applications, manage asset lifecycle, and provide 24/7 customer and technical support.
  • Build relationships with key partners and stakeholders to ensure/validate vendor team is maintaining quality customer support, promptly addressing concerns through process updates or technology solutions.
  • Scope, plan and manage data driven projects in collaboration with GSRS stakeholders.
  • Conduct system audits and communicate findings/recommendations to a varied set of stakeholders, leveraging data to tell a clear and compelling story.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in deploying and supporting various physical security technologies including both access control and video management systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 10 years of experience deploying, administering, supporting physical security technologies through an increasing level of scope and responsibility.
  • 3 years of experience in program development.
  • Experience developing project plans to deliver customer-oriented results with strong organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Ability to engage in technical conversations in the physical security domain with system administrators, field technicians, and system designers.
  • Ability to effectively evaluate work problems and program goals to efficiently prioritize projects and tasks in support of the broader strategic objectives.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to convey technical insights to a non-technical audience.

Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe technologieën te ontdekken, deze verder te verkennen en te delen met je collega’s en opdrachtgevers. Je bent een sparringpartner voor je andere teamleden als het gaat om technische uitdagingen en oplossingen, variërend van migratievraagstukken met bestaande databases naar de Cloud tot de implementatie van een Data Lake-oplossing.

  • Heeft ervaring met Cloud-technieken en platformen, zoals AWS, Azure, Spark, Hadoop;

title: Quality Control Associate Materials Management
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Quality Control Associate for material management supports the Quality Control (QC) department by specializing in material and vendor management, with oversight of the department’s budget and the stability program. This role is responsible for maintaining inventory of laboratory supplies, chemicals, and reagents; coordinating with vendors to ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials while notifying QC personnel of any delays or discontinuations, monitoring department spending and ensuring Stability schedule, protocol, samples, and launches are maintained in compliance with internal and regulatory requirements. The position also manages preventive maintenance and calibration schedules for QC equipment, schedules and documents servicing activities, prepares and tests reports for regulatory bodies, and ships test samples or reagents to necessary vendors with proper documentation. Additionally, the Quality Control Associate I serves as back-up for the QC sample room and provides support for other QC administrative functions, including documentation, filing, and record management.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Material & Vendor Management:
o Review and maintain inventory of laboratory supplies, chemicals, and reagents to support laboratory operations.
o Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials, and promptly notify QC personnel of any delays or discontinuation of materials from vendors.
o Monitor and track department budget related to materials and supplies to ensure spend is staying within allotted budget.
• Equipment Maintenance:
o Maintain preventive maintenance (PM) and calibration schedules for QC equipment (e.g., pipettes, thermometers, and other departmental instruments).
o Schedule and document equipment servicing and calibration activities.
• Regulatory Reporting & Testing:
o Prepare test reports for submission to regulatory bodies, ensuring accuracy and compliance with required standards.
o Coordinate and track the shipment of test samples or reagents to vendors or external laboratories, ensuring clear communication, proper documentation, and strict chain of custody throughout the process.
• Stability Program Management:
• Establish the annual stability schedule
• Completes launches according to the plan to ensure on time testing
• Stability sample management
• Authoring of stability reports
• Ensuring all internal and regulatory commitments associated with the stability program are met.
• Quality Control Administrative Support:
o Serve as back-up for the QC sample room, assisting with sample receipt, storage, and tracking as needed.
o Provide support for other QC administrative functions as needed, including documentation, filing, and record management.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
• BA/BS degree in scientific discipline or business with 0-2 years experience (experience in SAP/zLIMS highly desired) or 6 years relevant experience
• Demonstrated ability to interact positively with all levels of colleagues.
• Strong communication (oral and written), interpersonal, and team/group interactive and leadership skills.
• Strong commitment to product quality, customer service, and continuous improvement.

TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS:
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Outlook, etc.
Experience with 9CFR & EU regulatory requirements.
Experience with outlines of production and special outlines.
Experience maintaining departmental budgets and tracking inventory using relevant management systems.
SAP/ZLIMS/Veeva Vault/ ETS


PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS
• Must be able to walk, sit, or stand for long periods of time.
• Must be able to reach above shoulder level, bend/stoop, kneel, push/pull, and handle/grip frequently.
• Must be able to work scheduled 40 hours with the ability to work overtime as needed.
• Must be able to work weekends as needed.
• Must be able to drive and can travel.
• Ability to safely lift and transport boxes weighing up to 40 pounds.
• Regular reaching, bending, stooping, and twisting.
• Repetitive motion and substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
• Flexibility to cover rotating weekend duties or have unusual attendance requirements.
• Ability to work for short periods in coolers and freezers as required for sample handling and inventory management.

title: Public Safety Officer Days
description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Provides security and protection for patients, visitors, and colleagues, as well as buildings and grounds. May be called upon to provide assistance in many different circumstances, settings and weather.

Job Description:

Essential Duties & Responsibilities including but not limited to:

1) Monitoring and Reporting - Patrols assigned areas on foot or in vehicle, checks for unsafe conditions, hazards, unlocked doors, security violations, blocked ingress and egress, and unauthorized persons. Conducts periodic inspections of all areas at designated times to ascertain their conditions of security and safety. Perform monthly preventative maintenance and required equipment checks, i.e.: elevator phones, outside emergency phones, vehicle equipment, door alarms and panel, building alarms, fire alarm panel, all doors and locks and radio equipment. Prepares logs or reports as required for post, writes or types reports entering information in a computer.
2) Enforcement - Directs vehicle and pedestrian traffic. Issues parking citations for colleagues parked in unauthorized lots. Patrols designated areas and all parking areas. Checks for and issues proper identification of colleagues, and enforcing the wearing of ID badges. Issues temporary badges to Visitors and Vendors. Checks suspicious packages as directed.
3) Emergency Response - Responds to all Codes and alarms in accordance with the Safety Manual and the Emergency Management Policy. First responders to acts of violence and aggression. Coordinates with local Police, Fire, and Emergency personnel as directed. Responds to alarms initiated by fire crash bars on exterior doors. Responds to elevator entrapments. Respond to and investigate reported thefts, disturbances and incidents. Responds to medical emergency call such as slips or falls in the facility or on the grounds, provide an emergency stretcher as needed, and assists with transport within building, awaiting ambulance as the case warrants.
4) Patient Observation - Performs patient watch or observation as directed. Responds appropriately to a variety of human service issues, including domestic abuse, substance abuse, forensic patients, psychiatric cases, and anxious/upset visitors. Maintain composure and professional demeanor in an occasionally chaotic environment. Practices universal precautions. Restrains patients as necessary utilizing de-escalation techniques.
5) Fire Prevention - Identifies and reports fire safety hazards. Keep fire exits, fire doors, corridor access and extinguishing equipment clear. Immediately notify appropriate personnel when equipment may be out of order and in need of repair or replacement.
6) Colleague and Patient Assistance - Provides assistance to patients, visitors, and colleagues with vehicle problems, such as jump starts, lock outs, shoveling, contacting AAA etc. Using a LHMC vehicle, transports patients and colleagues between buildings and designated parking lots.
7) Courier - Responsible for multiple daily bank and pharmacy details. Delivers payroll to various buildings. Delivers large deposits from Dietary, Cashiers, Wall Street and others to area banks. Delivers or accompanies daily cash trays from Dietary, Gift Shop and Credit Union checks. Retrieves and delivers pharmacy items, such as vaccines, alcohol, and narcotics. Retrieves and delivers stat charts, specimens, x-rays and other equipment from Lab, Radiology, Health Information Management (H.I.M.) to off site facilities.
8) Notifies the Maintenance Department of changing weather conditions as it relates to snow removal and sanding for the safety of patients, visitors, and colleagues.
9) Coordinates with Funeral Home staff for removal of deceased patients, verifies that accompanying legal documents are complete, records pathology statistics and processes paperwork.
10) Maintains courteous and effective interactions with colleagues and patients.
11) Demonstrates an understanding of job description, performance expectations, and competency assessment.
12) Demonstrates a commitment toward meeting and exceeding the needs of our customers
13) Participates in departmental and/or interdepartmental quality improvement activities.
14) Participates in and successfully completes Mandatory Education.
15) Performs all other duties as needed or directed to meet the needs of the department.
16) Organizational Requirements:
• Incorporates Lahey Hospital and Medical Center Guiding Principles, Mission Statement and Goals into daily activities.
• Complies with all LHMC Policies.
• Complies with behavioral expectations of the department and LHMC
• Maintains courteous and effective interactions with colleagues and patients.
• Demonstrates an understanding of the job description, performance expectations, and competency assessment.
• Participates in departmental and/or interdepartmental quality improvement activities.
• Participates in and successfully completes Mandatory Education.
• Performs all other duties as needed or directed to meet the needs of the department.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: High School Graduate or equivalent


Licensure, Certification, Registration: Current valid driver’s license required. CPI NCI Certification. AVADE Workplace Violence Prevention Levels I, II, III Certification, BLS Provider Certification (CPR & AED), AHA Heart-Saver First Aid Certification, Stop the Bleed and Nasal Naloxone Certification, and successful completion of Safe Environment for Suicidal/Homicidal Patients and Restraints/Seclusion Safety training. All certifications must be obtained within six (6) months of hire


Skills, Knowledge & Abilities: Observant, paying close attention to detail; Ability to remain calm in difficult situations; Adaptable to sometimes rapidly changing situations; Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact effectively across diverse cultures and at various social and educational levels. Basic computer and data entry skills. In the absence of a particular skill, a colleague must have the ability to be trained to a level of proficiency.


Experience: 1 - 2 years of healthcare security experience preferred. Military, law enforcement, and customer service work experience are also preferred. Bachelor's degree level of education or current student enrolled in a criminal justice program also encouraged.

$20.00 - $24.38

title: Supply Chain Program Manager
description:
Hyve Company Overview

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.



Key Responsibilities

1. Process Mapping & Analysis

  • Document, map, and analyze "as-is" business processes across various departments to identify bottlenecks, redundancies, and areas for automation.
  • Provide suggestions to senior management on process improvements.
  • Conduct root-cause analyses on process failures and system issues.

2. Systems Evaluation & Integration

  • Evaluate existing MRP/ERP systems, software applications, and data flows to ensure they effectively support business processes.
  • Collaborate with IT and software development teams to design, test, and implement system enhancements, APIs, or new platform integrations.

3. Requirements Gathering & Documentation

  • Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to gather detailed business and technical requirements.
  • Translate business needs into clear technical specifications, user stories, use cases, and system flowcharts.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, process maps, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Work as a Point of Contact for Supply Chain team to work together with quality team to perform ISO audit annually.

4. Project Management & Testing

  • Act as a project lead or key contributor on systems implementation and process improvement initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Biz Ops team to perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validate that new systems/processes meet defined business requirements.
  • Create training materials and conduct training sessions to help teams transition smoothly to new systems and workflows (change management).

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.

Technical Skills

  • Data Analysis: Essential knowledge in SQL, Excel (advanced), and data visualization tools (Power BI) to analyze process performance metrics.

title: NSD Program Director
description:
About Vantage


Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Description

The Program Director is accountable for leading the front-end development lifecycle of new data center opportunities across APAC, progressing projects from initial site identification through land acquisition and execution readiness. Acting as the central coordinator across internal and external stakeholders, this role drives due diligence, investment decision-making, and governance processes to maximize site conversion and ensure development opportunities align with Vantage's strategic growth objectives.

The Program Director will oversee cross-functional due diligence programs spanning site evaluation, technical and infrastructure assessments, commercial analysis, and risk management. A key responsibility will be leading governance frameworks, stage-gate processes, and investment approval pathways to ensure opportunities meet defined criteria before advancing. The role will provide transparency across the APAC project pipeline, develop robust business cases, and lead the preparation and presentation of investment recommendations to the APAC Investment Council and other executive decision-making forums.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration across Leadership, Site Selection, Design & Engineering, Construction, Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and other subject matter experts. Acting as a key integrator, the Program Director will align technical, commercial, operational, and strategic priorities, drive decision-making through effective governance, and ensure Vantage has the right capacity in the right markets at the right time to support customer demand and long-term growth across the APAC region.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council, driving strategic investment decisions, prioritization of development opportunities and portfolio growth initiatives across the region.

  • Lead and manage all aspects of technical and commercial due diligence and front-end planning for new development projects, including site assessments, feasibility studies, conceptual design, due diligence workstreams, power and fibre strategy development, entitlement, and permitting activities.

  • Provide strategic leadership, thought partnership, and executive-level guidance on key projects and initiatives, including budget management, schedule oversight, risk mitigation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment between development, investment, operations, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure successful project execution and achievement of regional growth objectives.

  • Lead the definition and execution of due diligence programs for complex infrastructure development opportunities, ensuring key technical, commercial, regulatory, and delivery risks are identified, appropriately investigated, and assessed to support investment, acquisition, and development decision-making.

Duties

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council process, providing transparency across the regional development pipeline, developing robust business cases, and preparing and presenting investment recommendations to executive leadership and decision-making forums.

  • Serve as the primary owner of front-end development activities, driving opportunities from site identification through land acquisition by coordinating due diligence, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and investment approvals to improve conversion of site selection opportunities.

  • Lead all early-stage project development and due diligence activities, including site selection, feasibility assessments, conceptual design, utility strategy (power, water, and fiber), permitting pathways, commercial assessments, risk evaluations, and investment approval processes.

  • Interpret technical findings and provide development and commercial recommendations and risk mitigation strategies to support acquisitions.

  • Act as the central point of integration across internal and external stakeholders undertaking due diligence, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely decision-making throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Provide executive oversight and portfolio governance across the APAC development pipeline, delivering regular updates to Executive Leadership on project progress, risks, schedules, budgets, quality, financial performance, cash flow, and critical decisions required to achieve business objectives.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across Site Selection, Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Procurement, Design, Engineering and Construction, and Executive Leadership teams to define project requirements, resolve issues, manage risks, and support informed investment decisions.

  • Lead and manage relationships with external consultants, landowners, contractors, utilities, government authorities, regulatory agencies, and industry stakeholders to secure successful project outcomes and maintain development momentum.

  • Drive project outcomes from concept through execution readiness, establishing scope, schedule, budget, governance frameworks, consultant engagement strategies, and business case approvals while maintaining alignment with strategic objectives and investment criteria.

  • Oversee portfolio reporting and governance, ensuring leadership maintains full visibility of pipeline health, site conversion performance, project risks, costs, schedules, market dynamics, and capital deployment priorities.

  • Identify and mitigate development, permitting, commercial, infrastructure, and execution risks to support successful project advancement and informed investment decisions.

  • Lead contract governance, performance reporting, and financial management activities, ensuring robust controls, risk management, and informed decision-making across the portfolio.

  • Champion continuous improvement by incorporating lessons learned, market intelligence, industry trends, and best practices to enhance development processes, strengthen governance, and support Vantage's long-term growth strategy across APAC.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • Proven experience managing complex development, infrastructure, construction, or real estate projects, ideally in a client-side environment.

  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, work independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience across APAC markets, particularly Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and Australia, is highly desirable.

  • Strong understanding of site acquisition, due diligence, planning, permitting, and utility infrastructure (power and fibre).

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior leaders and external partners.

  • Degree in Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, Business, or a related field preferred.

  • Flexibility to travel regularly across APAC.

  • Adaptable, self-motivated, and comfortable working across multiple time zones, cultures, and remote environments.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.


Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.


Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.


Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.
