title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Leidos is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to support the development of mission-critical embedded software and firmware for missile defense systems. The selected candidate will contribute to the design, development, integration, and demonstration of advanced software capabilities in a fast-paced engineering environment. This role requires close collaboration with integrated engineering teams and strong technical communication skills to support delivery of high-quality software solutions to customers.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conceptual design across the full stack of software for airborne systems, embedded software architectural design, code implementation, team peer review, unit testing, cohesive integration of loosely coupled software modules within subsystems and across distributed networks, use of DevOps and CI/CD pipelines, and development of software tools, harnesses, and infrastructures to support a fully integrated solution.

  • Leading and contributing to the design, development, testing, troubleshooting, and debugging of embedded software systems.

  • Frequent and direct communication with customers, end users, internal stakeholders, and team members.

  • Applying established software engineering principles, standards, and best practices throughout the full software development life cycle (SDLC) including but not limited to: (a) software requirements analysis, (b) hardware compatibility analysis, and (c) development of tools and software products that support infrastructure, platform design and system maintenance.

  • Recommending and implementing new technologies, tools and standards to enhance software engineering practices, which align to organizational goals.

  • Leading and mentoring other team members, contributing to the delivery of complex projects, all the while aligning with technical strategy and execution plans.

  • Demonstrate initiative in identifying improved development workflows, tools, and engineering practices, including emerging AI-enabled development capabilities.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical discipline from an accredited institution, with an overall GPA of 3.0 or higher.

  • 12+ years of relevant technical experience, or 10+ years with a master’s degree in a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience with real-time embedded system in defense, aerospace, or safety-critical platforms preferred.

  • U.S. Citizenship required.

  • Active DoD Secret Security Clearance required.

  • Must be a resident of North Alabama or willing to relocate to the Huntsville-North Alabama area.

  • Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems development.

  • Experience with real-time operating system (RTOS) such as VxWorks, Integrity, or FreeRTOS

  • Proficiency with embedded processors and microcontrollers (i.e. ARM Cortex, RISC-V, or similar architectures)

  • Experience with embedded debugging tools (JTAG, oscilloscopes, etc.)

  • Must have strong knowledge of modern software development practices including Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and test automation and understand the reasons these practices are used on mission and safety critical programs.

  • Must have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to address highly complex technical challenges.

  • Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks and contribute effectively in a collaborative team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with high-speed guided weapons systems, flight controls systems, or similar embedded solutions.

  • Experience developing large-scale embedded, high-performance systems with a high level of determinism.

  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).

  • Prior experience working in highly regulated or mission-critical environments (e.g., aerospace or defense sectors).

  • Experience with software safety standards (DO-178C, MIL-STD-882e).

  • Experience with Agile management tools and concepts such as Jira.

  • Experience with software configuration management tools such as Git and GitLab.

  • Proven experience mentoring developers across multiple experience levels.

Clearance Requirement

  • Active DoD Secret Security Clearance required.

title: Project Coordinator, Cardiac Solutions
description:
Join Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific and help support the successful delivery of cardiac safety clinical trials that advance global healthcare innovation. As a Project Coordinator within our Cardiac Solutions team, you will partner closely with Project Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to support study execution from startup through closeout. You will play a key role in coordinating project activities, maintaining study documentation, tracking deliverables, supporting financial processes, and ensuring a high level of service for sponsors and internal teams. This role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in clinical research project management while contributing to innovative cardiac safety solutions used in clinical trials worldwide.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and incentives.

  • Engaging employee events and hybrid work technology support.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Support Project Managers throughout the planning, setup, monitoring, and closeout phases of cardiac safety studies.

  • Assist with study database setup and maintenance activities to support project execution and data integrity.

  • Prepare, maintain, and organize study documentation and project records throughout the study lifecycle.

  • Coordinate equipment distribution, tracking, reconciliation, and inventory activities to support study requirements.

  • Create, update, and distribute project reports, status updates, meeting materials, and study communications.

  • Support the archival of study documentation and records in accordance with company procedures and regulatory requirements.

  • Coordinate Project Assurance meetings, prepare meeting agendas, document meeting minutes, and track action items through completion.

  • Assist with documentation and database updates resulting from project scope changes and operational requirements.

  • Support financial activities, including invoice reconciliation follow-up and project forecasting reports.

  • Facilitate issue management by documenting, monitoring, and tracking project issues to support timely resolution of customer concerns and escalations.

  • Monitor project tasks and deliverables to help ensure study timelines and milestones are achieved.

  • Respond to customer inquiries and participate in sponsor meetings and conference calls as requested by the Project Manager.

  • Take ownership of assigned project activities and lead specific project tasks and deliverables when appropriate.

  • Ensure timely completion of required training, documentation, and compliance activities.

  • Support process improvement initiatives and contribute to the successful achievement of departmental objectives.

What We Look For

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant industry experience.

  • 1 to 3 years of experience within pharmaceutical, clinical research, healthcare, medical device, life sciences, or related industries.

  • Understanding of the drug development process and clinical trial environment.

  • Strong organizational, planning, prioritization, and multitasking skills.

  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively in English.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.

  • High attention to detail with demonstrated responsiveness to inquiries, requests, and project deadlines.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality service and operational support.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative global team environment.

At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

description:
Salary: £33,000, Permanent role.
Start date: September 2027

Location: Successful graduate will be based from Peterborough with occasional travel to our London hub (Kings Cross), one of our construction sites or a partner office. Please note your placements may vary across the region and departments so flexibility is essential.

Help shape the future of water, the environment and the communities we serve

With a plan worth over £11 billion of investment, we're building for better — for you, for the communities we serve, for our environment. As part of this we are looking for you to join Anglian Water's Graduate Programme and tackle some of the biggest environmental and infrastructure challenges facing the region. From climate resilience and major engineering projects to digital innovation and customer experience, you'll develop the skills, experience and support needed to become one of our future leaders or specialists.

Your career path

The water industry is changing rapidly, creating exciting opportunities for the next generation of talent. At Anglian Water, you'll work on real challenges that matter, developing expertise across your chosen profession while contributing to projects that support customers, communities and the environment.

You'll learn from experienced colleagues, take on meaningful responsibility and build the skills, knowledge and confidence to shape your future career, while helping us shape the future of water.

To find out more from our recent graduates please visit our Anglian Water careers page: Careers - Anglian Water - Join us and be part of the change

Professional Development & Memberships

We're committed to helping you build a career, not just gain a job. Through our two-year graduate programme, you'll experience different placements, work on real business challenges and learn from experienced colleagues across the organisation. You'll have access to a wide range of development opportunities, support towards professional qualifications and funded membership of a relevant professional institution, helping you grow your expertise and achieve professional accreditation where appropriate.

Your programme

Working within the Reservoirs Programme you will gain exposure to a wide range of technical activities supporting the design and engineering of nationally significant infrastructure projects.

You'll be involved in:

  • Supporting the management of design and engineering activities with our strategic suppliers

  • Supporting definition of project requirements, scope, assumptions and basis of design

  • Supporting development and agreement of technical justifications and evidencing of project technical decisions

  • Supporting survey scope development and implementation

  • Supporting technical assurance activities

  • Assisting with the preparation of reports and presentations for senior stakeholders

  • Working collaboratively with teams across the programme, including project management, site delivery, stakeholder, legal, planning, consenting teams

Throughout the programme, you'll receive structured development, mentoring and hands-on experience across a range of technical areas.

We're particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate strong technical understanding, problem solving skills, organisational skills, excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

What you will bring

We are looking for people who are curious, ambitious and ready to learn. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, working collaboratively and bringing different perspectives to the challenges we face. Most importantly, we're looking for graduates who want to help shape the future of water while developing a successful and rewarding career of their own. We welcome applicants who are excited about technology products and passionate about the water industry.

You will have achieved, or be working towards, an Engineering degree in any discipline, including Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Process, or a related engineering field.

For this role, you’ll need to have obtained in the last 3 years or be studying towards a minimum 2:2 in the preferred degree disciplines listed and have graduated by September 2027 for the 2027 intake.

Benefits

Alongside a competitive salary, you'll receive a comprehensive health and wellbeing package, private healthcare, 26 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, and a double-matched pension scheme with up to 21% total contribution. We also offer an excellent family leave package, including enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave, helping you balance your career with the moments that matter most.

Closing Date: 27th September 2026

Site Tour: 26th and 28th October, at our Lincs site. This is an opportunity to learn more about the role, meet colleagues, and gain first-hand insight into the work you'll be doing.

Assessment Centres (in Person): 11th or 13th November at our Lancaster House office, Huntingdon

title: Inbound Customer Advisor (Wealth)
description:

We love people who do the right thing for our customers, and our colleagues. We want people who speak up, who take responsibility, and who make good decisions.

Customer Service careers are different here at Aviva. We believe in creating a better tomorrow, for everyone. Job Summary

The Environmental Coordinator Principal is responsible for coordinating the implementation of environmental compliance programs, permit requirements, and corporate environmental policies, standards, procedures and strategic environmental goals within their assigned region, plant and project scope. Responsibilities include ensuring direct reports meet performance and development goals, providing training, guidance and other necessary support to business unit leadership and staff on applicable environmental requirements, identifying applicable environmental requirements associated with Company assets and projects, and coordinating with the appropriate business unit staff, Environmental Services representatives, contractors, and external parties to ensure compliance with environmental requirements.

The Environmental Coordinator Principal should have an advanced understanding of the following environmental programs:
• Above ground and underground storage tanks,
• Transportation of hazardous materials,
• Solid and hazardous waste management,
• Spill Prevention Control and Countermeasures,
• Wastewater, storm water, groundwater, and drinking water sampling, reporting and control,
• Oil and chemical spill response and management,
• Air emissions monitoring, control and reporting,
• Asbestos and PCB management,
• Pollution prevention,
• Environmental site assessments, and
• Emergency planning, and community right-to-know.

Key competencies of this position are technical expertise, planning and organization ability, problem solving, written and oral communication skills and initiative. Must be able to work autonomously and with limited to no supervision and assume manager responsibilities in the absence of direct management.

Posted as an Environmental Coordinator Senior and Environmental Coordinator Principal

Assist and provide input to Environmental Services on the development of Company environmental policies and procedures. Communicate deviations appropriately.

title: Analyst, HR Operations
description:
Location

Brookfield Place New York - 225 Liberty Street, 8th Floor

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.


Job Description

Human Resources Services (HRS) is an internal function providing global operations and business support across Brookfield’s lines of business.

As a member of the HR Service Desk (HRSD), the Analyst, HR Operations is responsible for delivering high-quality HR support to employees, managers, and the broader global HR team. The role serves as a key point of contact for HR-related questions, employee assistance, and the execution of day-to-day HR transactions across the employee lifecycle.

The Analyst will respond to employee and manager inquiries, provide guidance on HR programs, policies, processes, and systems, and complete a broad range of transactions within Workday and other HR platforms. This includes supporting activities such as hires, job changes, organizational changes, leaves, employee data updates, and terminations.

The role requires a strong customer-service mindset, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to independently manage and resolve employee requests in a high-volume, global shared services environment. This position supports Brookfield Asset Management and affiliate organizations globally.

Responsibilities

  • Employee & Manager Support: Serve as a primary point of contact for employees and managers, responding to HR-related questions and providing clear, timely, and professional assistance.

  • HR Case Management: Manage employee and manager requests from intake through resolution, ensuring questions and issues are appropriately researched, documented, resolved, or escalated when required.

  • HR Transactions: Process a broad range of employee lifecycle transactions accurately and efficiently within Workday, including hires, job changes, transfers, promotions, organizational changes, employee data updates, leaves, and terminations.

  • Employee Data Administration: Maintain accurate employee information within HR systems and complete required data reviews and validation to support data integrity.

  • Employee Guidance: Assist employees and managers in navigating HR processes, policies, systems, self-service tools, and available HR resources.

  • Onboarding & Offboarding Support: Support employee onboarding and offboarding activities, ensuring required HR transactions, documentation, and employee communications are completed accurately and on time.

  • HR Documentation: Prepare, review, and maintain employee-related documentation and correspondence associated with HR transactions and processes.

  • Issue Resolution: Investigate transactional or system-related issues, identify appropriate solutions, and partner with HR colleagues or other teams where additional expertise or escalation is required.

  • Process & Knowledge Support: Follow established HR procedures and knowledge articles while identifying opportunities to improve processes, employee experience, and service delivery.

  • Service Delivery: Execute HR requests and transactions in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs), quality standards, controls, and compliance requirements.

  • Confidentiality & Compliance: Handle sensitive employee information with discretion and ensure HR transactions are completed in accordance with company policies, procedures, and applicable requirements.

  • Perform other HR Service Desk transactional, administrative, and employee support activities as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Strong customer service orientation with a demonstrated ability to support employees and managers in a professional and responsive manner.

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 3 years of HR administrative, HR operations, employee services, or shared services experience, preferably within a professional services environment.

  • Experience processing HR transactions across the employee lifecycle.

  • Experience working with an HRIS; Workday experience is considered an asset.

  • Experience working in a high-volume HR shared services, service desk, or case management environment is preferred.

  • Ability to interpret HR processes and policies and provide clear guidance to employees and managers.

  • Ability to independently investigate and resolve employee requests, including more complex or non-standard situations, using sound judgment and appropriate escalation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and data integrity.

  • Highly organized with the ability to manage a high volume of requests and competing priorities.

  • Self-motivated with the ability to take ownership of employee requests and manage them through to resolution.

  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information appropriately.

  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

  • Experience using Excel to review, reconcile, and audit data using formulas, lookups, and pivot tables is an asset.

Salary Range: $70,000 - $85,000

Our compensation structure is comprised of a base salary and a short-term incentive program (cash bonus). Cash compensation tends to vary based on geography to account for local market conditions and is set to be market competitive. Compensation decisions are based on a number of factors including relative experience, overall years of experience, industry experience, education and designations.


Brookfield is committed to maintaining a Positive Work Environment that is safe and respectful; our shared success depends on it. We do not tolerate workplace discrimination, violence or harassment. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit and business needs, without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicant information is collected and handled in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Produktionsledare inom sömnad till anstalten Täby
description:
Om Kriminalvården

Kriminalvården växer – vi bygger nytt, bygger om och bygger till och söker nu fler medarbetare. Vårt viktigaste mål är att minska återfall i brott – att bryta den onda cirkeln. Lyckas vi med det blir samhället tryggare och säkrare för alla. Vi är den myndighet som ansvarar för anstalter, frivård, häkten och klienttransporter.

Verksamhetsområde Stockholm Öst omfattar de två slutna anstalterna Österåker och Täby. Hos oss arbetar framför allt kriminalvårdare, men också vårdpersonal, lärare, administratörer, produktionsledare och andra viktiga yrkesgrupper. Klienterna på anstalterna sysselsätts med bland annat utbildning, behandlingsprogram, verkstadsarbete samt monterings- och förpackningsuppdrag – allt för att skapa struktur, meningsfullhet och förutsättningar för en bättre framtid.

Anstalten Österåker är inne i en spännande expansionsfas med nya anstaltsplatser och sysselsättningslokaler som tas i drift mellan 2025 och 2027. Här finns goda möjligheter att växa med verksamheten – både i antal medarbetare och i nya, spännande roller. Anstalten ligger utanför Åkersberga – perfekt för dig som uppskattar att slippa rusningstrafiken. Bil är det smidigaste sättet att ta sig hit. Anstalten Täby är en liten anstalt med familjär miljö och goda pendlingsmöjligheter. Båda anstalterna erbjuder personalparkering.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Kriminalvårdens arbetsdrift är en av flera insatser som ska ge de intagna meningsfull sysselsättning under anstaltstiden och främja deras anpassning i samhället efter frigivningen. På anstalten Täby består produktionen, arbetsdriften, huvudsakligen av sömnad men även förpackningsarbete. Som produktionsledare har du direktkontakt med våra klienter, i den dagliga kontakten bidrar till klienternas lärande samtidigt som du upprätthåller säkerheten och bidrar till att klienterna reflekterar. Rollen förutsätter att du har ett intresse för sömnad och är kreativ.

Tillsammans med två andra kollegor motiverar du som produktionsledare klienterna att delta i arbetet, planerar och arbetsleder. I arbetet ingår visitationer, skötsel av lokaler, visst löpande maskinunderhåll, lagerhantering, administration och dokumentation. Produktionsledarens roll sammanhänger med ansvar för den dagliga driften och du kommer själv att vara med och delta i produktionsarbetet, för att säkerställa att våra leveranser sker enligt avtalad tid. All verksamhet sker utan att göra avkall på säkerheten.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är trygg, stabil och har självinsikt. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra människor och har väl grundade och tydliga värderingar. I stressituationer är du lugn, stabil och kontrollerad. Du är kreativ och flexibel och kan lätt anpassa dig till nya förutsättningar. Du har god förståelse för hur människan tar till sig kunskap och anpassar ditt sätt att förmedla budskap utifrån mottagares förutsättningar. Du ska även ha en fysisk status som möjliggör att agera fysiskt om situationen så kräver.

För att trivas och lyckas i ditt uppdrag är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen och tron på att människan är utvecklingsbar. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Fullständig gymnasieskolekompetens i form av slutbetyg eller gymnasieexamen eller annan utbildning som Kriminalvården bedömer likvärdig
  • Arbetslivserfarenhet av att leda och fördela arbete
  • Arbetslivserfarenhet inom sömnad
  • God datorvana och administrativ förmåga

Det är även meriterande med:

  • Arbetslivserfarenhet inom kriminalvård, säkerhetsarbete, pedagogiskt arbete eller social omsorg
  • Goda kunskaper i PErS
  • Kunskap om fakturering
  • Truckkort

Intervjuer

I denna rekrytering påbörjas urvalsprocessen efter att annonseringstiden löpt ut och intervjuer kommer ske 20 oktober på anstalten Täby.

Övrigt

Kriminalvården har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Svaren i urvalsfrågorna och CV ligger till grund för om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i processen.

För att bli aktuell för anställning inom Kriminalvården krävs att du motsvarar högt ställda krav gällande lämplighet, omdöme, säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetande och att du följer gällande lagar. Det innebär att du står upp för demokratiska värderingar och den statliga värdegrund som gäller för Kriminalvårdens verksamhet.

Vissa befattningar är placerade i säkerhetsklass och då kommer en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. title: Data Engineer
description:
Heb jij de eerste stappen binnen het Data Engineer vak gezet en ben jij toe aan de volgende stap?



Ontdek hieronder precies welke vaardigheden, ervaring en kwalificaties u nodig heeft om te slagen in deze functie, voordat u solliciteert.
Welkom bij Savills – Waar ambitie en innovatie samenkomen

Bij Savills zoeken wij een Data Engineer die inmiddels weet hoe het is om binnen een organisatie te werken, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor het eigen werk en samen te werken in een team.


Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen. Wat wij zoeken is de basis, de juiste instelling en de wil om te groeien.


Deze rol is bewust niet voor iedereen. Je werkt niet dagelijks met de nieuwste AI-technologieën en je komt niet terecht in een groot engineering team vol specialisten. Wat je wél krijgt, is veel autonomie, langdurig eigenaarschap, een gezonde werk-privébalans en de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen in een team waar je werk er direct toe doet.


Waar kom je terecht?

Je wordt onderdeel van het Insight & Data team van Savills Nederland. Dit team maakt deel uit van de bredere afdeling Data, Intelligence & Strategy (DIS), die de teams van Savills ondersteunt met marktinzichten, maatwerkapplicaties en data-oplossingen die de vastgoedadvies- en investeringspraktijk voeden. De oplossingen die wij bouwen ondersteunen het onderzoek, de marktanalyses en de data-inzichten waarmee Savills haar klanten adviseert.


Als Insight & Data team zijn wij verantwoordelijk voor vrijwel alle maatwerk data-oplossingen binnen de organisatie. Dat varieert van ETL-processen, databases en dashboards tot webapplicaties, geografische toepassingen en geautomatiseerde informatieservices. Je krijgt daardoor te maken met zowel de techniek als de business die gebruikmaakt van wat we bouwen. Onze omgeving bestaat onder andere uit Python, PostgreSQL, Azure, GitHub, Power BI, Esri, FastAPI en React.


Wat ga je doen?
  • Bouwen en onderhouden van ETL-processen in Python.
  • Werken met PostgreSQL databases.
  • Ontwikkelen van nieuwe datastromen en koppelingen met externe databronnen.
  • Verbeteren van bestaande processen en databronnen.
  • Ondersteunen van collega's bij data-gerelateerde vraagstukken.
  • Meewerken aan grotere projecten binnen het datalandschap.

Na je inwerkperiode krijg je steeds meer eigenaarschap over een eigen data-domein, inclusief de bijbehorende databronnen, ETL-processen, datakwaliteit en kennis van de business.


Hoe werken wij?

Wij zijn een compact, technisch team binnen een grotere organisatie. Dat betekent korte communicatielijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en veel vertrouwen. Nieuwe collega's krijgen begeleiding via dagelijkse stand-ups, code reviews en samenwerking binnen projecten. Tegelijkertijd verwachten we dat je zelfstandig kunt werken, documentatie leest en actief vragen stelt wanneer dat nodig is.


We bouwen oplossingen die jarenlang worden gebruikt. Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat collega's elkaar helpen en dat kennis niet bij één persoon blijft hangen.


Wie zoeken wij?
  • Je hebt ervaring met Python. Dit is een vereiste.
  • Ervaring met SQL en/of PostgreSQL is een sterke pré.
  • Je hebt minimaal zes maanden relevante werkervaring en bent bewust op zoek naar een volgende stap.
  • Je bent nauwkeurig, kritisch en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk.
  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief samenwerking op.
  • Je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Wat mag je van Savills verwachten?
  • Veel autonomie en vertrouwen.
  • Een klein en betrokken team, met een duidelijke plek binnen een grotere organisatie.
  • Goede begeleiding en ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.
  • Langdurige verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen projecten en data-domeinen.
  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans.
  • Een informele werksfeer met borrels, teamactiviteiten en sociale evenementen.
  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken voor maximaal 2 dagen per week.
  • Marktconforme primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder 25 vakantiedagen, twee extra vrije dagen, een goed pensioen, een Shuttle Pas voor woon-werkverkeer, een discretionaire bonus en budget voor opleidingen en cursussen.

Past deze rol bij jou?

Deze rol past waarschijnlijk goed als je graag eigenaarschap neemt, houdt van een stabiele werkomgeving en het leuk vindt om stap voor stap systemen en processen beter te maken. xgiwjmb


Deze rol past waarschijnlijk minder goed als je vooral zoekt naar een omgeving met de nieuwste AI-technologieën, machine learning of een groot team van gespecialiseerde engineers.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Als Data Engineer bij Zonneplan werk je aan iets dat de hele organisatie raakt. Je bouwt en verbetert het centrale dataplatform, maakt data veilig beschikbaar voor alle teams en legt de technische basis voor een nieuw ML-platform. Dat betekent: pipelines die betrouwbaar draaien, datakwaliteit die teams kunnen vertrouwen en selfservice-oplossingen waarmee collega's zelf aan de slag kunnen. Je ziet direct wat jouw werk oplevert wanneer dataverzoeken sneller worden afgehandeld en teams autonomer met data werken.

Je werkt vanuit Team Infra en schakelt dagelijks met engineering, Trading & Optimization, GenAI en andere developmentteams. Denk aan een terugkerend dataverzoek dat je samen vertaalt naar een duurzame selfservice-oplossing, of een dataset die je veilig ontsluit zodat het GenAI-team er zelfstandig dashboards mee kan bouwen. Agentic Engineering is een vast onderdeel van hoe we werken: je krijgt een Claude Code Max 20x-licentie (of equivalent) tot je beschikking en we moedigen actief aan om AI in te zetten bij alles wat je doet. De lijnen zijn kort, de impact breed. Zo help je Zonneplan datagedreven en AI-gedreven te werken, en dat versnelt plan Zero: betere data betekent snellere beslissingen en slimmere energiesystemen.

Je werkt 32-40 uur per week met een salaris tussen €3.500 en €5.000 bruto per maand.

Jouw impact bij Zonneplan

  • Jij bouwt en verbetert het dataplatform. Je ontwikkelt datapipelines en datamodellen die de hele organisatie van betrouwbare data voorzien. Je monitort wat er draait, signaleert problemen vroeg en lost ze op voordat ze impact hebben op dashboards, analyses of ML-toepassingen.
  • Jij maakt data veilig en breed beschikbaar. Je richt toegangscontroles en datakwaliteitschecks in zodat teams zelfstandig en verantwoord met data kunnen werken. Je vertaalt dataverzoeken vanuit de organisatie naar structurele oplossingen en verkort daarmee de doorlooptijd flink.
  • Jij legt de basis voor het ML-platform. Je bouwt de technische fundamenten waarop toekomstige machine learning-toepassingen kunnen draaien. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met andere developers om te zorgen dat het platform aansluit op wat zij nodig hebben, van modeltraining tot serving.
  • Jij werkt AI-gedreven en verbetert continu. Agentic Engineering is geen experiment, het is hoe we werken. Je zet tools zoals Claude Code in bij ontwikkeling, testen, documentatie en monitoring. Terugkerend werk automatiseer je en je deelt wat je leert actief met je team.

Dit neem jij mee

  • Je hebt minimaal 1 tot 2 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer en bent breed inzetbaar op het vakgebied.
  • Je beheerst SQL en hebt ervaring met datamodellering en het bouwen en beheren van betrouwbare datapipelines.
  • Je denkt kritisch over datakwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid, en neemt daar eigenaarschap over.
  • Je maakt technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk voor niet-technische collega's en werkt graag samen met andere teams om gebruikersbehoeften te vertalen naar oplossingen.
  • Je signaleert verbeterkansen en pakt ze op zonder dat iemand je erom vraagt. AI zet je dagelijks in om sneller en slimmer te werken.
  • Ervaring met tools uit onze stack zoals Dagster, Snowflake, Postgres, Kafka, dbt, dlthub, Airbyte, Kubernetes of AWS is mooi meegenomen. Je hoeft niet alles te kennen, maar nieuwe tooling maak je snel eigen.
  • Heb je eerder gewerkt aan data mesh of self-service analytics? Dan is dat een echte pre. Je snapt dan hoe je teams in staat stelt zelfstandig met data te werken zonder in te leveren op kwaliteit of veiligheid.

Dit krijg je van ons

  • Een salaris tussen €3.500 en €5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis.
  • 25 vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om er meer bij te kopen) en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een persoonlijk keuzebudget voor sport, boodschappen of iets anders dat bij je past.
  • Vanaf dag één investeren we in jouw groei met de Zonneplan Academie, sterke tooling (waaronder een Claude Code Max 20x-licentie) en ruimte om te blijven leren. Het groeipad loopt van medior Data Engineer naar senior Data Engineer en op termijn naar Tech Lead Data.
  • Een werksfeer waarin je snel schakelt met engineers, data-specialisten en productteams. Je werkt in een team dat het fundament onder alles legt wat Zonneplan bouwt, en dat merk je in de waardering en de breedte van je impact.

Samen bouwen aan de energie van morgen

Bij Zonneplan werken we aan één duidelijk doel: een Nederland zonder fossiele energie. Wij noemen dat plan Zero. Geen uitstoot, geen verspilling, geen afhankelijkheid. Dat klinkt groot, en dat is het ook. Maar als Data Engineer breng je dit doel concreet dichterbij. Jouw werk zorgt ervoor dat teams sneller en beter beslissingen nemen op basis van betrouwbare data. Van slimmere energiesystemen tot betere klantenservice: elk dashboard dat klopt en elke pipeline die draait, maakt duurzame energie een stukje toegankelijker. Samen zetten we stappen naar een toekomst waar iedereen trots op kan zijn.

Heb je vragen? Bel of mail 088 020 3012 / samer.elmokdad@zonneplan.nl

title: Software Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering, GCS SRE
description:

SRE ensures that Google's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to users' needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design.

SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

To learn more: check out our books on Site Reliability Engineering or read a career profile about why a Software Engineer chose to join SRE.

As part of Google's Cloud Storage SRE team, you will be a key technical driver for one of Google's most business-critical and largest global storage systems. Your mission is to ensure the reliability of the service by simplicity, robust engineering, and risk management principles to guide technical priorities.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Lead a team of Software/Systems Engineers on projects for users and be directly responsible for uptime.

title: Senior Account Representative, SMB (South)
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

As PayPal continues its mission to revolutionize commerce, we’re looking for a driven Senior Account Representative to join our Small and Medium Business Sales team in Germany.

Small businesses are the engine of local economies everywhere, and PayPal’s SMB team helps them compete on a bigger stage. In this role, you’ll own the end-to-end commercial relationships for a portfolio of around 80 of our higher-value SMB merchants.

You’ll proactively identify opportunities to deepen relationships, expand product adoption and solve merchant needs to protect and grow transaction margin. It’s a role for someone who wants real ownership, from spotting the next growth opportunity to working through merchant problems that don’t yet have a playbook.

This is a virtual position, with our German headquarters located in Berlin.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate internally to influence process quality and efficiency.
  • Determine appropriate actions and consider alternative solutions.
  • Acquire, manage, and expand relationships with small and medium-sized merchants.
  • Use analytical skills and judgment to recommend best solutions.
  • Influence through defined processes and procedures.

title: Azure Platform & DevOps Engineer
description:
Amstelveen | Azure | CI/CD | Python | Up to €85,000 annually


Solliciteer snel! Er wordt een groot aantal sollicitanten verwacht voor de hieronder beschreven functie, wacht niet met het versturen van uw cv.

Build the platform behind a technology-driven investment firm

Not every engineer wants to work in an environment with multiple management layers, narrowly defined responsibilities and limited influence.

Some are looking for the opposite.

On behalf of our client Ostrica, a technology-driven investment management firm based in Amstelveen, RIXT.IT is looking for an Azure Platform & DevOps Engineer who wants to take ownership of the foundation on which the business operates.

This is a role for someone who enjoys responsibility.

Someone who understands that great software does not start with code, but with a secure, reliable and scalable platform that allows innovation to thrive.

About Ostrica

Ostrica combines technology, data and investment expertise to support investment management activities and investment operations.

Technology is not a support function. It is a strategic enabler of the business.

The organisation is compact, entrepreneurial and highly knowledge-driven. Decision-making is fast, communication lines are short, and you will work directly with business stakeholders and leadership.

You will report directly to the Managing Director and play an important role in shaping the future of the technology landscape.

The Opportunity

Unlike many organisations, parts of the business actively develop their own solutions in Python.

Your primary responsibility is not building applications from scratch.

Your responsibility is to ensure that software is reviewed, tested, deployed and operated according to professional engineering standards.

You will own the Azure platform, improve operational excellence and establish the processes that allow internally developed applications to move safely and reliably into production.

The role is approximately:

80% Azure Platform, Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps

20% Python, code reviews and application support

What will you be doing?

As Azure Platform & DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the technology foundation that enables the business to develop, deploy and operate applications securely and efficiently.

Working closely with business stakeholders and leadership, you will take ownership of the Azure platform, software delivery processes and infrastructure standards that support Ostrica's operations.

  • Designing, building and maintaining infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code
  • Managing and continuously improving the Microsoft Azure environment
  • Ensuring platform reliability, performance, security and scalability
  • Establishing and maintaining governance, monitoring and operational best practices
  • Identifying opportunities to optimise infrastructure and cloud services

DevOps & Software Delivery

  • Designing, maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes
  • Supporting testing, implementation, release management and production deployments
  • Improving delivery reliability, automation and operational efficiency
  • Contributing to architecture decisions and technical standards across the organisation

Software Quality & Application Support

  • Reviewing Python applications developed by business teams
  • Supporting and maintaining existing applications and services
  • Assisting with the maintenance of legacy C# applications where required
  • Ensuring solutions meet standards for quality, security and maintainability
  • Troubleshooting, debugging and resolving technical issues

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Working closely with internal stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions
  • Supporting architecture and technology roadmap discussions
  • Providing technical guidance and best practices across the organisation
  • Helping teams automate workflows and optimise existing processes
  • Maintaining technical documentation throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Contributing to process improvements, standardisation and platform maturity
  • Driving a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement

What are we looking for?

You are an analytical and detail-oriented engineer with a passion for technology and a strong sense of ownership.

You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and feel comfortable operating in an environment where you are given significant responsibility and the freedom to make an impact. Working in a small team energises you.

You are proactive, curious by nature and continuously looking for ways to improve platforms, processes and software quality. xgiwjmb

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related field
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure or similar public cloud platforms
  • Experience managing cloud environments and production workloads
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, DevOps or GitOps practices
  • Strong understanding of platform governance, security and operational excellence
  • Solid Python skills, including the ability to review, assess and improve application code
  • Experience designing and working with APIs and microservices
  • Good knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work closely with both technical and business stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, asynchronous programming and modern Python frameworks
  • Experience with SQLAlchemy or other ORM frameworks
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep or similar)
  • Experience with Docker and containerised environments
  • Experience with C#/.NET or willingness to support existing C# applications
  • Experience within financial services, fintech or investment environments
  • Interest in technology, automation and financial markets

What’s in it for you?

At Ostrica, you will join a technology-driven organisation where you can genuinely influence the way technology is built, governed and deployed.

In return, you can expect:

  • An attractive salary package of up to €85,000 gross per year
  • A 13th month salary and a competitive pension scheme
  • Opportunities to earn performance-related bonuses
  • 25 vacation days, plus approximately 5 additional days off when Euronext is closed
  • Full reimbursement of travel expenses
  • Flexible working hours with the possibility to work from home occasionally in consultation
  • A generous training and development budget for courses, certifications and professional growth
  • Direct access to decision-makers and the opportunity to influence technology strategy
  • A high degree of autonomy and ownership within a compact and entrepreneurial environment

title: Technology Services, Project Manager
description:
Location

Brookfield Place New York - 225 Liberty Street, 8th Floor

Technology Services

Technology Services (TS) is responsible for delivering all enterprise infrastructure, applications and related end user technology services across all Brookfield business groups.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.


Job Description

Role Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning and delivery of technology initiatives that support Brookfield’s business operations and strategic priorities. This role manages the full project lifecycle—from initiation through delivery—ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, and budget. The Project Manager works closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and leadership to coordinate delivery activities, manage risks, and maintain strong governance and communication throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of technology projects including infrastructure, application, security, and enterprise system initiatives.

  • Define project scope, objectives, success criteria, and deliverables in partnership with business and technology stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans including timelines, milestones, dependencies, and resource requirements.

  • Manage project execution and track performance against established plans, identifying and addressing deviations proactively.

  • Establish and maintain appropriate governance structures, including project steering committees and status reporting.

  • Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies while implementing mitigation strategies.

  • Manage project budgets, forecasts, and financial reporting in accordance with established governance and financial controls.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including technology engineers, architects, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.

  • Ensure project deliverables meet defined quality standards and support the intended business outcomes.

  • Facilitate regular stakeholder communication and provide clear reporting on project status, risks, and progress.

  • Support vendor engagement activities including scope definition, commercial review, and delivery oversight.

  • Ensure alignment with technology governance, security policies, and compliance requirements throughout project execution.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of project management standards, processes, and governance practices within the PMO.

Key Deliverables

  • Successful delivery of technology projects within approved scope, schedule, and budget.

  • Comprehensive project documentation including project charters, work plans, status reports, and closure documentation.

  • Accurate and timely reporting of project progress, financial status, risks, and issues.

  • Well-managed project governance including stakeholder engagement and decision frameworks.

  • Effective management of project risks, issues, and change requests.

  • Delivery of technology capabilities that support business initiatives, operational improvements, or regulatory requirements.

  • Strong collaboration and alignment between technology teams and business stakeholders.

Required Experience

  • 5–7+ years of experience managing technology or IT projects in enterprise environments.

  • Proven experience delivering complex application, infrastructure, buildouts, or enterprise technology initiatives.

  • Experience working in financial services, asset management, or similarly regulated industries is preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technology teams.

  • Experience managing project budgets, vendors, and project governance structures.

  • Experience working within structured project delivery frameworks or PMO environments.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong project management capabilities across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder management.

  • Excellent organizational and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex delivery environments.

  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and technical teams.

  • Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and maintain alignment across multiple business and technology stakeholders.

  • Understanding enterprise technology environments including applications, infrastructure, and security considerations.

  • Familiarity with technology governance, compliance, and operational risk frameworks.

  • Proficiency with project management tools and productivity software (e.g., Microsoft Office, project planning tools).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).

  • Experience managing infrastructure modernization, cloud migration, or enterprise application implementations.

title: Lab Specimen Processor, 20 Hours, Second Shift
description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Under the general supervision of the Laboratory Manager accepts, processes, identifies and labels specimens according to protocol. The Lab Assistant is familiar with the patient and specimen requirements, stores and transports specimens according to protocol and ensures specimen integrity is preserved at all times. They will operate automated instrumentation and assist in the upkeep that comes along with instrumentation. Coverage may include rotating weekends and holidays.

Job Description:

Essential Duties & Responsibilities including but are not limited to:

General Laboratory
1. Ensures proper labeling and identification of specimens and requisition forms. Brings discrepancies to the attention of the supervisor or senior staff. Records discrepancies and resolutions for quality monitoring.
2. Inventories and maintains adequate supplies in an organized fashion for various laboratories. Restocks workstations.
3. Monitors reagent and supplies and communicates need to the appropriate person to maintain adequate inventory and timely purchasing of necessary supplies.
4. Responsible for receiving, archiving, and discarding specimens according to established procedures.
5. Prepares benches and work stations for each day’s specimen workload. Organizes and reloads instruments and supplies for each station appropriate to its service.
6. Properly prepares infectious biohazardous waste for transport in a manner that meets the requirements of Lahey Clinic Environmental Safety and Health Policy.
7. Helps to monitor laboratory equipment temperature and humidity readings. Maintains equipment temperature charts. Initiates corrective action and brings to the attention of team lead.
8. Organizes and files specimens in an established, organized specimen storage system. Assists Senior Staff in specimen retrieval to permit additional diagnostic testing.
9. Perform send out tasks, including packing lists, scanning requisitions and other administrative duties.
10. Assists with specimen receipt and specimen triage, ensuring proper quality monitoring methods are followed. Discrepancies are immediately brought to the attention of the supervisor or senior staff and properly documented.
11. Responsible for equipment maintenance and upkeep, including troubleshooting and correcting basic problems. Brings to the attention of appropriate staff when needed.
12. Monitor Satellite Accumulation Areas (SAA) within the laboratory. Transport chemical waste in compliance with MWRA and hospital regulations. Transfer hazardous waste from work benches to SAA.
13. Assists staff as appropriate with routine and special projects.
14. Maintains established department policies, procedures and objectives, including the areas of quality assurance, safety, environmental and infection control.
15. Follows all JCAHO Patient Safety Goals and related Laboratory and Hospital Policies.

Location Specific- Clinical Laboratory
1. Train in Phlebotomy -drawing blood from patients and collecting and documenting specimens based on physician orders. This clinical staff position is the face of the lab and their effort starts the whole laboratory process, providing phlebotomy draws with attention to patient comfort and the physician orders.

Location Specific- Anatomic Pathology Laboratory
1. Collects, documents, and transports surgical pathology specimens from on campus clinical sites to the grossing rooms.
2. Assigns Cases to pathologists following the proper protocol.
3. Transports routine and special specimens within the hospital, maintaining diagnostic viability and specimen integrity for each case.
4. Daily exposure to formaldehyde and other hazardous chemicals and fixatives, all under controlled conditions. Minimal risk when proper protocols are observed and followed.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: High School Diploma or equivalent.

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:

  • Ability to identify and evaluate proper specimen collection and storage.

  • Manual dexterity and acuity necessary to prepare specimens, screen specimens, prepare solutions, and operate instrumentation and a computer.

  • Ability to concentrate for long periods of time, utilize good judgment, work accurately under pressure and handle stress to meet deadlines.

  • Interpersonal verbal and written English language skills sufficient to exchange information with physicians and other colleagues.

  • Work requires the ability to perform venipuncture techniques.

  • Skill in the use of personal computers and related software applications.

Experience: 1-year related laboratory experience preferred, but not required.

$21.00 - $28.26

title: Senior backend software engineer (zzp - freelance)
description:
Kadaster

Zorg ervoor dat u het onderstaande overzicht en de vereisten voor deze vacature volledig leest.

Het Kadaster registreert en verstrekt gegevens over de ligging van vastgoed in Nederland en de daarmee samenhangende rechten, zoals eigendom en hypotheek. Als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan is dat onze wettelijke taak. Onze gegevens bieden houvast bij het onderzoeken van maatschappelijke vraagstukken, of het nu gaat om de beste route voor een nieuwe snelweg, actuele ontwikkelingen op de woningmarkt of het in beeld brengen van leegstand.


Opdracht

Voor de DSO OBO Kadaster zijn wij op zoek naar een Senior Software Engineer, ter versterking van het DSO Ozon team.


Het Ozon team ontwikkelt en beheert de dienst Ozon, die worden gebruikt binnen de Omgevingswet. Met de Omgevingswet heeft de overheid de regels voor ruimtelijke ontwikkeling vereenvoudigd en samengevoegd, zodat het bijvoorbeeld makkelijker is om bouwprojecten te starten. De Omgevingswet is een bundeling van 26 wetten en regels over ruimtelijke ordening, wonen, infrastructuur, milieu, water en natuur. Aannemers, ondernemers, overheden en omwonenden kunnen bij één loket snel zien snel wat er mag of mogelijk is in de leefomgeving, Bij hetzelfde loket kunnen meteen vergunningen worden aangevraagd.


De dienst Ozon vervult een belangrijke rol in het Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet door Omgevingsdocumenten van de Bevoegd Gezagen te valideren en te registreren en vervolgens beschikbaar te stellen via diverse API’s. Op basis van de API’s van Ozon is het onder andere mogelijk Omgevingsdocumenten te bekijken in de GEO-viewers van het DSO. Daarnaast maken ze een koppeling met Toepasbare Regels mogelijk waarmee burgers worden geholpen bij het aanvragen van een vergunning.


De dienst wordt ontwikkeld en beheerd door het Kadaster. Het Kadaster is hierbij ketenpartner in het Digitaal Stelsel van de Omgevingswet (DSO). We zijn samen met andere ontwikkelpartners georganiseerd in operationele beheerorganisaties (OBO’s). De diensten die de verschillende OBO’s ontwikkelen en beheren, vormen de operationele keten van het DSO-LV.


De teams binnen de OBO’s werken nauw samen om de gewenste functionaliteit voor het programma Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet te realiseren. In dat programma werken verschillende organisaties op een Agile wijze samen op basis van het SAFe framework. Dat betekent onder andere dat er wordt gewerkt in sprints van 2 weken en Program Increments van een kwartaal.


Je wordt onderdeel van het Ozon team. Wij bestaan uit 10 ontwikkelaars, 1 test engineer, een informatie analist en een Product Owner. Daarbij worden we ondersteund door een Scrum Master, integratiespecialisten en functioneel beheerders.


Wij werken met Agile Scrum in sprints van 2 weken. Dagelijks hebben we een stand-up, en elke sprint een planning, demo, retrospective en meerdere refinements. We proberen elkaar scherp te houden op ons sprintdoel, en vinden het belangrijk dat een retrospective afwisselend en zinvol is.
We doen DevOps, wat betekent dat we volledig verantwoordelijk zijn voor onze applicaties, van idee tot productie.


Ozon bestaat uit een 10-tal services (API’s), Java backends en een Angular frontend beheerportaal, die allemaal draaien op een Kubernetes cluster in de Azure Cloud.


Belangrijkste technieken, methoden en tools

  • Java (25)
  • Spring Boot (4)
  • Angular typescript
  • OpenAPI
  • Swagger
  • jOOQ
  • Hibernate
  • JPA
  • Kotlin
  • Github Copilot
  • RabbitMQ
  • PostgreSQL/ PostGIS
  • XML/GML
  • Geolson
  • Robot Framework
  • Container technologie (Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud)
  • Traefik
  • CI/CD tooling (Git, Tekton, ArgoCD, Maven)
  • Issue tracking (Jira)
  • Agile, Scrum, DevOps

Verantwoordelijkheden

Als Senior Software Engineer verwachten we dat je actief meedenkt en meebouwt aan onze services. Je bent op de hoogte van de algemeen geldende software principes en technologie en kan deze toepassen. Je voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je eigen, maar ook voor andermans werk. Je neemt initiatief en bent proactief. KISS, SOLID en YAGNI zijn geen geheim voor je.


De belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn

  • Preppen en schrijven van stories;
  • Actief meedenken tijdens refinements, hier scherp zijn;
  • Meedenken over software architectuur;
  • Optimaliseren van configuratie en performance;
  • Gedegen code schrijven, van voldoende kwaliteit; op zo 'n manier dat je medeontwikkelaar dit ook begrijpt;
  • Een ontwikkelaar anno nu schrijft niet enkel meer code: hij of zij configureert ook -lees configuration-as-code-, en past tooling toe daar waar gepast;
  • Sparren over software architectuur & ontwerp; de balans vinden tussen YAGNI en toekomstbestendig design;
  • Beseffen dat een gedegen testdekking ook onderdeel uitmaakt van code schrijven;
  • Evenals documenteren;
  • Doen van code reviews; delen van kennis tijdens code reviews;
  • Analyse van complexe bugs en issues;
  • Het uitvoeren van DevOps beheerwerkzaamheden;
  • Actief bijdragen aan onze development guidelines;
  • Deelnemen aan de Java community binnen het Kadaster.

Competenties

  • Besluitvaardig en vasthoudend; kan zijn/haar eigen pad trekken in complex krachtenveld
  • In staat om zelfstandig binnen een organisatie te bewegen en omgevingssensitief
  • Communicatief zowel schriftelijk als mondeling sterk

title: Senior Software Engineer - Java
description:
Senior Software Engineer – Java

Financial Crime Product | Backend Engineering | Warsaw

Every day, banks process enormous volumes of transactions. Vyntra's Financial Crime platform analyses that data in real time to help financial institutions identify fraud and suspicious activity.

We're growing our engineering team in Warsaw and looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work, solving difficult problems and improving the technology behind them.

The role

You'll join our Financial Crime Product Development team, working in a small, experienced engineering team on backend systems used by banks around the world.

The work is predominantly Java and Spring Boot within a larger distributed platform processing significant volumes of financial data.

We're looking for someone who wants to understand the problem rather than simply implement a ticket. You'll be involved in technical design, development and production, with opportunities to improve existing systems and influence how new solutions are built.

We work from our Warsaw WeWork office a minimum of 2 days per week.

Your work will include

  • Designing and developing backend services using Java and Spring Boot
  • Taking features from technical design through development and into production
  • Working with distributed systems, messaging and large volumes of data
  • Investigating production issues, finding root causes and implementing long-term solutions
  • Improving the performance, reliability and scalability of existing systems
  • Contributing to technical and architectural decisions
  • Collaborating with other engineers while taking ownership of your own solutions

What we're looking for

You have experience building and running production systems and are comfortable working independently on complex technical problems.

You have:

  • Good hands-on experience with Java and Spring/Spring Boot backend development
  • Experience with microservices and distributed or cloud-based systems
  • Experience investigating production issues and troubleshooting beyond your own code
  • Good understanding of databases and SQL
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience contributing to technical design and making decisions about how things should be built
  • Experience working in agile development teams
  • Clear, practical communication skills

You don't need to know every technology we use. Our wider stack includes Kafka and other messaging systems, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL, Grafana, Python, Spark, Elasticsearch and StarRocks.

Experience with some of these is useful, but we're more interested in what you've built, improved or troubleshot than how many technologies you can list.

The team

Our Warsaw engineering team is small and close-knit, currently around 10 people and growing to around 15.

It's Vyntra's technical hub for our Financial Crime product, with developers and architects working closely together. It's an environment where engineers can work independently, contribute ideas and have a genuine influence on how things are built.

About Vyntra

Vyntra was created through the combination of Swiss fintech NetGuardians and Belgian fintech Intix.

Today we're around 150–160 people globally, with teams across Switzerland, Belgium, Poland, Nairobi and Singapore. Our customers are banks and financial institutions around the world.

In Warsaw, our focus is Financial Crime: building technology that helps banks detect fraud and suspicious activity using large-scale transaction data.

You have experience building and running production systems and are comfortable working independently on complex technical problems.

You have:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring/Spring Boot backend development
  • Experience with microservices and distributed or cloud-based systems
  • Experience investigating production issues and finding root causes
  • Experience with SQL databases
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience contributing to technical design and decisions, not just implementing predefined solutions
  • Experience working in agile development teams
  • Clear and practical communication skills

title: Intern - HBM Design Architect | MS or PhD Student
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

About the Team

At Micron Technology, we transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. The Heterogeneous Integration Group (HIG) HBM Architecture team develops next-generation High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) solutions that enable advancements in Artificial Intelligence, high-performance computing, networking, and data center technologies. The team collaborates across architecture, design, verification, packaging, product engineering, and system engineering to evaluate innovative memory technologies and drive future product development.

Position Overview

As an HBM Design Architect Intern, you will work alongside experienced architects and engineers to evaluate HBM and DRAM architecture concepts, develop analytical models, and investigate design tradeoffs affecting performance, power, thermal behavior, reliability, and manufacturability. This internship provides hands-on experience in semiconductor architecture analysis while offering opportunities to leverage AI Assisted engineering workflows, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI technologies to support design exploration and engineering productivity.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze HBM and DRAM architecture tradeoffs related to timing, bandwidth, power, area, thermal performance, reliability, and design complexity using analytical, simulation, and AI Assisted methodologies.
  • Develop first-order models, simulations, and data-analysis tools to compare design alternatives, identify key sensitivities, and support architecture pathfinding studies.
  • Collaborate with architecture, circuit design, verification, layout, packaging, product, and system engineering teams to evaluate implementation feasibility and technology tradeoffs.
  • Review simulation, experimental, and silicon data to perform root-cause analysis, validate assumptions, improve model accuracy, and develop evidence-based recommendations.
  • Apply Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and AI Assisted engineering workflows to enhance engineering analysis, technical research, and productivity while documenting and presenting findings to multi-functional teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field and returning to the degree program following completion of the internship.
  • Strong academic foundation in at least two of the following areas: CMOS circuits, digital or mixed-signal design, semiconductor devices, computer architecture, memory systems, thermal sciences, power delivery, signal integrity, or advanced packaging.
  • Experience using engineering analysis, modeling, or simulation tools through graduate research, coursework, laboratory projects, or internships.
  • Demonstrated ability to define assumptions, perform technical analysis, evaluate results, and communicate evidence-based conclusions.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Graduate research, internship, thesis, dissertation, or project experience related to HBM, DRAM, SRAM, memory controllers, high-speed interfaces, semiconductor architecture, or 3D integrated circuit technologies.
  • Experience with transistor-level simulation or schematic-entry tools such as HSPICE, FineSim, Spectre, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of timing, power, area, performance, thermal, and reliability tradeoffs in advanced semiconductor products.
  • Familiarity with AI workloads and the impact of memory bandwidth, latency, capacity, power, and thermal characteristics on system performance.
  • Experience using data analytics, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, or AI Assisted engineering workflows to improve technical insight, design exploration, or productivity.

Ervaring, kwalificaties en soft skills: heeft u alles in huis om te slagen in deze functie? Ontdek het hieronder.
Functieomschrijving

Softwareontwikkeling verandert razendsnel AI verandert hoe we code schrijven, testen en verbeteren. Wij omarmen dat, niet om méér code te produceren, maar om sneller tot betere oplossingen te komen.


We zoeken een Fullstack Software Engineer (PHP) die nieuwsgierig is naar nieuwe manieren van werken, AI-tools actief inzet als onderdeel van het vak, en begrijpt dat niet de tool maar jij verantwoordelijk bent voor wat naar productie gaat.


Binnen Louwman bouwen we een bedrijfskritisch platform waarmee we processen binnen onze automotive-organisatie digitaliseren: van inkoop en inruil tot reconditionering, voorraadbeheer en verkoop. Honderden collega's werken ermee en jaarlijks verwerken we er duizenden voertuigen mee en we zijn nog lang niet klaar.


Je werkt mee aan zowel nieuwe functionaliteit als het technische fundament daaronder. Concreet:



  • ontwerpen en bouwen van functionaliteit, van domeinlogica tot gebruikersinterface;
  • vertalen van complexe bedrijfsprocessen naar begrijpbare code;
  • bouwen en onderhouden van API's, integraties en event-driven koppelingen tussen diensten;
  • automatiseren van processen die nu nog handmatig gaan;
  • verbeteren en refactoren van bestaande functionaliteit, inclusief geautomatiseerde tests;
  • bewaken van kwaliteit, performance, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
  • meedenken over architectuur en technische keuzes;
  • slim inzetten van AI, zowel in je eigen ontwikkelproces als binnen de applicatie voor de eindgebruiker.

Onze architectuur en stack

We zijn niet dogmatisch: een architectuurprincipe of technologie is een middel, geen doel. Je begrijpt waarom je iets toepast en herkent wanneer een eenvoudigere oplossing beter is.


AI als onderdeel van het vak

We verwachten niet dat je elke regel code zelf intikt, maar wel dat je actief onderzoekt hoe AI je helpt sneller en beter te ontwikkelen: bij het analyseren van een probleem, doorgronden van bestaande code, genereren van code of tests, refactoren of documenteren.


AI-generated code is geen eindproduct. Jij begrijpt wat er wordt gegenereerd, beoordeelt het kritisch, en zorgt dat het past binnen onze architectuur, coding guidelines, security-eisen en teststrategie. AI mag je versnellen; engineering blijft jouw verantwoordelijkheid.


Wie ben jij?

Ervaring in jaren is voor ons geen maatstaf we kijken naar hoe je problemen oplost, jezelf ontwikkelt en welke kwaliteit je oplevert. Je bent nieuwsgierig, volgt ontwikkelingen in het vak actief, en durft bestaande oplossingen ter discussie te stellen wanneer het beter kan.



  • aantoonbare ervaring met professionele softwareontwikkeling in PHP; Symfony is een pré;
  • je ontwerpt, bouwt, test en levert functionaliteit zelfstandig naar productie;
  • je begrijpt objectgeoriënteerd programmeren, software-designprincipes en de basis van Domain-Driven Design en event-driven architectuur (of hebt de interesse om dit snel eigen te maken);
  • unit- en integratietests zijn voor jou onderdeel van het ontwikkelproces, niet iets voor achteraf;
  • je werkt met API's, messaging en integraties tussen systemen;
  • je gebruikt AI-tools actief tijdens ontwikkeling, of hebt een duidelijke visie op verantwoord gebruik, en beoordeelt AI-output kritisch;
  • je denkt na over maintainability, performance en security, en kunt technische keuzes uitleggen en bespreken;
  • je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands; ontwikkeling (code, documentatie) gebeurt in het Engels.


Je werkt in een gedreven developmentteam van PHP/fullstack developers dat het platform zelf bouwt met veel invloed op product én techniek. We werken niet alleen tickets weg: we denken mee over het probleem achter een vraag en bepalen samen hoe we iets goed bouwen. We delen kennis, reviewen elkaars werk en dagen elkaar uit. Nieuwe technologie AI-assisted development, architectuur, tooling krijgt serieus de ruimte, zolang kwaliteit niet optioneel wordt.



  • Salaris tot € 6.000 bruto per maand, passend bij je kennis, ervaring en niveau;
  • hybride werken, met maandag en vrijdag als vaste kantoordagen;
  • goede pensioenregeling, thuiswerkvergoeding en reiskostenvergoeding;
  • veel verantwoordelijkheid en invloed op technische keuzes;
  • ruimte om nieuwe technologie en AI-tooling daadwerkelijk toe te passen;
  • MacBook van de zaak.


Wie zijn wij?

Louwman Group werkt vanuit de missie Passie om mensen te bewegen. Als 100% familiebedrijf kijken we verder dan vandaag: samen met duizenden collega's bouwen we aan mobiliteitsoplossingen, waarin technologie een steeds grotere rol speelt. Je bouwt hier niet aan een zijlijn-project, maar aan software die direct onderdeel is van de dagelijkse operatie.


We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je kunt, hoe je denkt en hoe je werkt. xgiwjmb Laat zien waar je trots op bent en vertel hoe AI jouw manier van werken heeft veranderd.
