title: Integrated Master Scheduler
description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Are you ready for your next challenge?

Leidos is seeking an Integrated Master Scheduler to support the Indo-Pacific Logistics and Sustainment Services (ILS2) Program Management Office (PMO). In this role, you will develop, maintain, analyze, and communicate integrated schedules that support the successful planning and execution of complex projects across multiple locations, mission partners, and functional areas.

What’s in it for you?

As an Integrated Master Scheduler, you will work closely with program leadership, Project Plan Managers, Resource Managers, Task Leads, Mission Partner Liaisons, and technical and operational teams to translate project requirements into executable schedules. Your work will provide program leadership and Government customers with the schedule visibility and analysis needed to understand priorities, identify dependencies and risks, coordinate resources, and make informed decisions. This is an opportunity for an experienced scheduler or project controls professional to apply their expertise to a dynamic, mission-focused program supporting logistics, facilities, deployment, sustainment, and emerging operational requirements across the Indo-Pacific region.

THE CHALLENGE (primary responsibilities)

  • Develop, maintain, and manage the ILS2 Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and supporting project schedules across multiple concurrent projects, locations, and task areas.

  • Partner with Project Plan Managers, Resource Managers, Task Leads, and technical teams to develop executable schedules incorporating activities, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, resource requirements, and Government decision points.

  • Integrate individual project schedules into the program-level IMS, providing program leadership and Government stakeholders with visibility into execution across the ILS2 enterprise.

  • Perform critical-path, schedule health, variance, trend, and risk analyses to identify emerging constraints and recommend actions to mitigate schedule and execution risk.

  • Monitor performance against approved schedule baselines and develop forecasts, status reports, dashboards, metrics, and executive-level briefings that provide actionable insight into program performance.

  • Identify and manage cross-project dependencies involving logistics, facilities, deployment, training, sustainment, mission support, workforce resources, Government organizations, mission partners, teammates, and vendors.

  • Coordinate with Resource Managers and project leadership to identify staffing and resource requirements, availability, dependencies, and constraints that could affect project execution.

  • Support development of Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), project plans, milestones, deliverables, and other program and project management artifacts.

  • Perform what-if and scenario analyses to evaluate the schedule impacts of changing priorities, resource constraints, emerging requirements, contingency operations, and surge requirements.

  • Participate in project reviews, planning sessions, risk reviews, and other program management activities, providing schedule analysis and recommendations to support informed decision-making.

  • Maintain schedule baselines, assumptions, change documentation, and supporting records in Government- and program-approved systems.

  • Identify lessons learned and recommend improvements to scheduling, forecasting, and project controls processes across the ILS2 program.

WHAT SETS YOU APART (basic qualifications)

  • High school diploma and 3+ years of relevant experience in project scheduling, project controls, program management, project planning, or a related discipline. Additional education, training, or relevant professional experience may be considered.

  • Demonstrated experience developing, maintaining, and analyzing integrated project schedules for complex programs or projects.

  • Experience using Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or comparable scheduling/project controls software.

  • Experience with schedule development and analysis, including critical path analysis, schedule health assessments, variance analysis, forecasting, and status reporting.

  • Experience integrating schedules across multiple projects, functional organizations, or geographically dispersed teams.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify schedule dependencies, constraints, risks, and potential impacts to project execution.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Project.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex schedule information into clear recommendations for program leadership and Government stakeholders.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a dynamic, mission-focused environment.

  • Active Secret security clearance required prior to start.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Department of War, Federal Government, or other large, complex programs.

  • Experience supporting geographically dispersed, OCONUS, operationally focused organizations.

  • Experience scheduling logistics, facilities, deployment, sustainment, or contingency response activities.

  • Experience developing or maintaining Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), Integrated Project Plans, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), resource-loaded schedules, or schedule risk analyses.

  • Experience integrating project schedules with workforce, resource, cost, or performance planning.

  • Familiarity with schedule quality and health assessment methodologies and industry scheduling best practices.

  • Experience working in Agile, hybrid, or PMBOK-aligned program/project management environments.

  • PMP, PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP), or equivalent project management/project controls certification.

  • Experience supporting contingency, surge, or rapidly changing operational requirements.

description:

Provides security and protection for patients, visitors, and colleagues, as well as buildings and grounds. May be called upon to provide assistance in many different circumstances, settings and weather.

Job Description:

Essential Duties & Responsibilities including but not limited to:

1) Monitoring and Reporting - Patrols assigned areas on foot or in vehicle, checks for unsafe conditions, hazards, unlocked doors, security violations, blocked ingress and egress, and unauthorized persons. Conducts periodic inspections of all areas at designated times to ascertain their conditions of security and safety. Perform monthly preventative maintenance and required equipment checks, i.e.: elevator phones, outside emergency phones, vehicle equipment, door alarms and panel, building alarms, fire alarm panel, all doors and locks and radio equipment. Prepares logs or reports as required for post, writes or types reports entering information in a computer.
2) Enforcement - Directs vehicle and pedestrian traffic. Issues parking citations for colleagues parked in unauthorized lots. Patrols designated areas and all parking areas. Checks for and issues proper identification of colleagues, and enforcing the wearing of ID badges. Issues temporary badges to Visitors and Vendors. Checks suspicious packages as directed.
3) Emergency Response - Responds to all Codes and alarms in accordance with the Safety Manual and the Emergency Management Policy. First responders to acts of violence and aggression. Coordinates with local Police, Fire, and Emergency personnel as directed. Responds to alarms initiated by fire crash bars on exterior doors. Responds to elevator entrapments. Respond to and investigate reported thefts, disturbances and incidents. Responds to medical emergency call such as slips or falls in the facility or on the grounds, provide an emergency stretcher as needed, and assists with transport within building, awaiting ambulance as the case warrants.
4) Patient Observation - Performs patient watch or observation as directed. Responds appropriately to a variety of human service issues, including domestic abuse, substance abuse, forensic patients, psychiatric cases, and anxious/upset visitors. Maintain composure and professional demeanor in an occasionally chaotic environment. Practices universal precautions. Restrains patients as necessary utilizing de-escalation techniques.
5) Fire Prevention - Identifies and reports fire safety hazards. Keep fire exits, fire doors, corridor access and extinguishing equipment clear. Immediately notify appropriate personnel when equipment may be out of order and in need of repair or replacement.
6) Colleague and Patient Assistance - Provides assistance to patients, visitors, and colleagues with vehicle problems, such as jump starts, lock outs, shoveling, contacting AAA etc. Using a LHMC vehicle, transports patients and colleagues between buildings and designated parking lots.
7) Courier - Responsible for multiple daily bank and pharmacy details. Delivers payroll to various buildings. Delivers large deposits from Dietary, Cashiers, Wall Street and others to area banks. Delivers or accompanies daily cash trays from Dietary, Gift Shop and Credit Union checks. Retrieves and delivers pharmacy items, such as vaccines, alcohol, and narcotics. Retrieves and delivers stat charts, specimens, x-rays and other equipment from Lab, Radiology, Health Information Management (H.I.M.) to off site facilities.
8) Notifies the Maintenance Department of changing weather conditions as it relates to snow removal and sanding for the safety of patients, visitors, and colleagues.
9) Coordinates with Funeral Home staff for removal of deceased patients, verifies that accompanying legal documents are complete, records pathology statistics and processes paperwork.
10) Maintains courteous and effective interactions with colleagues and patients.
11) Demonstrates an understanding of job description, performance expectations, and competency assessment.
12) Demonstrates a commitment toward meeting and exceeding the needs of our customers
13) Participates in departmental and/or interdepartmental quality improvement activities.
14) Participates in and successfully completes Mandatory Education.
15) Performs all other duties as needed or directed to meet the needs of the department.
16) Organizational Requirements:
• Incorporates Lahey Hospital and Medical Center Guiding Principles, Mission Statement and Goals into daily activities.
• Complies with all LHMC Policies.
• Complies with behavioral expectations of the department and LHMC
• Maintains courteous and effective interactions with colleagues and patients.
• Demonstrates an understanding of the job description, performance expectations, and competency assessment.
• Participates in departmental and/or interdepartmental quality improvement activities.
• Participates in and successfully completes Mandatory Education.
• Performs all other duties as needed or directed to meet the needs of the department.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: High School Graduate or equivalent


Licensure, Certification, Registration: Current valid driver’s license required. CPI NCI Certification. AVADE Workplace Violence Prevention Levels I, II, III Certification, BLS Provider Certification (CPR & AED), AHA Heart-Saver First Aid Certification, Stop the Bleed and Nasal Naloxone Certification, and successful completion of Safe Environment for Suicidal/Homicidal Patients and Restraints/Seclusion Safety training. All certifications must be obtained within six (6) months of hire


Skills, Knowledge & Abilities: Observant, paying close attention to detail; Ability to remain calm in difficult situations; Adaptable to sometimes rapidly changing situations; Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact effectively across diverse cultures and at various social and educational levels. Basic computer and data entry skills. In the absence of a particular skill, a colleague must have the ability to be trained to a level of proficiency.


Experience: 1 - 2 years of healthcare security experience preferred. Military, law enforcement, and customer service work experience are also preferred. Bachelor's degree level of education or current student enrolled in a criminal justice program also encouraged.

Role Summary

Owns the firm’s Planview platform and related portfolio management capabilities. This role is responsible for setting the product vision, roadmap, and adoption strategy to support enterprise planning, investment governance, resource management, business case development, and strategic execution.

The role applies deep knowledge of portfolio management practices, enterprise planning processes, and technology platforms to define business requirements, prioritize enhancements, and maximize the value delivered through Planview. This individual ensures Planview capabilities align with business objectives and strategic priorities while maintaining a scalable, effective, and well-governed platform.

Working closely with senior leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, and vendors, this role evolves portfolio management capabilities, strengthens governance, improves decision-making, and increases transparency into investment and execution outcomes. Preferred:

  • Experience with enterprise portfolio management (PPM) and strategic planning disciplines.
  • Experience supporting annual planning, funding governance, business case management, and resource planning.

title: Consultant Data Engineer
description:
Join Sia’s Data Science team as a Data Engineer Consultant, where you will help shape a young, diverse, and growing team with a flat structure that values entrepreneurial spirit, initiative, well-being, and knowledge-sharing.


Solliciteer na het lezen van de volgende vaardigheids- en kwalificatievereisten voor deze functie.

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries.

Job description

As a Data Engineer Consultant, you will be working on various client projects as well as on building Sia AI solutions, together with the French Data Engineering team:

  • Cloud services at GCP, AWS and Azure: architecture choices, use of storage and compute services, cost monitoring and optimization, role management, Infrastructure as Code
  • Docker and Kubernetes: containerization and orchestration of applications, management of Kubernetes clusters adapted to Data Science workloads

  • CI/CD: managing the integration and ongoing deployment of applications and internal platforms, supporting the deployment of Data Science projects at clients' sites

Qualifications
  • You hold a Master’s Degree with a strong quantitative component, such as Econometrics, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, or Quantitative Finance
  • You have 1–3 years of relevant experience in Data, DevOps, Cloud, or Software Engineering

  • Ideally, you are already familiar with at least one cloud services platform, such as GCP, AWS, or Azure, with experience mixing different services within the same project. If not, you have a strong appetite to learn more about these topics

  • You will be able to work in a DevOps culture, taking responsibility for the code lifecycle, from development to deployment and maintenance of applications. Mastery of the Gitlab-CE ecosystem is a plus. xgiwjmb You are also familiar with Infrastructure as Code concepts and tools, ideally Terraform

  • You have excellent interpersonal and team working skills

title: Special Programs Records Coordinator
description:
Job Description

Job Description

Required Certificates and Licenses: None

Residency Requirements: This position is virtual with periodic travel across Texas required. Residents of Texas strongly preferred. Residents of states contiguous to Texas may also be considered.

Start Date - Immediate

Salary - $48K plus the eligibility of a performance bonus

The Remote Special Programs Records Coordinator owns the data infrastructure, reporting, and compliance operations for Special Programs records across several campuses and four programs (SPED, 504, GT, EB), covering a records base of roughly 20,000–30,000 students per cycle. This role designs and maintains the automated pipelines and reports that route student records, builds and administers the team's tracking and training systems, and coordinates the records and TEA clerk teams. The coordinator operates at the intersection of data engineering, compliance operations, and team leadership — translating raw multi-source data into the tracker-ready views clerks work from, while also stepping directly into clerk, TEA clerk, or lead duties as needed to maintain coverage and turnaround.

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANYONE. We provide families an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, (TXSS). We want you to be a part of our talented team!

The mission of Stride K12 partner school, (TXSS). is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

Data Infrastructure & Reporting

• Designs, builds, and maintains a multi-source Power Query pipeline consolidating student records data across several campuses (20,000–30,000 students per cycle)

• Authors and maintains the Power BI reporting model that flags and routes records, including the tracker-ready output views the team works from

• Manages the underlying data architecture, including multi-tier key design, join logic, QA/validation layers, and schema-change handling

• Owns the per-clerk tracker system end to end, including standardized templates, defined schema, and consolidation loaders

• Maintains cloud data sources (SharePoint/OneDrive) for scheduled refresh

Automation

• Builds and maintains Power Automate flows for records-request mail merges and notification routing

• Designs and administers the Microsoft Lists handoff infrastructure across all four programs, including per-campus SPED architecture and automation rules

Records Compliance Operations

• Manages special programs records compliance across three campuses and four programs

• Owns the records request and TREx workflow, including requesting, monitoring, and tracking returns

• Maintains the compliance boundary between records and program departments retrieves and routes required documents, while eligibility determinations remain with program departments

Training & Documentation

• Builds and delivers the department's training library, including go-live decks, per-program handoff decks and quick references, and platform guides (PowerSchool, Frontline)

• Writes and maintains clerk-facing process documentation and standards

Team & Process Coordination

• Coordinates records clerk and TEA clerk teams across three campuses, including staffing model, clerk assignment, and work routing

• Serves as backup across all records roles — clerk, TEA clerk, and lead functions — stepping in wherever coverage is needed

• Designs records processes and workflows, and coordinates handoffs with receiving departments.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Coordinates the work of Records and TEA Clerk teams across three campuses but has no formal supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

· High school diploma or equivalent

· Two (2) years of experience in records operations, data reporting, or a comparable analytical/coordination role, with prior special programs or records compliance experience strongly preferred

· Demonstrated experience building and maintaining data pipelines or reporting models in a production environment

· Shows advanced competence and expertise in using various technological and data systems

· Advanced Power Query (M) and Power BI: data modeling, pipeline design, and report authoring

· Power Automate flow building; Microsoft Lists and SharePoint administration

· Strong Excel skills, with the ability to standardize and document complex processes

· Records compliance knowledge across special programs (SPED, 504, GT, EB)

· Ability to train and coordinate distributed teams across multiple campuses

· Ability to design and troubleshoot multi-tier data architecture, including join logic, QA/validation layers, and schema-change handling

· Ability to translate complex data systems into clear, clerk-facing documentation and training

· Strong written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across records, program, and receiving departments

· Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with FERPA

· Excellent organizational and time management skills across data, compliance, and coordination workstreams running in parallel

· Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment on system design and process decisions

· Flexible, team-player; adapts to a changing office environment

· Proficient in Office 365(Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, etc.); Web proficiency.

· Ability to travel 25% of the time

· Ability to clear required background check

Certificates and Licenses: None required.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

· Experience administering Power BI at a departmental or organizational scale, including workspace and refresh management

· Experience building Power Automate approval or notification flows tied to Microsoft Forms or Lists

· Experience working directly in Frontline, TREx, PowerSchool, or Archive Manager

· Experience developing training decks or documentation libraries for a distributed team

· Experience working in a school district or education records environment

· Experience covering frontline records, TEA clerk, or lead duties directly

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

· This position is virtual with periodic travel across Texas required. Residents of Texas strongly preferred. Residents of states contiguous to Texas may also be considered.

  • Palveluiden ja tietoyhteyksien toteuttaminen: rakennat AI-agenttien tarvitsemia palveluita, rajapintoja ja tietoyhteyksiä sekä yhdistät konsernin AI-palveluita paikallisiin ratkaisuihin.

  • Tuotantokelpoisten ratkaisujen kehittäminen: huomioit tiedonkäsittelyn, tietoturvan, monitoroinnin, laadunvarmistuksen, dokumentoinnin ja ylläpidettävyyden.

  • Yhteistyö ja käyttöönotto: työskentelet liiketoiminnan, IT ja kansainvälisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa ratkaisujen suunnittelussa, tuotantoon viennissä ja jatkuvassa kehittämisessä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme kokenutta ja käytännönläheistä teknistä osaajaa, jolla on vahva tausta ohjelmistokehityksestä, integraatioista tai teknisestä automaatiosta ja kiinnostusta tekoälyä hyödyntävien tuotantoratkaisujen rakentamiseen.

Toivomme sinulta:

  • kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä, integraatioista tai teknisestä automaatiosta

  • kokemusta tuotantokäyttöön soveltuvien ratkaisujen rakentamisesta

  • ymmärrystä kielimalleista, AI-agenteista ja niitä tukevista teknisistä palveluista

  • kokemusta rajapinnoista, tiedonkäsittelystä ja järjestelmäintegraatioista

  • kykyä suunnitella ylläpidettäviä ja skaalautuvia kokonaisuuksia

  • kykyä ymmärtää liiketoiminnan tarpeita ja muuttaa niitä toimiviksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi

  • oma-aloitteista, analyyttistä ja yhteistyökykyistä työskentelyotetta

  • valmiutta työskennellä suomeksi ja englanniksi kansainvälisessä ympäristössä

  • soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa esimerkiksi tietotekniikan, ohjelmistokehityksen, tietojenkäsittelyn, automaation tai muun tehtävää tukevan alan parista.

Katsomme eduksi

Tehtävässä on hyötyä kokemuksesta tai ymmärryksestä seuraavilla alueilla:

  • AI-agenttien ja monivaiheisten automaatioiden tekninen toteuttaminen

  • Azure-palvelut, pilvi-integraatiot ja työnkulkujen orkestrointi

  • tietokannat ja tietolähteitä hyödyntävät ratkaisut

  • versionhallinta, konttiteknologiat ja CI/CD

  • tekninen testaus ja monitorointi

  • tietoturvalliset integraatiot, käyttöoikeusmallit ja säännellyt toimintaympäristöt

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Tehtävässä onnistumista tukevat vahva tekninen perusta, kyky hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia sekä kiinnostus uusien teknologioiden oppimiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden ottaa keskeisen teknisen roolin Intrum Suomen AI-ratkaisujen kehittämisessä.

Pääset rakentamaan ratkaisuja, joissa tekoäly yhdistetään liiketoimintaprosesseihin ja olemassa oleviin järjestelmiin. Tavoitteena on toteuttaa hallittuja, turvallisia ja ylläpidettäviä ratkaisuja, jotka tukevat liiketoiminnan kehittämistä pitkällä aikavälillä.

Työskentelet yhdessä AI Agent Engineerin, liiketoiminnan asiantuntijoiden, prosessien omistajien, tuoteomistajien, järjestelmäkehittäjien ja konsernin kansainvälisten AI-asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Tehtäväkenttää voidaan kehittää oman osaamisesi, kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan.

Intrum tarjoaa kansainvälisen markkinajohtajan työympäristön ja mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä sekä kehittää osaamistasi nopeasti kehittyvällä alueella. Meillä on kannustava työkulttuuri, jossa työpanostasi arvostetaan ja pääset työskentelemään motivoituneiden kollegoiden kanssa.

Palkan lisäksi tarjoamme hyvän lounasedun sekä virike-edun, jota voit hyödyntää esimerkiksi liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hierontaan ja hammashoitoon. Lisäksi käytössäsi ovat silmälasietu ja henkilöstöetuohjelman vaihtuvat tarjoukset.

Modernit ja viihtyisät toimitilamme sijaitsevat hyvien yhteyksien päässä Helsingin Herttoniemessä. Työskentelemme hybridimallimme mukaisesti vähintään 12 päivänä kuukaudessa toimistolla.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian ja tehtävä on vakituinen. Käytäntömme mukaisesti tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkistetaan luottotiedot, ja luottotietoselvityksen läpäiseminen on edellytys työsuhteen solmimiselle.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian hakujärjestelmämme kautta. Hakuaika päättyy viimeistään 29.9.2026, mutta aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: SAM Commercial Resolutions Officer (Remote: FL, GA, AL, VA, NC, SC, TX)
location: Remote Opportunity - VA, NC, SC, GA, FL & AL
description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

SUMMARY/OBJECTIVES

Responsible for managing a portfolio of classified loans in a manner that reduces problem assets and minimizes losses to the bank.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

It is the responsibility of the Commercial Resolutions Officer to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of the assigned duties and to perform these essential functions:

  • Day-to-day management of a portfolio of classified assets. Communicate with borrowers via phone, face-to-face meetings, and written correspondence. When necessary, issue past due and demand letters to delinquent borrowers in accordance with bank policy and applicable banking laws.
  • Document collection activities including borrower calls/meetings and correspondence in the Fiserv Premier collections system.
  • Maintain an orderly e-file system to retain necessary documentation. Ensure that e-files are complete and up-to-date.
  • Effectively manage maturing loans in the assigned portfolio. Negotiate renewal/modification terms with borrower and secure necessary approvals. Clear any documentation or approval exceptions identified post-closing.
  • Review all assigned loans and develop a resolution strategy for each. Resolution strategies should have a goal of either rehabilitating the loan to the degree it can be moved back to a Relationship Manager or moving the loan out of the bank in a manner that minimizes losses to the bank and is compliant with applicable banking laws and bank policies. Resolution strategies should be documented and updated as needed.
  • Negotiate settlements with borrowers and guarantors, including deed-in-lieu of foreclosure, short sale, and discounted payoffs with a focus on minimizing problem assets, losses, and expenses. Utilize sound judgment in recommending settlements for approval and secure approval from the Director of Special Assets prior to finalizing settlements with borrowers. Retain documentation that evidences rationale for settlement.
  • Ensure that coding is accurate on all loans in portfolio based on current status, including the risk rating, accrual status, status code, and loss given default. Ensure that codes tied to credit reporting are accurate based on the current status of the loan. Submit coding changes in a timely manner and follow up to ensure changes are properly made.
  • Engage attorneys, appraisers, and other outside vendors as needed. Ensure invoices are properly reviewed and approved in a timely manner. Follow the bank’s appraisal ordering process to engage appraisals and recommend appropriate charge-offs according to bank policy. Make best efforts to minimize expenses associated with using outside vendors and leverage internal Legal department when possible.
  • Identify loans in portfolio that require an impairment analysis and conduct the analysis as needed. If an impairment or charge off is identified, complete the appropriate charge off/impairment document and submit it for approval through the bank’s charge off/impairment process. Ensure that the charge off form is accurate and includes sufficient commentary to identify the reason for the charge off/impairment and the current status of the loan.
  • Coordinate the transfer of loans to other areas of the bank when necessary. This includes loans moving back to a Relationship Manager and OREO/OAO transfers. Ensure that proper approvals are obtained, transfer documentation is completed, and coding is updated to reflect the change.
  • Ensure that all actions taken are compliant with state and federal law, banking regulations, and bank policy. Stay apprised of changes in banking laws and regulations that impact loans.
  • Actively participate in the SAM Quarterly Review process by completing and submitted loan reviews in a timely manner.
  • Assist the Director of Special Assets in responding to audit requests, including internal and third-party audits, internal loan review, and regulatory reviews.
  • Serve as a resource for other areas of the bank (Branches, Finance, Legal, etc.) to answer questions and assist with specific needs.
  • As needed, assist the SAM Manager with special projects as they arise.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

COMPETENCIES

• Strong Data Acquisition and Management skills

• General banking knowledge

• Strong negotiation and mediation skills

Qualifications, Education, and Certification Requirements

  • Education: High School Diploma required. College degree or some college preferred.
  • Experience: 5+ years of banking experience, preferably working in a lending or collections environment.
  • Certifications/Specific Knowledge: Strong organizational, communication, and computer skills (particularly with Microsoft Office products).

TRAINING REQUIREMENTS/CLASSES

Required annual compliance training; New Employee Orientation

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Must be able to effectively access and interpret information on computer screens, documents, reports, and cash denominations, and identify customers. This position requires a large amount of time in front of a computer. This can be done sitting or standing with use of the right desk. This position may require bending and reaching.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Telecommuting roles no matter if hybrid or 100% full time telecommuting must have a secure home office environment that is free from background noise and distractions. They must also have a reliable private internet connection that is not supplied by use of cellular data (hot spot). Cable or fiber connections are preferred. Requirements are subject to change, as new systems and technology is delivered. Travel may be required to come to meetings as needed.

Salary Ranges:

$87,282.00 - $139,425.00

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled/veterans.

title: Program Manager I
description:
Join our Team at Portland Community College

Please Note: PCC currently limits employment to individuals residing in Oregon and Washington. Employment offers are contingent upon the ability to establish residence in Oregon or Washington.

Portland Community College will also ensure that applicants requiring reasonable accommodation for the hiring process are provided for. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact the PCC Talent Acquisition Team at pccjobs@pcc.edu.

Portland Community College is the largest post-secondary institution in Oregon and 19th largest in the nation, serving approximately 80,000 full- and part-time students. With four comprehensive campuses, five workforce training and education centers, and 200 community locations in the Portland metropolitan area, our unique role is to make high-quality education accessible to everyone, creating opportunities for our students and contributing to the economic development of our community.

Summary:

The Program Manager I leads the Margaret Carter Skills Center (MCSC) in providing accessible education, workforce development, career readiness, and skills-building opportunities. The position ensures programs and services are effectively implemented, responsive to community needs, and aligned with MCSC goals and College priorities.

The Program Manager I oversees a focused program area with responsibility for daily operations, staff supervision, program implementation, participant services, operational planning, and routine budget and grant administration. The position provides direct supervision and operational leadership for assigned staff and works collaboratively with the Community Resource Advocate to coordinate participant support, outreach, community partnerships, and resource navigation. The position exercises independent judgment in managing day-to-day operations while working within established College policies and approved program plans.

See the classification description for additional information:
https://www.pcc.edu/hr/employment/management-jobs/program-mgr1/

What You'll Do and Who We Are Looking For

Distinguishing Characteristics

The Program Manager I is responsible for the day-to-day management of MCSC, with direct responsibility for supervising and developing staff, coordinating operations and participant services, and monitoring program resources. The position exercises independent judgment in setting operational priorities, addressing staff and program needs, and ensuring effective service delivery within established College policies, grant requirements, and approved program plans.

Duties and Responsibilities specific to Margaret Carter Skills Center (MCSC)

  • Coordinate the implementation of Computer Fundamentals, Sewing, STEAM, CAT Studio, career-readiness, and digital literacy programming.
  • Provide day-to-day supervision, coaching, and operational direction to the Community Resource Advocate to ensure effective participant support, referrals, outreach, and community resource coordination.
  • Collaborate closely with the Community Resource Advocate to develop outreach strategies, strengthen community partnerships, coordinate participant services, and improve access to resources that support student success.
  • Supervise Professional Casual instructors and Office Support staff to ensure effective scheduling, customer service, instructional support, and daily program operations.
  • Coordinate participant intake, referrals, follow-up, and engagement activities.
  • Monitor instructional supply inventories, facility operations, and equipment needs.
  • Recommend operational improvements to the Dean.
  • Monitor program participation, engagement, and outcomes; maintain accurate program data and prepare reports to support assessment, grant requirements, and continuous improvement.
  • Support implementation of grant-funded activities, including monitoring program expenditures, maintaining required documentation, and ensuring activities align with established grant requirements and program goals.
  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with PCC departments, community-based organizations, educational partners, and employers to expand participant access to education, training, career pathways, and supportive resources.
  • Coordinate safe and effective operation of instructional and STEAM/CAT Studio spaces, including equipment use, training protocols, supplies, and compliance with applicable college procedures.

These qualifications, skills and abilities are critical for success in this position. Throughout the screening process, you will be evaluated based on the demonstration of these success criteria.

  • Demonstrated experience directly supervising employees, not simply serving as a lead. Evidence of setting expectations, coaching, giving feedback, addressing performance concerns, managing conflict, developing employees, and building an accountable and collaborative team.
  • Experience independently managing day-to-day operations of a program or service area, including staffing, schedules, services, priorities, facilities/resources, and solving operational problems.
  • Demonstrated experience working effectively with diverse and historically underserved communities. Shows cultural responsiveness, relationship-building, understanding of barriers to access, and an ability to create welcoming and inclusive services. Spanish-English bilingual ability is an additional strength.
  • Experience with workforce development, adult education, career readiness, digital literacy, college access, community education, CTE/STEAM, or similar programming. Understands how education and skills development connect participants to employment, education, and career pathways.
  • Demonstrated ability to monitor budgets or grant-funded activities, maintain documentation, use data to track participation/outcomes, prepare reports, and ensure work is completed according to requirements and established goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to build productive relationships with community organizations, educational partners, employers, internal departments, and other stakeholders. Communicates clearly, follows through, and can represent MCSC professionally.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Adult Education, Social Science, Business Administration, Educational Leadership, or related field. Relevant experience may substitute year-for-year.
  • Three years of progressively responsible experience in community education, workforce development, student services, or a related area.
  • Two years of progressively responsible supervisory or management experience, including direct responsibility for supervising staff, providing coaching and performance feedback, managing employee performance, and supporting staff development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish preferred.
  • Experience leading workforce development, adult education, college access, career pathways, community engagement, or student success programs.
  • Experience building cross-sector partnerships and managing grants, contracts, budgets, and program operations.
  • Experience using data to evaluate effectiveness, strengthen programs, and advance equitable student outcomes.
  • Knowledge of workforce readiness, digital literacy, STEAM/CTE, and micro-credentials, with demonstrated experience serving diverse and historically underserved populations through culturally responsive and inclusive practices.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

  • Work is generally performed in office, classroom, laboratory, and community settings with occasional travel between PCC locations and partner sites.

Why You'll Love Working Here

The PCC district encompasses a 1,500-square-mile area in northwest Oregon and offers two-year degrees, one-year certificate programs, short-term training, alternative education, pre-college courses and life-long learning. As part of our College community, you’ll enjoy:

  • A collaborative and inspiring campus community

  • Opportunities for learning and professional development

Portland Community College embraces equity and inclusion as a priority. We are committed to building a community with a variety of backgrounds, skills, views, and life experiences. The more we value equity and inclusion, the more we will add value to the work we do and how we serve our students, engage with each other, and the Oregon Community that we serve. Creating a culture that honors equity and inclusion is our objective and the smart path forward.

Position Grade

Management I

Employment Type

Full time

Total Rewards Package / What We Offer

  • Comprehensive benefit package designed to provide employees and their families, including domestic partners, with access to a broad range of benefit options. Includes Health, Dental, and Vision options, Group Life, Long-term Disability, Long-term Care, and Auto and Home Insurance programs

  • Oregon PERS contribution - PCC currently fully funds the Oregon Public Employees Retirement System (PERS/OPSRP) pension and contributes an additional 6% into the employee's Individual Account Program under PERS/OPSRP

  • Tax deferred annuity program and a deferred compensation program where employees may save additional pre-tax dollars for retirement

  • PCC provides a tuition waiver for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and dependent children under 24 years of age, as well as partial tuition reimbursement for full-time employees at other accredited institutions

  • Free access to the sport centers / campus gymnasiums, performing arts, and cultural events

  • Generous Paid Leave (Pro-rated by FTE for Part-Time Employees) reference Management and Confidential Employee Handbook

    • 14.67 hours of vacation leave per month

    • 1 day of sick leave per month

    • 12 paid holidays

More detailed information on the benefits plans, who is eligible, and how to enroll or make changes can be found at . Please email PCCBenefits@pcc.edu if you have any questions.

How We Determine Initial Salary Placement

The initial salary placement typically is between the minimum $72,765 to 89,135 the midpoint range. Placement will generally not exceed the mid-point, based on qualifications, experience, and internal equity.

Oregon Veterans' Preference in Public Employment

Portland Community College complies with the Oregon Veterans' Preference in Public Employment law which provides qualifying veterans and disabled veterans with preference in employment. You will be given instructions during the application process to claim Veterans' Preference in the recruitment of this position, and to provide the documents required for verification of eligibility. Please do not send your documentation to the hiring manager directly. For verification of eligibility, please submit the following documentation:

  • Veterans: DD214

Notice of the Availability of the Annual Security Report

Pursuant to the Jeanne Clery Disclosure of Campus Security Policy and Campus Crime Statistics Act (Clery Act), you may view Portland Community College’s (PCC) most recent Annual Security Report (ASR) on the Department of Public Safety website. title: PMO Lead
description:
PMO Lead

Location: This is a Hybrid working role. Whiteley, Hampshire

Clearance Required: This role will require attainment and maintenance of SC clearance.

Drive Delivery Excellence on a Complex Aviation Programme

At Leidos, we're delivering innovative solutions that support critical aviation capabilities. We are looking for a PMO Manager to lead the Programme Management Office (PMO) within a major, complex systems integration programme.

This is a fantastic opportunity to play a key role in shaping programme delivery, governance, and performance across multiple workstreams. You'll lead a team of Project Managers and work closely with programme leadership, customers, and partners to ensure successful delivery against business, technical, and contractual objectives.

We're interested in hearing from candidates with experience in complex programme environments. While systems integration experience is valuable, we recognise that transferable skills gained in defence, transportation, technology, engineering, infrastructure, or other highly regulated sectors can be equally relevant.

What You'll Be Doing

As PMO Manager, you will:

  • Lead and continuously improve the PMO function, ensuring effective governance, planning, reporting, risk management, change control, and delivery oversight.

  • Manage, coach, and support a team of Project Managers, helping them deliver successful outcomes across multiple work packages.

  • Maintain high-quality programme reporting, dashboards, and insights to support decision-making and provide transparency for stakeholders.

  • Ensure programme controls, processes, and governance frameworks are fit for purpose and aligned with customer and contractual requirements.

  • Support financial, schedule, and performance management activities across the programme.

  • Build strong, collaborative relationships with customers, partners, suppliers, and internal teams.

  • Drive consistency, data quality, and continuous improvement across programme delivery practices.

  • Help create an inclusive, supportive, and high-performing environment where individuals and teams can thrive.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in people who can demonstrate many of the following:

  • Experience leading PMO activities within complex programmes or projects.

  • A strong understanding of programme governance, planning, reporting, risk management, and change control.

  • Experience working in complex delivery environments with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and priorities.

  • Strong leadership skills, with experience managing, mentoring, or developing project or programme teams.

  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of working within contractual frameworks.

  • Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to problem-solving.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently at all levels.

  • Experience using PMO tools, methodologies, and reporting systems to support delivery success.

Desirable Experience

While not essential, the following would be advantageous:

  • Experience within systems integration, aviation, defence, transportation, or other complex regulated industries.

  • Knowledge of customer-supplier delivery models and contract-driven environments.

  • Experience supporting large-scale transformation, technology, or engineering programmes.

  • Professional qualifications such as APM, PRINCE2, MSP, PMI, or equivalent.

  • Experience implementing PMO best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Familiarity with earned value management, integrated schedules, or portfolio reporting.

This role is based in Whiteley, Hampshire, with opportunities for hybrid working. Appointment is subject to the successful candidate holding, or being eligible to obtain, UK Security Check (SC) clearance.

What we do for you:
At Leidos we are PASSIONATE about customer success, UNITED as a team and INSPIRED to make a difference. We offer meaningful and engaging careers, a collaborative culture, and support for your career goals, all while nurturing a healthy work-life balance.


We provide an employment package that attracts, develops and retains only the best in talent. Our reward scheme includes:

  • Contributory Pension Scheme

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • 33 days Annual Leave (including public and privilege holidays)

  • Access to Flexible benefits (including life assurance, health schemes, gym memberships, annual buy and sell holidays and a cycle to work scheme and much more!)

  • Flexi-Time Working

Commitment to Diversity:

We welcome applications from every part of the community and are committed to a truly diverse and inclusive culture. We foster a sense of belonging, welcoming all perspectives and contributions, and providing equal access to opportunities and resources for everyone. If you have a disability or need any reasonable adjustments during the application and selection stages please let us know, and we will respond in a way that best fits your needs.

Who We Are:

Leidos UK & Europe – we work to make the world safer, healthier, and more efficient through technology, engineering and science.

Leidos is a growing company delivering innovative technology and solutions focused on safeguarding critical capabilities and transformation in frontline services, our work in the United Kingdom includes addressing some of the most complex problems in defence, healthcare, government, safety and security, and transportation.

What Makes Us Different:

Purpose: you can use your passion and abilities at Leidos to keep the people you care about safe. We are at the forefront of machine learning, AI, cyber security and solutions. Using your skills in the technology frontline by helping to build a safer world. You can inspire change.

Collaboration: having flexibility to do your job is one of our core benefits, enabling you to become part of our extraordinary team. We have been empowering our people to work flexibly for years. Whether you work from home, the office or on customer sites, we will give you the digital tools and the flexibility to work smarter and align your needs and ours.

People: Leidos empowers people from every background to be themselves and gives you the tools to learn new skills by enabling growth whilst developing. We believe that extraordinary people need opportunities to grow, to be inspired and to inspire others. At Leidos, we invest in technical academies, career rotations and a career development plans that enhance your future.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Original Posting:

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range:

£58,400.00-£74,900.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

title: Data Solutions Engineer
description:
Als Data Solutions Engineer binnen het kanaal Store Sales & Finance help je Jumbo bij het bouwen van een toekomstbestendig en robuust datalandschap. Met behulp van Azure, Databricks, Unity Catalog, PySpark, Python en Power BI ontwikkel je data-oplossingen waarmee business teams beter en sneller beslissingen kunnen nemen.



De volgende informatie is bedoeld om potentiële kandidaten een beter inzicht te geven in de vereisten voor deze functie.
Jouw baan in een notendop

Als Data Solution Engineer binnen het kanaal Store Sales & Finance ontwerp en realiseer je end-to-end data-oplossingen. Je verwerkt en transformeert data uit verschillende bronnen naar betrouwbare dataproducten die gebruikt worden voor analytics, reporting en advanced analytics use cases. Je werkt nauw samen met de business om data-behoeften te vertalen naar schaalbare technische oplossingen en zorgt ervoor dat datapijplijnen en dataproducten geautomatiseerd, goed gemonitord en toekomstbestendig zijn volgens moderne DevOps- en CI/CD-principes.


Waar doen we het voor?

Je wordt onderdeel van een multidisciplinair scrumteam binnen de Analytics-afdeling van de Jumbo Tech Campus. Samen met data engineers, analisten, product owners en scrum masters werk je aan het centrale cloud-dataplatform van Jumbo.


Jouw nieuwe team

Betrouwbare data speelt een cruciale rol. Met jouw oplossingen zorg je ervoor dat business teams beschikken over de juiste inzichten om betere beslissingen te nemen. Door hoogwaardige datapijplijnen en dataproducten te ontwikkelen, draag je direct bij aan de prestaties van onze winkels, financiële processen en de verdere ontwikkeling van een data-gedreven Jumbo. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het Azure-dataplatform van Jumbo en help je mee aan de verdere professionalisering van het data landschap.


Met wie werk je samen?

Je werkt nauw samen met data engineers, data analisten, consultants, product owners, scrum masters en business stakeholders binnen Store Sales & Finance. Daarnaast werk je samen met andere data teams om gezamenlijke standaarden, oplossingen en best practices verder te ontwikkelen, deel je kennis binnen de Data Guild en werk je in een agile omgeving.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Een bachelor- of masterdiploma in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische richting.
  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol.
  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van robuuste datapijplijnen, data-oplossingen en dataproducten binnen Azure.
  • Bekendheid met Databricks, Unity Catalog en het Azure Data Platform.
  • Ervaring met Python en/of PySpark.
  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van business en techniek.
  • Bekendheid met DevOps-werkwijzen en CI/CD-tools zoals GitHub Actions en Terraform.
  • Een teamgerichte instelling en de drive om continu processen, data en technologie te verbeteren.

Nice to have

  • Azure-certificeringen op het gebied van Data Engineering.
  • Ervaring met Power BI en self-service analytics.
  • Kennis van data science- of machine learning-omgevingen.
  • Ervaring binnen retail, e-commerce of een grote enterpriseomgeving. xgiwjmb
  • Ervaring met moderne data platformarchitecturen en cloud-native oplossingen.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data engineer – Van veldmeting tot dashboard

De volgende informatie geeft een overzicht van de vaardigheden, kwaliteiten en kwalificaties die nodig zijn voor deze functie.

Ben jij gek op data en krijg je energie van het omzetten van grote hoeveelheden meetgegevens naar bruikbare inzichten? Als data engineer bij Iv analyseer je monitoringdata van uiteenlopende infraprojecten en vertaal je deze naar heldere rapportages, analyses en dashboards.


Je werkt dagelijks met data afkomstig uit trillings-, geluid- en deformatiemetingen rondom spoorprojecten, bouwactiviteiten en civiele constructies. Denk aan trillingen door treinverkeer, het aanbrengen van damwanden, monitoring van spoortunnels en kunstwerken, of geluidsmetingen in de omgeving van infraprojecten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze data betrouwbaar wordt verwerkt, geanalyseerd en gepresenteerd.


Met behulp van onder andere Python, Power BI en diverse databronnen ontwikkel je analyses, automatiseringen en dashboards die opdrachtgevers en collega’s helpen om de juiste beslissingen te nemen. Je signaleert afwijkingen, onderzoekt trends en vertaalt complexe meetresultaten naar begrijpelijke conclusies en adviezen. Daarnaast stel je rapportages op waarin je de resultaten helder en overzichtelijk presenteert.


Je komt terecht op de afdeling Monitoring met ruim tien directe collega’s in Sliedrecht. De werksfeer is open, no-nonsense en collegiaal. We schakelen snel, helpen elkaar en houden van heldere communicatie. Samen werken we aan innovatieve infraprojecten: groot, klein en altijd maatschappelijk relevant. Als starter krijg je veel ruimte om te leren ‘on the job’ en jezelf te ontwikkelen.


Wat verwachten we van jou?

0 tot 3 jaar werkervaring binnen het vakgebied


Affiniteit met dataverzameling, data-analyse en visualisatietools (zoals Power BI)


Interesse in monitoring en veldwerk


Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands


Dit is werken bij Iv
Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Een uitdagende en gevarieerde baan bij het meest diverse ingenieursbureau van Nederland! Zo kun je rekenen op:


De gaafste projecten in alle sectoren: je werkt aan hoogwaardige oplossingen waar de maatschappij écht iets aan heeft. Iv werkt aan ’s werelds grootste offshore windplatformen, bruggen en sluizen tot fabrieken, waterzuiveringsinstallaties en onderzeeboten.


Een professionele én gezellige werkomgeving: bij Iv vind je een laagdrempelige werksfeer waarin hard werken hand in hand gaat met plezier. Zo bezoeken we tweejaarlijks het EK- of WK-voetbal, vieren we nieuwjaar groots in de Efteling, organiseren we gezellige zomerbarbecues en nog veel meer!


Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden: kies voor meer salaris, extra vakantiedagen of beide!


Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: 31 vakantiedagen, jaarlijkse gratificatie (7%), winstuitkering, flexibele pensioenregeling en reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding.


Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden: we bieden talloze mogelijkheden tot het volgen van opleidingen, cursussen en trainingen om nóg beter te worden in je vak.


Kortom: bij Iv werk je samen met 1400 andere specialisten aan de grootste uitdagingen van deze tijd én beleef je veel plezier. xgiwjmb Dat noemen wij: engineering that excites.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Binnen Enexis bouw en beheer je MetricCAT, hét KPI-dashboard voor onze Agile teams.



Solliciteer snel, bekijk de volledige omschrijving door naar beneden te scrollen om de volledige vereisten voor deze functie te ontdekken.
Wat ga je doen?

Met jouw energie kan het



  • Jij maakt met MetricCAT (Core Adaptation Tool) de prestaties van onze Agile teams en ketens inzichtelijk én stuurbaar.
  • Je werkt in een hecht DevOps-team aan moderne tools als Streamlit, ServiceNow, Jira en Confluence en verbindt data, mensen en processen.

Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan


Je richt je volledig op de doorontwikkeling én het structureel beheer van MetricCAT, een in Streamlit gebouwd product dat cruciale KPI’s uit onze Agile omgeving ontsluit. Je integreert data uit onder andere Jira, ServiceNow en Confluence, zorgt voor betrouwbare datamodellen en bouwt dashboards die management en teams direct gebruiken om beter te sturen. Je werkt nauw samen met product owners, scrum masters, release train engineers en teamleads om de juiste metriek te bepalen, verbetert continu op basis van feedback en borgt de performance en stabiliteit van de oplossing. Zo til je onze Agile performance- en portfoliosturing naar een volgend niveau.


Dit zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden:



  • Het doorontwikkelen én beheren van MetricCAT, inclusief het verzamelen, analyseren en visualiseren van data.
  • Samenwerken met stakeholders om relevante metrieken te identificeren en om te zetten in inzichtelijke rapportages en dashboards.
  • Integreren van data uit diverse bronnen (o.a. Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence) en vertalen naar begrijpelijke, gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards.
  • Doorvoeren van optimalisaties en verbeteringen op basis van gebruikersfeedback en monitoring.
  • Borgen van betrouwbaarheid, performance en datakwaliteit binnen MetricCAT.
  • Faciliteren van de rapportagebehoeften van management en stakeholders met heldere datavisualisaties.
  • Actief deelnemen aan Agile ceremonies en afstemmen van voortgang met het team.
  • Kennisoverdracht via documentatie en coaching van collega’s.

Functie-eisen

Zo pak jij het aan


Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en krijgt energie van het vertalen van complexe data naar heldere inzichten. Je neemt ownership: je voelt je productverantwoordelijk voor MetricCAT, schakelt proactief met stakeholders en bewaakt de balans tussen doorontwikkeling en stabiel beheer. Communicatief ben je stevig genoeg om data-gedreven keuzes uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische collega’s. Verder heb je:



  • Aantoonbare ervaring als Data Engineer, bij voorkeur in een complexe (IT/Agile) omgeving.
  • Ervaring met Agile-methodieken en het meten van Agile performance met behulp van data.
  • Ervaring met Python en Streamlit, of met een ander code-based dashboarding framework (zoals Dash, Plotly of vergelijkbaar).
  • Ervaring met data-integratie, -transformatie en -opslag; sterke SQL-vaardigheden. Ervaring met Matillion en Snowflake is een pré.
  • Ervaring met API’s en het ontsluiten van gegevens uit systemen zoals Jira, Confluence en ServiceNow.
  • Zeer goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om zelfstandig én in teamverband binnen een Agile omgeving te werken.

Team & cultuur

Je zet je schouders eronder met


Jouw collega’s van de Agile Release Train IT Solutions & Support. Binnen deze ART maak je deel uit van een multidisciplinair DevOps-team met een Product Owner, Scrum Master en 6 DevOps Engineers. Samen beheren en ontwikkelen jullie onder meer ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence en Columinity én zijn jullie eigenaar van MetricCAT. De samenwerking is informeel, gericht op continu verbeteren en je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over architectuur, performance en gebruiksvriendelijkheid. Je werkt intensief samen met teams in de business, andere IT-teams en stakeholders in de Agile organisatie.


Wat krijg je van ons?

En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou



  • Mogelijkheden om hybride te werken, inclusief een door Enexis ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 netto per dag.
  • Ruimte om te groeien met een intern ontwikkelplatform en/of externe opleidingen en trainingen. xgiwjmb
  • Laptop of tablet en telefoon die je ook buiten werktijd mag gebruiken.

title: Data Engineer
description:
• Een ruime keuze uit moderne leaseauto’s.


Solliciteer na het lezen van de volgende vaardigheids- en kwalificatievereisten voor deze functie.

Ben jij gepassioneerd over data en technologie? Wil je organisaties helpen om het maximale uit hun data te halen met behulp van Microsoft Power BI, Azure Data Platform en Fabric? Dan is deze uitdaging iets voor jou!


Jouw uitdaging als Data Platform Engineer

Als Data Platform Engineer speel je een essentiële rol in het ontwerpen, bouwen en implementeren van moderne data-oplossingen. Je adviseert klanten over hoe zij hun data kunnen transformeren in waardevolle inzichten, gebruikmakend van de nieuwste technologieën binnen het Microsoft‑ecosysteem. Of het nu gaat om geavanceerde rapportages, datamodellen of complete data‑architecturen, jouw expertise maakt het verschil!


Wat ga je doen?

  • Adviseren van klanten over data-architectuur en datavisualisatiestrategieën.
  • Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van rapportages en dashboards in Power BI die aansluiten op de businessdoelen van de klant.
  • Realiseren van schaalbare dataplatforms met behulp van Azure Data Platform, Data Factory, Synapse en Microsoft Fabric.
  • Optimaliseren van datamodellen en het opzetten van ETL‑processen voor efficiënte data‑integratie.
  • Samenwerken met stakeholders om complexe datavraagstukken op te lossen en inzichten te vertalen naar actiegerichte aanbevelingen.
  • Op de hoogte blijven van de laatste ontwikkelingen binnen het Microsoft‑ecosysteem en deze toepassen in projecten.

Wat biedt Unica jou?

Werken aan uitdagende en innovatieve projecten bij diverse klanten. Een inspirerende werkomgeving met ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Toegang tot trainingen en certificeringen binnen het Microsoft‑ecosysteem.



  • Een marktconform salaris met uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.
  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden, inclusief de optie voor hybride werken.
  • Een ruime keuze uit moderne leaseauto’s.
  • Maar liefst 25 vakantiedagen en de ruimte om thuis te werken.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling.
  • Korting bij zorgverzekeraars Zilveren Kruis en CZ via onze collectieve ziektekostenverzekering.
  • Deelname aan onze winstdelingsregeling.
  • Een warm welkom met een uitgebreid onboardingstraject en verschillende introductieactiviteiten om je snel thuis te laten voelen.
  • Ruime doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen Unica om jouw persoonlijke ambities waar te maken.
  • Korting op allerlei diensten en producten van onze leveranciers zoals Boels, Grohe, Fietsvoordeelshop en nog veel meer.

Natuurlijk vragen we ook wat van jou

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Azure Data Platform en/of Microsoft Fabric en Power BI.
  • Je bent bekend met datamodellering, DAX, en datavisualisatie‑best practices.
  • Je hebt ervaring met ETL‑processen en tools zoals Azure Data Factory of Synapse Analytics.
  • Kennis van programmeertalen zoals SQL, Python of R is een pré.
  • Je bent analytisch sterk, resultaatgericht en hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • Certificeringen zoals PL‑300, DP‑500 of vergelijkbaar zijn een pré.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlande en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Jouw team

Als Power BI / Data Platform / Fabric Consultant word je onderdeel van de organisatie Unica Business Applications. Het team bestaat uit een kleine 25 professionals, van consultants tot solution architects. Samen zorgen we voor het continue verbeteren van het applicatielandschap van onze klanten. Er is ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ontwikkeling; de sfeer is informeel en gericht op resultaat.


Wie zijn wij?

Met ruim 90 jaar ervaring in de technische dienstverlening is Unica de robuuste werkgever. Vakmanschap staat bij ons centraal. We geloven in onze mensen, in onze teams en in onze klanten. We blijven doen waar we goed in zijn en denken tegelijkertijd vooruit. Zo voegen we innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen toe aan ons dienstenportfolio, zoals op het gebied van energietransitie, IoT en smart buildings. title: Senior Estimator, Life Science
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Preconstruction Estimator - Life Science

Who You’ll Work With

You will join one of our 45 offices in the US, be part of a committed team of over 1500 professionals, and work in teams and directly with our clients doing work that is shaping the world around us. You will be welcomed into a rapidly growing business and team and empowered to make an impact. You will be valued, cared for, and challenged on your path to becoming a world-class professional consultant and surrounded by leaders who are committed to creating an environment that enables you to realize your own success and fulfillment.

When you join Design Group as an MEP Estimator, Construction, you are joining a team that will challenge you and position you for growth. In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world’s leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Construction Practice and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy.

What You’ll Do

You'll work individually and in teams to support capital projects and implement solutions for our clients. Together, you will help our clients make critical changes to improve their performance and realize their most important goals.

  • Create and submit well organized, high quality written estimates that account for project risks

  • Prepare construction and installation estimates from feasibility studies, conceptual designs, preliminary designs, or detailed designs

  • Review all project plans, specifications, take-offs, I&C, and documents to gain a full understanding of intended use of the estimate

  • Collaborate with the design team and offer cost effective alternates

  • Prepare cost estimates for small- and large-scale jobs

  • Manage project from estimating/bidding, detailing, product purchasing, delivery, scheduling, installation, and construction administration

  • Calculate the estimated cost, supplemented by adjustments for overhead and profit, and presenting a final price

  • Develop accurate labor and material costs with accurate quantity take-offs

  • Maintain strong working relationships with the design team, sub-contractors, sub-consultants, OEMs, and suppliers

  • Develop and maintain relationships with trade contractors and end-users in targeted regions

  • Coordinate with Design Group construction teams as required to maintain current cost data

  • Make an impact day-to-day with your skills and expertise, strengthening that relationship with our clients and team

  • This role will require occasional travel for project visits or meetings.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years construction cost estimating experience focused on Life Science/Pharmaceutical estimating from conceptual stage through buyout

  • Demonstrated knowledge of estimating practices and procedures utilizing estimating software

  • Prior experience utilizing on-screen takeoff or bluebeam and estimating databases

  • Strong understanding of CSI Estimating Format

  • Prior experience in gathering and utilizing historical cost information as well as a network of trusted subcontractors

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively and meet tight deadlines.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand project schedules

  • Demonstrated ability to plan, organize and manage multiple projects

  • Demonstrated ability to work in teams and gather subcontractor input for optimizing project performance

  • A willingness to travel for project requirements including installation and start-up activities, client and company sponsored meetings, trainings, industry related seminars, forums, and conventions

  • Experience working on large commercial/industrial projects (both greenfield and brownfield/renovations)

  • Read and understand construction, installation, and I&C documents: details and drawings

  • Self-motivated individual with good written and verbal communication skills

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Procore & Project)

  • BS degree in Construction Management or Engineering preferred

Our culture and commitment to our people is what sets us apart. We foster an environment of mutual respect, integrity, and unconditional interest in the individual and collective success of our professionals. Our model and entrepreneurial mindset offer a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible path. As an MEP Estimator, Construction, you will build a meaningful and fulfilling career with the support of professional development resources and mentorships including our First Year Experience program, Individual Development Plans, and Career Path resources and tools. You will be surrounded by exceptional talent who will support your development as both a world-class professional and a highly effective leader.

Feel like you're on the path to becoming an Life Science Estimator but you're not quite there yet? We'd love to connect with you to see if we can take you from where you are today and grow you into a Design Group Professional.

#LI-BL1


At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process. ​

title: Devops engineer (zzp - freelance)
description:
Deze aanvraag is niet bedoeld voor zzp-ers.


Als u meer wilt weten over de vereisten voor deze functie, lees dan verder voor alle relevante informatie.

Max tarief: 100 euro

Opdrachtomschrijving

Je beheert ons serverpark nu deze gemigreerd zijn naar RedHat 9, Je rolt de nieuwe versies van de verschillende voorzieningen van Stelseldiensten uit naar de OTAP-omgevingen Je onderneemt actie op basis van signalen uit onze Alerting- en Monitoringsystemen Je beheert het containerplatform op basis van Linux en Docker Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de Continuïteit en Veiligheid van onze dienstverlening richting afnemers, gebruikers en HLV's Je neemt deel aan de Scrum events, de inhoudelijke backlog refinement van het team en de Program Increment planning en System Demo's van de Agile Release Train Samen met jouw collega DevOps Engineers zit je in een pool om middels het draaien van stand-by diensten van telkens één week de 24/7 dienstverlening te garanderen

Achtergrond opdracht

Het uiteindelijk doel van deze opdracht is het borgen van de continuïteit van de dienstverlening van de voorzieningen van Stelseldiensten, door ad hoc operationele problemen op te lossen en structureel te werken aan Applicatie Lifecycle Management. Je bent in een dynamische omgeving verantwoordelijk voor het beschikbaar houden van zwaar belaste platformen met hoge eisen omtrent security. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om je eigen ideeën uit te werken binnen je DevOps team en de Community of Practice. Onze organisatie, onze werkwijze en daarbij gebruikte technologieën zijn continu in ontwikkeling. Beheer en doorontwikkeling van de voorzieningen (inclusief infrastructuur) vindt plaats in het Productiehuis, waarbij gewerkt wordt volgens de principes van de SAFe-methodiek. Het doel van de directie Productiehuis is om de Logius oplossingen (inclusief infrastructuur) te beheren en door te ontwikkelen. De directie Productiehuis is verantwoordelijk dat dit binnen de afgesproken service-niveaus, budgetten en regelgeving gebeurt. Ook levert de directie Productiehuis de capaciteit en structuur om bestaande en nieuwe diensten en producten zodanig te ontwikkelen dat het afgestemde portfolio kan worden waargemaakt. De medewerkers worden geplaatst in een HR-team en verrichten werkzaamheden in een Agile Release Train (ART). In een ART zijn componentteams en featureteams. Componentteams creëren toegevoegde waarde voor de featureteams, zoals platformcapaciteit. De featureteams creëren op basis daarvan toegevoegde waarde voor de klanten, zoals een nieuwe functionaliteit. Teams zijn multidisciplinair samengesteld en bestaan uit circa tien personen. Elk team heeft een Scrum Master en een Product Owner. xgiwjmb

  • Je hebt kennis van, en hands-on ervaring met, het beheren van container ecosystemen zoals Docker, rancher Kubernetes platform hebt ervaring

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met deployment en provisioning eco-systemen zoals maar niet uitsluitend Ansible Playbook (5 jaar)
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring/kennis van/met Gitlab CICD Kubernetes Harbor Minio Postgres Operators (5 jaar)
