title: AV- och Workplace Specialist
description:
Boliden är ett högteknologiskt metallföretag med egna gruvor och smältverk som arbetar långsiktigt för att säkerställa samhällets tillgång till bas- och ädelmetaller. I hundra år har vårt arbete varit en del av de värdekedjor som format det moderna samhället. På Boliden vet vi att metallerna vi bryter och tillgängliggör kommer att fortsätta spela en avgörande roll i framtiden. Det viktiga är hur vi producerar dem. Bli en del av oss och driv förändring för kommande generationer.

Vill du arbeta nära både människor och teknik i en roll där du gör vardagen enklare för många? Hos Boliden får du bidra till stabila, smidiga och användarvänliga workplace-lösningar i en verksamhet där tekniken spelar en viktig roll varje dag.

Din roll

Som AV- och Workplace Specialist blir du en viktig del av vårt lokala IT-stöd i Aitik. Du arbetar nära verksamheten och bidrar till att våra kollegor får en stabil, smidig och användarvänlig upplevelse av våra workplace-tjänster.

I rollen ansvarar du för bland annat konferensrum, AV-utrustning, skrivarlösningar, infoskärmar och KVM-lösningar. Du får kombinera teknik, service och problemlösning i en vardag där ditt arbete gör konkret skillnad för våra användare.

Ditt team

Du blir en del av ett lokalt IT-team i Aitik och samarbetar nära både kollegor inom IT, verksamheten och externa leverantörer. Tillsammans arbetar ni för att skapa fungerande, hållbara och lättanvända tekniska lösningar som stödjer verksamhetens behov varje dag.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Installera, underhålla och felsöka konferensrum och AV-utrustning.
  • Ge användarstöd och support kopplat till bland annat AV, konferensrum, skrivare och Office-relaterade tjänster.
  • Arbeta med drift och utveckling av infoskärmar, skrivarlösningar och KVM-lösningar.
  • Samordna service, inköp och leverantörskontakter inom ditt område.
  • Dokumentera rutiner och arbetssätt så att lösningarna blir enkla att använda och förvalta.
  • Bidra till förbättringar som minskar driftstörningar och skapar en bättre användarupplevelse.

Ditt bidrag

Vi söker dig som är nyfiken på teknik och tycker om att hjälpa andra. Du behöver inte kunna allt från start – det viktigaste är att du har ett serviceinriktat arbetssätt, tar ansvar och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är lösningsorienterad, strukturerad och trygg i mötet med olika människor. Du tycker om att skapa ordning, följa upp ärenden och hitta praktiska vägar framåt när något inte fungerar som det ska.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Slutförd gymnasieutbildning.
  • Erfarenhet av användarnära IT-support, AV-teknik, teknisk service eller liknande arbetsuppgifter.
  • Intresse för teknik, felsökning och problemlösning.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.
  • B-körkort.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

  • Microsoft Teams Rooms eller annan konferensrumsteknik.
  • Skrivare och printlösningar.
  • Digital signage eller infoskärmar.
  • Enklare nätverks- och installationsteknik.
  • Leverantörskontakter eller samordning av externa parter.

Varför arbeta tillsammans med oss

På Boliden vill vi skapa en arbetsplats där omsorg, mod och ansvar är en självklar del av allt vi gör. Vi tror på samarbete och på att varje medarbetares bidrag har betydelse för kommande generationer. Hos oss arbetar ansvarstagande och kreativa människor tillsammans mot vår vision att vara världens mest hållbara och respekterade metalleverantör.

Ansök idag för att bli en del av något verkligt meningsfullt!

Hos oss på Boliden är mångfald och inkludering en drivkraft för innovation. Vi vet att olika perspektiv och erfarenheter stärker oss och hjälper oss att ligga i framkant i en viktig och spännande bransch. Därför uppmuntrar vi ansökningar från människor med olika bakgrunder och synsätt. Tillsammans bygger vi en arbetsplats där alla kan känna sig trygga och inspirerade att nå sin fulla potential.

Sista ansökningsdag: Söndag 4e oktober 2026.

Vill du veta mer om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Service Specialist Workplace, Lina Wiklund, lina.wiklund@boliden.com.

Frågor om din ansökan besvaras av Talent Acquisition Coordinator Emma Bystedt, emma.bystedt@boliden.com.

Facklig information får du via Unionen.aitik@boliden.com

Urval och intervjuer kommer att genomföras löpande. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Project Title
AI-Enabled Germhold Reduction for Dry Strip Workstation

Project Description
This internship project focuses on leveraging data analytics and AI-Enabled methodologies to understand and reduce equipment Germholds within the Dry Strip workstation in a semiconductor manufacturing environment. The project aims to identify key factors contributing to Germhold occurrences, develop data-driven insights, and evaluate opportunities to improve workstation efficiency and manufacturing capacity.

The intern will gain hands-on experience working with operational datasets, engineering teams, and manufacturing equipment while exploring the application of Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, and predictive analytics within semiconductor manufacturing processes.

Objective of the Project

  • Identify key drivers and trends associated with equipment Germholds in the Dry Strip workstation.

  • Apply data analytics and machine learning techniques to uncover opportunities for Germhold reduction.

  • Develop a structured methodology to improve understanding of equipment performance and operational efficiency.

  • Explore AI-Enabled approaches for predictive identification of Germhold risks and improvement opportunities.

Opportunities for Full Time Employment
Interns demonstrating strong technical aptitude, learning agility, and successful project outcomes may be considered for future internship or full-time opportunities, subject to business needs and evaluation outcomes.

Project Scope

  • Analyze manufacturing and equipment datasets to identify Germhold patterns, trends, and potential root causes.

  • Apply statistical analysis, machine learning models, and data visualization techniques to evaluate Germhold occurrences and impacts.

  • Collaborate with Process Engineers and Equipment Engineers to validate analytical findings and assess improvement opportunities.

  • Develop dashboards or reporting tools to monitor Germhold trends and track improvement initiatives.

  • Evaluate the use of Generative AI, AI Assistants, or Agentic AI solutions for automated insight generation and engineering reporting.

Learning Opportunities

  • Gain hands-on experience with semiconductor manufacturing equipment and Wet Process operations.

  • Learn how industrial datasets are analyzed to improve equipment and manufacturing performance.

  • Develop practical skills in data analytics, machine learning, data visualization, and AI-Enabled engineering workflows.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and subject matter experts to understand manufacturing challenges and improvement methodologies.

  • Explore the application of Artificial Intelligence technologies within advanced manufacturing environments.

Deliverables

  • Comprehensive analysis identifying major contributors to Germholds within the Dry Strip workstation.

  • AI-Enabled or machine learning-based assessment highlighting opportunities for Germhold reduction.

  • Dashboard or analytical reporting solution to monitor Germhold performance and improvement progress.

  • Final presentation summarizing methodology, findings, recommendations, and potential future opportunities.

Impact of the Project

  • Improve understanding of equipment Germhold behavior and contributing factors.

  • Enable data-driven decision-making for workstation efficiency improvement.

  • Support capacity enhancement through reduction of Germhold occurrences.

  • Demonstrate the value of AI-Enabled analytics and predictive methodologies in manufacturing operations.

Skillsets Required

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience with Python, R, SQL, Power BI, or other data analytics and visualization tools.

  • Familiarity with statistical analysis, data modeling, and machine learning concepts.

  • Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, AI Assistants, or AI-Enabled workflows is advantageous.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to present insights effectively.

Course of Interest
The ideal candidate should be pursuing a Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

Duration of Period
The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full time internship period of at least 5 months from Jan to May 2027.

You’ll drive daily permit meetings, validate risk assessments, monitor compliance, and lead on-site safety initiatives. Your proactive approach will help us minimise operational risks, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and enable our teams to exceed performance and environmental targets.

  • Oversee mechanical and electrical isolations (LOTO) and site access controls.
  • Support incident management and communicate lessons learned.
  • Collaborate with operational teams and stakeholders to drive efficiency and continuous improvement. Support with Industrial Emissions Directive, Water Recycling Centre and Sludge Treatment Centre permit compliance.

About You

  • Demonstrable experience working within a Permit To Work system and on operational or high-hazard sites.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge and drive improvement.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a diverse, highly skilled team, empowered to make a difference every day. We offer a collaborative environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to help shape the future of water recycling in our region.

As a valued employee, you’ll be entitled to:

  • 26 days annual leave – rising with length of service and the ability to buy more
  • Excellent family friendly policies, such as 26 weeks full pay for maternity / adoption leave, as well as 4 weeks paid paternity / partner leave. Opportunity for shared parental pay

title: Production Scheduler - Contract Manufacturing
description:
The Production Scheduler – Contract Manufacturing is responsible for developing, coordinating, and maintaining a detailed, time phased production schedule for our partner Yongtuo. The role ensures external production plans are aligned with Watts’ demand, service, inventory, and working capital objectives, while respecting supplier capacity, constraints, labor availability, and site specific operating rules.
This role acts as the primary scheduling interface between Watts and Yongtuo, driving predictable execution, schedule adherence, and on time, in full delivery performance despite indirect control of assets. Success in this role directly impacts customer service, supply continuity, and trust with both customers and manufacturing partners.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

Production Planning & Scheduling

  • Translate Watts supply plans and customer demand signals into feasible finite production schedules at Yongtuo
  • Build and maintain detailed schedules by SKU, line, and time bucket (shift/day/week as appropriate to site capability)
  • Partner with S&OP functions to discuss demand requirements against supplier‑provided capacity, labor models, yields, run rates, and changeover logic
  • Sequence production to optimize service levels, and supplier efficiency while minimizing expediting and volatility

Execution & Supplier Coordination

  • Serve as the primary scheduling point of contact for external factories
  • Collaborate closely with supplier production, maintenance, and quality teams to:
    • Address execution gaps, delays, and constraints
    • Incorporate planned downtime, line restrictions, or quality holds
    • Resolve short‑term disruptions with minimal impact to customer service
  • Monitor daily/weekly execution vs. plan and escalate risks proactively when output deviates from commitments

Customer & Service Protection

  • Proactively identify and communicate service risks, delivery impacts, and recovery actions
  • Ensure schedule changes are aligned with S&OP and S&OE decisions and clearly communicated to internal stakeholders
  • Support root cause analysis when KPIs such as line fill rate, OTIF, or production attainment fall below target

Scenario Modeling & Decision Support

  • Conduct “what‑if” analysis to assess impacts of:
    • Supplier disruptions or capacity changes
    • Demand volatility or priority order changes
    • Material constraints or quality events
  • Recommend trade‑offs and mitigation plans that balance customer service, cost, and supplier capability

Systems & Data Governance

  • Maintain and validate supplier scheduling master data, including:
    • Run rates, yields, minimum batch sizes
    • Capacity limits and constraint logic
    • Changeover matrices and sequencing rules
  • Track actual performance vs. plan and drive data corrections with suppliers and internal teams
  • Ensure schedules reflect contractual agreements and operational realities

EMPLOYEE CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Collaborate Across Workgroups
  • Initiate Positive Change
  • Deliver High Quality Results
  • Focus on the Customer
  • Develop Self and Others
  • Accountability

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, or related field
  • APICS certification (CPIM/CSCP) preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in production scheduling, supply planning, or manufacturing planning (experience with contract or outsourced manufacturing strongly preferred)
  • Strong understanding of MRP, finite scheduling, and capacity planning
  • Ability to influence external partners and internal stakeholders without direct reporting authority
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Fluent English and Chinese is a must

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Bouw niet alleen software. Ontwerp de ruggengraat van een bedrijf.



Scroll naar beneden voor de volledige details van de vacature, inclusief de vereiste ervaring en de bijbehorende taken.

De meeste vacatures zoeken een developer. Wij zoeken iemand die systemen doorgrondt en het team dat ze bouwt sterker maakt. Een engineer die elke sprint meelevert én tegelijk de grote lijn bewaakt. Iemand die complexe bedrijfsprocessen vertaalt naar elegante domeinmodellen, schaalbare architectuur en technische keuzes die jaren meegaan. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar met de handen in de code. Iemand die het voortouw neemt zodra vraagstukken ingewikkeld worden en de rest meeneemt in plaats van vooruit rent. Die het niveau van het team omhoog tilt en het overzicht behoudt. Kortom, iemand waar je écht van kan leren en op kan bouwen.


Bij krijg je de kans om een bepalende rol te spelen in de technische ontwikkeling van een platform dat dagelijks door duizenden consumenten wordt gebruikt en waarop meer dan 120 collega's vertrouwen om hun werk te kunnen doen. Niet als manager. Wel als technische autoriteit, sparringpartner en kartrekker. En bovenal een echte liefhebber.


Dit zijn wij

Miljoenen bezoekers vertrouwen op voor het vergelijken en kopen van een telefoon met of zonder abonnement. Onze kracht is om software te maken die klanten helpt om de beste keuze te maken uit oneindig veel combinaties. Het is complexe materie die we op een eenvoudige en doeltreffende manier presenteren. Ruim 120 collega’s werken met onze inhouse backend-applicaties om alle bestellingen van A tot Z af te ronden. Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren Backend Team bestaande uit medior en senior engineers. We werken volgens Scrum, in een 3-wekelijkse sprint. We geven engineers ruimte om technische keuzes te maken en verwachten tegelijkertijd dat zij initiatief tonen en eigenaarschap om tot de beste oplossingen te komen. Je krijgt veel vrijheid, maar ook veel invloed.


Waarom deze rol interessant is

Veel organisaties praten over complexiteit. Wij hebben het daadwerkelijk. Achter een relatief eenvoudige klantreis schuilt een ecosysteem van producten, abonnementen, leveranciers, logistieke processen, voorraadbeheer, pricing, fulfilment en orderstromen die continu veranderen. Die complexiteit vraagt om meer dan goede code. Ze vraagt om engineers die patronen herkennen, abstraheren, modelleren en structureren. Engineers die kunnen bepalen welke keuzes vandaag nodig zijn zonder de flexibiliteit van morgen te verliezen. Dat is precies waar jij het verschil gaat maken.


Dit ga je doen


  • Architectuur en domeinmodellering

title: RTA Lead
description:
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Real-Time Analyst (RTA) Lead to oversee real-time workforce management activities and lead a team of approximately 7 RTA professionals. The role will be responsible for ensuring optimal staffing, queue performance, schedule adherence, and service level achievement across multiple queues and geographies. The RTA Lead will partner closely with WFM and Operations teams to identify risks, manage intraday performance, and drive timely actions to meet operational targets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of approximately 7 RTAs, providing direction, coaching, performance management, and operational support.
  • Monitor real-time performance across multiple queues, programs, and geographies.
  • Ensure achievement of key WFM and operational targets, particularly SLA/Service Level and queue performance.
  • Monitor and manage schedule adherence and take appropriate real-time actions to address staffing gaps.
  • Monitor occupancy, forecast variance, and abandonment rates and identify potential risks to operational performance.
  • Manage real-time staffing adjustments, including intraday movement, skill allocation, breaks, and queue prioritization.
  • Ensure queue management accuracy and proper allocation of available resources based on business requirements.
  • Identify and escalate service-level risks, staffing issues, and operational exceptions in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate closely with Operations, WFM Planning, and other stakeholders to implement real-time recovery strategies.
  • Analyze intraday performance trends and provide recommendations to improve efficiency and service delivery.
  • Conduct regular team huddles, coaching sessions, and performance reviews for RTAs.
  • Ensure consistent execution of RTA processes, policies, and WFM guidelines across supported accounts and geographies.
  • Prepare and communicate real-time performance updates, operational alerts, and escalation reports.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on staffing optimization, queue management, and WFM effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience managing RTA/Real-Time Analyst teams.
  • Strong leadership experience within a Workforce Management (WFM) environment.
  • Proven experience managing or supporting teams of RTAs, preferably in a contact center/BPO environment.
  • Experience managing multiple queues, programs, and geographies.
  • Strong understanding of real-time workforce management principles and contact center metrics.
  • Demonstrated experience managing SLA/Service Level Achievement and intraday performance.
  • Strong knowledge of Schedule Adherence, Occupancy, Forecast Variance, Abandonment %, and Queue Management Accuracy.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and make time-sensitive operational decisions.
  • Willingness to work on shifting schedules, weekends, and holidays as required by business operations.

The Facilities Technology Transfer (FTT) Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., is responsible for providing facilities engineering planning and support for deployment of technology transfer from Micron’s Technology Development Fabs to Micron’s HVM facilities.

Engineering includes analysis of production tool utility requirements, analysis of new technology utility requirements and First of a Kind (FOAK) materials, processes and tools that may have impact on facilities, safety, and/or the environment. GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can!

What you will do

The candidate will be responsible for processing incoming borrower payments and wire activity, ensuring cash is accurately applied to the appropriate loan records and that daily work is balanced and reconciled. This role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to research unidentified or unapplied wires, and timely coordination with internal teams to resolve exceptions.

What you can expect

  • Handle cash processing functions for loans serviced by PRELS, including incoming borrower payments, wire transfers, ACH activity, and other cash receipts.

  • Research and resolve unidentified wires, unapplied receipts, payment discrepancies, receipt account items, and posting exceptions, including monitoring aging items and escalating unresolved issues as appropriate.

  • Process approved disbursements in the loan system, including suspense, expense, escrow, and reserve activity, and set up and monitor pre-authorized borrower transfers.

  • Support monthly subsidy billing, MIP transmission to HUD, month-end reporting, ad hoc reporting, and audit requests.

  • Communicate with internal teams, banking partners, Treasury, Accounting, Asset Management, Special Servicing, and other servicing contacts to obtain supporting details needed to identify, apply, and clear funds.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of research, resolution steps, clearing activity, and audit support while ensuring payment processing follows internal controls, servicing requirements, and established deadlines.

  • Identify recurring payment issues or process gaps and recommend improvements to reduce unapplied cash and enhance productivity, efficiency, and customer service.

What you will bring

  • Bachelor’s degree with treasury, banking, cash operations, or loan servicing experience.

  • Strong understanding of cash processing, bank activity, payment application, daily balancing, and reconciliation responsibilities.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including spreadsheets, formulas, calculations, and data review.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Analyst with strong experience in banking collections operations and quality assurance within a call center or shared services environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring customer interactions, evaluating compliance with quality standards and banking collections procedures, identifying performance gaps, and providing actionable feedback to improve overall customer experience and operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct regular quality audits and evaluations of customer interactions, including voice and other supported communication channels.
  • Monitor and assess collection calls to ensure adherence to established quality standards, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements.
  • Evaluate agents' performance based on call quality, collection effectiveness, customer handling, communication skills, and process adherence.
  • Identify recurring quality issues, performance trends, and process gaps that may impact customer experience or business results.
  • Provide clear, timely, and constructive feedback to agents and operations teams.
  • Participate in calibration sessions with Operations, Training, and other stakeholders to ensure consistency in quality scoring.
  • Prepare and maintain quality reports, scorecards, audit results, and performance trend analysis.
  • Recommend coaching and process improvement opportunities based on quality findings.
  • Support root-cause analysis and corrective action initiatives for recurring quality and compliance issues.
  • Ensure accurate and consistent application of quality standards across audited transactions.
  • Stay updated on process changes, client requirements, and relevant banking collections policies and procedures.
  • Perform other quality-related tasks and initiatives as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of work experience in UK, US, or AU banking collections operations and quality assurance within a call center or shared services environment.
  • 2–4 years of contact center experience in the banking industry.
  • Proven experience in quality monitoring, call auditing, and performance evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of banking collections processes and customer interaction standards.
  • Experience handling or auditing collections accounts for UK, US, or Australian markets is highly preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to identify performance trends and translate quality findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
  • Willing to work on shifting schedules, including night shifts, weekends, or holidays, depending on business requirements.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of collections compliance and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with quality management systems, QA scorecards, and call monitoring tools.
  • Experience conducting calibration sessions and providing quality-related coaching.
  • Strong reporting and data analysis skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Operations, Training, and other support functions.

title: Contract Analyst
description:
Position Title

Contract Analyst

Days - Full Time

Remote

Position Summary / Career Interest:

Operating independently, the Contract Analyst is accountable for the contracting process from start to finish, including analysis and negotiation of contract terms and conditions and for drafting contracts as needed. Position ensures that contracts include appropriate provisions in compliance with Hospital policy, accreditation standards, and federal and state healthcare program regulations. The Contracts Analyst manages all types of health care business related agreements and contract (IT, services, equipment, product purchases, etc.) This position works with all levels of leadership and requires the ability to work under tight deadlines and provide creative solutions to resolve conflict with external parties. The successful candidate will be equally effective as an individual contributor and a team player.

  • Demonstrated skill set in contract negotiations, drafting contracts and excellent team collaboration as evaluated by the department director.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
General program information and/or position overview.

Leidos is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to serve as the technical lead for day-to-day security activities supporting enterprise and isolated environments. This position will provide technical leadership and oversight for security operations, vulnerability management, RMF/ATO support and continuous monitoring activities.

The individual will lead and mentor security personnel, establish priorities and coordinate security activities across infrastructure and engineering teams. This is a hands-on technical lead position, and the individual will be expected to directly support security engineering and operational security activities as needed.

The individual will work closely with the ISSM, customer, program leadership and technical teams to translate security requirements into actionable work and maintain the overall security posture of the environment.

This is a 100% on-site position. All work must be performed at the customer site.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate day-to-day security operations, establish priorities and assign and track activities across the security team.

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to security personnel, system administrators, engineers and other technical teams.

  • Lead vulnerability management from identification through closure, including analysis, prioritization, remediation, validation and documentation.

  • Coordinate vulnerability remediation across Windows, Linux, network, desktop support and other engineering teams and provide hands-on support for complex or high-priority issues as needed.

  • Oversee and perform vulnerability scanning and analysis using ACAS, Tenable/Nessus or equivalent technologies.

  • Oversee implementation and validation of DISA STIGs and approved security configuration baselines across infrastructure systems.

  • Ensure recurring security activities are performed, including audit log and account reviews, vulnerability reviews, security control validation and continuous monitoring.

  • Support and oversee RMF/ATO activities, including security documentation, control evidence, Body of Evidence (BoE), POA&Ms and compliance with NIST SP 800-53, ICD 503 and applicable security directives.

  • Work with the ISSM to translate security and compliance requirements into technical and operational activities and evaluate system or configuration changes for potential security impact.

  • Provide security oversight and technical support for isolated or restricted environments, including vulnerability scanning, logging, patching, hardening and security monitoring.

  • Review security logs and events using Splunk or equivalent SIEM/log-management technologies and ensure identified issues are appropriately addressed.

  • Develop and maintain repeatable security processes and procedures for vulnerability management, compliance monitoring, evidence collection and security operations.

  • Track security risks, deficiencies, remediation activities and compliance status and communicate status, risks and recommendations to customer and program leadership.

  • Participate in Technical Exchange Meetings (TEMs), security reviews, engineering meetings and customer discussions related to system security and accreditation.

  • Manage, supervise and mentor security and technical staff as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Experience with application performance and latency problems related to security requirements from front, middle, and back end

  • Working experience with Windows Server 2016/2019, Active Directory, IIS, DNS, DHCP, Exchange, DFS

  • Experience implementing security controls on common network services such as file, email, and active directory across multiple geographically dispersed sites.

  • Experience with networking technologies and security assessment to include, but not limited to, STIGs.

  • Experience implementing and supporting enterprise system security and malware monitoring and prevention tools such as Splunk, McAfee HBSS, and ACAS

  • Solid network and systems troubleshooting experience with TCP/IP, Internet security, and encryption (data at rest, data in transit)

  • Ability to produce clear and concise documents and diagrams capturing networking and operational procedures and LAN/WAN topology using MS Visio, MS Project, MS Excel and MS Word.

  • Candidate must, at a minimum, meet DoD 8570.11- IAT Level II certification requirements (currently Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, GSEC, or SSCP along with an appropriate computing environment (CE) certification)

Education/Experience Requirements

  • Candidate must have a Bachelor's, with at least 8 years of relevant experience. Additional years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

Clearance

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph required OR active TS/SCI and willingness to get a Poly.

  • US Citizenship is required due to the nature of the government contracts we support.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing and/or supervising a team of technical professionals

  • CISSP or CASP Certification

title: Buyer
description:
Rolls‑Royce SMR is on a mission to deliver clean, affordable energy for all. As the UK’s leading Small Modular Reactor programme, we’re building a British solution to a global energy challenge and shaping one of the country’s most significant green export opportunities.

Our Procurement function is foundational to delivering our first SMR and enabling future fleet deployment. To support this, the role will support increasing workload with HVAC, accelerate supplier onboarding activities, and improve tracking and reporting of key procurement and supply chain metrics. The Buyer will run sourcing activity, manage purchase orders and support supplier engagement across a diverse, high‑value and operationally critical portfolio.

Reporting into the Procurement Manager, this role will support the creation of commercial strategies, deliver procurement activity and help build a scalable, efficient supply base across siteworks, civils and operational categories.


What you’ll be doing

  • Support sourcing and category activity across siteworks, civils and operations spend areas, ensuring delivery against cost, quality and schedule requirements.

  • Run end‑to‑end procurement activities including RFQs/RFPs, evaluations, negotiation preparation, contract placement and supplier onboarding.

  • Support the development of the supply base—identifying opportunities for cost efficiency, delivery improvement and supplier optimisation across construction and operational services.

  • Work closely with stakeholders across Programme Delivery, Engineering and Operations to ensure early engagement and accurate requirements capture for major projects.

  • Assist in implementing category strategies that drive standardisation, value for money and improved risk management across siteworks and logistics contracts.

  • Analyse commercial, technical and market data to support recommendations and decision‑making.

  • Maintain high standards of governance, compliance and documentation throughout the procurement lifecycle.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement across processes, reporting, supplier performance management and contract frameworks.


This is a key role supporting operational readiness and large‑scale project delivery.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in procurement within manufacturing engineering automotive, aerospace, defence.

  • Exposure to significant or complex project environments, ideally within regulated or engineering‑led sectors (e.g., energy, nuclear, infrastructure, rail, construction).

  • Experience supporting delivery and operational procurement, including logistics and project‑based requirements.

  • Understanding of collaborative working arrangements and construction contracts, with exposure to negotiation processes.

  • Strong commercial awareness with experience running competitive tenders and supporting supplier negotiations.

  • Confidence working with technical specifications, cost breakdowns and supplier performance data.

  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, able to work effectively with operational, technical and commercial teams.

  • MCIPS (or working towards) is desirable but not essential.


Location & Ways of Working

This role can be based from our Manchester (or Warrington) office. Hybrid working is standard, with regular weekly office attendance expected. Some travel may be required depending on supplier and business activity.

Salary: £31,875 – £39,375 depending on experience and benefits include:

title: Principal Information Systems Engineer
description:
Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account


Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more.


About the Role

Happen Bank is looking for a Principal Information Systems Engineer to own the strategy, architecture, and technical direction for our Windows and Mac end user computing environment. You’ll serve as the senior technical authority for device management, security, automation, and endpoint modernization, while acting as the escalation point for the most complex and high-impact issues.

In this role, you’ll shape how Happen manages and secures devices at scale, modernize tooling and processes, and design automation that improves reliability and reduces repetitive work. You’ll also mentor teammates and partner with vendors and onshore/offshore resources to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business needs.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the top escalation point for Windows and Mac issues Helpdesk can’t resolve, diagnosing and closing out the most complex, high-visibility problems, while simultaneously solving the “why does this keep happening and how do I engineer this to not happen again”
  • Administer SCCM, Intune and JAMF, building and deploying application packages and OS images to laptops and desktops across the globe
  • Shape the systems and strategy behind secure, efficient, cost-effective client management, including how we evaluate, test, and roll out new Windows and Mac OS versions
  • Build automation — scripting in Bash, Python, and PowerShell — to eliminate repetitive work, using AI tools to speed up scripting, testing, and troubleshooting where it genuinely helps
  • Lead technical resources across projects, coordinating with teammates in the US and with vendors and onshore/offshore partners to keep delivery on track
  • Review designs and solutions from junior team members for technical accuracy, and coach and mentor them as they grow
  • Evaluate and certify security updates, patches, and service packs before they roll out to Mac and PC clients, balancing speed with risk
  • Develop integrations with new technologies, including systems that carry real risk and visibility, and architect how new endpoints get configured and deployed

About You

  • 10+ years of experience in end user computing, endpoint engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field
  • Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Deep hands-on expertise with endpoint management platforms such as JAMF, Active Directory, SCCM, and Intune
  • You take ownership of problems through to resolution, exercising sound technical judgment, and consistently look for ways to improve reliability, efficiency, and user experience
  • Works independently with minimal oversight, prioritizing and multitasking across competing priorities without losing quality
  • Brings deep, hands-on expertise with CIS/NIST standards and applies them confidently in complex, highly sensitive environments
  • Spots new or unprecedented problems quickly and works through them methodically, asking the right questions before acting
  • Proven ability to establish technical direction and align engineering decisions align with company objectives
  • Applies sound judgment when using AI and other new tools to move faster on scripting, troubleshooting, and automation — staying alert to accuracy, data sensitivity, and compliance in a regulated environment
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical solutions for teammates, vendors, and end users and cross-trains others effectively
  • Experience with Intune for client software deployment, inventory, antivirus, and endpoint security
  • JAMF, SCCM, or Intune certification
  • Experience with Okta, Entra ID, and identity access management
  • Experience with Terraform, AWS EC2, or Kubernetes/EKS

Nice to Have

  • Network engineering experience, including 802.1x configuration for wired and wireless connections
  • Familiarity with configuration profiles and preference files (.plist)
  • Experience with Citrix or Amazon Workspaces
  • Experience with Bitwarden or a similar corporate credential manager

Work Location

title: Protection Technical Expert (WPE)
description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Protection Technical Expert (WPE) provides regional technical expertise and coordination support to strengthen gender-based violence (GBV) risk mitigation, protection analysis, and localization efforts across designated areas of operation. The position leads and supports GBV risk analyses, safety audits, service mapping, stakeholder engagement, and contextual monitoring to identify protection risks affecting women and girls and inform evidence-based programme adaptation, advocacy, and coordination efforts. The role serves as IRC’s representative in relevant GBV and Protection coordination mechanisms at regional level and works closely with local authorities, women-led organizations, service providers, and humanitarian actors to strengthen referral systems, promote safe programming, support partner capacity strengthening, and advance initiatives aimed at preventing and mitigating risks of violence against women and girls.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and support GBV risk analyses, safety audits, protection assessments, and contextual analyses across programme locations to identify risks affecting women and girls, inform programme adaptation, and support evidence-based local advocacy efforts.
  • Represent IRC in GBV, Protection, and inter-agency coordination mechanisms at regional level, including the GBV Workstream, Protection Cluster, and relevant technical working groups, serving as the primary focal point for WPE-related issues.
  • Maintain and regularly update service mapping, referral pathways, and referral directories to ensure safe, ethical, and timely referrals for GBV survivors.
  • Establish, strengthen, and maintain strategic relationships with specialized GBV service providers, local authorities, women-led organizations, civil society organizations, and community-based actors.
  • Support partnership development and localization efforts through regular engagement, technical support, and capacity strengthening of local partners and women-led organizations.
  • Conduct partner monitoring visits and support programme quality assurance processes to ensure adherence to survivor-centred principles, GBV guiding principles, donor requirements, and IRC technical standards.
  • Contribute to the design, coordination, and implementation of awareness-raising and community outreach initiatives, including key international campaigns such as 16 Days of Activism Against Gender-Based Violence and International Women's Day.
  • Support operational processes related to the recruitment, onboarding, management, and supervision of incentive workers, volunteers, and community facilitators.
  • Serve as a co-facilitator and technical resource person during trainings, workshops, learning events, and capacity-strengthening initiatives for partners, local stakeholders, and humanitarian actors.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring on GBV programming, survivor-centred approaches, psychosocial support, safe referrals, and GBV risk mitigation to IRC teams and partner organizations.
  • Monitor emerging protection trends, service gaps, and contextual developments, and provide regular analysis and recommendations to inform programme strategy and decision-making.
  • Contribute to the development and adaptation of technical tools, guidance documents, assessments, reports, and learning products related to GBV prevention, risk mitigation, and response programming.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education:

  • Master’s degree in social work, psychology, law, human rights, gender studies, social sciences.
  • Specialized training and certifications in Gender-Based Violence (GBV), Protection, Case Management, Psychosocial Support (PSS), and/or humanitarian programming are considered a strong asset.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible professional experience in GBV prevention, risk mitigation, and response programming within humanitarian and/or development settings.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting GBV risk analyses, safety audits, assessments, and contextual analyses.
  • Experience supporting partner-led implementation and providing technical oversight and capacity strengthening to local partner organizations.
  • Proven experience representing organizations in inter-agency coordination mechanisms, including GBV, Protection, and related working groups.
  • Experience developing and maintaining referral pathways, service mapping, and coordination with specialized GBV service providers.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating trainings, workshops, and capacity-strengthening initiatives for staff, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting advocacy initiatives, community engagement activities, and localization efforts is highly desirable.

Demonstrated Skills and Competencies:

  • Advanced technical expertise in GBV programming, including prevention, risk mitigation, response, and survivor-centred approaches.
  • Strong understanding of GBV Case Management principles, referral systems, and specialized service provision.
  • Advanced knowledge of psychosocial support approaches and women and girls’ empowerment programming, including structured interventions.
  • Strong understanding of protection mainstreaming and GBV risk mitigation across humanitarian sectors.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Strong facilitation, mentoring, coaching, and capacity-building skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, networking, representation, and partnership management skills.
  • Strong report-writing, presentation, and communication skills in English and Ukrainian.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and support multiple geographical locations simultaneously.
  • Strong commitment to IRC values, safeguarding principles, and survivor-centred programming.

Languages:

  • Ukrainian – Native.
  • English – Upper-Intermediate to Advanced (B2–C1).

REPORTING STRUCTURE AND TEAM COLLABORATION

Reports to the Field Coordinator and receive technical supervision from the Protection Coordinator (WPE)

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND OTHER RELEVANT INFORMATION

  • This role requires full-time work in the office or hybrid type of work is possible after probation period
  • Applicants must have a home or alternate workspace so they can effectively complete their work during regularly scheduled work hours.
  • Travel to other locations is needed up to 30% of time
  • Exempt from overtime
  • Sometimes work on weekends may be required
  • Work in the matrix organization
  • Fast pace of working, multitasking and stressful work
  • The organization cares about staff and provides flexible working options (start early-finish early, start later-finish later, remote work)
  • Staff can ask for accommodation in the workplace. Specific requests can be discussed with HR.

IRC employees are eligible to the following benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • Purposeful job and development opportunities
  • English classes and unlimited online training courses
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical insurance for staff and family members
  • Free psychological support to employees and their family members
  • 30 calendar days of annual vacation with flexibility beyond the legally set minimum requirements
  • Up to 10 days of paid medical leave

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Engineering · Amsterdam (hybrid)



Lijkt deze vacature u wat? Solliciteer dan snel, want er wordt een groot aantal sollicitaties verwacht. Scroll naar beneden om de volledige functieomschrijving te lezen.

Inner Circle is a dating app for people who are done wasting time. Every member is screened thoroughly, so the profiles you see are people worth dating.



All of that, the screening, the matches, the marketing, the subscriptions, runs on data. Every AI model and feature that we ship next is built on the data you own.


Goal of the Role

You build and run the systems that move our data; from the product database, app events, attribution and payment providers into Snowflake - the central analytical database that streams data to various destinations. Everything the company decides sits on top of what you build.



You'll be part of our engineering team, reporting to the Head of Engineering. But you set the technical direction for data: architecture, tooling, standards and roadmap come from you, backed by reasoning your manager can follow and trust.



We're building toward being an AI-native company, and data is the constraint on how far that goes. Claude Code is part of how we work day to day. Engineers build with it, and we're moving toward agentic workflows for things like error triage and bug fixing. Every AI use case we take on, whether that's smarter screening, matching, or internal tooling, ends up depending on the data being correct, timely and well-modelled. That's the platform you own.


Tech stack: Snowflake, DBT, Dagster, DataBricks, Python, AWS, BigQuery, MySQL, GitHub, ETL/ELT, Tableau, Claude Code, DataDog


Key Result Areas

1. Own the direction of the data platform


This is yours to shape. You form a view of where the platform needs to go, make the call, and bring the reasoning rather than the question. Tooling and architecture decisions come with the tradeoffs; stated cost, complexity, who maintains it, what happens when it breaks. Your roadmap separates the urgent from the structural, and the structural work actually happens.


2. Build and run reliable pipelines


You own how data moves, end to end. The best pipelines are boring ones: they run, and when they don't, you know before anyone else does. Failures are caught by monitoring, not by someone asking why a dashboard is empty. New sources and markets get integrated properly.


3. Engineer for correctness


Correctness is designed in, not checked afterwards. Tests sit at the right layers and failures are actionable instead of noise. Models are incremental and idempotent, so the same run gives the same result. The messy parts; deduplication, late-arriving data, timezones, attribution windows, are handled deliberately.


4. Set the engineering standard for the data stack


You define how data gets built here, and the standard you set outlasts you. Everything is version-controlled, reviewed and covered by CI. Nothing reaches production by hand. Code is readable enough that someone else can pick it up cold, because at some point someone will. Warehouse spend is watched, and access is managed as code.


5. Be the data counterpart the rest of the company can rely on


Data isn't a reporting function here. Screening, matching, marketing, subscriptions and increasingly our AI tooling all run on what you build, which means most of the company touches your models whether they know it or not. You're close to the business, upstream and downstream, so your work lands visibly and fast.




What Will Help You Be Successful

  • Senior experience owning a production data platform end to end


  • Deep hands-on Snowflake, dbt modelling, and confidence with Dagster or a comparable orchestrator


  • You use AI tooling seriously in your own work and have a view on where it helps and where it doesn't


  • Experience with building APIs using Python


  • Comfortable in AWS, the infrastructure your pipelines run on isn't a black box to you


  • You've integrated third-party sources before: event tracking, attribution, payment and subscription data


  • You handle deduplication, late-arriving data, timezones and attribution windows deliberately, not reactively


  • You form a view, state it, and own the outcome and can explain the tradeoff to a non-data manager


  • You trace problems to root cause, raise issues early, write things down, and follow through




What We Offer

  • A career opportunity that makes a positive impact on people's lives


  • A competitive salary matched with your experience and ambition


  • An amazing work environment in our office at Prins Hendrikkade, at the heart of Amsterdam


  • A MacBook or other hardware of your choice to be able to do your job


  • Stay healthy and bring-your-own-device allowance


  • Training and development budget


  • Frequent team get-togethers and team activities


  • Free Inner Circle VIP membership for you and your single friends




About Inner Circle

Inner Circle is a dating app built on the contrarian belief: opposites don't attract. The best connections happen between people who already live life the same way. So we don't sell more options, or better odds. We sell relevance, people worth dating. Every member is screened, so effort and intention are in place before anyone gets in. And where every other app is built to keep you swiping, ours is built to get you off it, and onto a date with someone worth your time.


At Inner Circle, we embrace our diverse community and team. We celebrate differences and know that they are key for helping us grow. xgiwjmb Our team consists of 40 team members, with 16 nationalities and a female: male ratio of 60 : 40. Whatever your race, religion, colour, gender, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or age, we make sure everyone has the space to be themselves.

title: Full Stack Developer- IMMEDIATE START
description:
Als Full Stack Developer bij Zonneplan bouw je aan de software die dagelijks duizenden bezoekers bedient en honderden nieuwe klanten oplevert. Van het eerste websitebezoek tot een gepersonaliseerde digitale offerte: alles is in-house ontwikkeld. Jij schrijft de code die direct bepaalt hoe tienduizenden mensen zonnepanelen, batterijen, laadpalen en energiecontracten aanvragen.

Je werkt in een development team met React en TypeScript aan de frontend en Laravel en PHP aan de backend. Voor deze functie werk je 32-40 uur per week met een salaris van €3.500 – €5.500.

Jouw impact bij Zonneplan

  • Jij bouwt full stack features voor de hele customer journey. Van de website en aanvraagstraat tot dynamische digitale offertes ontwikkel je functionaliteiten die dagelijks duizenden bezoekers soepel door het proces leiden. Je werkt met React en TypeScript aan de frontend en Laravel en PHP aan de backend.
  • Jij bewaakt en verbetert de kwaliteit van onze codebase. Je schrijft geteste, leesbare code die voldoet aan de Definition of Done. Via code reviews help je teamgenoten scherp te blijven.
  • Jij pakt technical debt structureel aan. Je verbetert architectuur, optimaliseert performance en stroomlijnt processen.
  • Jij zorgt voor stabiele releases en betrouwbare software. Je ondersteunt deployments via GitHub Actions, monitort applicatieprestaties in Grafana en spoort issues op met Sentry.

Dit neem jij mee

  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met Laravel en PHP en weet hoe je een schaalbare, onderhoudbare backend neerzet.
  • Je hebt ervaring met React en TypeScript en kunt zelfstandig frontend features bouwen die goed presteren.
  • Je schrijft schone, geteste code en hebt een scherp oog voor kwaliteit, van unit tests tot code reviews.
  • Je hebt ervaring met of affiniteit voor AI-ondersteund ontwikkelen, bijvoorbeeld met Claude Code, GitHub Copilot of vergelijkbare AI-assistenten.
  • Je werkt graag in een agile team met standups, refinements en retro's, en neemt eigenaarschap over je werk binnen de sprint.

Dit krijg je van ons

  • Een salaris tussen €3.500 en €5.500, afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om er meer bij te kopen, en reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Een persoonlijk keuzebudget voor sport, boodschappen of iets anders dat bij je past.
  • Een Claude Code Max 20x abonnement voor je dagelijkse werk, side projects en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
  • Investering in jouw groei met de Zonneplan Academy, goede tools en ruimte om te blijven leren.
  • Een team met wekelijkse refinements, scherpe retro's en korte lijnen naar product owners en stakeholders.

Agentic Engineering bij Zonneplan

De development-afdeling werkt AI-first: je stuurt AI-agents aan, paired met Claude Code en automatiseert wat geautomatiseerd kan worden.

Samen bouwen aan de energie van morgen

Bij Zonneplan werken we aan één duidelijk doel: een Nederland zonder fossiele energie. Wij noemen dat plan Zero. Geen uitstoot, geen verspilling, geen afhankelijkheid. Als Full Stack Developer bouw je aan de technologie die dit mogelijk maakt. Elke feature die jij oplevert, helpt klanten makkelijker over te stappen op schone energie. Van zonnepanelen en batterijen tot laadpalen en energiecontracten: jouw code maakt duurzame energie toegankelijker voor iedereen.

Heb je vragen? Bel of mail 088 020 3012 / samer.elmokdad@zonneplan.nl

title: Department Assistant, Compensation Benefits and Member Services
description:
Job Description

Who We Are
​Creative Artists Agency (CAA) is the leading entertainment and sports agency, with global expertise in filmed and live entertainment, digital media, publishing, sponsorship sales and endorsements, media finance, consumer investing, fashion, trademark licensing, and philanthropy. Distinguished by its culture of collaboration and exceptional client service, CAA’s diverse workforce identifies, innovates, and amplifies opportunities for the people and organizations that shape culture and inspire the world. The trailblazer of the agency business, CAA was the first to build a sports business, create an investment bank, launch a venture fund, found technology start-up companies, establish a philanthropic arm, build a business in China, and form a brand marketing services division, among other innovations. Named Most Valuable Sports Agency by Forbes for eight consecutive years, CAA represents more than 2,000 of the world’s top athletes in football, baseball, basketball, hockey, soccer, in addition to coaches, on-air broadcasters, and sports personalities and works in the areas of broadcast rights, corporate marketing initiatives, social impact, and sports properties for sales and sponsorship opportunities. Founded in 1975, CAA is headquartered in Los Angeles, and has offices in New York, Nashville, Memphis, Chicago, Miami, London, Munich, Geneva, Stockholm, Shanghai, and Beijing, among other locations globally.

The Role
We are looking for a Department Assistant to provide administrative support to the Benefits, Compensation, and Member Services teams and white-glove service to members. The individual must be comfortable working with people in a variety of roles both within and outside of the company. This is an excellent opportunity for someone interested in growing and expanding their knowledge of both the compensation and benefits functions. This hybrid position requires onsite presence four days a week or more, as mandated by the business.

Responsibilities

Provides department administrative support to Benefits, Compensation and Member Service teams. Responsibilities include:

  • Manages calendars and phones for all assigned executives on the team, setting up and managing meetings, reserving conference rooms, greeting and directing visitors, etc.

  • Handles internal and external requests for meetings, utilizing strong judgment in prioritization and flexibility to meet scheduling changes and shifting priorities.

  • Schedules travel, processes expense reports, and invoices, and coordinates logistics for team meetings, and events.

  • Receives inquiries from CAA Members and either handles questions, or routes to the appropriate team member.

  • Responds to questions submitted through the HR general phone line, related to routine questions on benefits and compensation policies.

  • Periodically provides administrative support to the Global SVP of Compensation and Benefits when they are working in person in the Los Angeles office (approx. once per month).

  • Collects, reviews and analyzes data and prepares reports, charts, budgets, and other presentation materials utilizing Workday, the Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and specialized software.

  • Compiles statistics and distributes reports or other communications on a regular schedule.

  • Maintains files, databases, and archives of relevant documents and records, and manages version control.

  • Creates, proofreads, formats, prints and assembles confidential meeting materials.

  • Ensures deliverable are error free and on time.

  • Performs other duties assigned, as needed.

Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

  • 1 -3+ years’ of administrative support experience, preferably in Compensation, Benefits, Member Services, or a related Corporate department.

  • Experience providing administrative support to multiple executives and team members.

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively interact with senior-level executives and their assistants and coordinators.

  • Demonstrated ability to maintain strict confidentiality in handling and preparing sensitive compensation, benefits, or member services documents, presentations and reports.

  • Possess excellent customer service mindset, strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Must be highly organized, resourceful and possess good judgment.

  • Interest in working in and learning about areas such as compensation, equity, benefits, HR operations, etc.

  • Intermediate or advanced level proficiency working in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Professional & proactive demeanor, detail oriented and possess superior organizational skills.

  • Must be able to work independently in a fast-paced and team-oriented department.

  • Must be able to juggle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and be able to quickly adjust to new priorities and circumstances.


Location
This position will be based in our LA office with a minimum of 4 days a week in the office.

The base hourly rate for this position is in the range of $28.00-$33.00. Ultimately, wages may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience, time in role, business sector, and geographic location, among other criteria. Please talk with a CAA Recruiter to learn more.

title: Intern- Solutions Engineer
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

The Solutions Engineer Intern sits within the Transform the Business pillar of the Quality Systems organization, supporting the AI Process Intelligence (AIPI) team. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related technical fields who are curious, eager to learn, and excited about AI and automation.

You will work closely with and under the guidance of senior Solutions Engineers and Process Architects, participating in defined project tasks, testing activities, documentation, and proof-of-concept development. You are not expected to independently lead projects — you are expected to learn fast, contribute meaningfully, and grow your skills in a structured and supportive environment.

Department

Global Quality Systems – Solutions Engineering

Project Title

AI‑Driven Automation and Knowledge Integration – Solutions Engineering Internship

Project Description

This internship is a learning‑focused, project‑based role designed to provide hands‑on exposure to AI‑enabled automation and enterprise system integration within Micron’s Quality Systems domain.
The project focuses on designing and developing prototype‑level automation and AI agent solutions to demonstrate how intelligent workflows, predictive models, and knowledge integration can enhance business processes. The intern will work under close mentorship and within a controlled, non‑production environment to explore AI architecture concepts, data pipelines, and system connectivity patterns.

Project Scope

  • Provide day-to-day support for MES-related production issues and user questions.

  • Maintain accurate and current documentation for MES configurations, workflows, routings, processes, system changes, and training materials.
  • Support the development and implementation of MES standards and best practices across manufacturing operations.

title: Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure SRE
description:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Technical Program Manager in Infrastructure SRE, you will lead high-impact, cross-organizational initiatives that safeguard and scale Google’s core compute backbone. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. title: Senior Emission Analyst
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Staff/ Senior Emission Analyst in Global Sustainability Team, you will be responsible for leading critical emissions data collection at Micron’s R&D and manufacturing sites globally utilizing FTIR and/or other forward-looking analytical technologies. You will be working in close partnership with instrument suppliers and/or vendors, site environmental sustainability leadership teams, site manufacturing teams, site facility teams, global smart manufacturing teams, global labs etc. to perform measurement, optimize measurement methodologies, write and document measurement reports, and provide data insights and recommendations to propel Micron towards the goal of achieving net zero emissions.

Responsibilities

Perform Actual Emissions (process greenhouse gas etc.) Measurement & Reporting

  • FTIR and/or analytics technologies pre-measurement calibration.

  • Coordinate with site manufacturing team for process recipe and dilution flow requirement.

  • Partner with site manufacturing and/or facility teams to perform abatement destruction and removal efficiencies (DRE) measurement and optimize abatement, setpoints where required.

  • Analyze measured data and write measurement reports (DRE etc.) according to international standards.

  • Use of Artificial intelligence and data analysis techniques to provide critical insights to reduce emissions at Micron.

  • FTIR and/or analytical technologies maintenance and troubleshooting in collaboration with instrument suppliers.

Optimize Actual Emissions Measurement & Reporting Procedures

  • Optimize the existing standard operating procedures (SOPs) for abatement DRE measurement and streamline reporting to improve measurement and report writing efficiencies.

Innovation and Training

  • Partner with instrument suppliers and/or ventures to explore and deploy forward-looking analytical technologies for improved accuracy and efficiencies in emission measurement.
