IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: SENIOR/STAFF DATA SCIENTIST, SMART MFG & AI
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

Job Summary

At Micron, we are transforming the future of semiconductor manufacturing through data, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytics. As a Senior/Staff Data Scientist, you will leverage massive volumes of manufacturing, engineering, and business data to develop predictive models, uncover actionable insights, and drive intelligent decision-making across our global operations.

In this role, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, data scientists, and business leaders to solve complex real-world challenges using machine learning, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics. You will have the opportunity to develop innovative AI-driven solutions that improve product quality, optimize manufacturing performance, accelerate operational excellence, and shape the future of intelligent manufacturing.

If you are passionate about turning data into impactful business solutions and thrive in a highly automated, data-rich environment, we invite you to join our team and make a meaningful difference.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Manufacturing, Product, and Business stakeholders to identify opportunities for data-driven solutions and process improvements.
  • Analyze large and complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights that drive business value.
  • Develop, validate, and deploy statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and predictive analytics solutions to address manufacturing and business challenges.
  • Lead moderately complex analytics and machine learning projects from problem definition through deployment and adoption.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis, root cause investigations, and advanced statistical analysis to solve real-world operational problems.
  • Design and implement scalable data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and feature engineering workflows.
  • Partner with Data Engineers and software teams to operationalize machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
  • Communicate technical findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Research, evaluate, and apply emerging AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics techniques to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentor junior team members on data science methodologies, best practices, and analytical approaches.
  • Ensure data science solutions align with Micron's Responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, and data governance standards.
  • Ability to apply baseline digital fluency and role-appropriate AI literacy to responsibly and effectively utilize AI-enabled tools for research, analysis, content creation, problem-solving, operational tasks, and business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and machine learning technologies to enhance productivity, accelerate innovation, and improve decision-making.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and the responsible use of AI while adhering to Micron's Responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, and data governance requirements.

Minimum Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, or a related field.
  • Proven experience developing and deploying statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and predictive analytics solutions to solve business, engineering, or manufacturing problems.
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets, including data extraction, cleansing, transformation, feature engineering, and model development.
  • Experience using SQL and other database query languages to access, manipulate, and analyze data.
  • Strong software development and programming skills with experience building scalable analytics solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive projects and influence stakeholders through data-driven insights.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Must-Have Technical Skills

  • Statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, including supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised learning.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or R.
  • Strong SQL and database querying skills.
  • Data preparation, feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and model validation.
  • Software development and analytics solution development.
  • Experience with large-scale data processing and analytics workflows.

Must-Have Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with a data-driven mindset.
  • Excellent problem-solving and structured thinking abilities.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to collaborate and influence across diverse technical and business teams.
  • Self-motivated with strong ownership and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Curiosity and continuous learning mindset to explore emerging technologies and innovative approaches.

Highly Desirable / Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Experience with distributed computing frameworks such as PySpark, SparkR, SparklyR, or Apache Spark.
  • Experience with Hadoop ecosystem technologies, including Hive, Spark, and HBase.
  • Experience with data visualization and analytics tools such as Tableau.
  • Experience working with time-series data, image analytics, anomaly detection, or datasets with evolving distributions.
  • Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
  • Experience applying AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics within semiconductor manufacturing or other highly automated industrial environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data science and machine learning platforms.
  • Experience mentoring junior data scientists or leading technical initiatives.

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

title: Intern - Semiconductor Research & Technology Development
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Semiconductor Technology Development Intern

Innovation, Technology & Products (ITP)
Albany Nanotech | Albany, New York
Summer 2027

About Micron

Micron is a global leader in memory and storage solutions that transform how the world uses information to enrich life.

The Innovation, Technology & Products (ITP) organization is responsible for developing the next generation of memory technologies and enabling future Micron products. At Albany Nanotech, Micron is establishing a leading-edge research and development presence focused on advanced lithography, materials innovation, technology pathfinding, and strategic semiconductor ecosystem partnerships. Albany serves as a key location for accelerating technology development and expanding collaboration across leading research institutions, equipment suppliers, and industry partners.

Position Summary

Micron is seeking highly motivated Master's and PhD students to join our Summer 2027 Semiconductor Technology Development Internship Program in Albany, New York.

As an intern, you will work alongside engineers and researchers developing future semiconductor technologies, advanced process capabilities, and next-generation memory solutions. You will contribute to meaningful technical projects, gain hands-on experience in semiconductor research and development, and present your work to engineering leadership at the conclusion of your internship.

This role is ideal for students who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working with advanced technologies, and contributing to innovations that will shape the future of the semiconductor industry.

Internship Areas

Interns may support projects in one or more of the following areas:

  • Advanced Lithography & High-NA EUV
  • Materials Research & Innovation
  • Process Integration
  • Thin Films & Deposition
  • Dry Etch Technology
  • Metrology & Defect Analysis
  • Advanced Packaging Technologies
  • Automation & Data Analytics
  • Semiconductor Equipment Development
  • Technology Pathfinding & Research

Albany's initial focus includes advancing next-generation lithography, enabling High-NA EUV, accelerating materials innovation, and driving technology pathfinding in collaboration with leading industry and research partners.

Responsibilities

  • Support semiconductor research and development activities
  • Design and execute engineering experiments
  • Analyze technical data and identify trends
  • Apply statistical methods to solve engineering problems
  • Develop recommendations based on experimental results
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and external research partners
  • Document findings and communicate technical results
  • Participate in team meetings, technical reviews, and development activities
  • Deliver a final project presentation to technical leadership
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools, data analytics platforms, and digital solutions to enhance research productivity, accelerate problem-solving, improve data analysis, and support technical decision-making while adhering to Micron's standards for responsible and secure AI use.

Minimum Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD degree in:

  • Chemical Engineering
  • Materials Science & Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Physics
  • Chemistry
  • Computer Engineering
  • Data Science
  • Related STEM discipline

Additional qualifications:

  • Expected graduation date of December 2027 or later
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and within collaborative teams
  • Demonstrated interest in advanced technology research and development

Preferred Qualifications

  • Semiconductor manufacturing, research, or laboratory experience
  • Cleanroom experience
  • Experience with data analysis tools such as JMP, Python, R, MATLAB, or similar software
  • Knowledge of statistical methods and experimental design
  • Experience conducting independent research projects
  • Technical publications, conference presentations, or research experience preferred
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools, advanced analytics platforms, or computational methods to improve engineering, research, data analysis, or problem-solving workflows.

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience in semiconductor research and development
  • Exposure to leading-edge semiconductor technologies
  • Mentorship from experienced Micron engineers, researchers, and technical leaders
  • Opportunities to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines
  • Professional development and networking opportunities
  • Experience working within one of the industry's most advanced semiconductor research ecosystems
  • The opportunity to contribute to technologies that will enable the future of memory innovation

Why Albany?

Albany Nanotech is one of the world's premier semiconductor research environments, bringing together industry leaders, universities, equipment suppliers, and research organizations to solve some of the industry's most complex technology challenges.

Micron's Albany team is focused on advancing next-generation lithography capabilities, accelerating materials innovation, enabling future technology roadmaps, and strengthening strategic research partnerships that support the future of memory technology development.

title: Intern - NAND Device Engineering AI
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

Location
Singapore

Department
NAND Device Engineering

Project Title
AI-Enabled Device Characterization Automation and Intelligent Engineering Workflow Platform

Project Description
As an AI / Data Science Intern in the NAND Device Engineering organization, you will participate in the development of AI-Enabled solutions that enhance engineering productivity, accelerate device characterization, and improve data-driven decision-making for advanced 3D NAND technologies. This internship provides an opportunity to apply Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, data science, and automation techniques to complex semiconductor engineering datasets.

The project focuses on developing intelligent automation workflows, AI-assisted analysis platforms, and Agentic AI solutions that streamline device characterization activities, automate engineering insights generation, and improve project execution efficiency. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will gain exposure to semiconductor device development, large-scale data analytics, and emerging Generative AI technologies within a manufacturing and product development environment.

Objective of the Project
Develop an AI-Enabled platform that automates device characterization workflows, enhances engineering data analysis, and provides intelligent decision-support capabilities to accelerate technology development and engineering learning.

Opportunities for Full Time Employment
High-performing candidates may be considered for future opportunities , subjected to business needs and individual performance.

Project Scope

  • Design and develop AI-Enabled workflows for automating device characterization data collection, analysis, anomaly detection, and reporting across multiple electrical characterization datasets.

  • Apply machine learning, statistical modeling, and Agentic AI techniques to identify performance trends, classify device behaviors, and generate engineering insights from large-scale datasets.

  • Develop automated data pipelines for data extraction, cleansing, feature engineering, and integration from characterization and metrology sources.

  • Create interactive dashboards, visualization tools, and AI Assistant capabilities that enable engineers to explore data, retrieve knowledge, and generate summary reports more efficiently.

  • Evaluate the application of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic Solutions for engineering workflow automation, project tracking, technical knowledge retrieval, and intelligent report generation.

Learning Opportunities

  • Gain practical experience applying Artificial Intelligence and machine learning techniques to semiconductor engineering challenges.

  • Learn how large-scale device characterization data is used to evaluate performance, variability, and technology development objectives.

  • Develop expertise in data engineering, analytics, visualization, and AI-enabled decision-support systems.

  • Explore modern Generative AI, LLM, and Agentic AI frameworks for engineering and technical applications.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to understand technology development processes and data-driven engineering methodologies.

Deliverables

  • AI-Enabled device characterization automation workflow.

  • Intelligent engineering dashboard with data visualization and insight generation capabilities.

  • Machine learning or Agentic AI model demonstrating automated pattern recognition and data interpretation.

  • Automated reporting framework for engineering summary generation and knowledge sharing.

  • Final project presentation, technical documentation, and reusable software assets.

Impact of the Project

  • Improve engineering efficiency through automation of repetitive data processing activities.

  • Accelerate analysis of characterization results and identification of meaningful device trends.

  • Demonstrate the value of Artificial Intelligence and Agentic AI technologies within semiconductor engineering workflows.

  • Enhance accessibility of engineering knowledge through intelligent data exploration and reporting tools.

  • Establish scalable foundations for future AI-Enabled engineering productivity solutions.

Skillsets Required

  • Strong programming proficiency in Python and experience developing data analysis, automation, or software solutions.

  • Knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, data science, or Artificial Intelligence concepts through coursework, projects, or research activities.

  • Familiarity with data processing libraries and frameworks such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, or similar technologies.

  • Exposure to data visualization, dashboard development, database technologies, or workflow automation platforms is desirable.

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, communication skills, self-motivation, and interest in AI-Enabled engineering solutions.

Course of Interest
The ideal candidate should be pursuing a Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

Duration of Period
The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full time internship period of 6 months.

About Micron Technology, Inc.

title: Head of Transformational Quality Programs
description:
Job Description

Lead the North America Food Safety & Quality transformation agenda by developing quality system strategies, performance measures, governance, and sustainable interventions across the FSQ NA three-year transformation plan. The role strengthens manufacturing quality processes, aligns global and regional priorities, and ensures transparent execution across all business units.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement quality system strategies and KPIs to strengthen manufacturing quality processes, including capital plans, facility improvements, and product protection device recommendations.
  • Design and launch targeted quality assurance programs to address specific issues across Quality, Laboratories, and Sanitation.
  • Partner with Global Quality Council members and committees to support global policy review, quality systems review, decision-making, and development.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of the FSQ NA three-year transformation plan across all six pillars and two enablers, ensuring appropriate sequencing, dependency management, and transparent progress reporting to FSQ leadership and the executive sponsor.
  • Set the quality transformation agenda, define operating mechanisms, and approve interventions that establish risk-based and sustainable expectations for compliance and quality performance.

Expected Experience & Required Skills

  • Demonstrated problem-solving capability and experience using quality and continuous improvement tools such as Six Sigma, Lean, and root cause analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional groups.

title: Servicetekniker | Lernia | Örebro
description:
Är du tekniskt intresserad, gillar praktiskt arbete och trivs med ett aktivt arbetsliv? Då kan rollen som servicetekniker inom vindkraft vara nästa steg för dig. Här får du möjligheten att arbeta i en växande bransch där du kombinerar teknik, problemlösning och arbete ute i fält. Tillsammans med engagerade kollegor bidrar du till en hållbar energiframtid!

Om tjänsten

Som servicetekniker erbjuds du en varierande roll, där arbetet sker både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor. Rollen innebär service, underhåll och reparation av vindkraftverk runt om i Sverige. Du kommer att arbeta nära kunder och bidra till att säkerställa en hög driftsäkerhet genom förebyggande underhåll, felsökning och tekniska insatser ute på fältet. Detta är en roll som passar dig som trivs i en praktisk och lösningsorienterad miljö med stor variation i både arbetsuppgifter och arbetsplatser.

  • Anställningsform: Tillsvidare

  • Start: Enligt överenskommelse

  • Omfattning: Heltid

  • Arbetstid: Dagtid

  • Placering: Kontoret är beläget i Örebro. Rollen innebär resor och arbete på olika orter runt om i Sverige

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Felsökning, reparation och avhjälpande underhåll på vindkraftverk, både mekaniskt och elektriskt.

  • Service och förebyggande underhåll enligt gällande serviceavtal och rutiner.

  • Medverka i olika projekt, installationer och tekniska uppdrag inom vindkraftsbranschen

  • Ansvar för servicebil samt säkerställa att utrustning, reservdelar och verktyg finns tillgängliga och är i gott skick

  • Dokumentation av utfört arbete samt rapportering och registrering av arbetsorder

Om dig

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är en ansvarstagande och säkerhetsmedveten person som alltid sätter kvalitet och säkerhet i första rummet. Du har ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt, tar gärna egna initiativ och trivs med att hitta praktiska lösningar på tekniska utmaningar. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som uppskattar samarbete och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.

Formella krav

  • Kunskaper inom maskin, mekanik och/eller el genom utbildning eller arbetslivserfarenhet.

  • Bekväm med att arbeta på höga höjder

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

  • Datorvana

  • B-körkort samt möjlighet att resa och arbeta på annan ort under perioder

Meriterande kvalifikationer

  • Erfarenhet som servicetekniker eller från liknande tekniska roller

  • Erfarenhet från vindkraftsbranschen

  • BE-körkort.

  • Erfarenhet av felsökning, service och underhåll av mekaniska eller elektriska system.

Om Lernia

Lernia är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och finns över hela landet. Med vårt omfattande nätverk erbjuder vi spännande jobb hos attraktiva arbetsgivare och varumärken som hjälper dig att utveckla din kompetens och karriär, både på lång och kort sikt.

Hur du söker tjänsten

För att söka tjänsten, scrolla ner till ansökningsformuläret nedan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Om du har några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på petra.dahdouh@lernia.se.

Bakgrundskontroll

För vissa tjänster ingår bakgrundskontroll som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. Om du går vidare i processen behöver du verifiera din identitet via BankID innan kontrollen genomförs.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer | Utrecht
description:
Klaar om impact te maken met automatisering en cloudtechnologie?

Denkt u de juiste kandidaat te zijn voor de volgende functie? Solliciteer dan na het lezen van de volledige omschrijving.

Als DevOps Engineer bij Team EIFFEL bouw je aan slimme CI/CD pipelines, automatiseer je infrastructuur en adviseer je klanten over moderne DevOps strategieën. Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in verschillende sectoren, waar je continu verbetert en vernieuwt. Of je je wilt verdiepen in cloudtechnologie of juist jouw brede DevOps expertise verder wilt uitbouwen: bij ons bepaal jij je route.


Dit ga je doen

Als DevOps Engineer werk je binnen onze Business Unit Technology aan uiteenlopende projecten. Je maakt deel uit van een team van 30 IT consultants en werkt voor verschillende soorten organisaties. Dat betekent afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en veel ruimte om je technische én adviesvaardigheden in te zetten. Je schakelt intensief met developmenten operations teams en speelt een belangrijke rol in het vormgeven van moderne DevOps werkwijzen. Jouw werkzaamheden:



  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van CI/CD pipelines voor diverse projecten.
  • Automatiseren van infrastructuur met tools zoals Terraform, Ansible of Pulumi.
  • Beheren en optimaliseren van cloudomgevingen, zoals Azure en AWS.
  • Adviseren van klanten over DevOps strategieën en best practices.
  • Monitoren en verbeteren van security en compliance binnen DevOps processen.
  • Samenwerken met developmenten operations teams om een cultuur van Continuous Improvement te stimuleren.

Je bent fit for the job als je...

Je hebt ruime ervaring als DevOps Engineer en voelt je thuis in een dynamische consultancy omgeving. Je kent containertechnologieën en cloudplatformen door en door en schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek en advies. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden weet je klanten helder mee te nemen in keuzes, oplossingen en best practices. Je wilt blijven groeien, nieuwe technieken ontdekken en werkt graag in omgevingen waar je impact maakt.


Harde eisen:

  • Hbo opleiding richting business IT & management of een vergelijkbare studie.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als DevOps Engineer binnen consultancy of een vergelijkbare dynamische omgeving.
  • Diepgaande kennis van Docker en Kubernetes, sterke ervaring met Azure en goede scriptingvaardigheden (bijv. Python, Bash).

Zachte eisen:

  • Je hebt ervaring met Infrastructure as Code en configuratiemanagement en zet dit effectief in.
  • Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (minimaal C1 niveau).
  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen klantvragen, technische uitdagingen en adviesrollen.

For international candidates: our consultants must be able to communicate in Dutch at a minimum of C1 level, both spoken and written.


Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 6.000 en 7.800 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en relevante certificaten. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot meer dan 950 trainingen en cursussen die je onbeperkt kunt volgen.


Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in een inspirerende consultancy omgeving waar je niet sectorgebonden bent. Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je samen met 75 consultants, waarvan 30 IT consultants in jouw directe team. De sfeer is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.



  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist

Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy,dat is Team EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is. Of je nu werkt voor een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis: jij helpt teams slimmer werken en brengt ideeën van papier naar praktijk. Soms voor grote transformaties, soms voor snelle oplossingen. Van startup tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.


Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je met 75 consultants verdeeld over drie specialisaties: Data & Analytics, IT en GEOS. Als DevOps Engineer maak je deel uit van het IT team, samen met zo’n 30 collega consultants. Omdat we niet sectorgebonden werken, krijg je de kans om in verschillende omgevingen ervaring op te doen. IT raakt alle sectoren,daardoor is er altijd een project dat past bij jouw kennis, ambitie en energie.


Elke vrijdag is onze samenwerkdag in het clubhuis in Arnhem. Die staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega’s en het versterken van de onderlinge verbinding. Moet je opdrachtgever je die dag op kantoor hebben? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.


Team EIFFEL is onderdeel van een community van ruim 3.000 experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers. Groot in omvang, maar persoonlijk in cultuur. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die wil groeien, ontwikkelen en zichzelf scherp wil houden.


Deze skills komen van pas

  • Software testing en automatisering

Je communiceert sterk en weet klanten op een duidelijke, rustige manier mee te nemen in complexe DevOps vraagstukken. Je werkt graag samen en stimuleert teams om continu te verbeteren. Met jouw analytische blik zie je snel waar knelpunten zitten en vind je oplossingen die werken, altijd met aandacht voor security en compliance. Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in DevOps en cloudtechnologie en past die kennis toe in je werk. Je houdt van hard werken, maar zeker ook van humor op de werkvloer. xgiwjmb En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent gericht op groei en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Lead Full-Stack Engineer ( Full-Time On-Site only)

Please read the full description first.

Applicants must already be located in UAE. No remote work.

Location:Business Bay, Dubai (Full-Time On-Site)

AtORIKEI, we build premium software and smart hardware where precision engineering meets high-end design. Our stack spans offline-first mobile apps, real-time IoT telemetry pipelines, and luxury inventory tracking systems - all built in-house by a small, highly capable team.

We're not a corporate environment. No endless bureaucracy, no micro-management, no vanity metrics. Instead, we offerhigh autonomy, exciting technical depth, and work that ships and matters every single day.

What You'll Do

You will be ahands-on engineer who owns the full product stack- mobile, web, and backend - writing production code daily and taking features from idea to live deployment independently.

  • Mobile (React Native / Expo):Build and maintain our iOS and Android apps - complex UI, offline-first sync, BLE/NFC hardware integrations, and real-time data flows.
  • Backend (NestJS / Node.js):Own API development, database design, microservices, and event-driven pipelines across PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Redis, and RabbitMQ.
  • Web Frontends (Next.js):Build and improve our internal admin tools, producer portals, and customer-facing web apps.
  • IoT & Hardware:Work directly with BLE sensors, MQTT telemetry, RFID scanners, and real-time alerting - integrating hardware with software seamlessly.
  • Production Ownership:Deploy, monitor, and maintain live systems. Debug production issues, manage CI/CD pipelines, and ship to TestFlight and App Store with confidence.
  • Architecture:Contribute meaningfully to technical decisions - data models, sync strategies, API design, and system scalability.

What We're Looking For Hard Skills

  • React Native (Expo)- production apps, not tutorials. You've shipped to the App Store.
  • Node.js / NestJS- REST APIs, authentication, background jobs, real-time WebSockets.
  • Next.js / TypeScript- server-side rendering, API routes, complex UI components.
  • PostgreSQL- schema design, query optimisation, migrations. TimescaleDB or similar a bonus.
  • Redis- caching, pub/sub, session management.
  • Offline-first / local-first architecture- experience with sync engines (PowerSync, WatermelonDB, or similar) is a strong plus.
  • IoT familiarity- BLE, MQTT, NFC, or hardware integrations. You don't need to be an embedded engineer, but you're comfortable bridging hardware and software.
  • Docker & Linux- comfortable deploying and troubleshooting containerised services on a Linux server.

Mindset

  • Ownership mentality- you don't wait to be told. You identify problems, propose solutions, and ship them.
  • High craft bar- you care about code quality, UI polish, and getting the details right.
  • Self-directed- you thrive with autonomy and can manage your own work without hand-holding.
  • Clear communicator- you can explain complex technical decisions simply and work closely with designers and the broader team.

Why Join ORIKEI?

  • Small team, real impact- your code ships to production and you see the results immediately.
  • Full-stack ownership- no siloing. You work across the entire product, mobile to backend to infrastructure.
  • Technically challenging- real-time sync, IoT pipelines, offline-first mobile, BLE hardware, vision AI. This is not a CRUD app job.
  • Great culture- genuine, values-driven team. Respectful, collaborative, and no corporate nonsense.
  • Business Bay, Dubai- modern office, great location.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Bij Happy Horizon geloven we niet in "one size fits all". Ben jij die Senior Backend developer? Dan is dit misschien jouw volgende stap.



Zorg ervoor dat u de informatie over deze vacature grondig leest voordat u een sollicitatie indient.
Bouw aan high-end platformen met Laravel, Drupal en meer…!

Ben jij een Senior Backend Developer die niet in één hokje te plaatsen is? Bij Happy Horizon ontwikkelen, bouwen en beheren we complexe platformen voor toonaangevende merken zoals Praxis, Gamma, CSU, Kemkens en Holland Food Service.


Of het nu gaat om een krachtig Laravel framework of flexibele Drupal; jij weet de motor onder de motorkap ronkend te krijgen.


Jouw tech en skills


We zoeken een Senior Backend Developer die energie krijgt van een hybride tech-omgeving en graag de brug slaat naar moderne frontends.



  • Ervaring: Je hebt een HBO-werk- en denkniveau en meer dan 5 jaar ervaring in backend development.


  • De backend: Je bent thuis in PHP (Laravel) en/of hebt een passie voor backend development.


  • CMS expertise: Ervaring met Drupal is een pré. Je weet hoe je deze systemen schaalbaar en veilig inricht.


  • Frontend-affiniteit: Je begrijpt wat onze frontend-collega's nodig hebben en hebt basiskennis van (of interesse in) Vue.js of React.


  • Integraties: Architecturen en API-koppelingen zijn voor jou gesneden koek.


  • Persoonlijkheid: Je bent een sociale teamplayer, denkt proactief mee over architectuur en spreekt professioneel Nederlands.


  • Professionalisering: Als Senior Developer bouw je niet alleen mee aan onze code, maar ben je de drijvende kracht die 'goed genoeg' nooit accepteert en onze development-cultuur actief naar een hoger plan tilt.


  • Beschikbaarheid: Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar om samen met ons te knallen, let's go!


  • De legacy challenge: We zijn eerlijk: we hebben een legacy product staan waar onze klanten op rekenen. Onderdeel van onze deal is dat jij één dag in de week je tanden hierin zet waardoor we voor iedereen een gezonde balans creëren onder de developers om het legacy product te onderhouden.



Waarom Happy Horizon?


Je komt te werken in een team van specialisten waar kennisdeling centraal staat. Geen dag is hetzelfde door de enorme variëteit aan projecten en technieken.



  • Doorgroei: Word de expert in jouw favoriete stack of groei door naar Software Architect of Technisch Specialist. Wij zullen het budget voor je trainingen regelen.


  • Vrijheid: We werken met moderne, flexibele producten en de nieuwste frameworks. Jouw input over nieuwe technieken wordt écht gewaardeerd.


  • Werklocatie: Je werkt in het hartje van de stad van Eindhoven in het iconische oude pand waar vroeger de V&D zat. Ook een plek waar je vanuit je chille bureau met ultra wide screens en gratis frisse drankjes direct de bruisende stad in stapt. Als je een frisse neus wil halen, zou je zelfs een rondje over het dakterras kunnen maken.


  • Vibe: Een hecht team in Eindhoven met een goede balans tussen hard werken en Brabantse gezelligheid. Kom je gezellig mee iets drinken op de vrijmibo?



Klinkt dit als jouw volgende uitdaging? xgiwjmb


Heb je zin om je tanden te zetten in diverse tech stacks en werk je graag in een omgeving waar jij onderdeel bent om samen met ons te professionaliseren?

description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

Position Description

PIMCO is seeking an Analyst to join the Product Strategy Group. The Product Strategy Group serves as a bridge between investment expertise, business strategy, and client engagement across a broad range of PIMCO investment strategies. In this role, you will gain exposure to financial markets, product development, portfolio analysis, and client communication while partnering with colleagues across Portfolio Management, Client Management, Legal & Compliance, and other areas of the firm.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for candidates beginning their careers in investment management. Analysts participate in a rotational-style coverage model that provides exposure to multiple product areas and investment strategies before transitioning into a primary strategy focus. Through this experience, Analysts develop a broad understanding of PIMCO's platform, investment capabilities, and client needs while building a strong foundation for long-term career growth.

Following the initial coverage period, Analysts are aligned to a designated strategy area based on business needs, individual strengths, and demonstrated interests.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Build deep command of PIMCO's investment process, portfolio positioning, and market outlook — enough to become the most credible advocate in the room for the strategies you cover
  • Represent the investment team internally: be a highly valued resource for Account Managers and Client Management on your assigned strategies, while building exposure across PIMCO's full platform
  • Own, alongside Portfolio Management and Marketing, a consistent suite of product and client-service materials, and actively seek out feedback to ensure ongoing quality and relevance
  • Develop a strong understanding of business, stakeholder and client needs and articulate business value and product intent to internal leadership.
  • Track the competition and bring a point of view to how we grow the platform
  • Apply and help develop AI-powered tools to improve the productivity and quality of recurring workflows
  • Construct attribution, performance, and risk reporting that shows how portfolios are positioned, and why they performed the way they did
  • Write market updates, portfolio commentary, and portfolio construction materials that clearly communicate PIMCO's investment views
  • Partner on RFPs and DDQs, drafting and reviewing content that represents our strategies accurately

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Engineering, applied science, or another related discipline
  • Zero to two years of relevant experience; internship experience in investment management or alternatives is preferred
  • Strong mathematical, quantitative, and analytical abilities, with a detail-oriented skill set
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; reasonable proficiency with Bloomberg preferred
  • Demonstrated curiosity and experience using new and emerging technologies and AI tools to solve problems and drive better outcomes
  • Strong time management and organizational skills, with the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Intellectual curiosity, high energy, and a self-starter mindset
  • Ability to work effectively and professionally with all levels of personnel both internally and externally; strong team player
  • Enthusiasm for the financial markets, investing, and macroeconomics
  • Interest in pursuing the CFA designation (or active status in the program) a plus

title: Reservoir Engineer

We are searching for a Reservoir Engineer for our Technology team located in Sugar Land, Texas. As a Reservoir Engineer, you will provide reservoir engineering support for assigned Chemically Enhanced Oil Recovery (CEOR) projects by coordinating activities with others within the team to collaboratively ensure targets are met. You will act as a liaison with internal and external customers and provide technical reports and presentations to diverse audiences. Through your work, you will perform and interpret relevant reservoir engineering analysis and draw appropriate conclusions.

  • Opportunity for a long term, advanced career path

  • A culture that values safety first, including training and personal protection

What You Will Do:

  • Manage assigned projects and monitor progress to ensure targets are met, while liaising with internal and external customers.

  • Coordinate activities with the other groups involved (Technology, Marketing, Sales and other reservoir engineers).

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Petroleum, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering

  • 6 years of relevant work experience in IOR (Improved Oil Recovery) / EOR (Enhanced Oil Recovery) techniques

  • Understating of multi-phase flow through porous media, fluids property modelling (phase behavior), routine and special core analysis

  • Experience in reservoir engineering including (not limited to) reservoir management, waterflooding performance evaluation/optimization, well testing, interwell tracer data analysis

  • Solid knowledge and experience in reservoir simulation including model construction, history matching, calibration and prediction

  • Proficient in Eclipse, CMG reservoir simulation software

  • Must be a creative thinker with the ability to build conceptual models to implement new ideas, processes and technologies

  • Proven ability to interact with a variety of contacts, both internal and external, including management and industry partners to identify and implement advanced reservoir engineering technologies.

  • Self-driven and ability to work under minimal supervision

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD in Petroleum, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering with 2 years of relevant work experience or MS with 4 years of relevant work experience

  • Advanced data analytics experience

  • Demonstrated organizational skills

  • Detail-orientated with excellent time management skills

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills to work effectively in a team environment and maintain a professional and positive attitude

  • Demonstrated ability to work and think independently

  • Project leadership/management experience

  • Open to new ideas and innovations

  • Ability to analyze and interpret complex data

Physical Demands:

  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing

  • Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds

ChampionX is now part of SLB, a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. As innovators, that’s been our mission for nearly a century. Position Title:

Information Systems Specialist 6

Job Description:

Join the Oregon Department of Agriculture (ODA) as a Systems Administrator (ISS6) – 8 month Job Rotation or Limited Duration position.

This is a limited duration appointment that is expected to end on or before June 30, 2027. Limited duration appointments are benefits eligible and have a designated maximum length of service.

We may also fill this position as a rotational assignment open to current State of Oregon employees. Rotation candidates are required to meet the position’s minimum qualifications. You must have your manager's approval before applying for this assignment.

We are looking for someone who wants to make a difference. Someone who is technically capable, service-oriented, and enjoys solving problems as part of a close-knit team. At ODA, we value humility, accountability, collaboration, and an eagerness to jump in wherever needed.

JOB ROTATION OPPORTUNITY

This opportunity is open to current State of Oregon employees interested in a job rotation assignment. The assignment is expected to last at least eight (8) months ending June 30th, 2027 and is intended to accelerate ODA's Data Center Modernization and Mac to Windows Transition projects. At the conclusion of the assignment, the employee is expected to return to their home agency unless otherwise arranged. You must submit an approval from your current manager in your application materials to be considered for this rotation.

If that’s you, come join our IT team as a Systems Administrator.

Key areas of responsibility include:

  • Administer and support ODA's Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, and enterprise infrastructure.

  • Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot systems to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing technology services.

  • Manage identity, access, endpoint management, and security solutions across the agency.

  • Partner with Enterprise Information Services (EIS), vendors, and project teams to deliver infrastructure improvements and technology modernization projects.

  • Document systems and procedures while providing technical guidance and support to IT staff and agency users.

Success in this role requires the ability to coordinate technical work through vendors, managed service providers, and statewide technology partners while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

Why the Oregon Department of Agriculture (ODA):

  • Innovative Mission: We’re at the forefront of protecting and promoting Oregon’s agricultural communities and economies.

  • Diverse Programs: ODA has 38 programs ranging from our staff and constituents in their dusty boots out in the fields to clean high-tech labs that serve every Oregonian.

  • Collaborative Agency: The staff ("AGGIES") at ODA, are unified in the mission to support our farmers and ranchers across the state. As a Systems Administrator, you will work as a part of the IT team to ensure systems are always available to working for all Aggies and the farmers and ranchers they support.

The Systems Administrator (ISS6), is a rotational full-time position located in Salem, Oregon. This position is a hybrid position and you will be expected to report to the Salem headquarters as needed.

What we’re looking for:

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative, customer-focused approach to delivering technology solutions.

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

  • Experience supporting and administering enterprise infrastructure, including cloud-hosted systems, servers, identity services, and business applications.

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and modern endpoint management solutions.

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, evaluate options, and implement sustainable solutions.

  • Experience administering identity and access management solutions and applying security best practices.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to build productive working relationships with users, vendors, managed service providers, and technology partners.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Commitment to providing exceptional customer service and creating positive user experiences.

  • Humility, accountability, collaboration, and professional maturity.

Preferred Experience

  • Microsoft Azure administration

  • Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune administration

  • Hybrid cloud environments

  • Enterprise backup and disaster recovery

  • Infrastructure monitoring and performance management

  • Identity and access management

  • Vendor and managed service provider coordination

  • Working with Oregon Enterprise Information Services (EIS)

  • Supporting both Microsoft and Apple operating environments

The minimum qualifications for this position are five (5) years of experience administering computer networks, servers, and business systems OR three (3) years of experience administering computer networks, servers, and business systems and an associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field OR a bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field AND one (1) year of experience administering computer networks, servers, and business systems.

If your experience aligns with the qualifications outlined above, we encourage you to apply.

We recognize that the best candidate may not have experience with every technology listed above. If you have strong technical fundamentals, the ability to learn quickly, and the skills to be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply.

If you have these qualities, let us know through your application materials! It’s how we will choose whom to move forward.

Projected Recruitment Timeline

  • Recruitment Closes: September 27th, 2026

  • 1st Round 45 min Interview: Second week of October

  • 2nd Round if needed: TBD

*These dates are approximate and may change. *

How to apply:

  • A cover letter and resume are required. Your cover letter should demonstrate how your experience and training relate to your qualities under the "what we’re looking for" section above.

  • Your cover letter may be addressed to the hiring manager, Ryan Schlunz, CIO.

  • Upon submitting your application, please check your Workday account for additional tasks to complete, such as questionnaires, and to request veteran's preferences (if applicable).

  • If you are a current State of Oregon employee you must attach an approval email from your current manager.

What’s in it for you

The opportunity to work in a productive and creative environment where no two days are the same! We offer a competitive benefits package, including comprehensive medical, vision, and dental benefits for employees and their qualified family members, as well as paid sick leave, vacation leave, personal leave, and 11 paid holidays a year. In addition, we offer membership in the Public Employees Retirement System (PERS), deferred compensation, and the opportunity to receive loan forgiveness under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF).

Additional Information:

For current state employees, please apply through your employee Workday account.

  • Please ensure you've provided a thorough and updated application regarding the position for which you are applying. The required application materials submitted at the time of application will be used to determine salary based on a pay equity assessment. For further information, please visit the Pay Equity Project homepage.

  • This position is a hybrid position and will be expected to report to the Salem Headquarters as needed to complete projects onsite.

  • This recruitment may be used to fill future vacancies.

  • The salary listed is the non-PERS qualifying salary range. If the successful candidate is PERS qualifying, the salary range will reflect the additional 6.95%. Please review the Classification and Compensation page for more details, or you may visit our website for information on Pay Equity.

  • If you are a current State of Oregon employee your must have your current Managers approval to apply for this position.

  • United States Employment Eligibility: The Oregon Department of Agriculture does not offer visa sponsorship. Within three days of hire, all applicants will be required to complete the US Department of Homeland Security's Form I-9, confirming authorization to work in the United States. The Oregon Employment Department is an E-Verify employer. If you are a successful candidate, you must present your I-9 acceptable documents (See page 3) for employment verification.

Questions/Need Help?

If you have questions about the recruitment or need accommodation for the recruitment process, don't hesitate to get in touch with the recruiter at oda.recruitment@oda.oregon.gov or call 503-986-4584.

description:

This job calls for a dynamic and passionate individual to serve as the Assistant Director, Student Community Engagement to improve the development and delivery of programmes and holistic educational needs of students under NTU's Community Engagement Framework, to promote an enriching and vibrant student life among the university's 34,000 student body.


The Assistant Director, Student Community Engagement supports the Deputy Director in the planning, execution, and continuous enhancement of student life initiatives across campus. The Assistant Director leads the development and delivery of a university-wide community collaboration framework to strengthen student engagement and vibrancy across Arts, Sports, Residential Life, Leadership, and Academic Clubs.   • Implement the strategic plans and programmes of the Student Engagement and Campus Vibrancy Division.

  • Lead and oversee the year-round planning and delivery of activities of 60+ community and interest-based student clubs.

  • Lead, oversee and implement the operationalisation of the NTU Community Engagement Framework towards established desired outcomes.

  • Lead and drive innovation in co-curricular programming across Student Organisations such as the Welfare Services Club and Special Interests Clubs to enhance student vibrancy and engagement.

  • Work closely with student leaders, partners and other stakeholders to keep various programmes on schedule and within budget.

  • Mentor and guide student leaders in their development and competencies building.
