title: Account Representative, SMB (South)
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

As PayPal continues its mission to revolutionize commerce, we’re looking for a driven Account Representative to join our Small and Medium Business Sales team in Germany.

Our SMB business exists so small businesses can compete like big ones. In this role, you’ll be the person hundreds of them count on. In practice, you’ll own the end-to-end commercial relationships for a portfolio of around 200 SMB merchants across Southern Germany.

You’ll protect existing transaction margin and drive growth through consistent account management, retention and sales activity. With a high-volume portfolio, strong organisation and prioritisation will be just as important as the quality of your customer conversations.

This is a virtual position, with our German headquarters located in Berlin.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Engage and collaborate with the immediate team.
  • Contribute to solutions and suggest efficiencies.
  • Exercise judgment on issues of importance.
  • Acquire, manage, and expand relationships with small and medium-sized merchants.
  • Prioritize work and ensure task completion guided by policies and procedures.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

What You'll Do

  • Own / Manage the commercial relationship with your merchants, working closely with colleagues across PayPal to deliver strong end-to-end outcomes.

  • Use AI-powered tools to spot growth, cross-sell and risk opportunities across your book.

  • Keep pipeline, forecast and portfolio health reporting accurate, and share effective practices with fellow AM2 colleagues.

  • Coordinate internal teams to resolve merchant needs, and decide the right action when standard process isn't enough

    What We're Looking For

    • Structured, organised, and able to plan and segment a large customer book while keeping follow-through and service quality high.

    • Skilled in customer and commercial conversations — building trust, identifying needs and converting the right opportunities without losing customer focus.

    • Comfortable using AI, data and playbooks to make sound trade-offs and escalate at the right time when several things need attention at once.

    • A reliable team collaborator who keeps records, pipeline and follow-ups accurate and aligned with internal stakeholders.

    What You'll Bring

    • 3+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

    Nice to Have

    • Customer-facing, account-servicing or relationship-management experience.

    We Believe in You

    Interested? Don’t hesitate to apply or reach out and let's talk — we’d love to get to know you!

    Subsidiary:

    PayPal

    Travel Percent:

    0

    PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit .

    For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

    Our Benefits:

    At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

    Who We Are:

    Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.

    Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

    PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.

    Belonging at PayPal:

    Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

    Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.

    We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

title: Takläggare / Tätskiktsmontör
description:
Takmontör till LW Sverige AB – Vill du vara en del av vårt växande team?

Är du redo för nya utmaningar inom tätskiktsarbete? Vi söker flera tätskiktsmontörer som vill vara med och arbeta med varierande arbetsuppgifter som att bränna ytor, montera taksäkerhet, isolera och arbeta med material som PVC och EPDM.

Vad vi söker:

  • Har erfarenhet av tätskiktsarbete - eller är nyfiken på att lära dig

  • Du är produktionsorienterad, lösningsfokuserad och kvalitetsmedveten.

  • Du är självgående, noggrann och gillar att arbeta i team.

  • Du har god samarbetsförmåga och trivs i en arbetsmiljö med högt tempo.

  • Inte rädd för att jobba på hög höjd.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Kollektivavtal enligt Plåt- och Ventilationsavtalet

  • Tjänstepension via Fora

  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 3000 kr/år

  • Arbetstidsförkortning – 5 extra lediga dagar/år utöver den lagstadgade semestern

  • Möjlighet till utveckling inom företaget

  • Ett inkluderande arbetsklimat där vi stöttar varandra

Placering och arbetsort:

Vårt huvudkontor ligger i Stockholm, och det är härifrån vi utgår. Vi har projekt på flera platser i Sverige, och i ansökan kan du ange om du föredrar att arbeta i Stockholm eller på annan ort.

Observera: Byggbranschen är rörlig, och vi kan därför inte garantera en fast tjänst på en specifik ort – inte ens i Stockholm. Om du söker jobb i Göteborg eller annan stad utanför Stockholm kan det handla om tillfälliga traktamenteprojekt, men det är inte säkert att sådana finns tillgängliga vid varje tillfälle.

Vi ser det som positivt om du är öppen för att arbeta på olika platser, även om vi självklart lyssnar på dina önskemål.

Om oss

LW Sverige AB är en ledande aktör inom klimatskal – vi bygger och underhåller tak och fasader i hela Sverige. Vi är cirka 180 medarbetare och växer stadigt. Hos oss får du vara med och skapa något beständigt – både i våra projekt och i din egen yrkesutveckling.

Vi värdesätter mångfald och jämställdhet och ser gärna kvinnliga sökande – vi tror på styrkan i blandade team!

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Tillsammans bygger vi framtidens tak - på riktigt.

title: 2026 Global Technology - Associate Software Engineer
description:
At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident.

We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity.

Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you.

Role Summary

The Technology program focuses on developing foundational skills to equip our early talent associates with the tools to be the future leaders of the organization. The program is non-rotational, with direct placement into a functional area based on your skillset and business unit needs. The program will focus on the pillars of education, exposure, experience, and engagement, which would include customized learning curriculum, exposure to senior leadership, community service projects, assigned mentors, and social activities.

Responsibilities

You will be placed within a specific department within Technology. As an Associate Software Engineer, you will:

  • Support part of the software development process: Design, develop, modify, adapt and implement short- and long-term solutions to information technology needs through new and existing applications, systems, databases and applications infrastructure

  • Review and interpret system requirements and business processes

  • Code, test, debug and implement software solutions

  • Recommend technical solutions based on partnership with our senior engineers

  • Implement automated testing

  • Work with existing data models and schemas

  • Apply strong logic and reasoning capabilities

  • Build industry knowledge to support the software development activities and understand the work of the team.

Areas of Interest:

  • Software Engineering (Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL, Git, CI/CD, Docker)

  • Mobile Application Development (iOS/Swift, Android/Java, Apple Testflight, Google Firebase)

  • Cloud Computing (Amazon Web Services: Development and Operations, Systems Administration, App Support)

  • Operating Systems (Linux)

  • Machine learning

Qualifications

Required:

  • Full time student with an expected graduation date of December 2025 – May/June 2026.

  • Minimum GPA: 3.00 overall

  • Major: Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering

  • Cognizant of relevant and modern software methodologies (e.g., Scrum) and understands their role as part of software delivery team

  • Demonstrate competence in at least one programming language or technology

Preferred:

  • Previous internship experience in financial services

  • Actively seeks feedback and mentorship to improve technical skills (e.g., through submitting work for code review)

  • A commitment to continuous learning and development

Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States (e.g., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant work status).

FINRA Requirements

FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role.

Work Flexibility

This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home.

Base Salary Ranges

Please review the job posting for the location of this specific opportunity.

$25 per hour for the location of: Maryland, Colorado, Washington and remote workers
$25 per hour for the location of: Washington, D.C.
$25 per hour for the location of: New York, California

This job is eligible for overtime pay.

Placement within the range provided above is based on the individual’s relevant experience and skills for the role. Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, which is determined upon company and individual performance.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At T. Rowe Price, our associates are our greatest asset. We thrive because our company culture is built on inclusion and because we sustain a work environment where associates can bring their best selves to work every day. The backgrounds, talents, and experiences of our global associates allow us to embrace new ideas and perspectives that move our business priorities forward and enable us to deliver strong client outcomes. Here, you can expect equal opportunity and fair and consistent treatment for all.

Benefits

We value your goals and needs, at work and in life. As an associate, you’ll be supported with resources, benefits, and work-life balance so you can thrive in ways that matter to you.

Featured employee benefits to enrich your life:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Annual bonus eligibility

  • A generous retirement plan

  • Hybrid work schedule

  • Health and wellness benefits, including online therapy

  • Paid time off for vacation, illness, medical appointments, and volunteering days

  • Family care resources, including fertility and adoption benefits

Learn more about our benefits.

T. Rowe Price is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity of thought, gender, and race. We believe our continued success depends upon the equal treatment of all associates and applicants for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, gender, age, mental or physical disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, or any other classification protected by country, federal, state, or local law.

title: Master Planner till Sherwin-Williams i Nässjö
description:
Är du analytisk, strukturerad och gillar att få saker att hända? Då kan det här vara nästa steg för dig!

Vi på Uniflex Höglandet söker nu en Master Planner till vår kund Sherwin-Williams i Nässjö. Här får du möjlighet att kliva in i en viktig roll inom Supply Chain och arbeta med planering, lagerstyrning, prognoser och produktion i en internationell organisation.

Det här är en roll för dig som gillar att kombinera analys med problemlösning och samarbete – och som trivs när du får ta ansvar och påverka hur verksamheten fungerar.

Om rollen

Som Master Planner blir du en viktig länk mellan försäljning, produktion, lager och kundservice. Ditt fokus blir att skapa en så bra balans som möjligt mellan efterfrågan, produktionskapacitet och lagernivåer.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Planera och följa upp lager av färdiga produkter.

  • Arbeta med säkerhetslager, lagerdagar och lagernivåer.

  • Analysera försäljningsdata och prognoser.

  • Säkerställa att produktionsplaneringen möter verksamhetens behov.

  • Identifiera och driva åtgärder kring överskotts- och inkuranslager.

  • Ta fram och följa upp relevanta KPI:er, exempelvis leveransprecision och Days of Supply.

  • Samarbeta nära produktion, kundservice, försäljning och andra funktioner.

  • Driva förbättringar av planeringsprocesser och arbetssätt.

  • Vara delaktig vid produktintroduktioner, utfasningar och produktöverföringar.

Du får med andra ord en bred roll med stor kontaktyta och möjlighet att göra skillnad.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en person som gillar att förstå varför saker händer och hur de kan göras bättre. Du är analytisk och noggrann, men samtidigt tillräckligt flexibel för att kunna hantera när förutsättningarna förändras.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har:

  • Högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis teknik, ekonomi eller Supply Chain, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet.

  • Erfarenhet av Supply Chain, materialplanering, produktionsplanering eller lagerstyrning.

  • God förståelse för planerings- och lagerprocesser.

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och vana att arbeta med data och analyser.

  • God kommunikativ förmåga på både svenska och engelska.

  • Förmåga att samarbeta med olika funktioner och skapa förtroende i organisationen.

Erfarenhet av Access är meriterande.

Det viktigaste är dock att du är driven, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad och att du trivs med att ta ansvar.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Som konsult hos Uniflex får du en arbetsgivare som finns med dig under hela uppdraget. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att du ska trivas, utvecklas och känna dig trygg i din roll.

Du får möjlighet att komma in i en internationell och välrenommerad organisation, samtidigt som du har Uniflex som arbetsgivare och stöd längs vägen.

Uppdraget är ett vikariat på heltid med placering i Nässjö, med start så snart som möjligt och planerad slutdag 31 augusti 2027.

Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Om företaget Uniflex är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med över 20 års erfarenhet av att matcha rätt kompetens med rätt arbetsplats. Sedan 2002 har vi hjälpt företag att hitta rätt kompetens inom teknik, industri, administration, kundservice och andra tjänstemannaroller.

Vi arbetar med rekrytering, bemanning, interimslösningar och samarbeten med underkonsulter – från specialister till ledare och roller inom administration och kontor. Genom åren har vi framgångsrikt matchat tusentals medarbetare med både små och stora verksamheter över hela landet.

Let’s get to work!

title: Director, Talent Management & Workforce Insights
description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer and serving as a member of the HR Leadership Team, the Director, Talent Management & Workforce Insights leads a broad enterprise portfolio spanning Total Rewards, Organizational Development, HR Operations and People Analytics. The role is accountable for the ongoing evolution of the firm's people programs, systems and enterprise HR services, ensuring they support business priorities and deliver a consistent and high-quality experience for our people.

Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition and leaders across the firm, the Director translates the firm's people strategy into practical, scalable and measurable outcomes. Through workforce insights, organizational expertise and disciplined execution, the role enables better people decisions across the firm while helping leaders strengthen organizational and business performance.

Key Accountabilities

Portfolio Leadership

  • Lead the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio, establishing clear priorities, accountabilities and measures of success.
  • Translate the firm's people strategy into firmwide initiatives, investments and outcomes that support business objectives.
  • Use market intelligence, workforce data and business insights to identify, inform and translate opportunities, strategies, risks and decisions into practical recommendations.
  • Ensure programs, systems and services operate as an integrated portfolio that delivers value for the business and our people.
  • Drive the ongoing evaluation and continuous improvement of enterprise people programs, policies and services.
  • Foster strong collaboration across HR to ensure firmwide solutions are practical, scalable and responsive to business needs.

Total Rewards, Performance & Wellbeing

  • Provide strategic leadership for the firm's Total Rewards portfolio, including compensation, recognition, benefits, wellbeing and performance management.
  • Ensure rewards programs remain competitive, sustainable and aligned with business priorities, market trends and workforce expectations.
  • Oversee the design and evolution of reward, recognition and performance practices that support attraction, retention, engagement and a high-performance culture.

Workforce Insights & Analytics

  • Advance the firm's workforce insights capability by evolving People Analytics into a strategic source of insight and decision support.
  • Identify workforce trends, risks and opportunities through reporting, analytics and data-driven analysis, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Strengthen workforce data governance, analytics capability and evidence-based decision-making across HR programs, workforce planning and talent strategies.

Organizational Effectiveness & Development

  • Lead the evolution of the firm's organizational effectiveness agenda, ensuring BDO has the leadership, organizational capabilities and workforce readiness required to support future business needs.
  • Partner with business leaders and HR Business Partners to strengthen leadership effectiveness, team performance, organizational design and change readiness across the firm.
  • Advance scalable organizational development practices that help the firm adapt to changing workforce expectations, emerging technologies and evolving business priorities.

HR Operations & Service Excellence

  • Provide strategic leadership for HR operations, systems and service delivery, ensuring efficient, consistent and high-quality support for employees, leaders and HR teams.
  • Modernize HR processes and ways of working by leveraging technology, automation and AI to improve efficiency, user experience and business outcomes.
  • Establish service standards, governance and performance measures that promote accountability, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Relationships & People Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships across the firm and serve as a strategic advisor on talent, workforce and organizational matters.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Strengthen leadership capability, succession and organizational effectiveness across the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio.

What You Will Help Us Achieve

Success in this role means:

  • A connected and high-performing Talent Management portfolio that delivers measurable value to the business and our people.
  • Modern, competitive people programs that support attraction, retention, wellbeing and performance.
  • A workforce insights capability that enables stronger business, talent and workforce decisions.
  • Enhanced organizational effectiveness and readiness for future business challenges.
  • Efficient, scalable and employee-centric HR operations and services.

What You Bring

  • Significant senior HR leadership experience within a complex organization, including leadership of multiple enterprise talent management or centre-of-expertise functions.
  • Experience leading complex talent management portfolios, combined with deep expertise in one or more areas such as Total Rewards, People Analytics, organizational development, workforce planning or organizational effectiveness.
  • Experience leading the design, evolution or transformation of enterprise HR programs, functions or operating models.
  • A track record of using workforce data, analytics and organizational insights to influence business decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and innovation mindset, with evidence of challenging traditional approaches and identifying opportunities to improve employee experience, organizational effectiveness and business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of emerging workforce trends and technologies, including artificial intelligence, and the ability to translate new capabilities into practical business, talent and workforce solutions.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to align and lead diverse specialist teams, fostering collaboration, shared accountability and enterprise-wide outcomes across multiple HR disciplines.
  • Strong judgement and business acumen, with the ability to balance employee experience, business priorities, risk and operational realities.
  • Experience within professional services or another complex, relationship-driven organization would be considered a strong asset.
  • University degree in Human Resources, Business or a related discipline. A relevant professional designation and/or advanced degree would be considered an asset.


Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.


At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars—Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next - shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

  • We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
  • We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
  • We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
  • We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
  • We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up: Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter: We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts: We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.


Flexibility: All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.

Code of Conduct: Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public.

BDO may use artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. While these tools assist our teams, our use of AI does not replace human decision making, and all employment-related outcomes are made by BDO personnel.

Privacy Policy | BDO Canada

title: QA Analyst
description:
The Specialty Synthesis Group Quality Assurance Team is looking to add a Quality Assurance Analyst to the dynamic group. PPG's Specialty Products is committed to product innovation, technology leadership and high performance materials for a wide range of applications and industries. Solving complex problems with unique solutions has been the legacy of PPG and improving the performance features and benefits of our customers’ products will continue to drive our customer relationships and technology innovations. As QA Analyst, you will work out of the Monroeville, PA facility and report to the Quality Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Timely preparation and submission of analytical samples for incoming raw materials, in-process batches and finished goods
  • Tabulation and interpretation of analytical test data
  • Liaison between production groups and QC Test Lab.
  • Raw material and batch approval to established specifications
  • Reporting and communication of batch dispositions
  • Participation in root cause investigations and problem-solving activities
  • Support Quality Management System Activities
  • Develop personally and professionally through work experience and by acquisition of new skills as determined by the expanding needs of the position.

Qualifications

  • B.S. degree in chemistry related field preferred with experience in quantitative analysis of HPLC, UPLC and GC techniques.
  • Quality Control or Quality Assurance experience is desirable.
  • Ability to perform light duty work including lifting a minimum of 25 lbs.

About us:

PPG: WE PROTECT AND BEAUTIFY THE WORLD®

Through leadership in innovation, sustainability and color, PPG helps customers in industrial, transportation, consumer products, and construction markets and aftermarkets to enhance more surfaces in more ways than does any other company. To learn more, visit www.ppg.com and follow @PPG on X.

The PPG Way 2030

We are customer champions

Proactive. Bold. Trustworthy. Everything we do starts with our customers. We listen, move fast and don’t stop until we solve their biggest challenges. When our customers win, we all grow.

We act with purpose and speed

Agile. Data-driven. Empowered. We take smart risks to stay ahead of the competition. We work proactively with agility, using quality data to develop solutions that create value.

title: Managing Director, Visual Communications Consulting
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

About the Practice

Visual Communications Consulting (VCC) sits inside Disputes & Economics and serves every practice on the Ankura map. We are one bench with three doors. Trial Studio delivers courtroom-grade demonstratives, scientific illustration, 2D and 3D animation, jury research, courtroom technology, and opening and closing presentations built shoulder to shoulder with counsel. Creative Comms carries transformation narratives, executive and board storytelling, crisis and litigation communications, and employee campaigns. Net New Creative is the multiplier: AI-augmented production, analytics storytelling, interactive exhibits, explainability design for models and data, and a content engine that runs across social, video, web, and events, all operating inside the firm's secure AI environment. The overlaps are the offer. Every practice at Ankura produces analysis that must persuade someone; VCC exists to bring those stories to life. We are expanding from a regional trial-services practice into a national and, in time, global one, and we are hiring the leaders who will build it.

The Role

We are looking for a Managing Director to do two things at once: lead the Creative Communications arc of the practice nationally, and anchor our regional expansion into Houston and Dallas. This is an origination role for a creative leader who has already run a strategic communications and creative function inside a consulting or professional services firm, who has produced litigation graphics and trial communications for high-stakes disputes, and who has sold, staffed, and delivered work that a client paid for on its own merits.

You will build a book. You will carry relationships with general counsel, communications chiefs, and outside counsel across energy, industrial, manufacturing, construction, and adjacent sectors where Houston and Dallas give us a natural foothold. You will work alongside Ankura's Forensics & Investigations, Risk & Compliance, Cybersecurity, Turnaround & Restructuring, and Global Strategic Advisory practices to bring visual and narrative intelligence into their engagements, billed to the client and accretive to the work. And you will lead the standing up of the Houston pod, a Trial Director and Trial Technician team backed by the core studio, from a vetted contractor network into a permanent presence as demand proves out.

The right person is as comfortable in a war room the night before opening statements as in a boardroom presenting a change narrative to a CEO, and is already producing with generative AI tools rather than reading about them.

What You Will Do

  • Originate and lead client engagements across litigation communications, crisis and issues management, investor and stakeholder communications, transformation and change narratives, and executive and board storytelling.

  • Serve as the practice's senior presence in Houston and Dallas: build the regional pipeline, develop relationships with law firms, corporate legal and communications leaders, and Ankura colleagues in the region, and lead the establishment of a regional trial services pod.

  • Direct trial visual communications on high-stakes matters, translating scientific, financial, and technical evidence into persuasive, courtroom-ready visuals in partnership with counsel and Ankura testifying experts.

  • Partner with Ankura practice leaders across the firm to scope, price, and deliver visual and narrative work as an accretive component of their engagements, and coach them on where that work adds value.

  • Lead cross-functional creative teams delivering presentations, video, web, paid and organic social, live events, and interactive content, managing quality, budgets, vendors, and margins.

  • Champion AI-augmented production across the practice: adopt, evaluate, and govern generative video, image, audio, and application tools inside the firm's secure AI environment, and build the training and change communications that drive adoption inside Ankura and for clients.

  • Recruit, develop, and mentor senior creative talent; contribute to hiring plans, upskilling programs, and the practice's revenue and utilization goals.

  • Contribute to the practice's thought leadership, conference presence, and marketing in the region and nationally.

What You Bring

  • Fifteen or more years in strategic communications, creative direction, or digital strategy, including senior leadership inside a consulting, professional services, or agency environment where your work was billed to clients.

  • Demonstrated origination: a record of winning and growing client relationships, ideally including anchor accounts you built and sustained.

  • Direct experience producing litigation graphics, trial presentations, or dispute-related communications for major matters, and fluency working with trial counsel and expert witnesses.

  • A portfolio spanning brand positioning, investor and financial communications, advocacy or public affairs campaigns, crisis response, and enterprise change communications, with measurable outcomes.

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams and managing budgets, vendors, and delivery across web, video, social, events, and print.

  • Working fluency with current generative AI production tools and a track record of driving AI adoption inside an organization.

  • Sector depth in energy, industrial, manufacturing, or construction, or another sector concentrated in the Texas market, is strongly preferred.

  • Expert witness or testifying experience in design, packaging, manufacturing execution, or communications is a plus.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a GQ (Global Quality) Package Reliability Engineer at Micron Technology Inc., you will contribute significantly to assuring the outstanding quality and durability of Micron’s products. This distinctive position allows you to coordinate package qualification for new products and innovative builds, materials, and processes. Your insights will influence product release recommendations derived from package reliability test data, enabling Micron to compete worldwide.

You will develop reliability test plans to evaluate risks related to excursions, conversions, and qualification concerns. Additionally, you will manage root cause analysis and corrective measures within the GQ department for package-related qualification failures and RMAs, preparing detailed reports for review. Cooperation is essential as you offer assistance to internal and external customers regarding package-related quality and reliability matters, addressing customer inquiries promptly.

  • Coordinate package qualification efforts for new products and innovative builds
  • Offer suggestions regarding product launch grounded in reliability test outcomes
  • Develop reliability test plans to evaluate risk related to excursions, conversions, and qualification issues
  • Coordinate root cause analysis and corrective action efforts within the GQ department for qualification failures and RMAs
  • Prepare detailed reports for discussion
  • Offer assistance to internal and external customers regarding package-related quality and reliability concerns

Successful Candidates Will Have

  • Detailed understanding of semiconductor component package assembly processes and challenges
  • Understanding of surface mount methods and associated challenges
  • Understanding of mechanical and material interaction effects on IC components and/or PCB assemblies
  • Good understanding of the effects of thermomechanical, thermal, mechanical, and hygroscopic swelling stresses on package reliability

title: Senior Backend Engineer Go, AI platform
description:
Who We Are

Is dit de functie die u zoekt? Zo ja, lees dan verder voor meer details en zorg ervoor dat u vandaag nog solliciteert.

Prosus is a leading global technology company, based in Europe. With ecosystems that span India, Latin America, Europe and beyond, Prosus is the power behind some of the world’s leading lifestyle ecommerce brands. We own and invest in a portfolio of 100+ companies in sectors such as in food delivery, quick commerce, fintech and experiences, all of which help billions of people buy, sell and transact every day.


We connect these leading brands through our AI-driven ecosystem that leverages data to deliver seamless, personalised lifestyle-ecommerce experiences for buyers and sellers, reshaping exceptional service for our two billion customers. Few companies can connect people and problem-solve across borders, as we do.


Through our Ventures business we also invest in companies which inspire and support the Prosus ecosystem. We search for new opportunities at the leading edge of AI and ecommerce, the digital AI workforce and in frontier technologies, such as robotics, drones and synbio.


The Opportunity

Toqan is Prosus's internal AI platform — the infrastructure and tooling layer that powers AI-driven products across the entire group. The team is expanding into new product territory, and this role sits at the centre of that expansion: owning the design and delivery of MCP (Model Context Protocol) server infrastructure and multi-model LLM integrations in production.


This isn't a maintenance role. You'll be building something new — MCP server infrastructure that doesn't yet exist — and connecting it to a growing roster of AI and LLM providers so that Toqan products can move fast without sacrificing reliability. The measure of success is concrete: MCP servers live and serving at least two new Toqan products within twelve months, alongside measurable gains in backend service reliability and deployment frequency.


The Toqan platform serves the whole Prosus portfolio, which means the backend systems you build here have reach far beyond a single product team. You'll join a 10-person engineering team in Amsterdam and work closely with product and platform colleagues to ship end-to-end — at pace, without compromising quality.


Who You Are

You are a senior backend engineer who has moved well past following patterns and into setting them. You're comfortable owning architectural decisions on novel infrastructure — the kind where the right answer isn't obvious and the stakes are real. You think in systems, spot failure modes early, and hold a high bar for production quality without letting perfect block good. The 80/20 mindset comes naturally: you know when to go deep and when to ship.


You've likely come from a startup or high-velocity environment where shipping fast wasn't a culture slogan — it was survival. You know how to cut scope without cutting corners, move from zero to production without a safety net, and iterate quickly on systems that are still finding their shape.


You're genuinely curious about the AI and LLM space — not as a trend to track, but as a domain where you've already done hands‑on integration work and want to go further. AI tools aren't an afterthought in how you work — you use them daily, whether that's Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex, and you've developed real judgment about where they accelerate work and where they don't. You operate with low ego, share context freely, and thrive in an environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down — it's where you do your best work.


What You Bring

  • Strong Go programming skills with a track record of building and operating production backend services


  • Hands‑on AWS experience — designing, deploying, and operating cloud‑native services at scale


  • Direct experience building MCP servers or working with Model Context Protocol in a real integration context


  • Practical experience integrating with multiple AI and LLM providers in production, translating model capabilities into robust backend systems


  • Comfortable owning CI/CD pipelines, automated test infrastructure (unit, integration, E2E), and build systems


  • Proven track record of collaborating across product and platform teams to ship features end-to-end


  • Systems‑level thinking — you design for reliability, scalability, and performance from the start, not as an afterthought


  • Background in startups or fast‑moving product teams where you owned outcomes end‑to‑end and shipped without waiting for perfect conditions


  • Active use of AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar) as part of your regular workflow — not occasionally, but as a genuine productivity multiplier


  • Experience building and maintaining event‑sourced systems is a plus


  • Python programming skills are a plus


  • Experience using Generative AI and ML infrastructure tooling to drive measurable improvements in engineering efficiency is a plus



Your Typical Day

Your day might begin by reviewing the state of the MCP server infrastructure — checking integration health across AI model providers, triaging any overnight alerts, and picking up where yesterday's design work left off. You're deep in Go for much of the morning: building out a new server endpoint, tightening an integration with an LLM provider, or pairing with a teammate on a tricky reliability edge case — with AI coding tools alongside you, cutting the time from idea to working code.


Mid‑morning, you might sync with product and platform colleagues to align on what's shipping next — translating requirements into backend architecture decisions and flagging dependencies early. In the afternoon, you're often in the CI/CD pipeline or test infrastructure, improving deployment confidence so the team can move faster without breaking things.


Throughout the day, you're a thinking partner for the broader 10-person engineering team — sharing context, reviewing code, and applying AI tooling where it genuinely accelerates the work.


What We Offer

Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a hybrid work setup based in Amsterdam.


Full details shared during the process.


Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. title: Co-op or Intern, Personal Debt Solutions - Multiple Locations - September 2026
description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

Our Edmonton, Calgary, St. Johns and Halifax offices are looking for a Co-op or Intern Student to join the Personal Debt Solutions team from September to December 2026. This is a net new role and the successful candidate and own the following responsibilities:
  • Efficiently utilize technical knowledge from courses to calculate and review income

  • Participate in other insolvency related tasks as required and support CPC team members
  • Build positive working relationships with clients and effectively respond to request and suggestions

How do we define success for your role?

  • You understand your client’s industry, challenges, and opportunities; clients describe you as positive, professional, and delivering high-quality work
  • You identify, recommend, & are focused on effective service delivery to your clients
  • You share in an inclusive & engaging work environment that develops, retains & attracts talent

Your experience and education

  • You display strong problem solving, analytical, and communication skills.


Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.


At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars—Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next - shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

  • We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
  • We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.

Giving back adds up: Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

title: PGIM Real Estate -Senior Investment Associate
description:
Job Classification:

Investment Management - Investments

A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

What you will do

PGIM Real Estate’s Originations team engages in all aspects of the loan origination process. As a Senior Investment Associate on the Northeast Originations team, you would be responsible for helping to facilitate the originations of multifamily and commercial real estate debt investments for Prudential's wide variety of capital sources including general account, separate accounts, core plus debt fund, structured debt strategies, Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and FHA.

This person will join a fully integrated mortgage origination team responsible for $2.5 billion+ of annual production. The expectation is that the Senior Investment Associate will develop and leverage internal and external relationships in order to efficiently guide all transactions through the approval and closing process. The individual will assume a leadership role in assisting the team with the daily operations to include training and oversight for the team’s analysts which includes reviewing underwriting and case file/authorization packages.

What you can expect

  • Assist the team’s Loan Officers in all aspects of the loan origination and closing process, including analysis and underwriting, debt structuring, pricing strategy, creating presentations to senior management for pricing and loan authorization, due diligence review, transaction negotiation and closing.
  • Involvement in all aspects of Core Plus transactions to include initial screening, underwriting, modeling, term sheet completion/negotiation, and compiling Investment Committee/loan authorization materials.
  • Involvement and management of legal aspects of the loan origination/closing process.
  • Assisting the team’s Loan Officers with market knowledge/expertise, i.e., become well versed in the region for which the team is responsible.
  • Maintain responsibility for assisting the team’s analysts and associates with closing and due diligence review.
  • Manage training and maintain oversight for the team’s analysts and associates.
  • Interact with existing and prospective borrowers, intermediaries, industry peers and the legal community on deals.
  • Develop internal relationships with the Credit and Portfolio Management teams. As well as external relationships with prospective borrowers and intermediaries while maintaining and building enduring relationships with existing clients across the platform to help facilitate the transaction process.
  • Develop expertise in all PGIM systems necessary for the originations process, i.e., Salesforce, Omnia, Loan Connect, etc.

What you will bring

  • Bachelor's Degree and 5+ years of experience in commercial real estate lending
  • A credit mindset and the ability to review, structure and underwrite loans to mitigate risks corresponding to the needs of PGIM’s various capital sources.
  • Strong quantitative skills and demonstrated analytical ability.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Outstanding written, oral communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as an integral member of a team.
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications, (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint) required.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally and attend industry events and conferences, required.
  • Interact professionally with internal and external parties, including originations, transactions, risk, legal, developers, investment firms, borrowers, and third‐party service providers.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability.

What will set you apart

  • Experience working with all real estate asset classes.
  • Experience using Argus Enterprise
  • Self‐motivated with perseverance, and a hands‐on, proactive style.
  • MBA from a top program preferred, but candidates with additional lending experience will be given similar consideration.

*PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

Note: Prudential is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The salary range for this role is from $135,000 to $150,000. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills. Roles may also be eligible for additional compensation and/or benefits.

About PGIM Real Estate

With $207.9 billion in gross assets under management and administration ($133.8 billion net),1 PGIM Real Estate provides investors and borrowers access to a range of real estate equity, real estate debt, agriculture, and impact solutions across the risk-return spectrum.

PGIM Real Estate is a business of PGIM, the global asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU). PGIM Real Estate’s risk management approach, execution capabilities and industry insights are backed by a 50-year legacy of investing in commercial real estate, a 140-year history of real estate financing,2 and the local experience of professionals in 32 cities globally. Through its investment, financing, asset management, and talent management approach, PGIM Real Estate engages in practices that strive to ignite positive environmental and social impact, while pursuing activities that seek to strengthen communities around the world. For more information visit pgimrealestate.com.

What we offer you:


  • Market competitive base salaries, with a yearly bonus potential at every level.
  • Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), and leave of absences, such as parental and military leave.
  • 401(k) plan with company match (up to 4%).
  • Company-funded pension plan.
  • Wellness Programs including up to $1,600 a year for reimbursement of items purchased to support personal wellbeing needs.
  • Work/Life Resources to help support topics such as parenting, housing, senior care, finances, pets, legal matters, education, emotional and mental health, and career development.
  • Education Benefit to help finance traditional college enrollment toward obtaining an approved degree and many accredited certificate programs.
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Shares can be purchased at 85% of the lower of two prices (Beginning or End of the purchase period).

Eligibility to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. To find out more about our Total Rewards package, visit Work Life Balance | Prudential Careers. Some of the above benefits may not apply to part-time employees scheduled to work less than 20 hours per week.


Prudential Financial, Inc. of the United States is not affiliated with Prudential plc. which is headquartered in the United Kingdom.


Prudential is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetics, disability, marital status, age, veteran status, domestic partner status, medical condition or any other characteristic protected by law.


If you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please email accommodations.hw@prudential.com.

If you are experiencing a technical issue with your application or an assessment, please email careers.technicalsupport@prudential.com to request assistance.

title: Universal Banker I - McKinney Henneman, Texas
description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

SUMMARY/OBJECTIVES

The Universal Banker serves as a full service, single point of contact in the branch for SouthState customers’ financial needs. The position operates in the dual capacity of a Teller and FSR providing exceptional customer service in both transactional and account management. The Universal Banker seeks to attract, expand, and retain customer relationships and is responsible for contributing to the financial growth of the bank.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Serves customers quickly, accurately, efficiently, and confidentially according to the South State Bank Service Standards.
  • Knows and understand the products and services offered by the Bank. These include facts and features, benefits and advantages, rules and regulations, price structure, and a simple definition of each service offered.
  • Able to identify customer needs and expectations by listening for clues. Seeks the opportunity to expand customer relationships by making referrals as outlined in the goals for this position.
  • Presents a neat and professional personal appearance, in accordance with bank policy.
  • Knows and ensures compliance to all banking regulations to include Regulation CC and Bank Secrecy Act.
  • Develop a strong understanding of customer facing technology with the ability to discuss with and enroll customers in self-service options.
  • Teller Duties:

    Processes transactions for savings, checking, and loan accounts.

    Maintains a neat and orderly work area.

    May assist in guiding and training new tellers.

    May allow customers access to safe deposit boxes.

    Cashes checks and processes savings withdrawals within assigned limits and in accordance with prescribed procedures.

    Sells certified checks.

    Balances transactions daily.

    May service/balance ATM.

    May utilize the branch capture system.

    Knows and follows policies and procedures in completing transactions, minimizing operational errors, and maintaining a proper workflow.

    Knows and follows the branch’s security and audit procedures and understands the function and operation of the security devices.

  • FSR Duties:
    • Opens new deposit accounts and understands the products and financial services offered by the bank. Also handles other services such as stop payments, wire transfers, and other maintenance functions within assigned limits.
    • Explains policies and procedures as necessary, keeping in mind most customers’ unfamiliarity with them.
    • Resolves customer problems and complaints with courtesy and discretion and direction and directs customers with difficult problems to other sources for assistance. Considers problems and complaints as opportunities to satisfy the customer and promote additional services.
    • Is knowledgeable of financial services offered by the bank.
    • Shows sincere appreciation for each customer’s time and business. Gives business card if not already given.
    • Knows and follows the branch’s security and audit procedures and understands the function and operation of the security devices.
    • Assures that branch records, reports and other correspondence resulting from customer development attempts are correct, timely and are properly distributed.

UNIVERSAL BANKER FUNCTIONS

  • One year of teller or cash handling experience and six months customer relationship building or sales experience
  • Demonstrated expertise in the Teller II and basic FSR job functions
  • Additional Responsibilities may include Vault Responsibilities or Back-Up Vault Responsibilities
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications, Education, and Certification Requirements

  • Education: High School diploma or equivalent
  • Experience: Cash handling, sales, customer service. Previous banking experience preferred.
  • Specific Knowledge: Good interpersonal skills, good computer skills, ability to read, write, speak, and understand English

TRAINING REQUIREMENTS/CLASSES

  • The SouthState Way New Team Member Orientation
  • Teller Foundations
  • Banker Foundations
  • All assigned Regulatory Compliance Training
  • Acknowledgement of all policies through DocuSign as assigned
  • Additional training may be required dependent upon experience

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Must be able to lift, up to 50 pounds, must be able to stand and/or sit for long periods of time. Must be able to effectively access and interpret information on computer screens, documents, reports, and cash denominations, and identify customers.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position is most likely in an open lobby area with an individual workstation. The position is located inside a cooled and heated facility with ability to go to a break room or rest room during breaks.

TRAVEL

Travel may be required to come to meetings or training as needed.

Work Location: 7777 Henneman Way McKinney, Texas 75070

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled/veterans.

title: Principal Culture Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

We are hiring for a key role that sits at the heart of our employee experience and communication strategy! Our culture comes to life through the programs, processes, and connections our employees experience every day – from onboarding to the moments that shape their careers.

Based in Bedford, MA at AspenTech HQ, we are seeking a Principal Culture Specialist to help shape and tell the story of our culture as AspenTech continues to grow as part of Emerson. You will partner closely with HR, Marketing, the Control Systems and Software Business Group, and the HR Enterprise team at Emerson to design employee experience and learning programs, lead our global employee groups and legacy culture initiatives, and elevate how we communicate with our people, bringing
clarity, creativity, and a modern touch.

You are passionate about making an impact and bringing fresh thinking to how we engage and communicate globally. You push yourself to deliver meaningful results, and you are comfortable challenging the status quo with thoughtful, creative solutions. You communicate with clarity and confidence, and you genuinely enjoy connecting with people, shaping stories, and helping teams stay aligned and motivated. You are self-directed and resourceful, energized by ambiguity, and you thrive when working across levels, functions, and cultures with limited resources.

If you are keen to take on this challenge and make an impact, we would love to hear from you.

Your Impact

Employee Experience & Culture:

  • Lead the delivery of initiatives that advance our Engagement, Culture, and Communication plans globally.
  • Guide HR teams and managers through the employee listening cycle: from survey preparation and analysis to action planning and follow-through.
  • Champion an employee-centric environment through recognition programs, growth and learning opportunities, and employee feedback systems.
  • Align with global Employee Value Proposition initiatives, using tools and materials to embed components into the employee lifecycle.
  • Own and continuously modernize our onboarding program, enhancing the experience for Hiring Managers and new employees.
  • Lead Employee Resource Group (ERG) strategy and other employee-affinity groups at a global scale, helping them gain structure, visibility, and momentum.
  • Own and evolve legacy AspenTech culture initiatives: AspenFUN, AspenTech Gives Back, and volunteering events, ensuring they stay relevant and impactful.
  • Learning & Leadership Development:
  • Reshape and own AspenTech's Learning and Leadership Development strategy, programs, and offerings, including the deployment of relevant Emerson programs across our business.
  • Facilitate professional and leadership development programs, workshops, and learning labs across the organization.
  • Coordinate mentoring and development programs globally, using feedback to refine design and impact.

Communications:

  • Own the internal communications strategy, reviewing channels and platforms and defining the most effective approach for a global audience.
  • Develop modern, engaging communication templates that standardize people-related communications and employer branding content, collaborating with Marketing.
  • Implement tools and methods to measure communication effectiveness, providing insights and proposing improvements.
  • HR & Strategic Planning:
  • Support the Vice President, HR with strategic planning of our Business Unit operating rhythm, including HR leadership meetings, all-hands sessions, and additional touchpoints with executives, people managers, and all-employees.
  • Design agendas, themes, and core content that keep discussions focused, forward-looking, and aligned with business and transformation priorities.
  • Prepare materials, storylines, and visual content that elevate leadership conversations and decision-making.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Collaborate closely with the Control Systems and Software Business Group and the HR Enterprise team at Emerson to align programs and share best practices.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships across HR, Marketing, and business leaders to connect people, ideas, and initiatives.

  • Background in leading change, with a track record of making progress toward goals.
  • Experience leading events, training programs, or employee groups, from development to delivery, in collaboration with key partners.

  • Familiarity with employer branding and how internal and external communications align preferred.

title: Firmware Systems Manager
description:
Build the Software Foundation Behind Autonomous Systems

Leidos is seeking a Firmware Systems Manager to lead and develop a team of engineers building the low-level software that connects sensors, hardware, and mission software across autonomous maritime systems.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role for someone with a strong background in embedded software or firmware who is ready to take on broader responsibility for people, engineering process, and technical execution. The successful candidate does not need to be the most senior firmware expert in the room, but should understand how disciplined software engineering practices translate into reliable embedded systems.

You will work closely with software, hardware, systems engineering, integration, and program teams to ensure firmware is developed, reviewed, tested, controlled, integrated, and released using sound engineering practices.

Responsibilities

Firmware & Software Engineering Leadership

  • Provide technical guidance and day-to-day leadership for engineers developing bare-metal and low-level embedded software.
  • Support development of firmware architectures, interfaces, drivers, and hardware/software integration approaches.
  • Maintain a working understanding of microcontroller-based systems, real-time behavior, hardware interfaces, and embedded C/C++ development.
  • Participate in and facilitate software and firmware design reviews and technical peer reviews.
  • Help engineers investigate and resolve complex hardware/software integration issues.
  • Promote maintainable, testable, and well-documented firmware designs.

Software Development Process

  • Establish and reinforce disciplined software development practices across firmware efforts.
  • Ensure effective use of source control, branching strategies, configuration management, and controlled software releases.
  • Promote effective peer review and pull-request workflows, including appropriate review of design and implementation changes.
  • Support development and improvement of CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, static analysis, unit testing, and other automated quality checks.
  • Promote appropriate use of Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), bench testing, and automated integration testing.
  • Ensure firmware baselines, dependencies, build environments, and released artifacts are reproducible and appropriately controlled.
  • Work with engineering teams to continuously improve development, integration, verification, and release processes.

People & Team Leadership

  • Directly manage and develop firmware and embedded software engineers.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, coaching, performance discussions, and career development activities.
  • Help engineers grow both technically and professionally while building greater ownership and independence.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, staffing, and development of the firmware team.
  • Foster a collaborative engineering culture built around accountability, technical rigor, continuous learning, and constructive peer review.
  • Report to the division-level Software/Firmware Engineering Manager.

Program & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Work closely with Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Integration & Test, and Program Management.
  • Help translate system and hardware requirements into executable firmware development activities.
  • Coordinate firmware development and integration activities across projects.
  • Identify technical, process, schedule, and integration risks and work with engineering teams to resolve them.
  • Support technical reviews, integration events, demonstrations, and customer deliverables.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience developing embedded software, firmware, or closely related software systems.
  • Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers, leading small teams, or coordinating engineering activities.
  • Proficiency with C/C++ and familiarity with embedded software development.
  • Experience working with microcontrollers, hardware interfaces, peripherals, drivers, or similar low-level systems.
  • Working knowledge of modern software engineering practices including:
    • Git or comparable source-control systems
    • Configuration management and software release practices
    • Peer review / pull-request workflows
    • Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
    • Automated build and test environments
    • Unit, integration, SIL, and/or HIL testing
    • Software design and technical reviews
  • Experience debugging software and hardware/software integration problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government SECRET security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as an engineering lead, technical lead, team lead, or first-line manager.
  • Experience developing embedded software for autonomous systems, robotics, maritime systems, or other complex electromechanical platforms.
  • Experience with STM32 or similar microcontroller families.
  • Familiarity with JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and embedded debugging techniques.
  • Experience implementing or improving CI/CD and automated testing for embedded systems.
  • Experience developing SIL/HIL environments or automated hardware test infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with requirements management, software configuration management, and formal software release processes.
  • Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) or bare-metal embedded development.
  • Familiarity with high-reliability or safety-focused software development practices.
  • Experience working in classified or regulated engineering environments.

Position Summary

This is a full-time position in department with the primary responsibility for overseeing and managing the Biological Safety Division within department. The BSO serves as the Chief Administrative Officer for the WU Institutional Biological Safety Committee (IBC) and as the Responsible Official for the WU select agent program. The BSO also provides consultation services for other departments in the University for issues involving biological safety and serves as a liaison between department and other University departments on a project-specific basis. The BSO is responsible for development and maintenance of policies, procedures, and training materials related to biological safety.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Chief Administrative Officer and an ex officio member of the WU Institutional Biological Safety Committee (IBC), including fulfilling all BSO responsibilities as described in the NIH Guidelines for Research Involving Recombinant DNA Molecules. Perform initial risk assessment and review of all projects submitted and forward to the IBC all research that requires full committee review (as mandated by the NIH Guidelines).
  • Provide consultation to other University departments on matters of biological safety, including: work with hazardous or infectious agents in research animals; design or renovation of research laboratories; import/export permits required for shipping/receiving potentially infectious materials; and training requirements for individuals in different work environments.
  • Develop training materials, policies, and procedures related to the safe handling of hazardous or potentially infectious materials in research laboratories or clinics. Update these materials as needed to stay current with federal, local and state regulations and University policies.

  • Inspect the University’s BSL3 and select agent laboratories.

description:
YouTube’s Social, Community and Escalation Operations team works 24/7 at the forefront of online engagement, managing both public conversations and sensitive user interactions. We are the brand's voice on social and community channels, actively shaping public discourse, fostering community growth, and scaling support. Simultaneously, we protect brand reputation and user safety through direct outreach and expert escalation management for sensitive and security-related issues.

As the Analyst for Operational Metrics and Performance within the Social and Escalation Operations team, you will provide the business with accurate, real-time visibility into operational health, social and escalation queue stability, and staffing capacity. You will be the architect of our data-driven decision-making process, designing the metrics that measure our success and ensuring our global teams have the insights they need to stay ahead of sensitive escalations, and inform product teams on scaled support trends.

Your role is critical in enabling the organization to access complex data easily and identify the trends necessary to inform performance assessments and strategic shifts. You will bridge the gap between raw data and actionable intelligence, automating reporting workflows and standardizing operational definitions across our entire support ecosystem.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $148000 - $214000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Own the design and strategy for metrics across all operations, standardizing definitions for critical Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as handling times, backlog, and Service-level agreement (SLA) to ensure global consistency.
