  • Lead the automation and maintenance of regular reporting and insight generation for the organization, ensuring seamless cross-functional visibility into operational health and performance trends.

title: CI | Data Engineer | Consultancy | Amsterdam | 90k
description:
CI | Data Engineer | Consultancy | Amsterdam | 90k

Solliciteer (door op de betreffende knop te klikken) na het doornemen van alle gerelateerde vacature-informatie hieronder.

Als Data Engineer vind je het leuk om aan complexe data vraagstukken te werken. Je bent de spin in het web als het gaat om het extraheren, transformeren en klaarzetten van data voor verder gebruik binnen organisaties, rekening houdend met de performance van de dataverwerking middels jobs die jij zelf configureert en beheert. Daarnaast zit je boordevol ideeën hoe de omgeving te verbeteren, waarbij je steeds de klant centraal plaatst. Het leren van nieuwe technieken is de reden waarom je dit werk hebt gekozen: nooit saai en volop mogelijkheden.


Over de organisatie

Wij zetten onze consultants in op hoogwaardige IT projecten door heel Nederland. Met de kennis die onze specialisten in huis hebben, adviseren wij teams en zetten koers naar innovatie. Nieuwe tooling helpt ons om klanten keer op keer te verrassen. Tussen alle IT consultancy bureaus vallen we misschien niet direct op in wat we doen, maar wel in hoe we het doen. Wij zijn opgesplitst in vier business units met ieder een eigen expertise. Niet dat we ervan houden om in hokjes te denken, maar dit werkt in de praktijk het beste. Bij een klant meedraaien in een team tot aan het uit de grond stampen van een splinternieuwe dataomgeving: als dataspecialist komt er van alles op je bord. Je collega's tref je bij een gezamenlijke data kantoordag, kennissessie of memorabel uitje.


Ons aanbod

Bij ons krijg je direct een vast contract voor 36 of 40 uur per week. De arbeidsvoorwaarden bij deze vacature zijn een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.200 en €6.200, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring, met 8% vakantiegeld en 24 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. Je krijgt pensioenopbouw, een telefoonvergoeding en een laptop naar keuze, en eenmalig €1.000 budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. Daarnaast ontvang je een auto van de zaak of mobiliteitsbudget met een kilometervergoeding, een ruim ontwikkelbudget voor trainingen en certificeringen, en flexibiliteit om thuis, op kantoor en bij de klant te werken.


Jouw profiel

De ideale kandidaat bestaat misschien niet. Toch zoeken we iemand die er dichtbij in de buurt komt. Want als data engineer ben je je ervan bewust dat jouw rol altijd in ontwikkeling is. Daarom doe je graag nieuwe kennis op en ben je creatief in het bedenken van oplossingen om klanten te verbluffen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, hebt een sterke klantfocus en kunt zelfstandig uit de voeten. Wat je meebrengt is dat je zelfstandig een dataomgeving kunt ontwerpen, bouwen en in gebruik nemen in een cloudomgeving zoals Azure, AWS of GCP. Je hebt ruime ervaring met de ETL methode en weet nieuwe data op een efficiënte manier te verwerken tot bruikbare datasets. Certificeringen zijn geen eis, maar wel een pré. Python en data libraries zoals Pandas, Numpy, PySpark en Matplotlib lezen en schrijven is geen probleem voor je. Kennis van DevOps, CI/CD tooling, Docker of Kubernetes levert bonuspunten op.


Interesse?

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel en wil jij klanten helpen met hun data uitdagingen? xgiwjmb Neem dan contact op of solliciteer direct.

title: Hemstädare till norra Stockholm
description:
Städpulsen är ett företag som specialiserat sig på främst Svanenmärkt hemstädning, kontorsstädning samt andra hushållsnära tjänster. Företaget eftersträvar att minska klimatpåverkan, därmed transporterar sig de anställda i största möjliga mån med kommunaltrafik. I det dagliga arbetet används miljömärkta rengöringsmedel och material för att minska på förbrukningen av kemikalier och vatten.

Företaget har kring 200 medarbetare som dagligen levererar service till organisationer och privatpersoner i hela Sverige, från Uppsala till Skåne.

Beskrivning

Brinner du för att hålla rent och fint? Bor du eller kan tänka dig arbeta i Norra Stockholm såsom Täby, Sollentuna, Vallentuna med omnejd? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

Städpulsen söker nu efter nya kollegor som vill jobba inom hemstäd. Vi är väldigt flexibla när vi bygger schemat eftersom vi tar hänsyn till dina förutsättningar samtidigt som vi kombinerar detta med vårt behov av personal.

För att arbeta hos oss är det viktigt att du har sinne för detaljer, är självgående, vågar ta initiativ och brinner för kvalitet. Vi värderar positiv attityd och god service eftersom du som anställd hos oss kommer att bli en del av våra kunders vardag.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer att arbeta med hemstädning hemma hos våra privata kunder. Vissa dagar befinner du dig hos samma kund, och andra dagar har du flera kunder. Arbetet kan komma ske individuellt eller i grupp.

Kvalifikationer

Vi ser gärna att du:

* Kan arbeta ensam och i grupp

* Har körkort

* Kan arbeta i ett hem där det kan finnas husdjur så som hund och katt

* Talar svenska eller engelska för att kunna kommunicera med kunderna och läsa instruktioner

* Har dator/telefonvana för att kunna läsa digitala scheman och instruktioner

Meriterande

* Tidigare erfarenhet av hemstädning eller lokalvård

* Tidigare erfarenhet av fönsterputs

Villkor

* Varierande arbetstider på vardagar mellan klockan 7-17

* Anställningsform: vid behov med chans till anställning

* Friskvårds bidrag

* Vid anställning får du tillgång till vår egna utbildningsportal

* Start omgående eller enligt överenskommelse

* Avtalsenliga löner

Stämmer detta in på dig? Inkom med din ansökan snarast då intervjuer och rekrytering sker löpande!

title: Fasadmontör
description:
Vi söker Fasadmontörer – Ansök idag!

Vill du vara med och leverera hållbara lösningar i ett innovativt företag med stora utvecklingsmöjligheter? Då har vi jobbet för dig!

Om rollen Som fasadarbetare kommer du att arbeta med montering av fasadmaterial som bland annat glas, puts och plåt. Du bidrar till att skapa hållbara och kvalitativa lösningar för våra kunder över hela Sverige.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Montera och installera fasadmaterial.

  • Arbeta effektivt och kvalitetsmedvetet.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har erfarenhet inom byggbranschen - uppskattas

  • Är lösningsorienterad, noggrann och trivs i högt tempo.

  • Har god samarbetsförmåga och tar egna initiativ.

  • Inte rädd för att jobba på hög höjd

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Kollektivavtal enligt Plåt- och Ventilationsavtalet

  • Tjänstepension via Fora

  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 3000 kr/år

  • Arbetstidsförkortning – 5 extra lediga dagar/år utöver den lagstadgade semestern

  • Möjlighet till utveckling inom företaget

  • Ett inkluderande arbetsklimat där vi stöttar varandra

Placering och arbetsort

Vårt huvudkontor ligger i Stockholm, och det är härifrån vi utgår. Vi har projekt på flera platser i Sverige, och i ansökan kan du ange om du föredrar att arbeta i Stockholm eller på annan ort.

Observera: Byggbranschen är rörlig, och vi kan därför inte garantera en fast tjänst på en specifik ort – inte ens i Stockholm. Om du söker jobb i Göteborg eller annan stad utanför Stockholm kan det handla om tillfälliga traktamenteprojekt, men det är inte säkert att sådana finns tillgängliga vid varje tillfälle.

Vi ser det som positivt om du är öppen för att arbeta på olika platser, även om vi självklart lyssnar på dina önskemål.

Om oss

LW Sverige AB är en ledande aktör inom klimatskal – vi bygger och underhåller tak och fasader i hela Sverige. Vi är cirka 180 medarbetare och växer stadigt. Hos oss får du vara med och skapa något beständigt – både i våra projekt och i din egen yrkesutveckling.

Vi värdesätter mångfald och jämställdhet och ser gärna kvinnliga sökande – vi tror på styrkan i blandade team!

Låter detta intressant? Ansök idag och bli en del av vårt team! Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.

title: Reservoirs Graduate Programmes
description:
Salary: £33,000 Permanent role.
Start date: September 2027

Location: Successful graduate will be based from Peterborough with occasional travel to our London hub (Kings Cross), one of our construction sites or a partner office. Please note your placements may vary across the region and departments so flexibility is essential.

Help shape the future of water, the environment and the communities we serve

With a plan worth over £11 billion of investment, we're building for better — for you, for the communities we serve, for our environment. As part of this we are looking for you to join Anglian Water's Graduate Programme and tackle some of the biggest environmental and infrastructure challenges facing the region. From climate resilience and major engineering projects to digital innovation and customer experience, you'll develop the skills, experience and support needed to become one of our future leaders or specialists.

Your career path

The water industry is changing rapidly, creating exciting opportunities for the next generation of talent. At Anglian Water, you'll work on real challenges that matter, developing expertise across your chosen profession while contributing to projects that support customers, communities and the environment.

You'll learn from experienced colleagues, take on meaningful responsibility and build the skills, knowledge and confidence to shape your future career, while helping us shape the future of water.

To find out more from our recent graduates please visit our Anglian Water careers page: Careers - Anglian Water - Join us and be part of the change

Professional Development & Memberships

We're committed to helping you build a career, not just gain a job. Through our two-year graduate programme, you'll experience different placements, work on real business challenges and learn from experienced colleagues across the organisation. You'll have access to a wide range of development opportunities, support towards professional qualifications and funded membership of a relevant professional institution, helping you grow your expertise and achieve professional accreditation where appropriate.

Your programme
As a Sustainability Graduate within the Reservoirs Programme, you'll help shape the delivery of one of the largest and most important water infrastructure investments in the UK's future. Working alongside technical specialists, project teams and delivery partners, you'll support the integration of sustainability across every stage of reservoir development, from early design through to construction delivery. You'll contribute to carbon measurement and reduction initiatives, help identify innovative low-carbon solutions, support biodiversity and environmental enhancement projects, and work on initiatives that maximise social value and create positive outcomes for local communities. You'll gain hands-on experience of applying sustainability principles on a nationally significant infrastructure programme while helping to build resilient water resources for future generations.

Project Management Graduate

As a Project Management Graduate within the Reservoirs Programme, you'll play a key role in helping deliver one of the UK's most ambitious and nationally significant infrastructure investments. Working alongside project managers, engineers, commercial teams and delivery partners, you'll support the planning, coordination and delivery of major workstreams that will help secure water supplies for future generations. You'll gain hands-on experience in programme controls, risk management, stakeholder engagement, scheduling, governance and project reporting, while contributing to the successful delivery of the Fens and Lincolnshire Reservoirs. Through a variety of placements across the programme, you'll develop the skills needed to manage complex projects safely, efficiently and collaboratively, helping turn strategic plans into real-world outcomes that benefit customers, communities and the environment.

Transformation Graduate

As a Transformation Graduate within the Reservoirs Programme, you'll help shape how one of the largest infrastructure programmes in the UK evolves and delivers lasting value. Working with programme leaders, subject matter experts and delivery partners, you'll support initiatives that develop programme maturity, improve ways of working, strengthen governance, enable innovation and drive continuous improvement across the programme. You'll gain experience in change management, business improvement, digital transformation, organisational development and programme performance, helping teams adapt and respond to the challenges of delivering a complex, multi-billion-pound investment. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to programme-wide transformation while developing the skills needed to lead change and build future capability across a nationally significant project.

Business Strategy Graduate

As a Business Strategy Graduate within the Reservoirs Programme, you'll help support the long-term planning and strategic decision-making that underpins one of the most important water infrastructure investments in the country's future. Working alongside senior leaders, strategy specialists and programme teams, you'll contribute to business planning, strategic analysis, governance, stakeholder engagement and investment decision-making. You'll help assess opportunities, risks and future challenges while supporting the development of strategies that balance customer needs, environmental responsibilities and regulatory requirements. Through exposure to a wide range of programme activities, you'll gain valuable experience in translating strategic vision into practical action, helping to ensure the Reservoirs Programme delivers lasting benefits for communities, the environment and future water resilience

What you will bring

We are looking for people who are curious, ambitious and ready to learn. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, working collaboratively and bringing different perspectives to the challenges we face. Most importantly, we're looking for graduates who want to help shape the future of water while developing a successful and rewarding career of their own. We welcome applicants who are excited about technology products and passionate about the water industry.

For this role, you’ll need to have obtained in the last 3 years or be studying towards a minimum 2:2 in any degree discipline and have graduated by September 2027 for the 2027 intake.

Benefits
Alongside a competitive salary, you'll receive a comprehensive health and wellbeing package, private healthcare, 26 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, and a double-matched pension scheme with up to 21% total contribution. We also offer an excellent family leave package, including enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave, helping you balance your career with the moments that matter most.

Closing Date: 27th September 2026

Site Tour: 26th and 28th October, at our Lincs site. This is an opportunity to learn more about the role, meet colleagues, and gain first-hand insight into the work you'll be doing.

Assessment Centres (in Person): 11th or 13th November at our Lancaster House office, Huntingdon

title: Intern - SSD Assembly Process & Equipment Engineering
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

Location
Singapore

Department
SSD Assembly Process & Equipment Engineering

Project Title
AI-Enabled SSD Depanel Process Characterization and Optimization

Project Description
This internship project focuses on characterizing process variations in SSD depanel operations within a high-volume manufacturing environment. The project aims to deepen understanding of the interactions between process parameters, equipment performance, and product quality outcomes.

The intern will undertake a structured engineering project involving Design of Experiments (DOE), statistical analysis, process characterization, and data-driven optimization techniques. In addition, the intern will explore AI-Enabled approaches to improve engineering productivity, automate data interpretation, and accelerate insight generation from process characterization activities.

The project provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in process engineering, equipment operations, and advanced manufacturing technologies within the semiconductor industry.

Objective of the Project

  • Characterize key process variables affecting SSD depanel performance and product quality.

  • Establish a robust operating window that satisfies mechanical and reliability requirements while minimizing board damage and cosmetic defects.

  • Apply statistical and engineering methodologies to optimize process capability and stability.

  • Explore AI-Enabled analytics techniques to accelerate engineering analysis and decision-making.

Opportunities for Full Time Employment
Interns demonstrating strong technical capability, learning agility, and successful project outcomes may be considered for future internship or full-time opportunities, subject to business needs and evaluation outcomes

Project Scope

  • Conduct process characterization studies for SSD depanel operations using statistical Design of Experiments (DOE) methodologies.

  • Analyze process and equipment data to identify critical process inputs, sources of variation, and optimization opportunities.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and equipment stakeholders to validate findings and evaluate improvement opportunities.

  • Develop data visualization and reporting tools to communicate process insights and recommendations.

  • Evaluate the use of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, or AI Assistant tools for automated analysis, report generation, and engineering knowledge capture.

Learning Opportunities

  • Gain hands-on experience in process characterization, DOE execution, and manufacturing process optimization.

  • Develop practical knowledge of SSD assembly processes, equipment engineering, and semiconductor manufacturing operations.

  • Learn advanced data analysis and visualization techniques for engineering applications.

  • Gain exposure to AI-Enabled engineering workflows, including Generative AI applications for technical reporting and insight generation.

  • Strengthen project management, technical communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Deliverables

  • Comprehensive characterization study identifying key factors influencing SSD depanel performance.

  • Established operating window with supporting statistical analysis and engineering rationale.

  • AI-Enabled analysis or proof-of-concept demonstrating automated insight generation, anomaly detection, or engineering reporting.

  • Final project report and presentation summarizing methodology, findings, recommendations, and potential future improvement opportunities.

Impact of the Project

  • Improve understanding of process variation and equipment interactions within SSD depanel operations.

  • Support development of a more robust and stable manufacturing process.

  • Enable data-driven decision-making through statistical analysis and process characterization.

  • Demonstrate opportunities for AI-Enabled solutions to improve engineering productivity and analysis efficiency.


Skillsets Required

  • Foundational knowledge of process engineering, statistics, or manufacturing systems.

  • Interest in Design of Experiments (DOE), process characterization, and process optimization methodologies.

  • Familiarity with data analysis tools such as Python, JMP, Minitab, SQL, Power BI, or equivalent platforms.

  • Exposure to Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, or AI-Enabled analytical tools is advantageous.

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, communication skills, and ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Course of Interest
The ideal candidate should be pursuing a Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.

Duration of Period
The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full time internship period of 5 months from Jan to May 2027.

title: CAEG Systems Administrator
description:
Leidos is seeking three (3) highly skilled CAEG Systems Administrators to provide specialized technical support, administrative oversight, and ensure the high availability of mission-critical engineering assets across the FAA’s Regional Service Areas. This role transitions beyond general IT support to focus on high-performance computing environments, complex server architectures, Storage Area Networks (SAN), and specialized CAD/CAE ecosystems. The ideal candidate will take ownership of the regional engineering platform to maintain 99.9% uptime and uphold strict FAA security and operational standards.

The Computer-Aided Engineering Graphics (CAEG) platform serves as the primary technical repository and design environment for the FAA’s Air Traffic Organization (ATO), directly supporting the safety and integrity of the National Airspace System (NAS).

Locations: Atlanta, GA (Eastern Service Area) | Fort Worth, TX (Central Service Area) | Des Moines, WA (Western Service Area)

Travel: Up to 10% travel to remote FAA sites within the assigned service area jurisdiction

Clearance: Must obtain and maintain an FAA Suitability / Public Trust clearance

Primary Responsibilities

  • System Monitoring & Maintenance: Proactively monitor the health and performance of Windows, Unix, and Linux server environments. Perform tuning for Storage Area Networks (SAN) to optimize data throughput for massive engineering files. Generate Capacity Planning Reports using simulation models to resolve hardware bottlenecks and prevent system degradation.

  • CAD/CAE Application & License Administration: Administer Autodesk and Bentley licensing servers to ensure continuous software availability across the regional network. Manage the ProjectWise Integration Server and Electronic Data Management System (EDMS) for seamless drawing collaboration. Oversee network plotter drivers and large-format printing interfaces.

  • Cybersecurity Compliance: Manage Active Directory (AD) objects and enforce granular access control measures. Direct security patching and vulnerability remediation activities to ensure 100% compliance with FAA timelines.

  • Database Administration & Disaster Recovery: Execute daily database replication and EDMS backups. Maintain and test the Enterprise Architecture-aligned Disaster Recovery (DR) plan annually in a NetApp environment to guarantee business continuity.

  • Tier 3 Technical Support & Mentorship: Serve as an escalation point for complex CAD/CAE system failures. Provide high-level technical mentorship and guidance to non-specialist engineering staff regarding platform capabilities and best practices.

  • Reporting: Prepare weekly status reports, monthly uptime metrics (targeting 99.9% availability), monthly security patch logs, and annual DR exercise reports.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 8 years of prior relevant experience or Masters degree and 6 years of prior relevant experience. May consider hands on training with additional years of proven experience in lieu of degree.

  • Hands-on experience as a System Administrator for Bentley ProjectWise.

  • Hands-on experience as a System Administrator for Autodesk Vault.

  • Technical experience working with Autodesk AutoCAD, Autodesk Revit, and Autodesk ReCap.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of IT principles, concepts, and methods encompassing data storage (SAN/NetApp), OS administration (Windows, Unix, Linux), software applications, and regional networking.

  • Proven ability to use analytical and evaluative methods to identify and resolve high-level capacity, availability, and system hardware issues.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills to deliver technical documentation, status updates, and user mentorship.

  • Ability to successfully pass background investigation to obtain and maintain an FAA Suitability / Public Trust clearance prior to starting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting IT/engineering infrastructure within the FAA, DoD, or other government aviation/defense environments.

  • Experience administering NetApp storage systems and conducting annual Disaster Recovery (DR), gap analyses and testing.

  • Background in managing large-format physical plotting networks and driver configurations for engineering teams.

title: Strategy & Open Innovation Lead, R&D Naturals
description:
Job Summary

Are you passionate about shaping the future of natural ingredients and driving innovation through strategic partnerships?

At IFF, we are looking for a Strategy & Open Innovation Lead to join our Naturals R&D organization in Grasse, France. In this highly visible leadership role, you will help & support the VP R&D Naturals to define and execute long-term strategic priorities while building a robust external innovation ecosystem, with expert team leaders, that accelerates growth, sustainability, and competitive advantage across Scent, Taste, and Beauty.

You will work at the intersection of science, business, and innovation, identifying emerging trends, technologies, partnerships, and opportunities that will help shape the future of our Naturals business.

As Strategy & Open Innovation Lead, R&D Naturals, you will play a pivotal role in defining and executing the long-term strategy of the Naturals R&D organization. You will combine strategic thinking, business insight, and external engagement to identify opportunities that support innovation, sourcing, sustainability, and business growth. Working closely with senior leaders across R&D and business functions, you will drive the Naturals Open Innovation agenda by developing strategic alliances, scouting emerging technologies, and creating collaborations with startups, academic institutions, suppliers, customers, and external innovation partners.

Based in Grasse, France, you will work in close proximity to our world-class natural ingredients expertise and be a key member of the Naturals R&D leadership network.

Where You'll Make a Difference

  • Contribute to the development and execution of the long-term strategic roadmap for the Naturals R&D organization.

  • Identify and evaluate market trends, emerging technologies, and innovation opportunities that can support future business growth.

  • Build, manage, and expand a network of strategic external partnerships across academia, startups, suppliers, technology providers, customers, and industry organizations.

  • Lead the Naturals R&D Open Innovation pipeline, from opportunity identification through evaluation, prioritization, and implementation.

  • Scout disruptive technologies and external capabilities that can accelerate innovation across Scent, Taste, and Beauty.

  • Assess technical, commercial, and strategic opportunities and develop business cases for investment and collaboration.

  • Translate external innovations into tangible R&D programs, innovation projects, and business outcomes.

  • Collaborate closely with R&D, Innovation, Sustainability, Procurement, Commercial, and Operations teams to ensure alignment and successful execution.

  • Support strategic alliance activities and contribute to strengthening IFF's external innovation ecosystem worldwide.

  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations and recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

What Makes You the Right Fit

  • Advanced degrees in Science, Engineering, Business, Innovation Management, or a related field.

  • Significant experience in innovation, strategy, business development, partnerships, or R&D leadership roles.

  • Strong understanding of natural ingredients, their supply chains, sourcing challenges, market dynamics, and innovation opportunities.

  • Proven experience building and managing external collaborations and strategic partnerships.

  • Demonstrated ability to assess technologies, identify trends, and translate innovation opportunities into business value.

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect scientific innovation to commercial impact.

  • Experience operating in complex, international, and cross-functional environments.

  • Fluent in English.

How Would You Stand Out?

  • You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and enjoy identifying new opportunities before others do.

  • You are equally comfortable discussing scientific topics, business strategy, and commercial implications.

  • You have exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • You are an excellent communicator with strong storytelling and executive presentation capabilities.

  • You thrive in highly collaborative environments and know how to bring diverse teams together around a common vision.

  • You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and a strong bias for action.

  • You are naturally curious and energized by emerging technologies, innovation ecosystems, and market trends.

Why Choose Us?

  • Join a world-leading company at the forefront of innovation in taste, scent, health, and biosciences.

  • Influence the future direction of the Naturals business through high-impact strategic initiatives.

  • Work closely with senior leaders and key decision-makers across a global organization.

  • Build relationships with some of the most innovative startups, research institutions, suppliers, and industry partners worldwide.

  • Be part of a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment where innovation, sustainability, and growth are at the heart of everything we do.

  • Access continuous learning and development opportunities while growing your global network and career.

As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity.

Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you.

Role Summary

Positions are available in our New York City office or with our AI Engineering squad in Harbor Point, Baltimore, MD. In either location, you will join a collaborative team of engineers, product owners, and business partners building high-impact AI products with leverage across the firm.

As a Senior Software Engineer on T. Rowe Price Labs' AI Engineering team, you will independently design, build, and scale production-grade AI agents and intelligent systems that solve complex business problems. You will lead technical workstreams, incubate new AI products, experiment with emerging technologies and innovative ideas, and partner with business-aligned technology teams to enable broader adoption at scale.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer with strong software fundamentals, practical AI engineering experience, and a product mindset. You will take ownership of complex and ambiguous problems, mentor other engineers, and contribute to the patterns and practices that shape AI engineering at T. Rowe Price.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design and delivery of production-grade AI agents and intelligent systems, including architecture, implementation, testing, evaluation, deployment, observability, and production support.

  • Establish evaluation and testing approaches for non-deterministic AI systems, including quality metrics, regression testing, failure analysis, and production monitoring.
  • Make informed engineering trade-offs across models, prompts, context, tools, latency, cost, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to reusable AI capabilities and shared engineering patterns that improve speed, quality, and consistency across teams.
  • Lead code and design reviews, mentor less-experienced engineers, and help others solve complex technical problems.
  • Own technical debt and continuously improve the quality, reliability, and maintainability of the systems you build.
  • Rapidly evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine when and how they can be applied to deliver meaningful business value.
  • Support the Build-Operate-Transfer model by preparing successful AI solutions for long-term ownership and scale by business-aligned technology teams.

Business Knowledge

  • Work directly with business stakeholders and product owners to understand priorities, shape solution direction, and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Translate complex business needs into effective technology solutions and clearly communicate technical trade-offs.
  • Balance innovation, business value, scalability, risk, fiscal responsibility, and long-term maintainability when making technical decisions.

  • Strong hands-on development experience in object-oriented languages such as Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications, intelligent workflows, or agentic systems using modern LLMs and AI development frameworks.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, software design, and debugging skills.

  • Ability to independently own complex technical problems and clearly communicate designs, decisions, and trade-offs.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Core, Lavaflow
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. Lavaflow is the next generation experiment data processing solution, which is scalable, efficient, and easy-to-use. It is built as a Google-wide standardized solution to make it generally available to users, and the de-facto way for users to onboard Rasta, an experiment analysis platform.

In this role, you will realize to full potential and make Agentic debuggability usable end-to-end for our clients to automate root-cause analysis and rapidly resolve production friction. You will require in-depth knowledge on how distributed systems work and connect those dots.

These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems.   • Take full ownership of the AI-motivated Lavaflow debugging roadmap, evolving Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and existing workflows into production-grade agentic tools.

Position Summary

The Feldman Lab is a dynamic and collaborative research environment focused on two primary areas: the pathobiology of the opportunistic pathogen Acinetobacter baumannii and the biogenesis of outer membrane vesicles in Bacteroides species. Our research combines expertise in microbiology, molecular biology, cell culture, murine infection models, protein purification, and protein biochemistry.

We are seeking a Research Technician II to support the technical and operational activities of our research program. The successful candidate will assist with laboratory experiments and studies, prepare materials and reagents, maintain laboratory stocks and equipment, and contribute to the organization and day-to-day management of the laboratory.

The position will also play an important role in maintaining accurate laboratory records, monitoring chemical and material inventories, and supporting laboratory safety and biosafety compliance. title: Customer Engineer, Application Modernization, Google Cloud
description:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to the customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, present solutions on Google Cloud.

You will identify, pursue, and win new business workloads and drive engagement within existing ones. You will have technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participate in planning and supporting business activities.
  • Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and workshops.
  • Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers, and continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
  • Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transition the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
  • Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, provide support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
  • Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
  • Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
  • Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, pen-testing).
  • Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
  • Experience driving the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
  • Experience working with, the startup ecosystem, and with prospecting, building and maintaining new customer relationships from scratch, with excitement for building out Greenfield territories.
  • Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover workloads with customers.

title: Barnmorska till Oxbackskliniken MVC
description:
Vill du arbeta på en barnmorskemottagning där du får tid att möta varje kvinna, arbeta nära dina kollegor och samtidigt vara med och utveckla verksamheten?

Nu söker vi en engagerad barnmorska till Oxbackskliniken MVC i Södertälje.

På Oxbackskliniken möter vi kvinnor och blivande föräldrar genom hela graviditeten och även inom preventivmedelsrådgivning, sexuell hälsa och eftervård. Vi erbjuder både fysiska och digitala besök och arbetar för att vården ska vara trygg, personlig och lättillgänglig.

Om Oxbackskliniken MVC

Oxbackskliniken är en del av Femcare och ligger i fina, moderna lokaler på Grödingevägen 21 i centrala Södertälje.

Här arbetar barnmorskor, undersköterskor, gynekologer och andra professioner nära varandra. Vi värdesätter teamarbete, ett nära samarbete och en god arbetsmiljö.

För oss är det viktigt att du trivs med dina kollegor och känner dig som en del av gruppen. Vi arbetar tillsammans, hjälper varandra och vill att alla medarbetare ska kunna vara delaktiga i hur vi utvecklar både verksamheten och vår arbetsmiljö.

Om tjänsten

Som barnmorska hos oss arbetar du med bland annat:

  • Graviditetsövervakning och eftervård
  • Preventivmedelsrådgivning och sexuell hälsa
  • Cellprovtagning
  • Digitala besök, chatt och videomöten
  • Föräldragrupper och andra gruppverksamheter
  • Övriga sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter inom mödrahälsovård


Du arbetar nära våra undersköterskor och övriga professioner på mottagningen. Tillsammans skapar vi ett tryggt och professionellt omhändertagande för våra patienter.

Vi ser gärna att du tycker om att hålla grupper och trivs med att skapa engagemang, trygghet och delaktighet hos deltagarna. Vi vill utveckla vår gruppverksamhet ytterligare och ser gärna att du har egna idéer.

Hos oss får du

En god arbetsmiljö

Vi lägger stor vikt vid att våra medarbetare trivs, både med arbetsuppgifterna och med varandra. Vi tror på ett öppet klimat där man kan fråga, diskutera och hjälpas åt.

Delaktighet och möjlighet att påverka

Hos oss ska du inte bara komma in och göra ditt arbete – du ska också kunna vara med och påverka. Vi välkomnar idéer och engagemang kring både patientarbetet, arbetssätt och arbetsmiljö.

Flexibilitet

Arbetet består av både fysiska och digitala vårdmöten. När verksamheten tillåter finns möjlighet att arbeta digitalt hemifrån, vilket ger flexibilitet i vardagen.

Variation i arbetet

Du får arbeta brett inom mödrahälsovård, sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa samt digital vård.

Kompetensutveckling

Vi erbjuder regelbundna utbildningar via mödrahälsovårdsenheten samt interna utbildningar inom Femcare.

Ett nära team

Du arbetar tillsammans med barnmorskor, undersköterskor, gynekologer och andra kollegor. Vi värdesätter samarbete, prestigelöshet och att alla bidrar till gruppen.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad barnmorska och som är trygg i din yrkesroll. Du är flexibel, lyhörd och har lätt för att planera och arbeta självständigt.

Du tycker om mötet med människor och har ett genuint engagemang för kvinnan och den blivande familjen. Du ser möjligheter, tar egna initiativ och vill vara med och utveckla verksamheten.

Vi tror att du:

  • är trygg och engagerad i din yrkesroll
  • tycker om att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra
  • har ett varmt och professionellt bemötande
  • tycker om att hålla grupper och skapa en trygg gruppdynamik
  • är nyfiken på utveckling och nya arbetssätt
  • bidrar med energi, idéer och lösningsfokus
  • trivs i en mindre teamorienterad verksamhet


Erfarenhet som enhetschef, annat ledarskap eller verksamhetsutveckling är meriterande. Även erfarenhet av att driva grupper, utbildningar eller andra utvecklingsinsatser ser vi som positivt.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid social lämplighet och att du passar in i gruppen. För oss är det viktigt att du är en person som bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat, samarbetar väl med andra och trivs med att arbeta nära dina kollegor.

Vi lägger också stor vikt vid att du vill vara delaktig i verksamheten och bidra till en god arbetsmiljö. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet och att du delar våra värderingar kring respekt, kvalitet, tillgänglighet och omtanke.

Tjänstens omfattning

  • Heltid (100 %) eller enligt överenskommelse
  • Tillsvidareanställning
  • Tillträde enligt överenskommelse

description:
Senior Full Stack Developer - Strong Angular Experience

Sitly Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Candidates for this position must be located in the Netherlands.

We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong Angular experience to make an impact on millions using our SEAN stack.

Are you passionate about building scalable, high-quality software and ready to make a global impact? Join our team and play a key role in shaping the future of our platform.

About Sitly

Join Sitly, an online marketplace that connects families with nannies and babysitters across 14 countries in Europe, Latin America, North America, and Asia. We pride ourselves on being an independent, fast growing & profitable tech company.

Sitly’s user base grows by the millions every year, and we have set ambitious goals to enhance our service and turn Sitly into the world’s leading childcare platform where any parent can find the perfect babysitter for their children within a day. Our office is located at Rokin in the heart of Amsterdam, directly across from the North-South metro line station.

IND-recognised sponsor: Sitly, through its parent company 2care4kids Holding BV, is an IND-recognised sponsor, allowing us to hire and support skilled migrants.

About the position

Are you excited by the idea of building software used by millions of people around the world?

Join Sitly, one of the world’s largest childcare platforms, and help connect families with babysitters across 14 countries. As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you’ll work across our front- and backend systems, building scalable features and improving the user experience for both parents and sitters.

As a Senior Full Stack Developer on our team, you'll play a vital role in crafting our platform and internal tools, making our service run seamlessly on both front and back-end. We’re specifically looking for someone with strong Angular experience. If you lean more towards backend development, please take a look at this other open vacancy: role

You’ll join our small, experienced Web/API team, where every developer plays a key role. You’ll write high-quality code, contribute to technical decisions, and bring your own perspective to improve how we work. Your input will help shape how we build our product.

Key Qualities We Cherish

  • You have passion for writing high-quality code, using best practices
  • You're experienced across both frontend and backend development, with more emphasis on frontend
  • You have a proactive mindset and feel comfortable working independently
  • You enjoy contributing to team discussions and decisions

Our Stack

  • NodeJS + Express in TypeScript: Our API serving multiple frontends.
  • Angular SPA web-app: Our main project for logged-in members.
  • PWA embedded Android app: Our web-app which is loaded under an Android wrapper.
  • MariaDB: Housing our user and translation data.
  • CloudFlare: Our layer for DNS management, Workers, CDN, and more.
  • ElasticSearch + Kibana: Powers our search, logs, and real-time monitoring.

What you'll do

  • Build and improve features on both our API (Node.js + Express) and Angular frontend.
  • Write API and E2E tests for new features.
  • Spot bugs and suggest improvements proactively.
  • Participate in SCRUM ceremonies and collaborate closely with product, QA, and mobile teams.
  • Document processes and features as you learn and build
  • Share ideas and propose technical improvements to our stack.

A typical day at Sitly

It’s Thursday, one of the two days you work from the office. You arrive at our office at the Rokin just across the metro station in the centre of Amsterdam. You grab a coffee before the team stand-up begins. Some of your teammates join remotely, while others are there in person. You share what you’ve been working on and sync on priorities for the week. You’re currently building a new API feature to improve sitter-parent communication, and you plan to pair up later with your onboarding buddy, another full-stack developer, for feedback on your implementation.

After the stand-up, you catch up with the product owner and team lead, who also work from the office a couple of days a week. Together, you review an upcoming feature and share your ideas on how to prioritise a few technical improvements. You bring your own perspective on how to enhance the platform. Your suggestions are well received and included in the implementation.

Around noon, a couple of colleagues put together one of their legendary shared lunches, something they enjoy doing for the team. You all take your time to connect over food and laughter, sometimes heading up to the rooftop terrace for a coffee and some fresh air.

In the afternoon, you continue working on your feature, write tests, and pick up a code review request from a remote teammate.

Required skills

  • Seasoned full-stack developer with experience delivering features end to end.
  • Expert in Angular
  • Proficient in Node.js, with strong knowledge of Express, TypeScript, and backend architecture.
  • Proactive: you take initiative, suggest improvements, prioritise, and take ownership.
  • Strong grasp of clean code, best practices, and scalable systems.
  • Solid experience with SQL and Git workflows.
  • Bonus: experience with AWS, Cloudflare, ELK stack or Jenkins.
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Who will you be working with?

Forge daily connections with our senior tech, product, and QA teams, ensuring cohesive product evolution.

What we value

Sitly comprises a group of passionate, independent, authentic, and diverse individuals who are humble, eager to learn, and constantly aim to improve. To preserve this culture, we're looking for someone who resonates with our core values:

  • Passion: Striving to love what you do and staying highly motivated to achieve your goals
  • Curiosity: A desire to understand how everything functions and a passion for learning daily
  • Humility: Preferring to admit when you're unsure rather than pretending to know. Being open to seeking help and also readily offering guidance when needed
  • Proactivity: Taking initiative and anticipating needs before they arise

Building and growing the best platform possible means we need you at your best, and we're committed that you've got everything you need:

  • A competitive salary based on your experience
  • Work-life balance: the flexibility to work on a hybrid schedule, with at least 2 days a week in our Amsterdam office.
  • Travel expenses are reimbursed for commutes over 15 kilometers to work.
  • Gain bonus shares after one year and the option to buy more at a discount, becoming a co-owner
  • Bicycle plan: the option to lease your new bicycle that Sitly will partly pay for you, after the first year of employment
  • A MacBook or any other preferred laptop of your choice.
  • Dedicated time and budget for self-improvement
  • Annual trip with the entire global team (over 20 nationalities)
  • Freedom and trust to impact a product benefiting millions globally

About Sitly & the team

Sitly started in 2012 and has become the fastest growing international platform that connects families with babysitters, nannies and childminders, making flexible and affordable at-home child care possible. Sitly is live on web, iOS and Android app, and has millions of registered families, babysitters, nannies and childminders in 14 different countries across Europe, Asia Pacific, North and South America.

We get up in the morning to improve the experience for our users, and to keep growing fast. Our small team (40 people) has to be smart about what we spend time on: We focus on the basics, while at the same time rapidly and radically testing new ideas.

We are a diverse team made up of 21 nationalities, from Brazilian to Norwegian, from Ukrainian to Dutch. We have a culture of independence, getting things done, and being humble while we do that. We focus on growth, but never lose sight of what is most important: providing the best childcare platform, that helps parents and babysitters across the globe.

Take the Leap and apply!

If this opportunity excites you, and you're eager to make a difference to millions of parents and babysitters around the world, we'd love to have you by our side.

The application process includes an initial conversation, an in-depth interview, and a technical assignment. xgiwjmb

title: Intern - Clock Design & Architecture, Intern
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

At Micron Technology, we transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

The Heterogeneous Integration Group (HIG) HBM Architecture team drives the development of future High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) architectures, clocking methodologies, and system-level technologies that support next-generation AI, HPC, networking, and data-center applications. The team works across architecture, design, verification, product engineering, and ecosystem partnerships to advance memory performance and design innovation.

As an Intern, you will work with experienced architects and engineers to evaluate HBM clocking architectures, PLL performance, timing behavior, and clock distribution strategies. This role offers opportunities to apply analytical and modeling techniques while using AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve design exploration and productivity.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze and document HBM clocking architectures, including clock distribution networks, WDQS timing architecture, and PLL design concepts.
  • Evaluate clock noise sensitivity, timing margins, jitter performance, and PLL impacts on high-speed IO signal quality.
  • Benchmark and compare alternative clock architecture solutions and provide data-driven recommendations.
  • Find opportunities for performance optimization and support architecture-level design decisions.
  • Apply Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and AI-assisted engineering workflows to enhance engineering analysis, data evaluation, and productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Solid understanding of analog and mixed-signal circuit fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with clock generation and distribution concepts, including PLLs, DLLs, jitter, and timing analysis.
  • Experience using circuit simulation tools such as SPICE, Spectre, HSPICE, MATLAB, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of timing analysis, clock quality metrics, signal integrity, and power integrity fundamentals.
  • Exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or AI-assisted engineering workflows used for engineering productivity and data analysis.
  • Coursework or research related to analog/mixed-signal design, PLLs, timing analysis, clocking systems, or high-speed interfaces.
  • Experience with Python or similar scripting languages for automation and data analysis.
  • Familiarity with semiconductor design methodologies, architecture evaluation, or high-speed memory systems.

Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. title: Water Operational Leadership Graduate
description:
Water Services Graduate Programme

Salary: £33,000, Permanent role.
Start date: September 2027

Location: Based within the Anglian Water area across the East of England. Please note your placements may vary across the region and departments, so flexibility is essential.

Help shape the future of water, the environment and the communities we serve

Water is at the heart of what we do at Anglian Water and is essential for the communities we serve to thrive. Our work within really matters, to our customers, to the environment and to our teams – all of us working to keep taps flowing.

The next 5 years are such an exciting time for the Water Industry, with an investment plan worth over £11 billion, we're building for better — driving improvements right across our Source to Tap systems and making the region more resilient. As part of this we are looking for you to join Anglian Water's Graduate Programme and tackle some of the biggest environmental and infrastructure challenges facing the region. From climate resilience and major engineering projects to digital innovation and customer experience, you'll develop the skills, experience and support needed to become one of our future leaders or specialists.

Your career path

The water industry is changing rapidly, creating exciting opportunities for the next generation of talent. At Anglian Water, you'll work on real challenges that matter, developing expertise across your chosen profession while contributing to projects that support customers, communities and the environment.

You'll learn from experienced colleagues, take on meaningful responsibility and build the skills, knowledge and confidence to shape your future career, while helping us shape the future of water.

To find out more from our recent graduates please visit our Anglian Water careers page Graduates - Anglian Water Careers

Professional Development & Memberships

We're committed to helping you build a career, not just gain a job. Through our two-year graduate programme, you'll experience different placements, work on real business challenges and learn from experienced colleagues across the organisation. You'll have access to a wide range of development opportunities, support towards professional qualifications and funded membership of a relevant professional institution, helping you grow your expertise and achieve professional accreditation where appropriate.

Your programme

Our Graduate Programme within Clean Water Services offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across the teams that keep water flowing to around 7 million customers every day. Through a series of structured placements, you'll develop a broad understanding of how operational excellence, innovation and long-term planning come together to deliver safe, reliable and sustainable clean water services.

Across our Source to Tap system from water abstraction, treatment and treated water distribution networks to system optimisation, asset planning, drought resilience and major capital projects. If you're passionate about making a difference, solving complex challenges and helping protect an essential resource for future generations, this programme is for you.

What you will bring

We are looking for people who are curious, ambitious and ready to learn. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, working collaboratively and bringing different perspectives to the challenges we face. Most importantly, we're looking for graduates who want to help shape the future of water while developing a successful and rewarding career of their own. We welcome applicants who are excited about technology products and passionate about the water industry.

For this role, you’ll need to have obtained in the last 3 years or be studying towards a minimum 2:2 in any degree discipline and have graduated by September 2027 for the 2027 intake.

Benefits

Alongside a competitive salary, you'll receive a comprehensive health and wellbeing package, private healthcare, 26 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, and a double-matched pension scheme with up to 21% total contribution. We also offer an excellent family leave package, including enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave, helping you balance your career with the moments that matter most.

Closing Date: 27th September 2026

Site Tour: You may be invited to a local site tour or meet the team session as part of the recruitment process. This is an opportunity to visit your potential workplace, meet the team, and learn more about the role and working environment.

Assessment Centres: Successful candidates will be invited to attend a face-to-face assessment centre at one of our locations across the Anglian Water region.

  • Norwich – 27 October 2026

  • Lincoln – 30 October 2026

  • Ipswich – 4 November 2026

  • Huntingdon – 5 November 2026

description:

09/14/2026

Position Title:

Correctional Sergeant (CRCI) Work-out-of-Class Opportunity for ODOC and OCE employees only

Job Description:

Correctional Sergeant (CRCI) Work-out-of-Class Opportunity for ODOC and OCE employees only

Columbia River Correctional Institution – Portland, Oregon

Oregon Department of Corrections

Are you ready to step into a leadership role and take on greater responsibility in maintaining safety, security, and professional development within the facility? We are seeking dedicated and experienced candidates for the position of Correctional Sergeant. This is an excellent opportunity for career advancement while playing a crucial role in maintaining security, overseeing staff, and guiding AICs toward rehabilitation.

This recruitment is for a work-out-of-class (WOC) position(s). The WOC position is anticipated to last 12 months, though may be extended or decreased due to business need. This position is available for current regular status employees of the Oregon Department of Corrections and Oregon Corrections Enterprises. All applicants interested in the WOC opportunity must attach written approval from their current supervisor at the time of application. Applications without approval will be declined.

About the Job – Your Role

As a Correctional Sergeant, you will be a senior security staff member responsible for overseeing custody, control, supervision, and daily care of adults in custody while upholding the mission of the Department. You will serve as a lead worker, ensuring facility operations run smoothly, safely, and efficiently. You will supervise AICs during movement assignments, monitor high-security areas, and conduct security operations such as transports, searches, and emergency response.

In this role, you will also play a key part in staff development, assisting in training and potentially mentoring subordinate staff as a Field Training Officer (FTO). You will lead by example, modeling professionalism, accountability, and behaviors that support rehabilitation efforts.

This position is represented by American Federation of State, County, and Municipal Employees (AFSCME). This position may be eligible for Police & Fire (P&F) benefits through Public Employees Retirement System (PERS), as defined by statute.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two (2) years of experience in a correctional security setting where your primary duties were the care and custody of AICs;
  • Be able to obtain, within two weeks, an Oregon Department of Public Safety Standards and Training (DPSST) Correctional Certificate OR a Correctional Certificate from another government agency;
  • Possess a High School Diploma or GED certificate;
  • Be 21 years of age or older;
  • United States Citizen.

Education will not be accepted as a substitute for the required experience.

Special Qualifications

Ability to obtain a valid Oregon motor vehicle operator's license.

Application Information

  • In the Work Experience section of your application make sure to include the dates and duties of all relevant positions and details to support how you meet these attributes. If you do not include education or work experience meeting the minimum qualifications, you will not be considered for the position. Only the candidates whose experience most closely matches the qualifications and requested skills of this position will be invited to interview. Applicants must meet the minimum qualifications on or before the job posting close date.
  • The job posting closes at 11:59 PM (PDT/PST) on the close date. After you submit your application, be sure to respond to the two questionnaires relating to public records requests and veterans’ preference immediately following your submittal. These questions are necessary to complete the application process.
  • Please monitor both your email and Workday account for updates regarding this recruitment.
  • As part of our selection process, we may require additional assessment stages, such as written exercises, to further evaluate candidates’ qualifications. Meaningful participation in these exercises is required for all applicants moving forward in the process. Failure to complete the required exercise(s) within the specified timeframe will result in disqualification from consideration. All candidates who successfully complete these screening stages and meet the necessary requirements will advance to the next stage in the selection process.
  • Please save a copy of this job announcement for reference, as it is not available for you to view after the announcement deadline.

About the Department

The Oregon Department of Corrections is responsible for over 12,000 adults in custody in 12 state prisons throughout Oregon. It advises and evaluates counties regarding administration of probation and parole programs supervising more than 24,000 offenders in Oregon communities. The mission is to protect communities, promote accountability, and transform lives.

The Oregon Department of Corrections serves a diverse and changing population of people who are incarcerated and on supervision. We commit to creating an organization both reflecting the diversity of the population we serve and ensuring all employees thrive in a culture of safety, trust, and belonging. We strive to be an anti-racist corrections system. Welcoming, inclusive, and respectful of all people. Free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

The Department offers a variety of programs and opportunity to create a safe and healthy environment to for our staff, volunteers, and adults in custody. Joining the Oregon Department of Corrections is joining a team working for the benefit of our communities through innovative and proven correctional practices.

Benefits

The salary range listed above is for non-PERS qualifying applicants. PERS qualifying applicants may be eligible for an adjusted range to reflect an additional 6.95%.

The State of Oregon provides a generous benefit package, which includes:

  • Family health, vision, and dental insurance
  • Vacation, sick leave, and 11 paid holidays
  • 21 days paid military leave for national guard and reserve components
  • Optional short and long-term disability
  • Term life insurance
  • Fully paid retirement program
  • Oregon Saving Growth Plan
  • Flexible spending accounts for health and childcare
  • And more

About the Process – What to Expect

  • After the application deadline, a recruiter will review submissions for education and experience to identify candidates who best fit the minimum qualifications and requested skills.
  • Top candidates will be referred to the hiring manager.
  • The hiring manager will review your application and schedule interviews.
  • Interview will be held with a panel of stakeholders who have completed panel assessment training. Scores will be determined based on predetermined questions and scoring guides. title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
Cyber Security Engineer

Location: Farnborough, UK

Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?..

Role Overview:

Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people and our community. Our mission and our values guide the way we do business. The foundation of our Leidos culture is our Values, Beliefs and Expectations by which we select, recognise and reward employees. They create the environment that drives us toward our mission.

Inspired to make a difference, we are committed to solving the world’s toughest problems. Passionate about customer success by being determined to understand and respond to our customers’ needs as if they were our own.

United as a team, we are bound together by our conviction that ethics and integrity is core to how we operate.

Because of a key strategic development and a new exciting business opportunity, we have a requirement for a security-cleared Cyber Security Engineer based in the UK working at our Farnborough site and remotely.

Leidos has more than 30 years’ experience of developing and running some of the largest government systems in the world. We are currently hiring to expand our UK based technical team who support our delivery for the UK Govt.

Come join our team and further develop your skills as we deliver and support systems key to the defence of the UK and partner nations.

Being part of the Leidos team is a commitment to push yourself and those around you to do better, constantly adapt and learn new technologies. We’re a passionate team and are committed to developing and growing our staff.

Leidos is a global science and technology solutions leader working to solve the world's toughest challenges in the defence, intelligence, homeland security, civil, and health markets. The company's 33,000 employees support vital missions for government and commercial customers.

What Will You Be Doing?

As a result of some exciting programme wins, we currently have a permanent vacancy for a Cyber Security Engineer to support the development and transition into live of a new IT application and infrastructure solution providing support to a critical operational end user.

Leidos is seeking an enthusiastic protective security specialist to lead the implementation and assurance of security within a key defence project. The incumbent will possess specialist skills in all areas of protective and information security and have demonstrable experience of applying security frameworks such as Government Functional Standard 007.

You will be joining a team of highly skilled and highly motivated individuals who are working on one of the UKs leading programmes.

Required Skills:

The Cyber Security Engineer plays a crucial role in protecting IT infrastructure by using a blend of technical expertise and strategic planning to ensure that the digital infrastructure remains secure from various types of attacks and vulnerabilities. You will be responsible for planning and implementing appropriate security controls to ensure that the information within is kept secure.

Key functions/outputs:

1. Vulnerability Scanning & Reporting

2. Endpoint Security

3. Incident Management & Tickets

4. System Hardening

5. Change Work

6. Participation in Regular Meetings

7. Documentation

Main Objectives:

Vulnerability Scanning & Reporting

Perform regular vulnerability scans and generate reports utilising the below tool sets or similar. The process should be focused on ensuring that the below tool sets are kept up to date and ensure that scans are performed regularly to help assist the Vulnerability and Patch Manager with identifying weaknesses in the system.

  • Code Scans: perform regular code scans to audit code quality metrics, potential bugs, and security vulnerabilities.
  • Vulnerability Management Tooling: perform regular Vulnerability Management Scans and ensure that the warehouse and plugins are kept up to date to capture new vulnerabilities.
  • Reporting: assist the Vulnerability and Patch Manager with generating regular vulnerability management reports, which are to be provided to the
  • cyber security and IA lead.

Endpoint Security:

  • Endpoint Protection: perform regular updates to Endpoints to ensure the latest packages are applied and policies are amended to keep up to date with new and emerging threats.
  • Antivirus and Anti-malware Protection: perform compliance checks to ensure that antivirus and anti-malware protection is deployed successfully and being kept up to date by the relevant team.
  • Network Controls: perform compliance checks and regular audits of network controls (i.e. firewall rules) to ensure that unauthorised access and threats are being blocked.
  • Access Control: ensuring that access controls have been implemented correctly to only allow authorised users to gain access to certain data and systems.

Incident Management & Tickets:

  • Incident Identification: help to recognise and confirm potential incidents through alerts, logs and user reports. This includes distinguishing between true threats and false positives.
  • Incident Response: respond to potential security breaches or cyber-attacks. The main effort should focus on containment, mitigating the damage, investigation of the root cause of the incident and restoring to normal operations.
  • Ticket Requests: respond to and resolve any tickets raised to the Leidos Security group on SD+ that require Cyber Security Engineering input.

System Hardening:

  • Patch Updates to Security Products: ensure that the security tool sets are kept up to date with regular security patches and software updates to fix vulnerabilities and improve system security.
  • System Compliance: perform regular system compliance audits and updates to ensure that the systems are compliant with industry best practices. This includes CIS, STIG, NIST etc.
  • Security Enforcing Function Configuration: Assist in the design, reviews and updates to security enforcing functions (i.e. GPOs or System Policies) and system controls to ensure that they are compliant and fit for purpose.
  • Vulnerability Assessments: conduct periodic assessments to identify and address potential vulnerabilities.

Change Work:

  • Security Impact Triage Tool (SITT): Assist in evaluation and impact assessment of system change to security posture of the environments.
  • Security Evaluation, Testing and Assurance (ST&V): perform Security, Evaluation, Testing and Assurance activities for any new changes that are planned in as part of PI Planning.

Participation in Regular Meetings:

Cyber Security Engineers are expected to lead or attend numerous meetings that require their input. This may include the following depending on work activity.

  • Security Working Group (SWG
  • Vulnerability Triage
  • Security Workshop
  • PI Planning
  • Daily Standups (Blue/Green Team)

Documentation:

Cyber Security Engineers are responsible for creating, maintaining and reviewing detailed documentation. This includes High-Level & Low-Level Designs (HLD/LLD), Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and compliance reports, and other ad-hoc security documentation, etc.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Clearance to Start SC
  • Clearance for Role DV

​

Intrigued? We’d love to hear from you...

What we do for you:
At Leidos we are PASSIONATE about customer success, UNITED as a team and INSPIRED to make a difference. We offer meaningful and engaging careers, a collaborative culture, and support for your career goals, all while nurturing a healthy work-life balance.
We provide an employment package that attracts, develops and retains only the best in talent. Our reward scheme includes:
• Contributory Pension Scheme
• Private Medical Insurance

• Access to Flexible benefits (including life assurance, health schemes, gym memberships, annual buy and sell holidays and a cycle to work scheme)

• Dynamic Working

Commitment to Diversity:

We welcome applications from every part of the community and are committed to a truly diverse and inclusive culture. We foster a sense of belonging, welcoming all perspectives and contributions, and providing equal access to opportunities and resources for everyone. If you have a disability or need any reasonable adjustments during the application and selection stages please let us know, and we will respond in a way that best fits your needs.

Who We Are:

Leidos UK & EUROPE – we work to make the world safer, healthier, and more efficient through technology, engineering and science.

Leidos is a growing company delivering innovative technology and solutions focused on safeguarding critical capabilities and transformation in frontline services, our work in the United Kingdom includes addressing some of the most complex problems in defence, healthcare, government, safety and security, and transportation.

What Makes Us Different:

Purpose: you can use your passion and abilities at Leidos to keep the people you care about safe. We are at the forefront of machine learning, AI, cyber security and solutions. Using your skills in the technology frontline by helping to build a safer world. You can inspire change.

Collaboration: having flexibility to do your job is one of our core benefits, enabling you to become part of our extraordinary team. We have been empowering our people to work flexibly for years. Whether you work from home, the office or on customer sites, we will give you the digital tools and the flexibility to work smarter and align your needs and ours.

People: Leidos empowers people from every background to be themselves and gives you the tools to learn new skills by enabling growth whilst developing. We believe that extraordinary people need opportunities to grow, to be inspired and to inspire others. At Leidos, we invest in technical academies, career rotations and a career development plans that enhance your future. #Theo

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

£47,600.00-£61,000.00
